Object_Definition: create function fn_get_comparable_ip (  @ip varchar(15) ) returns bigint as begin  	declare @ip_part1 bigint 	declare @ip_part2 bigint 	declare @ip_part3 bigint 	declare @ip_part4 bigint 	declare @first_dot_pos smallint 	declare @second_dot_pos smallint 	declare @third_dot_pos smallint  	set @first_dot_pos = charindex('.', @ip) 	if @first_dot_pos = 0 		return cast(@ip as bigint)  	set @second_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@first_dot_pos + 1) 	set @third_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@second_dot_pos + 1)  	set @ip_part4 = cast(substring(@ip, @third_dot_pos + 1, len(@ip)) as bigint)  	if(@first_dot_pos!=0) 	begin 		set @ip_part1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) 		set @ip_part2 = cast(substring(@ip, @first_dot_pos + 1, @second_dot_pos - @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) 		set @ip_part3 = cast(substring(@ip, @second_dot_pos + 1, @third_dot_pos - @second_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) 	end  	return @ip_part1 * 1000000000 + @ip_part2 * 1000000 + @ip_part3 * 1000 + @ip_part4  end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: ( bigint OUT, @ip varchar)

Object_Definition: create function SplitIDs (  @OrderList varchar(8000) ) returns @ParsedList table (  ID int ) as begin 	declare @OrderID varchar(10), @Pos int  	set @OrderList = ltrim(rtrim(@OrderList))+ ',' 	set @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1)  	if replace(@OrderList, ',', '') <> '' 	begin 		while @Pos > 0 		begin 			set @OrderID = ltrim(rtrim(left(@OrderList, @Pos - 1))) 			if @OrderID <> '' 			begin 			insert into @ParsedList (ID) 			values (cast(@OrderID as int)) --Use Appropriate conversion 		end  		set @OrderList = right(@OrderList, len(@OrderList) - @Pos) 		set @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1) 	end end  return end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@OrderList varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.complete_schedule 	@schedule_id     int, 	@exit_code       int, 	@status_code     int, 	@exit_module     smallint, 	@next_start_time datetime, 	@current_time    datetime, 	@status          varchar( 256 ), 	@level           smallint, 	@next_task_seq   int,	 -- this is ignored if @next_start_time is not null 	@taskresult      int as 	begin transaction  	-- first insert stuff into the log data 	exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, 0, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult  	-- now insert and fix up history for this item 	exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id  	-- update the event schedule table 	if( @next_start_time is null ) 	begin 	   -- Right now we never want to leave the next_task_seq as null for a completed schedule. 	   -- If it is null, set it to whatever the last sequence was 	   if( @next_task_seq is null ) 	   begin 	      select @next_task_seq = next_task_seq 	         from event_schedule 	   	     where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	   end  		DECLARE @called_status varchar(MAX),                 @calling_id    int,                 @dependent_id  int  		SELECT    @calling_id = calling_event             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  		SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  		IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) 		BEGIN 			DECLARE @event_name    varchar(128) 			SELECT  @event_name = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN') 				FROM event          AS e 				JOIN event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id 				WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  			IF (@status_code = 0) 			BEGIN 				SELECT @called_status = 'Called Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status 				-- insert status_log for calling schedule 				exec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult 				-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule 				exec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id 				-- clear dependent schedule id and set success status for calling schedule 				UPDATE    event_schedule 					SET   status = @called_status, 						  dep_schedule_id = NULL 					WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id 			END 			ELSE IF (@status_code = 1) 			BEGIN 				SELECT @called_status = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status 				-- insert status_log for calling schedule 				exec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult 				-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule 				exec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id 				-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task table 				UPDATE    es 					SET   status = @called_status, 						  status_code = 1, 						  dep_schedule_id = NULL, 						  next_task_seq = nts.next_task_seq, 						  end_time = @current_time 					FROM  event_schedule AS es 					JOIN ( 						SELECT s.schedule_id, MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq, t.cond_seq 							FROM script_task AS t 							JOIN event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id 							WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq 							GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq 						 ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq 					WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id 				-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task table 				UPDATE es 					SET status = @called_status, 						status_code = 1, 						dep_schedule_id = NULL, 						end_time = @current_time 					FROM event_schedule AS es 					WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  				IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL) 					EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' 			END 		END  	   -- this event is not supposed to recur, all done        update event_schedule             set status_code = @status_code, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module,                 status = @status, end_time = @current_time, next_task_seq = @next_task_seq, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  }             where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	end 	else 	begin 		-- this event will recur, update the status and set the new start time 		update event_schedule 			set status_code = null, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module, 				start_time = @next_start_time, status = @status, end_time = @current_time, 				next_task_seq = null, cond_seq = null, dep_schedule_id = null,  -- these should be re-evaluated every time, set to null 				config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  } 			where schedule_id = @schedule_id 			 			delete from computer_state where  schedule_id = @schedule_id 	end  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @exit_code int, @status_code int, @exit_module smallint, @next_start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @level smallint, @next_task_seq int, @taskresult int)

Object_Definition: create procedure del_session    @computer_id      int,    @status           varchar (254),    @clear_wol_time   int = 1 as    declare  @schedule_id      int,             @event_id         int,             @cond_seq         int,             @next_task_seq    int,             @found            int     set @found = null     if not exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id)       return 0     select @schedule_id = schedule_id, @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @next_task_seq = next_task_seq from event_schedule       where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code = -3 and computer_id = @computer_id     if (@schedule_id is not null)    begin       select @found = event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq       if (@found is null)          select @found = event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq    end     begin transaction     if (@found is not null)    begin       update event_schedule set status_code = NULL, status = @status where schedule_id = @schedule_id       if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 1       end    end     delete sessions where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 1    end     if (@clear_wol_time != 0)    begin       update computer set last_wol_attempt = null where computer_id = @computer_id        if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 1       end    end     commit transaction     return 1

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_history_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @task_seq      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @schedule_id   int as    declare @history_id int     --Dayakar DE-Enhanced Altiris SDK    declare @app_id int     select @app_id = app_id from event_schedule_info where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	 	if (@app_id is null) 		set @app_id = 0     if exists (select event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_install_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from image_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_image_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from unattended_install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_unattended_install_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_config_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from capture_pct_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_capture_pct_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from deploy_anywhere_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_deploy_anywhere_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_script_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from reboot_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_reboot_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_copyfile_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from registry_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_registry_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_wait_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     --HLS PRD#7.1.11 {    -- we dont have a "task_table" for Get inventory, thats why we are using task table to find out if the event_id represents a Get inventory task    if exists (select event_id from task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_type = 19)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_get_inventory_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end    --}  status:    -- update all status_log records that correspond to this history entry    if (@history_id != 0)    begin       begin transaction       update status_log set history_id = @history_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id and history_id is null       if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 0       end        commit transaction    end

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_live_event_status    @comp_id int,    @task_type int,    @event_name varchar(128),    @status varchar(256),    @status_code int,    @current_time    datetime,    @module smallint,    @level smallint,    @user_id int = 0,    @system_user_id int = 0,    @redeploy int = 0  as       declare @user_name varchar(128)     declare @full_name varchar(128)     declare @domain varchar(128)     declare @user_log varchar(256)     declare @his_id int    begin transaction    if(@user_id != 0 )     begin 	select @user_name = name, @domain = netbiosdomain, @full_name = fullname from securityuser where [user_id] = @user_id               select @user_log = 'user=' + @user_name +' ' + 'domain='+@domain + ' ' + 'fullname=' + @full_name     end     exec @his_id = sel_next_system_id 'HISTORY_ID'    if(@his_id != 0)    begin    	insert into history  				(	history_id,  					computer_id,  					event_name,  					task_type, 					redeploy )  				values  				(	@his_id,  					@comp_id,  					@event_name,  					@task_type, 					@redeploy )               -- Live event schedule id is logged as 1 for identification 	insert into status_log  		(	computer_id,  			schedule_id,  			history_id,  			status,  			status_code,  			schedule_time,  			module,  			complete_time,  			level, 			[user_id],  			system_logon_user_id, 			user_log )  		values  		(	@comp_id,  			1,  			@his_id, 			@status, 			@status_code,  			@current_time,  			@module, 			@current_time,  			@level,  			@user_id,  			@system_user_id,  			@user_log )    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@comp_id int, @task_type int, @event_name varchar, @status varchar, @status_code int, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @user_id int, @system_user_id int, @redeploy int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_locale_info 	@computer_id int, 	@user_index int, 	@lang_id int, 	@locale_id int, 	@time_zone_bias int, 	@oem_cp int, 	@ansi_cp int, 	@oslang_id int = 0  as 	begin transaction  	if not (@oslang_id = 0 AND EXISTS (select * from [locale_info] where  	computer_id = @computer_id)) 	begin  		-- first we need to delete any existing values 		if (@user_index is null) 			delete from [locale_info] where computer_id = @computer_id and user_index is null 		else 			delete from [locale_info] where computer_id = @computer_id and user_index = @user_index  		-- now insert the new values 		insert into [locale_info] 			( computer_id, user_index, lang_id, locale_id, time_zone_bias, oem_cp, ansi_cp,os_langid  ) 			values 			( @computer_id, @user_index, @lang_id, @locale_id, @time_zone_bias, @oem_cp, @ansi_cp,@oslang_id )  	end 	-- Check for error and commit or roll back the transaction 	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @user_index int, @lang_id int, @locale_id int, @time_zone_bias int, @oem_cp int, @ansi_cp int, @oslang_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.ins_new_event_schedule 	@computer_id int, 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@next_task_seq int, 	@start_time datetime, 	@status_code int, 	@calling_sched_id int = null as 	declare @new_schedule_id int 	--bug fix 25835 	declare @windowsuser_id int 	set @windowsuser_id =0  	begin transaction 	exec @new_schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'  	if (@calling_sched_id is not null) 	begin         	update event_schedule 		set start_time = dateadd(minute, 1, @start_time) 		where computer_id = @computer_id 			and start_time <= @start_time 			and status_code is null 			and dep_schedule_id is null  		update event_schedule 		set dep_schedule_id = @new_schedule_id 			where schedule_id = @calling_sched_id 	end  	insert into event_schedule ( 				schedule_id, 				computer_id, 				event_id, 				cond_seq, 				next_task_seq, 				start_time, 				status_code, 				calling_event 			   ) 	values	( 				@new_schedule_id, 				@computer_id, 				@event_id, 				null, 				@next_task_seq, 				@start_time, 				@status_code, 				@calling_sched_id 			   )     --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User 	select @windowsuser_id = windows_user_id from event_schedule_info where schedule_id = @calling_sched_id 	  insert into  event_schedule_info 		( schedule_id, windows_user_id ) 	  values         ( @new_schedule_id, @windowsuser_id)      -----------------     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return -1    end     commit transaction     return @new_schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @cond_seq int, @next_task_seq int, @start_time datetime, @status_code int, @calling_sched_id int)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure ins_new_snmp_enclosure   @name varchar(64),   @manuf varchar(64),   @model varchar(64),   @ip_address varchar(20),   @community varchar(256),   @rack_name varchar(64) as   declare @enclosure_id as int,           @tran int,           @status int,           @rack_id int,           @org_name varchar(64)    set @tran = @@trancount    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    select @rack_id=rack_id from physical_rack where name=@rack_name    if(@rack_id is null)   begin     exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'      insert into physical_rack(rack_id, name, real_name, manuf_rack)       values(@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, 1)   end    select @enclosure_id=enclosure_id, @org_name=name from physical_enclosure where manuf=@manuf and model=@model       and ip_address=@ip_address and community=@community and rack_id=@rack_id    if (@enclosure_id is null)   begin     exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'      insert into physical_enclosure(enclosure_id, name, real_name, manuf, model, ip_address, community, rack_id)       values(@enclosure_id, @name, @name, @manuf, @model, @ip_address, @community, @rack_id)      set @status = 1   end   else   begin     if(@org_name = @name)       set @status = 0     else     begin       set @status = 2       update physical_enclosure set name=@name, real_name=@name where enclosure_id=@enclosure_id     end   end    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)   begin     commit transaction     select @enclosure_id, @status   end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @manuf varchar, @model varchar, @ip_address varchar, @community varchar, @rack_name varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_nic_interface    @id int,    @nic_id int,    @interface_id int, 		 -- -1 means use existing    @name varchar( 64 ) = null,    @ip varchar( 16 ) = null,    @netmask varchar( 16 ) = null,    @gateway varchar( 16 ) = null,    @broadcast varchar( 16 ) = null,    @state int = null as    declare @last_id int    declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     if( -1 = @interface_id )    begin       -- we don't have an existing id, just insert the data and let SQL generate one       insert into nic_interface          ( [id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state )          values          ( @id, @nic_id, @name, @ip, @netmask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state )        -- save the inserted identity so we can return it       set @last_id = @@identity    end    else    begin       -- update the data       update nic_interface  	     set [id] = @id, nic_id = @nic_id,              [name] = @name, ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,  			broadcast = @broadcast, state = @state          where interface_id = @interface_id              -- the last identity was passed in but return it anyway       set @last_id = @interface_id    end     if( @@error != 0 )    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return -1    end    else    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          commit transaction       return @last_id    end

if(@user_id != 0 )     begin 	select @user_name = name, @domain = netbiosdomain, @full_name = fullname from securityuser where user_id = @user_id               select @user_log = 'user=' + @user_name + ' ' + 'domain='+@domain+ ' ' + 'fullname=' + @full_name     end   --]     insert into status_log       (  computer_id,          schedule_id,          status,          status_code,          [module], Object_Definition: CREATE procedure ins_snmp_blade   @mac_addr1 varchar(36),   @mac_addr2 varchar(36),   @ip_addr1 varchar(20),   @ip_addr2 varchar(20),   @serial_num varchar(64),   @manuf  varchar(128),   @model_num varchar(64),   @prod_name varchar(128),   @physical_enclosure_id int,   @idx int,   @cpu_count int,   @cpu_speed int,   @cpu_desc varchar(128),   @ram_total int,   @bios_ver varchar(64) as declare @computer_id int,           @interface_id int,           @bay_id int,           @tran int,           @change_method int,           @old_computer_id int,           @need_update int,           @event_id int,           @initial_event_id int,           @computer_name varchar(64),           @new_time datetime,           @time datetime,           @schedule_id int,           @bootoption int    set @tran = @@trancount   set @need_update = 0   set @bootoption = NULL    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    -- check first if we already have a bay and a computer (RIP&Replace stuff!)   select distinct @computer_id=computer_id from nics where mac_addr = @mac_addr1 or mac_addr = @mac_addr2    select @bay_id=bay_id, @change_method=change_method, @old_computer_id=computer_id, @event_id=event_id,  	@initial_event_id=initial_event_id  	from physical_bay  	where enclosure_id = @physical_enclosure_id and idx = @idx    if(@bay_id is not null)   begin     -- we already have the bay; lets see if it is a virtual one     if(@initial_event_id is not null)     begin       -- the bay, the blade has been plugged in is a virtual one!       set @need_update = 1        -- the inserted blade has been assigned to another bay in the past => remove all identification, but store the history       if (@computer_id is not null)       begin         delete from nics where computer_id = @computer_id         update computer set asset_tag = null, serial_num = null, uuid = null, status = null, icon = 1           where computer_id = @computer_id       end 	  else 	  begin 		if (@old_computer_id is not null and @initial_event_id is not null) 		begin 			delete from nics where computer_id = @old_computer_id 			update computer set asset_tag = null, serial_num = null, uuid = null, status = null, icon = 1 				where computer_id = @old_computer_id 		end 	  end        -- update the virtual bay with the hardware information we received from the new blade       update computer set asset_tag=null, serial_num=@serial_num, uuid=null, status=null, icon=1, manuf=@manuf, hidden=null,            model_num=@model_num, prod_name=@prod_name, processor_count=@cpu_count, bios_version=@bios_ver where computer_id=@old_computer_id        if(@initial_event_id = 0)       begin         -- just send a wait with the default boot option         exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id         select 2 as change_method, @old_computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption       end       else       begin         -- we have a pre-defined job for this bay, let's schedule it         -- reschedule any events that might be already scheduled for this computer to run after the rule event.           set @time = getdate()           set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @time)            update event_schedule set start_time = @new_time where computer_id = @old_computer_id                                                             and start_time <= @time and status_code is null            select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule where event_id = @initial_event_id and @old_computer_id = computer_id           if (@schedule_id is null)           begin             exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'             insert into event_schedule (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, start_time, next_task_seq)               values (@schedule_id, @old_computer_id, @initial_event_id, @time, 0)           end           else           begin             update event_schedule set start_time = @time, status = null, status_code = null,                                     end_time = null, broker_time = null, cond_seq = null, next_task_seq = 0                                   where schedule_id = @initial_event_id           end           -- make sure that we have a computer name, otherwise just use the mac as name => bug #37925           update computer set name=@mac_addr1, computer_name=@mac_addr1 where computer_id=@old_computer_id and (computer_name is null or computer_name = '')            -- get the boot environment           select top 1 @bootoption=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@initial_event_id order by task_seq           if(@bootoption = 1 or @bootoption is null)           begin             exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id           end            select 1 as change_method, @old_computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption       end        -- update the bay information       update physical_bay set initial_event_id=null, icon=37 where bay_id=@bay_id       set @computer_id = @old_computer_id     end     else     begin       -- the bay is not a virtual one       -- lets check the change methode       if(@change_method < 3)       begin         -- rip & replace (0), select a job (1), wait for user interaction (2)         if (@old_computer_id != @computer_id or @computer_id is null)         begin           if(@old_computer_id is not null)           begin             -- the computer has been associated with another bay             update computer set asset_tag=null, serial_num=@serial_num, uuid=null, status=null, icon=1, manuf=@manuf,               model_num=@model_num, prod_name=@prod_name, processor_count=@cpu_count, bios_version=@bios_ver where computer_id=@old_computer_id              insert into deleted_mac_addrs select mac_addr from nics where computer_id=@old_computer_id             delete from nics where computer_id=@old_computer_id             delete from hardware where computer_id=@old_computer_id             set @need_update = 1           end           if(@computer_id is not null)           begin             delete from nics where computer_id=@computer_id             update computer set asset_tag=null, serial_num=null, uuid=null, status=null, icon=1               where computer_id=@computer_id             set @need_update = 1           end            set @computer_id = @old_computer_id            if(@change_method = 0)           begin             -- redeploy             if((select count(history_id) from history where computer_id=@computer_id) = 0)             begin               -- we don't have a history although we should have => send a wait               update physical_bay set [wait]=1 where computer_id=@computer_id               exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id               select 2 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption             end             else             begin               select @computer_name=computer_name from computer where computer_id=@computer_id               select 0 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, @computer_name as computer_name, 0 as bootoption             end           end            if(@change_method = 1)           begin             -- If Run Event rule             -- reschedule any events that might be already scheduled for this computer to run after the rule event.             set @time = getdate()             set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @time)              update event_schedule set start_time = @new_time where computer_id = @computer_id                                                             and start_time <= @time and status_code is null              select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule where event_id = @event_id and @computer_id = computer_id             if (@schedule_id is null)             begin               exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'               insert into event_schedule (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, start_time, next_task_seq)                 values (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, @time, 0)             end             else             begin               update event_schedule set start_time = @time, status = null, status_code = null,                                     end_time = null, broker_time = null, cond_seq = null, next_task_seq = 0                                   where schedule_id = @schedule_id             end              -- get the boot environment             select top 1 @bootoption=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq             if(@bootoption = 1 or @bootoption is null)             begin               exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id             end              select 1 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption           end            if(@change_method = 2)           begin             -- wait             update physical_bay set [wait]=1 where computer_id=@computer_id              -- get the default boot environment             exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id              select 2 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption           end         end         else         begin           -- the bay includes the same computer as before => just ignore it, no action needed           select 3 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, 0 as bootoption         end       end        if(@change_method = 3)       begin         -- ignore the change         if (@computer_id is null)         begin           exec @computer_id = sel_next_system_id 'COMPUTER_ID'            if (@computer_id = 0)           begin             rollback transaction             return -1           end           set @need_update = 1           -- insert a new computer record           insert into computer(computer_id, name, computer_name, serial_num, manuf, model_num, prod_name, processor_count, pxe_support, bios_version, node_type)             values(@computer_id, @mac_addr1, @mac_addr1, @serial_num, @manuf, @model_num, @prod_name, @cpu_count, 1, @bios_ver, 1)         end  		delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id and bay_id != @bay_id          update physical_bay set computer_id=@computer_id where enclosure_id = @physical_enclosure_id and idx = @idx          select 3 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, 0 as bootoption       end     end   end   else   begin     -- bay is null...     set @old_computer_id = @computer_id     if (@computer_id is null)     begin       exec @computer_id = sel_next_system_id 'COMPUTER_ID'        if (@computer_id = 0)       begin         rollback transaction         return -1       end       set @need_update = 1       -- insert a new computer record       insert into computer(computer_id, name, computer_name, serial_num, manuf, model_num, prod_name, processor_count, pxe_support, bios_version, node_type)         values(@computer_id, @mac_addr1, @mac_addr1, @serial_num, @manuf, @model_num, @prod_name, @cpu_count, 1, @bios_ver, 1)     end      -- insert a new bay     exec @bay_id = sel_next_system_id 'BAY_ID'     if (@bay_id = 0)     begin       rollback transaction       return -1     end  	delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id and bay_id != @bay_id      if (@old_computer_id is null)     begin       insert into physical_bay(bay_id, enclosure_id, idx, name, real_name, computer_id, used_bays, change_method, [wait])         values(@bay_id, @physical_enclosure_id, @idx, cast(@idx as varchar(64)), cast(@idx as varchar(64)), @computer_id, 1, 2, 1)        exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id       select 2 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption     end     else     begin       -- we already had the computer in our database, but no assigned bay; maybe the SNMP stuff has not been set up       -- correctly => send an ignore       insert into physical_bay(bay_id, enclosure_id, idx, name, real_name, computer_id, used_bays, change_method, [wait])         values(@bay_id, @physical_enclosure_id, @idx, cast(@idx as varchar(64)), cast(@idx as varchar(64)), @computer_id, 1, 3, 0)       select 3 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, 0 as bootoption     end   end    if(@need_update = 1)   begin     -- insert hardware details (if available)     if (@cpu_speed is not null or @ram_total is not null)     begin       insert into hardware(computer_id, proc_desc, proc_speed, proc_count, ram_total)         values(@computer_id, @cpu_desc, @cpu_speed, @cpu_count, @ram_total)     end      -- insert the nics 	exec ins_nic @computer_id, 0, @mac_addr1      if (@mac_addr2 is not null)     begin       insert into nics(computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr)         values(@computer_id, 1, @mac_addr2)     end      -- insert nic interfaces     insert into nic_interface([id], nic_id, ip)       values(@computer_id, 0, @ip_addr1)     if (@mac_addr2 is not null)     begin       insert into nic_interface([id], nic_id, ip)         values(@computer_id, 1, @ip_addr2)     end   end    update computer set icon = 41  where computer_id = @computer_id    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)     commit transaction

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[is_need_check_visibility]     @user_id int, 	@obj_id  int AS BEGIN     DECLARE @need_check int     SELECT  @need_check = 1      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM database_info WHERE req_login = 1 AND enforce_visibility = 1)         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securityprivilegelink l                         LEFT JOIN securitygroupmember   m ON m.group_id = l.[user_id]                         WHERE     l.privilege_id = 1 AND @user_id IN (l.[user_id], m.[user_id]) )         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                         WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                         AND       p.[object_id] = @obj_id AND p.[allow] > 0 )         SET @need_check = 0      RETURN  @need_check END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @obj_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task]     @schedule_id   int,     @operation_str varchar(64) as begin 	DECLARE   @calling_id   int 	SELECT    @calling_id = calling_event         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  	DECLARE   @dependent_id   int 	SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id         AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  	IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @failure_code int,                 @exit_code    int, 		        @taskresult   int, 		        @exit_module  smallint, 		        @level        smallint, 		        @current_time datetime         SELECT  @failure_code = 1,                 @exit_code    = 19501,                 @taskresult   = 0,                 @exit_module  = 16,                 @level        = 3,                 @current_time = GETDATE()  		DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  		DECLARE @errstatus   varchar(MAX);         SELECT  @errstatus = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @eventname + '] Was ' + @operation_str 		 		-- insert status_log for calling schedule 		exec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @errstatus, @failure_code, @exit_code, @exit_module,                                  @level, @taskresult  		-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule 		exec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id 		 		-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task 		UPDATE es             SET status          = @errstatus,                 status_code     = @failure_code,                 dep_schedule_id = NULL,                 next_task_seq   = nts.next_task_seq,                 end_time        = @current_time             FROM event_schedule AS es             JOIN (                 SELECT    s.schedule_id,                           MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq,                           t.cond_seq                     FROM  script_task    AS t                     JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id                     WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq                     GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq                  ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq             WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id 		 		-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task 		UPDATE    event_schedule             SET   status          = @errstatus,                   status_code     = @failure_code,                   dep_schedule_id = NULL,                   end_time        = @current_time             WHERE schedule_id     = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id          IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL)             EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' 	END end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @operation_str varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure mth_check_automation_job    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule es          where ( (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is NULL)             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)            and es.event_id in ( select t.event_id from [task] t left outer join [script_task] st 			on t.event_id = st.event_id  			and t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq  			and t.task_seq = st.task_seq 			where ((t.task_type = 10 and st.execution_mode = 0) 			or t.task_type = 13 			or t.task_type = 15 			or t.task_type = 17 			or t.task_type = 22) )        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure mth_check_current_schedule 	@computer_id	int, 	@schedule_id	int, 	@task_seq		int, 	@boot_env		int as 	declare @return_code  int 	set @return_code = null  	if (@schedule_id = 0) 	begin 		-- The agent thinks there is has not work, lets make sure. 		select top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule es join task t  				on es.event_id = t.event_id 				and es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq 				and es.next_task_seq = t.task_seq 			where computer_id = @computer_id and (es.status_code = -1 or es.status_code = -3) 				and ( ( @boot_env = 1 -- BOOT_AUTOMATION = 1 						and ( t.task_type = 10 						or t.task_type = 11 						or t.task_type = 13 						or t.task_type = 15 						or t.task_type = 17 ) ) 					or  					( @boot_env != 1 ) )  		if (@return_code is null) 			set @return_code = 0 	end 	else 	begin 		-- The agent thinks it is working on a job. 		select top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule 			where computer_id = @computer_id 				and schedule_id = @schedule_id 				and next_task_seq = @task_seq 				and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  		if (@return_code is null) 		begin 			select top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule 				where computer_id = @computer_id and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  			if (@return_code is null) 				set @return_code = 0 -- Agent thinks it has a job, but we don't.  			-- We think it is working on a different job than the agent thinks. 		end 		else 		begin 			-- We are in sync with the agent. 			set @return_code = 0 		end 	end  	return @return_code
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_env int)

new ID from the system table */ 	declare @new_event_id int 	exec @new_event_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_ID'     -- determine if there is already a folder with this    --    name in the destination    declare @strippass smallint     set @strippass = 1    select @strippass = ( select top 1 strip_task_pass from database_info )    declare @orig_name   varchar(256)    declare @exist_name  varchar(256)    declare @new_name    varchar(256)    select @orig_name = ( select name from event where event_id = @src_event_id )    if @folder_id is null or @folder_id = 0       select @exist_name = ( select top 1 name from event where folder_id is null and name = @orig_name )    else       select @exist_name = ( select top 1 name from event where folder_id = @folder_id and name = @orig_name )    if @exist_name is not null       select @new_name = @event_prefix + @orig_name    else       select @new_name = @orig_name  --{ 	/*If the length of name is greater than 128 do not trim. return with error */ 	/*Bug Fix No.39243*/ 	 	/* reduce the name to a legal size */ 	--set @new_name = substring(@new_name, 1, 64)  	if(len(@new_name) > 128 ) 	begin 		rollback transaction 		select -4 as id 		return (-4) 	end 	--}  	/* create the new event */ 	insert into event       ( event_id, name, description )       select @new_event_id, @new_name, description       	from event where event_id = @src_event_id  	/* update the folder_id if provided */ 	if ( @folder_id != 0 ) 		update event set folder_id = @folder_id where event_id = @new_event_id 	else 		update event set folder_id = null where event_id = @new_event_id  	/*************************************************************************/    /* Create new rows for all child tables                                  */ event_id,    --      time_method,    --      start_hour,    --      start_min,    --      min_clients,    --      min_client_timeout )    --   select    --      @new_event_id,    --      time_method,    --      start_hour,    --      start_min,    --      min_clients,    --      min_client_timeout    --   from    --      event_times    --   where    --      event_id = @src_event_id     /******************************************************* event_condition */    declare @cond_seq int    declare event_condition_cursor cursor local for       select cond_seq from event_condition where event_id = @src_event_id    open event_condition_cursor    fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       insert into event_condition          (  event_id,             cond_seq,             name )          select             @new_event_id,             cond_seq,             name          from             event_condition          where             event_id = @src_event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq        fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    end    close event_condition_cursor    deallocate event_condition_cursor     /******************************************************** condition_item */    declare @item_seq int    declare condition_item_cursor cursor local for       select cond_seq, item_seq from condition_item where event_id = @src_event_id    open condition_item_cursor    fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @cond_seq, @item_seq    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       insert into condition_item          (  event_id,             cond_seq,             item_seq,             field_type,             oper_type,             key_value,             drive,             conjunct, 			token )	--42871          select             @new_event_id,             @cond_seq,             @item_seq,             field_type,             oper_type,             key_value,             drive,             conjunct, 			token	--42871          from             condition_item          where             event_id = @src_event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and item_seq = @item_seq        fetch next from varchar(64)    declare @domain_member      int    declare @personality_path   varchar(255)    declare @username           varchar(255)    declare @password           varchar(255)    declare @computer_name      varchar(64)    declare @single_comp        bit     set @single_comp = 0     --  Try to find the IP address first    select   @subnet_name = subnet_name,             @domain_name = domain_name,             @domain_member = domain_member,             @personality_path = personality_path,             @username = username,             @password = password    from custcfg    where ip_address = @IP     if (@subnet_name) is null    begin       -- Next, try to find with last octet as wildcard.       select @temp_ip = @octet1 + '.' + @octet2 + '.' + @octet3 + '.*'       select   @subnet_name = subnet_name,                @domain_name = domain_name,                @domain_member = domain_member,                @personality_path = personality_path,                @username = username,                @password = password       from custcfg       where ip_address = @temp_ip        if (@subnet_name) is null       begin          -- Next, try to find with last 2 octets as wildcards.          select @temp_ip = @octet1 + '.' + @octet2 + '.*.*'          select   @subnet_name = subnet_name,                   @domain_name = domain_name,                   @domain_member = domain_member,                   @personality_path = personality_path,                   @username = username,                   @password = password          from custcfg          where ip_address = @temp_ip           if (@subnet_name) is null          begin             -- Next, try to find with last 3 octets as wildcards.             select @temp_ip = @octet1 + '.*.*.*'             select   @subnet_name = subnet_name,                      @domain_name = domain_name,                      @domain_member = domain_member,                      @personality_path = personality_path,                      @username = username,                      @password = password             from custcfg             where ip_address = @temp_ip              if (@subnet_name) is null             begin                -- Finally try to find all octets as wildcards.                select   @subnet_name = subnet_name,                         @domain_name = domain_name,                         @domain_member = domain_member,                         @personality_path = personality_path,                         @username = username,                         @password = password                from custcfg                where ip_address = '*.*.*.*'                 if (@subnet_name) is null                begin                   -- If nothing found then exit the proc.                   if (@subnet_name) is null                   begin                      return                   end                end                else                begin                   declare @sOctet1 varchar(3)                   declare @octetlen int                    select @octetlen = 3 - len (@octet1)                   select @sOctet1 = ''                   while (@octetlen > 0)                   begin                      select @sOctet1 = @sOctet1 + '0'                      select @octetlen = @octetlen - 1                   end                   select @sOctet1 = @sOctet1 + @octet1                   select @computer_name = substring(@subnet_name,1,3) + @sOctet1 + @ip_name                end             end          end       end    end    else    begin       set @computer_name = substring(@subnet_name,1,15)    end     if (@computer_name is null)       set @computer_name = substring(@subnet_name,1,6) + @ip_name     --  Got the computer name and IP new create the Event.    declare @find_comp_id int    declare @find_event_id int    declare @event_id int    declare @event_name varchar(128)     set @event_name = 'Custom Boot: ' + @IP     select @find_comp_id = c.computer_id          from computer c          where c.computer_id = @computer_id             and c.[name] = @computer_name             and c.domain_name = @domain_name             and c.domain_member = @domain_member     select @event_id = e.event_id          from event e, event_schedule es          where e.[name] = @event_name             and es.computer_id = @computer_id             and e.event_id = es.event_id     select @find_event_id = it.event_id          from  event_schedule es,             install_task it          where es.status_code = 0             and es.event_id = @event_id             and it.event_id = es.event_id             and it.install_file = @personality_path     if ((@find_comp_id is null) or (@find_event_id is null))    begin       begin transaction          declare @folder_id  int          declare @config_set_id int          declare @config_item_id int          declare @cur_time datetime          declare @folder_name varchar(64)           select @folder_name = 'Custom Boot Events'      -- Get the folder_id or create it if needed.          select @folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where name = @folder_name          if (@folder_id) is null          begin             exec @folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'             insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, name)                   values (@folder_id, NULL, @folder_name)          end      -- Get event_id, create if needed.          select @event_id = e.event_id             from event e, event_schedule es             where e.[name] = @event_name                and es.computer_id = @computer_id                and e.event_id = es.event_id           if (@event_id is null)          begin             delete event where [name] like 'Custom Boot:%' and event_id in (select event_id from event_schedule where computer_id = @computer_id)          end           -- This is so we don't change the name, just run the rip or pct package on the machine.          if (@subnet_name = '*' and @find_comp_id is null)          begin             if (@event_id is not null)             begin                declare @temp_comp_id   int                 select @temp_comp_id = c.computer_id                   from  computer c,                         event_schedule es,                         install_task it                   where c.computer_id = es.computer_id                     and es.status_code = 0                     and es.event_id = @event_id                     and it.event_id = es.event_id                     and it.install_file = @personality_path                 if (@temp_comp_id is not null)                begin                   rollback transaction                   return                end             end          end           if (@event_id is null)          begin             exec @event_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_ID'     -- Insert an event             insert into event (event_id, folder_id, [name])                   values (@event_id, @folder_id, @event_name)             insert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq)                   values (@event_id, 0)     -- Insert Configuration Information             if (@subnet_name != '*' and @find_comp_id is null)             begin                exec @config_set_id = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_SET_ID'                exec @config_item_id = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID'                 insert into task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq) values (@event_id, 0, 0)                insert into config_set (config_set_id) values (@config_set_id)                insert into nic_config_set (config_set_id, nic_id) values (@config_set_id, 0)                insert into config_item (config_item_id, config_set_id, target_computer_id) values (@config_item_id, @config_set_id, @computer_id)                insert into nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id) values (@config_item_id, 0)                insert into config_task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, config_set_id, reconfig) values (@event_id, 0, 0, @config_set_id, 1)             end     -- Insert in the personality package.             if (@personality_path) is not null             begin                insert into task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq)                      values (@event_id, 0, 1)                insert into install_task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, install_file, all_users)                      values (@event_id, 0, 1, @personality_path, 0)             end          end          else          begin    -- Update the config.             if (@subnet_name != '*' and @find_comp_id is null)             begin                if (select 1 from task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = 0) is null                   insert into task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq) values (@event_id, 0, 0)                 select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_choice where event_id = @event_id                if (@config_set_id is null)                begin                   exec @config_set_id = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_SET_ID'                   exec @config_item_id = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID'                   insert into config_set (config_set_id) values (@config_set_id)                   insert into nic_config_set (config_set_id, nic_id) values (@config_set_id, 0)                   insert into config_item (config_item_id, config_set_id, target_computer_id) values (@config_item_id, @config_set_id, @computer_id)                   insert into nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id) values (@config_item_id, 0)                   insert into config_task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, config_set_id, reconfig) values (@event_id, 0, 0, @config_set_id, 1)                end                else                begin                   select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id                end             end             else             begin                delete from config_set where config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = 0)                delete from task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = 0             end     -- Update the personality package.             update event set folder_id = @folder_id where event_id = @event_id              if (@personality_path) is not null             begin                if (select 1 from task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = 1) is null                   insert into task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq) values (@event_id, 0, 1)                 if (select 1 from install_task where event_id = @event_id) is null                   insert into install_task (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, install_file, all_users) values (@event_id, 0, 1, @personality_path, 0)                else                   update install_task set install_file = @personality_path where event_id = @event_id             end             else             begin --               delete from install_task where event_id = @event_id                delete from task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = 1             end              select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task                   where event_id = @event_id             if @config_set_id is null             begin                exec @config_set_id = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_SET_ID'                insert into config_set (config_set_id) values (@config_set_id)                insert into nic_config_set (config_set_id, nic_id) values (@config_set_id, 0)             end              select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item                   where config_set_id = @config_set_id and target_computer_id = @computer_id             if (@config_item_id) is null             begin                exec @config_item_id = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID'                insert into config_item (config_item_id, config_set_id, target_computer_id) values (@config_item_id, @config_set_id, @computer_id)                insert into nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id) values (@config_item_id, 0)             end          end           if (@subnet_name != '*' and @find_comp_id is null)          begin             update config_set                set cname_method = 0,                   cname_addl = 1,                   cname_append = 1,                   cname_numbers = 1,                   msnet_method = 0,                   msnet_is_domain_member = 0,                   nw_method = 0,                   nw_login_to_tree = 0,                   nw_run_scripts = 1,                   lic_method = 0,                   use_existing_data = 0                where                   config_set_id = @config_set_id           update nic_config_set                set ip_method = 0                where config_set_id = @config_set_id           update config_item set 		computer_name = @computer_name, 		domain_member = @domain_member, 		domain_name = @domain_name,                 msnet_domain_username = @username,                 msnet_domain_password = @password, 		lic_os_user = c.lic_os_user, 		lic_os_org = c.lic_os_org, 		lic_os_key = c.lic_os_key, 		ip_hostname = @computer_name, 		nw_pref_server = c.nw_pref_server, 		nw_pref_tree = c.nw_pref_tree, 		nw_nds_context = c.nw_nds_context, 		nw_user_name = c.nw_user_name, 		nw_login_to_tree = c.nw_login_to_tree, 		nw_run_scripts = c.nw_run_scripts 	/*	ua_fullname = c.ua_fullname, 		ua_groups = c.ua_groups, 		ua_password = c.ua_password, 		ua_username = c.ua_username, 		ua_cannot_change = c.ua_cannot_change, 		ua_must_change = c.ua_must_change, 		ua_pw_never_expires = c.ua_pw_never_expires     */             from config_item ci, computer c                where ci.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and c.computer_id = @computer_id           update nic_config_item set 		ip_use_dhcp = c.ip_use_dhcp, 		/*ip_address = c.ip_address, 		ip_netmask = c.ip_netmask, 		ip_gateway = c.ip_gateway,*/ 		ip_domain = c.ip_domain, 		ip_dns = c.ip_dns, 		ip_wins = c.ip_wins             from config_item ci, nics c                where ci.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and c.computer_id = @computer_id           update nic_interface set                 ip = ni.ip,                 mask = ni.mask,                 gateway = ni.gateway,                 broadcast = ni.broadcast,                 [name] = ni.[name],                 state = ni.state             from nic_interface ni                 where [id] = @config_item_id                    and ni.[id] = @computer_id          end     -- Schedule event          declare @schedule_id int           select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule             where computer_id = @computer_id and event_id = @event_id           -- Get time for event.          select @cur_time = getdate()          select @cur_time = @cur_time - .00069445          declare @small_time smalldatetime          select @small_time = @cur_time          select @cur_time = @small_time           if (@schedule_id) is null          begin             exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'              insert into event_schedule                (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, next_task_seq, start_time, status, defer_mins)             values                (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, 0, @cur_time, 'Custom Configuration', 5)          end          else          begin             update event_schedule                set cond_seq = NULL,                    next_task_seq = 0,                    start_time = @cur_time,                    recur_value = NULL,                    status_code = NULL,                    status = 'Custom Object_Definition: create procedure mth_ensure_init_handlers  @event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int  as  declare @count int select @count = count(*) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq  if (@count = 0) -- if there are no handlers for this item, make some begin 	-- Add the default fail handler - stop 	update task set on_fail = 0 where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq 	-- Add the default success handler - continue 	insert into task_return_handlers (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, ret_code, handler) 	   values (@event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, 0, 1) end

if object_id('cond_seqs') is not null delete from cond_seqs        --for each event condition in the initial deployment event       insert into cond_seqs (cond_seq)select distinct cond_seq from x_task where           event_id = 2000001 order by cond_seq        --debug --      select cond_seq from cond_seqs        declare cond_cursor cursor static local for       select distinct cond_seq         from cond_seqs        open cond_cursor        fetch next from cond_cursor         into @cond_seq        while @@fetch_status = 0       begin         --use the condition name         select @name = [name] from x_event_condition where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq 		--create a new job for each condition on the old initial deployment event         exec @event_id = ins_event @name @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_capture_pct_task        set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq 		update x_wait_task               set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_config_task             set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_copyfile_task           set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_image_task              set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_install_task            set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_partition_task          set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_reboot_task             set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_registry_task           set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_script_task             set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_unattended_install_task set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_event_condition         set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq          fetch next from cond_cursor           into @cond_seq       end         close cond_cursor       deallocate cond_cursor        if object_id('cond_seqs') is not null drop table cond_seqs        --delete any condition items in initial deployment event. They don't mean anything       delete x_condition_item where event_id = 2000001        --delete the initial deployment event_conditions. They are not needed anymore       delete x_event_condition where event_id = 2000001    end     if @default_event_id is null       select @default_event_id = 0     return @default_event_id

Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[mth_set_folder_visibility] @user_id int as 	--Check if user is admin 	declare @adminright int 	set @adminright = 1	--admin right  	declare @isadmin int 	declare @do_vis_check int  	set @do_vis_check = 0  	if (select top 1 req_login from database_info) = 1 and (select top 1 enforce_visibility from database_info) = 1 	begin 	declare  @privilege_tablename    varchar(128) 		set @privilege_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 	if object_id('tempdb..' + @privilege_tablename) is not null 		exec ('delete from '+@privilege_tablename) 					 		--LB#74142	 		exec wc_sel_security_right @user_id,@adminright,0, @privilege_tablename 		--exec wc_sel_security_right @user_id,@adminright    		set @isadmin = null 		--select @isadmin = granted from ##wc_last_effective_rights 		declare @strsql nvarchar(128) 		declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500); 		set @strsql = N'select @isadminOut=granted from '+@privilege_tablename;  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@isadminOut int OUTPUT'; 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @isadminOut=@isadmin OUTPUT;  		if (@isadmin > 0) 		begin 			exec mth_set_all_folders_visibility @user_id, 1 		end 		else 		begin 			set @do_vis_check = 1  			--create temp folder table 			declare @folders table (x int identity, folder_id int, processed int default 0, markedvisible int default 0) 			--seed with root folders 			insert into @folders (folder_id)  				select folder_id from event_folder where parent_id is null  			-- add all event folders to @folders 			while @@RowCount > 0 				insert into @folders (folder_id) 				select event_folder.folder_id 				from event_folder 					inner join @folders RecordList on event_folder.parent_id = RecordList.folder_id 					where not exists  					(select * from @folders CurrentRecords where CurrentRecords.folder_id = event_folder.folder_id)  			declare  @permissions_tablename    varchar(128) 			set @permissions_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_permissions' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))  			if object_id('tempdb..' + @permissions_tablename+'') is not null 				exec ('drop table dbo.' + @permissions_tablename ) 			exec ( 'create table dbo.'+ @permissions_tablename + '(permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)')  			--put the root (Jobs) into the group list. It is represented as -10 even though in the db table, event.folder_id it is NULL 			insert into @folders (folder_id) values (-1)  			declare @folder_id int 			declare @actual_visible int 			declare folder_cursor cursor local for select folder_id from @folders order by x desc 			open folder_cursor 			fetch next from folder_cursor into @folder_id 			while @@fetch_status = 0		--for each folder 			begin 				--		for each folder in temp table ordered by leaves first 				--			actual_visible = wc_sel_security_permission 				declare @folder_marked_visible int  --				exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, 80, @folder_id, 0 				-- -1 tells wc_sel_security_permission to match any permission 				--LB#74142 				declare  @tablename    varchar(128) 				set @tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 				exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @folder_id, 0, @tablename							 				--exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @folder_id, 0 		 				set @strsql = N'select @actual_visibleOut=granted from '+@permissions_tablename;  				set @ParmDefinition = N'@actual_visibleOut int OUTPUT'; 				execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @actual_visibleOut=@actual_visible OUTPUT; 				--select @actual_visible = granted from ##wc_last_effective_permissions 				if @actual_visible is null 					set @actual_visible = 0   				select top 1 @folder_marked_visible = markedvisible from @folders where folder_id = @folder_id 				--if folder not markedvisible 				if @folder_marked_visible = 0 or @actual_visible = 1 				begin --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, @actual_visible) 					insert into #job_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, @actual_visible) 				end       else  				begin 					-- set folder.folder_id,visible = 2	 					-- has a child folder that is visible. Don't want to have an orphaned group 					-- setting visible to 2 means that the group will be displayed, but none of its immediate child jobs --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, 2) 					insert into #job_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, 2) 				end 				 				--if folder is visible 				if @folder_marked_visible = 1 or @actual_visible = 1 					--set folders parent to markedvisible 					update @folders set markedvisible = 1  						where folder_id in (select parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id)  				fetch next from folder_cursor into @folder_id 			end   			close folder_cursor 			deallocate folder_cursor 		end 	end       else 	begin 		--security not turned on make everything visible woohooo 		exec mth_set_all_folders_visibility @user_id, 1 	end  	return @do_vis_check
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[mth_set_group_visibility] @user_id int as 	--Check if user is admin 	declare @adminright int 	set @adminright = 1	--admin right  	declare @isadmin int 	declare @do_vis_check int  	set @do_vis_check = 0  	if (select top 1 req_login from database_info) = 1 and (select top 1 enforce_visibility from database_info) = 1 	begin 	declare  @privilege_tablename    varchar(128) 	set @privilege_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 	if object_id('tempdb..' + @privilege_tablename+'') is not null 		exec('delete from dbo.'+ @privilege_tablename) 	 		--LB#74142	 		exec wc_sel_security_right @user_id,@adminright,0, @privilege_tablename 		--exec wc_sel_security_right @user_id,@adminright    		set @isadmin = null 		--LB#74142 		declare @strsql nvarchar(128) 		declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500); 		set @strsql = N'select @isadminOut=granted from '+@privilege_tablename;  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@isadminOut int OUTPUT'; 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @isadminOut=@isadmin OUTPUT;  		--select @isadmin = granted from ##wc_last_effective_rights 		if (@isadmin > 0) 		begin 			exec mth_set_all_groups_visibility @user_id, 1 		end 		else 		begin 			set @do_vis_check = 1  			--create temp group table 			declare @groups table (x int identity, group_id int, processed int default 0, markedvisible int default 0) 			--seed with root folders 			insert into @groups (group_id)  				select group_id from computer_group where parent_id is null  			-- add all computer groups to @groups 			while @@RowCount > 0 			insert into @groups (group_id) 			select computer_group.group_id 			from computer_group 				inner join @groups RecordList on computer_group.parent_id = RecordList.group_id 			where not exists (select * from @groups CurrentRecords where CurrentRecords.group_id = computer_group.group_id) 			 			declare  @permissions_tablename    varchar(128) 			set @permissions_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_permissions' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 			if object_id('tempdb..'+@permissions_tablename) is not null 				exec('drop table '+ @permissions_tablename) 			exec ('create table dbo.' + @permissions_tablename + '(permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)')  			--put the root (All Computers) into the group list. It is represented as -1 even though in the computer table it is NULL 			insert into @groups (group_id) values (-1)  			declare @group_id int 			declare @actual_visible int 			declare group_cursor cursor local for select group_id from @groups order by x desc 			open group_cursor 			fetch next from group_cursor into @group_id 			while @@fetch_status = 0		--for each group 			begin 				--		for each group in temp table ordered by leaves first 				--			actual_visible = wc_sel_security_permission 				declare @group_marked_visible int  				-- -1 tells wc_sel_security_permission to match any permission 				--	exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, 80, @group_id, 0 				--LB#74142 				declare  @tablename    varchar(128) 				set @tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 				exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @group_id, 0, @tablename							 				--exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @group_id, 0 				----------------- 				 				declare @str_sql nvarchar(128) 				declare @Parm_Definition nvarchar(500); 				set @str_sql = N'select @actual_visibleOut=granted from '+@permissions_tablename;  				set @Parm_Definition = N'@actual_visibleOut int OUTPUT'; 				execute sp_executesql @str_sql, @Parm_Definition, @actual_visibleOut=@actual_visible OUTPUT; 				--select @actual_visible = granted from ##wc_last_effective_permissions 				if @actual_visible is null 					set @actual_visible = 0  				select top 1 @group_marked_visible = markedvisible from @groups where group_id = @group_id 				--if group not markedvisible 				if @group_marked_visible = 0 or @actual_visible = 1 				begin 					--	set computer_group.group_id.visible = actual_visible --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, @actual_visible)  					--new 					insert into #computer_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, @actual_visible) 				end 				else 				begin 					-- set computer_group.group_id,visible = 2	 					-- has a child group that is visible. Don't want to have an orphaned group 					-- setting visible to 2 means that the group will be displayed, but none of its immediate child computers --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, 2)  					--new 					insert into #computer_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, 2) 				end 				 				--if group is visible 				if @group_marked_visible = 1 or @actual_visible = 1 					--set groups parent to markedvisible 					update @groups set markedvisible = 1  						where group_id in (select parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @group_id)  				fetch next from group_cursor into @group_id 			end  			close group_cursor 			deallocate group_cursor 		end 	end 	else 	begin 		--security not turned on make everything visible woohooo 		exec mth_set_all_groups_visibility @user_id, 1 	end  	return @do_vis_check
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure mth_validate_bootoptions as 	if object_id ('x_task') is not null and object_id ('x_bootoptions') is not null 	begin 		declare @x_bootoption_id int 		declare @x_boot_image_cpu_arch int 		declare @x_boot_option_type int 		declare @x_cpus_supported int  		declare x_task_cursor cursor local for 		  select bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch from x_task  		open x_task_cursor 		fetch next from x_task_cursor into @x_bootoption_id, @x_boot_image_cpu_arch  		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			declare @bootoption_type int 			declare @b_bootoption_valid int 			declare @cpus_supported int  			set @b_bootoption_valid = 0  			select @bootoption_type = (select top 1 bootoption_type from boot_options  				where bootoption_id = @x_bootoption_id) 			 			if @bootoption_type is not null 			begin 				--check if @x_boot_image_cpu_arch is auto select 				if @x_boot_image_cpu_arch = 0 				begin 					set @b_bootoption_valid = 1 				end 				else 				begin 					select @cpus_supported = (select top 1 cpus_supported from boot_options  						where bootoption_id = @x_bootoption_id and 						bootoption_type = @bootoption_type)  					if @cpus_supported is not null 					begin 						--check if @x_boot_image_cpu_arch is supported by @cpus_supported 						if (@x_boot_image_cpu_arch = 1 and 1 & @cpus_supported != 0) or 						(@x_boot_image_cpu_arch = 2 and 6 & @cpus_supported != 0) 							set @b_bootoption_valid = 1 					end 				end 			end  			--if there is no match in the boot_options table set it to default 			if @b_bootoption_valid = 0 				update x_task set bootoption_id = 1 where bootoption_id = @x_bootoption_id  			fetch next from x_task_cursor into @x_bootoption_id, @x_boot_image_cpu_arch 		end  		close x_task_cursor 		deallocate x_task_cursor 	end

create procedure nsa_sel_xml_schedules 	@top_count int, 	@last_date datetime as declare @sqlLf char(2) select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10) set rowcount @top_count select '<Schedule>' + @sqlLf + 	'<ComputerName>' + coalesce(c.computer_name, '') + '</ComputerName>' + @sqlLf + 	'<DomainName>' + coalesce(domain_name, '') + '</DomainName>' + @sqlLf + 	'<JobID>' + coalesce(cast(es.event_id as varchar(10)), '') + '</JobID>' + @sqlLf + 	'<JobName>' + coalesce(e.name, '') + '</JobName>' + @sqlLf + 	'<Status>' + coalesce(es.status, '') + '</Status>' + @sqlLf + 	'<StartTime>' + coalesce(cast(es.start_time as varchar(32)), '') + '</StartTime>' + @sqlLf + 	'<Recur>' + coalesce(cast(es.recur_value as varchar(10)), '') + '</Recur>' + @sqlLf + 	'<RecurType>' + coalesce(cast(es.recur_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</RecurType>' + @sqlLf + 	'<LastSentTime>' + coalesce(cast(es.[_nslastsent] as varchar(32)), '') + '</LastSentTime>' + @sqlLf + 	'</Schedule>' + @sqlLf as xml_data from event_schedule es, event e, computer c where es.event_id = e.event_id 	and es.computer_id = c.computer_id 	and (es._nslastsent is null or es._nslastsent <  @last_date) order by es.event_id, es.start_time;
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@top_count int, @last_date datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_active_schedules    @computer_id int as    declare @ret int     if( 0 <> @computer_id )    begin       -- return the number of active schedules for this computer 	  select @ret = count( schedule_id ) from event_schedule where 	     status_code < 0 and next_task_seq <> -1 and computer_id = @computer_id    end    else    begin       -- return the total number of active schedules 	  select @ret = count( schedule_id ) from event_schedule where 	     status_code < 0 and next_task_seq <> -1 and computer_id = @computer_id    end     return @ret
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_active_session    @computer_id   int,    @time          datetime as    declare @expiring      tinyint,            @active        tinyint,            @expire_time   datetime,            @limited_lic   int,            @waiting       int     select @waiting = 0     select @expire_time = expire, @limited_lic = limited_license from computer where computer_id = @computer_id    if (@@rowcount > 0)    begin       if ( 1 = @limited_lic and @expire_time >= @time )          set @expiring = 1       else          set @expiring = 0    end    else    begin       set @expiring = NULL    end     select @waiting = wait_state from sessions where computer_id = @computer_id    if (@@rowcount > 0)       set @active = 1    else       set @active = 0     select @expiring as expiring, @active as active, @waiting as waiting
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time datetime)
