Object_Definition: create procedure sel_bootoption_id 	@schedule_id int, 	@resolve_default int = 1 as 	 	declare @default_bootoption_id int 	declare @bootoptionid int 	declare @cpu_arch int  	select @bootoptionid = bootoption_id, @cpu_arch = boot_image_cpu_arch from task t, event_schedule es                        		where t.event_id = es.event_id                                 and  t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq               			and  t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 			 	and  es.schedule_id = @schedule_id                                 and (es.event_id in (select it.event_id from image_task it 		                	where it.event_id = es.event_id 		                        and it.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		                        and it.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 					or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from registry_task rt 						where rt.event_id = es.event_id 							and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 					or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from unattended_install_task rt 						where rt.event_id = es.event_id 							and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 					or es.event_id in (select st.event_id from script_task st 						where st.event_id = es.event_id 							and st.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and st.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 							and st.execution_mode = 0) 					or es.event_id in (select w.event_id from wait_task w 						where w.event_id = es.event_id 							and w.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and w.task_seq = es.next_task_seq)) 	if ( @bootoptionid is NULL) 		set @bootoptionid = 0  	if ( @cpu_arch is NULL) 		set @cpu_arch = 0  	if (@resolve_default = 1) 	begin	 		if (@bootoptionid = 1 ) 		begin 			exec @default_bootoption_id = sel_default_bootoption_id 			select @default_bootoption_id, @cpu_arch 		end 	end 	  	select @bootoptionid, @cpu_arch
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @resolve_default int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_bootoption_type 	@schedule_id int as 	declare @bootoption_type int 	declare @bootoption_id int  	select @bootoption_id = bootoption_id from task t, event_schedule es                        		where t.event_id = es.event_id                                 and  t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq               			and  t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 			 	and  es.schedule_id = @schedule_id  	if (@bootoption_id = 1 or @bootoption_id is null) 	begin 		select @bootoption_id = default_boot_option from database_info 	end 	 	select @bootoption_type = bootoption_type from boot_options where bootoption_id = @bootoption_id  	if (@bootoption_type is null) 		set @bootoption_type = 0  	return @bootoption_type
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_bw_settings_changed 	@comp_id	int, 	@ret_if_no_settings int = 1   -- the value to return if there are no settings as 	declare @modified int  	select @modified = modified 		from bw_prop 		where computer_id = @comp_id  	if( @modified = 0 ) 	begin 	    -- this clients settings have not changed 		return 0 	end 	else if( @modified is null ) 	begin 	    -- we have no settings for this client         return @ret_if_no_settings 	end  	-- if @modified is 1 	return 1

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_comp_is_present 	@comp_id	int, 	@serial_num varchar(64), 	@uuid		varchar(64), 	@asset_tag	varchar(64), 	@mac_addr	varchar(64), 	@os			varchar(128), 	@primary_lookup int as 	declare @comp_count int 	declare @found		int 	set @found = 0  	if ((@primary_lookup | 4) = 4) -- serial 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( computer_id ) 			from computer 			where computer_id = @comp_id and serial_num = @serial_num and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = 4 	end  	if ((@primary_lookup | 8) = 8) -- asset 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( computer_id ) 			from computer 			where computer_id = @comp_id and asset_tag = @asset_tag and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = @found | 8  	end  	if ((@primary_lookup | 16) = 16) -- uuid 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( computer_id ) 			from computer 			where computer_id = @comp_id and uuid = @uuid and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = @found | 16 	end  	if ((@primary_lookup | 32) = 32)-- mac_addr 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( c.computer_id ) 			from computer c join nics n	on c.computer_id = n.computer_id 			where c.computer_id = @comp_id and n.mac_addr = @serial_num and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = @found | 32 	end  	if (@found = @primary_lookup) 		set @comp_count = 1 	else 		set @comp_count = 0  	return @comp_count
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@comp_id int, @serial_num varchar, @uuid varchar, @asset_tag varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @os varchar, @primary_lookup int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_comp_recur_type 	@schedule_id 	int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select @ret_val = recur_type from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		return 0 	end  	return 1
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_comp_status_code 	@schedule_id 	int, 	@check_task		int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select @ret_val = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 	end 	else 	begin 		if @check_task = 1 		begin 			set @ret_val = null 			select top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq from task t, event_schedule es 				where t.event_id = es.event_id and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 					and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 					and es.status_code != 0 					and es.status_code is not null 					and es.next_task_seq >= 0 					and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id 				order by t.task_seq asc  			if @ret_val is null 			begin 				set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 			end 		end 	end  	return @ret_val
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @check_task int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_event_tree]     @nInitDeployIcon     int,     @nFolderIcon         int,     @nBaseIcon           int,     @user_id             int,     @do_visibility_check int    -- not used AS BEGIN     EXEC @do_visibility_check = is_need_check_visibility @user_id, -10     IF ( @do_visibility_check = 0 )     BEGIN         SELECT      event_id  AS [ID],                     folder_id AS [ParentID],                     201       AS [Container],                     CASE WHEN event_id = 2000001                               THEN @nInitDeployIcon                          WHEN master_guid IS NOT NULL AND master_server IS NOT NULL                                THEN 68 -- IIDX_LINKED_JOB                               ELSE @nBaseIcon                      END      AS [Icon],                     [name],                     CASE WHEN event_id = 2000001 THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS [OrderSeq]             FROM    event         UNION         SELECT      folder_id,                     parent_id,                     200,                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016                               THEN 49 -- IIDX_SYSTEM_EVENT_FOLDER                               ELSE @nFolderIcon                     END,                     [name],                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END             FROM    event_folder         ORDER BY 2, 6, 5, 1     END     ELSE     BEGIN         DECLARE       @tmpUsrObj TABLE (ObjectId int, PermissionId int, Allow int)         INSERT INTO   @tmpUsrObj             SELECT    p.[object_id], p.[permission_id], p.[allow]                 FROM  securityuser           u                 JOIN  securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = u.[user_id]                 WHERE u.[user_id] = @user_id                 AND   p.[object_id] > 1000000              DECLARE      @tmpObjs TABLE (ObjectId int, Visible int)             INSERT INTO  @tmpObjs                 SELECT   DISTINCT [object_id], 1                     FROM (                         SELECT        p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                             FROM      securitygroupmember    m                             JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                             LEFT JOIN @tmpUsrObj             u ON u.ObjectId = p.[object_id] AND u.PermissionId = p.[permission_id]                             WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                             AND       p.[object_id] > 1000000                             AND       u.ObjectId IS NULL                             GROUP BY  p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                             HAVING    MIN(p.[allow]) > 0                     ) a                 UNION ALL                 SELECT   DISTINCT ObjectId, 1 FROM  @tmpUsrObj WHERE Allow > 0          WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    ef.folder_id, 1                     FROM  event_folder ef                     JOIN  @tmpObjs ov on ov.ObjectId = ef.parent_id                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tmpObjs cr where cr.ObjectId = ef.folder_id)          DECLARE @i int = 1         WHILE   @i > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    DISTINCT ef.parent_id, 0                     FROM  event_folder ef                     JOIN  @tmpObjs    oo ON oo.ObjectId = ef.folder_id                     WHERE ef.parent_id NOT IN (SELECT ObjectId FROM @tmpObjs )              SET @i = @@ROWCOUNT         END          SELECT      event_id         AS [ID],                     folder_id        AS [ParentID],                     201              AS [Container],                     @nInitDeployIcon AS [Icon],                     [name],                     0                AS [OrderSeq]             FROM    event             WHERE   event_id = 2000001         UNION         SELECT      event_id,                     folder_id,                     201,                     CASE WHEN master_guid IS NOT NULL AND master_server IS NOT NULL                               THEN 68 -- IIDX_LINKED_JOB                               ELSE @nBaseIcon                      END,                     [name],                     3             FROM    event    ev             JOIN    @tmpObjs ov ON ov.Visible = 1 AND ov.ObjectId = ev.folder_id OR (ev.folder_id IS NULL AND ov.ObjectId = ev.event_id)             WHERE   event_id <> 2000001         UNION         SELECT      folder_id,                     parent_id,                     200,                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016                               THEN 49 -- IIDX_SYSTEM_EVENT_FOLDER                               ELSE @nFolderIcon                     END,                     [name],                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END             FROM    event_folder ef             JOIN    @tmpObjs     ov ON ov.ObjectId = ef.folder_id         ORDER BY 2, 6, 5, 1     END END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@nInitDeployIcon int, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int, @user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules    @cur_time   datetime as 	select top 50 es.broker_time, es.computer_id, es.event_id, es.next_task_seq, es.schedule_id, es.start_time,  		es.status, es.status_code, es.recur_type, es.recur_value, es.defer_mins, es.cond_seq, es.config_choice_id,  		es.rip_replace_event, es.initial_deployment, st.location, st.cond_seq 		from event_schedule es  left outer join script_task st on 				es.event_id = st.event_id 				and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq or es.cond_seq is null) 				and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq 		where start_time <= @cur_time 		and ( next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null ) 		and ( status_code is NULL or status_code = -2 ) 		and es.schedule_id in 		(	select top 1 schedule_id 			from event_schedule es2 			where computer_id = es.computer_id 				and start_time <= @cur_time 				and ( next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null ) 				and ( status_code is NULL or status_code = -2 )                 and ( es2.dep_schedule_id is null or                    es2.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule                       where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 and schedule_id = es2.dep_schedule_id ) ) 			order by start_time, schedule_id 		)         and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or            dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule 		      where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 and schedule_id = es.dep_schedule_id ) ) 		and computer_id not in 					( select computer_id 						from event_schedule 			where next_task_seq > -1 				and (status_code < 0 and es.schedule_id != schedule_id) 		) 		and( computer_id in (select computer_id from sessions) 			or st.location = 2) 		order by start_time, schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines    @time      datetime,    @wol_wait  int = 60,    @to_all    char(1) = 'Y' as    declare @wol_time datetime    set @wol_time = DATEADD(second, -@wol_wait, @time)     --    -- I changed the join on the nic_interface table to a left outer join because there are no    -- entries in the nic_interface table if BootWorks is the only agent that's connected to the    -- database.  This is because we don't want BootWorks to update the nic_interface table    -- because it's supposed to be used for the production OS.    -- This fixes bug #24899.    --     if (@to_all = 'Y')    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c 		    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) 		order by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end    else    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c 			join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where c.wol_support = 1             and (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0  and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) 		order by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@time datetime, @wol_wait int, @to_all char)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt    @time      datetime as       select top 1 c.computer_id           from computer c 		    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on ni.id = n.computer_id          where -- (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time) and  			es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		      and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 		and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  				where es.event_id = st.event_id  					and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 					and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2)  				)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_wol    @time   datetime as  select [broker_time], [computer_id], [event_id], [next_task_seq], [schedule_id], [start_time], [status],           [status_code], [recur_type], [recur_value], [defer_mins], [cond_seq], [config_choice_id]    from event_schedule es    where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null) and (status_code is null or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @time          and computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 )          and computer_id not in ( select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is not null) )          and( computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions )  			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) )          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )    order by start_time, schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_find_next_computer     @BeginID char(7),     @SearchTable varchar(255),     @SearchColumn varchar(255),     @SearchData varchar(255) as declare @Children TABLE (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int) declare @RowCnt int declare @MaxRows int declare @ExecSql nvarchar(2048) --LB#74365  create table #GroupOrder (group_id int, parent_id int, name varchar(64), search_order int) insert into #GroupOrder (group_id, parent_id, name, search_order)   select group_id, parent_id, name, 2147483647   from computer_group    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id IS NULL AND group_id != -7 order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end  create table  #SortedComputers (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, computer_id int) insert     into      #SortedComputers (computer_id)     select    c.computer_id     from      computer    c     left join #GroupOrder g on c.group_id = g.group_id     order by  isnull(g.search_order, case when c.node_type IS NULL then 2147483647                                           when c.node_type < 3     then 1 else NULL end) DESC, c.name  select @ExecSql =  case @SearchTable   when 'nic_interface' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.id AND            t.' + @SearchColumn + ' LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   when 'all_fields' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM   #SortedComputers s LEFT OUTER JOIN             computer c ON s.computer_id = c.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nics n ON s.computer_id = n.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nic_interface i ON s.computer_id = i.id LEFT OUTER JOIN             physical_bay p ON s.computer_id = p.computer_id      WHERE (c.computer_id LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_key) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.computer_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.asset_tag) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.serial_num) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.logged_on_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.uuid) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(n.mac_addr) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             i.ip LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(p.real_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''') AND             s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   else     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.computer_id AND            LOWER(t.' + @SearchColumn + ') LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum' end execute sp_executesql @ExecSql drop table #SortedComputers drop table #GroupOrder
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@BeginID char, @SearchTable varchar, @SearchColumn varchar, @SearchData varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_find_next_computer_set_order (@GroupID int) as begin   declare @Children table (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int)   declare @RowCnt int   declare @MaxRows int   declare @ExecSql nvarchar(255)    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id = @GroupID order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end    update #GroupOrder set search_order = (select MIN(search_order) - 1 from #GroupOrder) where group_id = @GroupID  end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@GroupID int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_group_tree]     @user_id             int,     @do_visibility_check int,    -- ignore     @bComps              tinyint = 1 AS BEGIN     declare @cont_folder int     declare @cont_physical_device_non_leaf int     declare @cont_physical_device_leaf int      set @cont_folder = 0;     set @cont_physical_device_non_leaf = 100;     set @cont_physical_device_leaf = 101;      declare @iidx_group_off int     declare @iidx_rack int     declare @iidx_enclosure int     declare @iidx_bay int     declare @iidx_empty_bay int     declare @iidx_bay_wait int     declare @iidx_virt_bay int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine_host_group int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine_host int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine_no_client int      set @iidx_group_off = 3;     set @iidx_rack = 35;     set @iidx_enclosure = 36;     set @iidx_bay = 37;     set @iidx_empty_bay = 38;     set @iidx_bay_wait = 45;     set @iidx_virt_bay = 67;     set @iidx_virtual_machine_host_group = 70;     set @iidx_virtual_machine_host = 71;     set @iidx_virtual_machine = 72;     set @iidx_virtual_machine_no_client = 80      declare @host_const int     declare @vm_const   int      set @host_const = 12000000     set @vm_const   = 13000000      DECLARE @tmpObjs TABLE (GroupId int)      EXEC @do_visibility_check = is_need_check_visibility @user_id, -1     IF ( @do_visibility_check = 1 )     BEGIN         DECLARE       @tmpUsrObj TABLE (ObjectId int, PermissionId int, Allow int)         INSERT INTO   @tmpUsrObj             SELECT    p.[object_id], p.[permission_id], p.[allow]                 FROM  securityuser           u                 JOIN  securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = u.[user_id]                 WHERE u.[user_id] = @user_id                 AND   p.[object_id] <= 1000000          INSERT INTO  @tmpObjs             SELECT   DISTINCT [object_id]                 FROM (                     SELECT        p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                         LEFT JOIN @tmpUsrObj             u ON u.ObjectId = p.[object_id] AND u.PermissionId = p.[permission_id]                         WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                         AND       p.[object_id] <= 1000000                         AND       u.ObjectId IS NULL                         GROUP BY  p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                         HAVING    MIN(p.[allow]) > 0                 ) a             UNION ALL             SELECT   DISTINCT ObjectId FROM  @tmpUsrObj WHERE Allow > 0          WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    cg.GroupId                     FROM  ( SELECT   [group_id] AS [GroupId],                                         CASE WHEN [parent_id] IS NULL AND [group_id] > -1 THEN -1 ELSE [parent_id] END AS [ParentGrId]                                 FROM [computer_group]                             ) cg                     JOIN  @tmpObjs ov on ov.GroupId = cg.ParentGrId                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tmpObjs cr where cr.GroupId = cg.GroupId)          DECLARE @i int = 1         WHILE   @i > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    DISTINCT cg.parent_id                     FROM  computer_group cg                     JOIN  @tmpObjs    oo ON oo.GroupId = cg.group_id                     WHERE cg.parent_id NOT IN (SELECT GroupId FROM @tmpObjs )              SET @i = @@ROWCOUNT         END     END      IF ( @bComps = 0 )     BEGIN         -- only display containers and physical devices (no computers)          SELECT Object_Definition: create procedure sel_inventory_group_tree 	@user_id int, 	@do_visibility_check int as 	declare @cont_folder int 	declare @cont_thin_client int  	select @cont_folder = 0; 	select @cont_thin_client = 4;  	-- display containers with computers also 	select  		group_id as id,  		parent_id as parentid,  		@cont_folder as container,  		icon as icon,  		name,  		0 as proc_type,  		0 as [os_bit],	 		0 	from computer_group cg left outer join #computer_visibility ov  			on cg.group_id = ov.object_id where @do_visibility_check = 0 or (ov.user_id = @user_id and (ov.visible > 0)) 	union 	select 		a.computer_id, 		a.group_id, 		a.node_type,         a.icon, 		a.[name], 		coalesce( 			( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = a.computer_id), 			(0) 			) as proc_type, 		coalesce([os_bit], 32),	 		0 	from 		computer a left outer join nics n 			on a.computer_id = n.computer_id 		where a.hidden is null and node_type = @cont_thin_client  			and (@do_visibility_check = 0 or exists  				(select visible from #computer_visibility ov  					where ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.visible = 1 and ((ov.object_id = a.group_id) or (ov.object_id = -1 and a.group_id is null) 					or (a.group_id is null and ov.object_id = a.computer_id) ) ) ) --63670, 63679 --					where ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.object_id = a.group_id and ov.visible = 1) 	order by 2 asc, 3 asc, 8 asc, 5 asc, 7 asc

Object_Definition: -- is this event linked to a master event create procedure sel_is_event_master_assigned 	@event_id	int as 	declare @event_unique_id as uniqueidentifier  	select @event_unique_id = master_guid 		from event 		where event_id = @event_id and master_server is not null  	if( @event_unique_id is not NULL ) 	begin 		return 1 	end  	return 0

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc 	 	if (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) 	begin 		return -1 	end  	select @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  	 	if( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) 		set @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  	select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set 		where config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task 			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  	if (@config_set_id is null) 		return -1     return @next_task_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc 	 	if (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) 	begin 		return -1 	end  	select @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  	 	if( @deploy_any_event_id is null) 		return -1 	 	return 	@next_task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_job_status_info 	@computer_id int as 	select t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, 		case t.task_type 			when 10 then				-- Script 				(select case when location = 1 then 'None' 							 when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  							 else 'Production' 						end  					from script_task st 					where st.event_id = t.event_id  						and st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  						and st.task_seq = t.task_seq) 			when 11 then 'Both'			-- Reboot 			when 12 then 'Production'	-- Copy File 			when 13 then 'Automation'	-- Registry  			when 14 then 'Both'			-- Config 			when 15 then 'Automation'	-- Image 			when 16 then 'Production'	-- Install 			when 17 then 'Automation'	-- Unattended Install 			when 18 then 'Production'	-- PCT 			when 19 then 'Production'	-- Inventory 			when 21 then 'Production'	-- Update Agent  			else 'None' 		end as boot_env 		from dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  			on es.computer_id = @computer_id  				and t.event_id = es.event_id  				and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  				and t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		where es.status_code is not null  			and es.status_code != -2 			and es.status_code < 0
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 	       and boot_env = 1		-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in 		( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  	if 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) 	Begin 		if @last_used_id = 3000000 		begin 			SET @last_used_id = 19000000 		end 	end     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err 	  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 	  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err 		 -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 		 RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_task_seq 	@schedule_id 	int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq 		from task t, event_schedule es 		where t.event_id = es.event_id 				and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 				and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 				and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id 				order by t.task_seq asc  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 	end  	return @ret_val
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_task_seq_copy @event_id bigint, @cond_seq int as declare @ret_val int  	select top 1 @ret_val = task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq  order by  task_seq desc  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = -1 	end  	set @ret_val = @ret_val +1  	return @ret_val

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_redeploy_tasks    @computer_id   int as    declare  @temp_id int,             @history_id int,             @script_tag_id int     select top 1 @temp_id = history_id       from history_view       where ((task_type = 15 and xml_task like '%<Upload>0%')or task_type = 17)     -- Image task or Unattended Install          and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@temp_id is not null)    begin       declare @new_history_id int       declare @min_task_seq int        set @min_task_seq = null       select @min_task_seq = min(task_seq) from task               where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)        if (@min_task_seq is null)       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and redeploy = 1             order by [sequence], history_id desc       end       else       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and [sequence] = @min_task_seq and redeploy = 1              order by history_id desc       end 		                 if (@new_history_id != @temp_id)          set @temp_id = @new_history_id        select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view          where history_id < @temp_id             and computer_id = @computer_id             and task_type != 10             and task_type != 11             and task_type != 12 	    and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        select top 1 @script_tag_id = history_id from history_view          where computer_id = @computer_id             and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%')  and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        -- get the one which was the lastest one ran.       if ((@script_tag_id > @history_id or @history_id is null) and @script_tag_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @script_tag_id - 1       end        if ( @history_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @history_id + 1       end       else       begin          -- if there was script, copy file or reboot prior to image event          -- get the first history_id for this computer          select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view             where history_id < @temp_id                and computer_id = @computer_id 	       and redeploy = 1             order by history_id           if ( @history_id is null)             set @history_id = @temp_id       end        select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id        return    end     -- no image or scripted install found, looking for tag.    select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id          and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%') 	 and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@history_id is not null)    begin       select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id       return    end     -- nothing was found, we will send all the history for this computer.    select task_type, xml_task       from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_return_handler 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@task_seq int, 	@ret_code int = null as declare @count int declare @handler int declare @handlername nvarchar(64)  select @count = count(*) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  if @count < 1    begin 	if @ret_code = 0 		select @handler = 1 -- continue 	else 	   begin 		select @handler = on_fail 		  from task 		  where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq 		  group by on_fail 	   end    end else    select @handler = handler 	from task_return_handlers 	where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  select @handler = coalesce (@handler, 0) -- default, stop  if @handler <> 0 AND @handler <> 1 	select @handler, [name] from event where event_id = @handler else 	select @handler, ' '  return @handler
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @ret_code int)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_return_handler_status_info @sched_id int, @ret_code int AS declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id 	from event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  select status, ret_code, result from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and 						        task_seq = @task_seq and 						        cond_seq = @cond_seq and 						         ret_code = @ret_code

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_task_password    @username		varchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      		select @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or 		   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_tc_job_tree    @SoftwarePackages varchar(50),    @nFolderIcon int,    @nBaseIcon int as 	declare @software_packages_folder_id int  	declare @job_folder table 	(	 		folder_id int 	)  	--Make sure we have a Software Packages folder under Thin Client System folder 	select @software_packages_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder  		where parent_id = 1000009 and name = @SoftwarePackages 	if @software_packages_folder_id is null 	begin 		exec @software_packages_folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID' 		insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, name) values (@software_packages_folder_id, 1000009, @SoftwarePackages) 	end  	declare @tmp_folder_id int 	declare folder_cursor cursor for select folder_id from @job_folder  	insert into @job_folder (folder_id) values (@software_packages_folder_id)  	open folder_cursor 	fetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id  	select @tmp_folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  	while @@fetch_status = 0 	begin 		--add any subfolders 		insert into @job_folder (folder_id) select ef.folder_id from event_folder ef where ef.parent_id = @tmp_folder_id		 		fetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id 	end  	close folder_cursor 	deallocate folder_cursor  	delete from @job_folder where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  	--Get the imediate child folders of @software_packages_folder_id    select       folder_id,       null,        200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union 	--Get the sub folders of @software_packages_folder_id's children folders    select       folder_id,       parent_id,       200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    union 	--Get immediate child jobs of @software_packages_folder_id    select	       event_id,       null,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union 	--Get jobs from @software_packages_folder_id's child folders    select       event_id,       folder_id,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    order by 2, 6, 5, 1
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@SoftwarePackages varchar, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_unattend_task_data     @event_id int,     @cond_seq int,     @task_seq int as    select t3.active, t3.value, t3.value_id, t3.vars_id, t3.vars_name, t3.type, t1.unattend_section_id as section_id,          t1.name as section_name, t3.unattend_id   from unattended_install_task t2, unattend_section t1   left join (select t1.event_id as [event_id], t1.cond_seq as [cond_seq], t1.task_seq as [task_seq], t1.active as [active],                     t1.unattend_vars_value as [value], t1.unattend_vars_value_id as [value_id],                     t2.unattend_vars_id as [vars_id], t2.name as [vars_name], t2.type as [type],                     t1.unattend_txt_data_id as [unattend_id], t3.unattend_section_id as section_id              from unattend_txt_data t1, unattend_vars t2, unattend_section t3, unattend_vars_value t4              where t1.unattend_vars_value_id = t4.unattend_vars_value_id and t4.unattend_vars_id = t2.unattend_vars_id and                    t2.unattend_section_id = t3.unattend_section_id) t3   on t3.section_id=t1.unattend_section_id and t3.event_id=@event_id and t3.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t3.task_seq=@task_seq   where t1.unattend_setup_id=t2.unattend_setup_id and t2.event_id=@event_id and t2.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t2.task_seq=@task_seq order by t1.unattend_section_id

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_capture_pct_task    @event_id      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @task_seq      int,    @xml_task      varchar(8000) output,    @inc_passwords int = 1  as    declare @xml_extra varchar(6000)    select @xml_extra = ''     if ( @inc_passwords = 1 )    begin       select @xml_extra =          '<Username><![CDATA[' + coalesce (username,'') + ']]></Username>' +          '<Password><![CDATA[' + coalesce (password,'') + ']]></Password>' +          '<PackagePassword><![CDATA[' + coalesce (pkg_password,'') + ']]></PackagePassword>'       from  capture_pct_task       where  @event_id = event_id             and @cond_seq = cond_seq             and @task_seq = task_seq    end     select @xml_task =       '<Task Type=''Capture PCT''>' +       '<TemplateFile>' + coalesce (template_file,'') + '</TemplateFile>' +       '<Folder>' + coalesce (folder,'') + '</Folder>' +       '<AddlCommandLine>' + coalesce (addl_cmd_line,'') + '</AddlCommandLine>' +       '<DomainUsers>' + coalesce (cast(domain_users as varchar (10)),'') + '</DomainUsers>' +       '<LocalUsers>' + coalesce (cast(local_users as varchar (10)),'') + '</LocalUsers>' +       '<CustomUsers>' + coalesce (custom_users,'') + '</CustomUsers>' +       '<CustomGroups>' + coalesce (custom_groups,'') + '</CustomGroups>' +       '<LastAccessed>' + coalesce (cast(last_accessed as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastAccessed>' +       '<LastValue>' + coalesce (cast(last_value as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastValue>' +       '<LastScale>' + coalesce (cast(last_scale as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastScale>' +       '<DontClean>' + coalesce (cast(dont_clean as varchar (10)),'') + '</DontClean>' + 	  '<CreatePkg>' + coalesce (cast(create_pkg as varchar (10)),'') + '</CreatePkg>' +       @xml_extra +       '</Task>'    from  capture_pct_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq

as varchar(10)),''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</ComputerID>' + @sqlLf +           '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '</AssetTag>' + @sqlLf +           '<SerialNumber>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(serial_num,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</SerialNumber>' +   '<OS>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(os,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</OS>' + @sqlLf +           '<Manufacturer>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(prod_name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</ProductName>' + @sqlLf +           '<ProcessorCount>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(cast(processor_count as varchar(10)),''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</ProcessorCount>' + @sqlLf +           '<PxeSupport>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(cast(pxe_support as varchar(10)),''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</PxeSupport>' + @sqlLf +           '<BwInstalled>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(cast(bw_installed as varchar(10)),''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</BwInstalled>' + @sqlLf + Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_config_task    @event_id      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @task_seq      int,    @xml_task      varchar(8000) output,    @inc_passwords int = 1 as    select @xml_task =          '<Task Type=''Config''>' +          '<ConfigSetID>' + coalesce (cast(config_set_id as varchar (10)),'') + '</ConfigSetID>' +          '<Reconfig>' + coalesce (cast(reconfig as varchar (10)),'') + '</Reconfig>' +          '</Task>'    from config_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_copyfile_task    @event_id      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @task_seq      int,    @xml_task      varchar(8000) output,    @inc_passwords int = 1 as    declare @xml_extra varchar(6000)    select @xml_extra = ''     if ( @inc_passwords = 1 )    begin       select @xml_extra =          '<Username><![CDATA[' + coalesce (username,'') + ']]></Username>'+          '<Password><![CDATA[' + coalesce (password,'') + ']]></Password>'       from copyfile_task       where  @event_id = event_id              and @cond_seq = cond_seq              and @task_seq = task_seq    end     select @xml_task =          '<Task Type=''CopyFile''>' +          '<LocalFile>' + coalesce (local_file,'') + '</LocalFile>' +          '<RemoteFile>' + coalesce (remote_file,'') + '</RemoteFile>' +          '<Upload>' + coalesce (cast(upload as varchar (10)),'') + '</Upload>' +          '<OSRequired>' + coalesce (cast(os_reqd as varchar (10)),'') + '</OSRequired>' +          '<RecurseDir>' + coalesce (cast(recurse_dir as varchar (10)),'') + '</RecurseDir>'+          '<AClientToDownload>' + coalesce (cast(aclient_to_download as varchar (10)),'') + '</AClientToDownload>'+          '<DownloadDirectory>' + coalesce (cast(download_directory as varchar (10)),'') + '</DownloadDirectory>'+          @xml_extra + 		 '<allow_automation>' + coalesce (cast(allow_automation as varchar (10)),'') + '</allow_automation>' +          '</Task>'    from copyfile_task    where  @event_id = event_id           and @cond_seq = cond_seq           and @task_seq = task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_event    @event_id      int,    @inc_passwords int = 1 as    create table #text_holder ( xml_data text )    insert into #text_holder values ( '' )    declare @ptrval binary(16)    select @ptrval = textptr(xml_data) from #text_holder     declare @xml_data varchar(8000)    set @xml_data = ''     declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     if not exists ( select event_id from event where @event_id = event_id )    begin       select '<Event></Event>' as xml_data       return 0    end     declare @temp_folder_id int    declare @temp_folder_name varchar (256)     select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event where event_id = @event_id    set @temp_folder_name = ''    if @temp_folder_id is not null    select @temp_folder_name = b.[name] from event_folder b, event a where b.folder_id = a.folder_id and a.event_id = @event_id     -- build the event XML tags    select @xml_data = @xml_data +       '<Event>' + @sqlLf +       '<EventID>' + coalesce(cast(@event_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</EventID>' + @sqlLf +       '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Name>' + @sqlLf +       '<Description>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.description, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Description>' + @sqlLf +       '<FolderID>' + coalesce(cast(@temp_folder_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</FolderID>' + @sqlLf +       '<FolderName>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(@temp_folder_name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</FolderName>' + @sqlLf +       '<JobDuration>' + coalesce(cast(isnull(datediff(ss, es.broker_time, es.end_time), 0) as varchar(20)),'') + '</JobDuration>' + @sqlLf    from event a 	left join event_schedule es 		on a.event_id = es.event_id    where a.event_id = @event_id     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''     --    -- iterate through the conditions    --    select @xml_data = @xml_data + '<Conditions>' + @sqlLf     declare @cond_seq int    declare event_condition_cursor cursor local for       select cond_seq from event_condition where event_id = @event_id    open event_condition_cursor    fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin        select @xml_data = @xml_data +             '<Condition>' + @sqlLf +             '<CondSeq>' + coalesce(cast(cond_seq as varchar(10)),'') + '</CondSeq>' + @sqlLf +             '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Name>' + @sqlLf +             '<ConditionItems>' + @sqlLf       from event_condition       where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''       --       -- iterate through the condition items       --       declare @item_seq int       declare condition_item_cursor cursor local for          select item_seq from condition_item where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq order by item_seq       open condition_item_cursor       fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @item_seq       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          select @xml_data = @xml_data +             '<ConditionItem>' +  @sqlLf +             '<FieldType>' + coalesce(cast(field_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</FieldType>' + @sqlLf +             '<OperType>' + coalesce(cast(oper_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</OperType>' + @sqlLf +             '<KeyValue>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(key_value, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</KeyValue>' + @sqlLf +             '<Drive>' + coalesce(drive, '') + '</Drive>' + @sqlLf +             '<Conjunct>' + coalesce(cast(conjunct as varchar(10)), '') + '</Conjunct>' + @sqlLf +             '</ConditionItem>' + @sqlLf          from condition_item          where event_id = @event_id and             cond_seq = @cond_seq and             item_seq = @item_seq           -- get the next condition item          fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @item_seq       end       close condition_item_cursor       deallocate condition_item_cursor        select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</ConditionItems>' + @sqlLf        updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data       select @xml_data = ''        -- iterate through the tasks       select @xml_data = @xml_data + '<Tasks>' + @sqlLf        declare @task_seq int       declare task_cursor cursor local for          select task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq       open task_cursor       fetch next from task_cursor into @task_seq       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin           declare @xml_task varchar(8000)          select @xml_task = ''           -- get the task information          if exists (select event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from image_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_image_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from unattended_install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_unattended_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_config_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from capture_pct_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_capture_pct_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from deploy_anywhere_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_deploy_anywhere_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_script_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from reboot_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_reboot_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_copyfile_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from registry_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_registry_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords  		 else if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_wait_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords            -- append the task information          select @xml_data = @xml_data + @xml_task           updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data          select @xml_data = ''           -- get the next task for this condition          fetch next from insert into #text_holder values ( '' )    declare @ptrval binary(16)    select @ptrval = textptr(xml_data) from #text_holder     declare @xml_data varchar(6000)    declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     -- start buffer with XML tags    select @xml_data = ''    select @xml_data =       'ScheduleID="' + cast(@sched_id as varchar(10)) + '" ' +       'ComputerID="' + cast(computer_id as varchar(10)) + '" ' +       'EventID="' + cast(event_id as varchar(10)) + '" '    from       event_schedule    where       schedule_id = @sched_id    if ( @xml_data is not null and @xml_data != '' )    begin       select @xml_data = '<ScheduleLog ' + @xml_data + '>' + @sqlLf       updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    end    select @xml_data = ''     --    -- Record each log entry    --    declare @log_id int    declare log_cursor cursor for    select log_id from status_log where schedule_id = @sched_id order by log_id    open log_cursor    fetch next from log_cursor into @log_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       select @xml_data =          '<LogEntry>' + @sqlLf +          '  <LogID>' + coalesce(cast(log_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</LogID>' + @sqlLf +          '  <HistoryID>' + coalesce(cast(history_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</HistoryID>' + @sqlLf +          '  <Level>' + coalesce(cast([level] as varchar(10)),'') + '</Level>' + @sqlLf +          '  <Status>' + coalesce(status,'') + '</Status>' + @sqlLf +          '  <CompleteTime>' + coalesce(cast(complete_time as varchar(32)),'') + '</CompleteTime>' + @sqlLf +          '  <StatusCode>' + coalesce(cast(status_code as varchar(10)),'') + '</StatusCode>' + @sqlLf +          '  <Module>' + coalesce(cast([module] as varchar(10)),'') + '</Module>' + @sqlLf +          '</LogEntry>' + @sqlLf       from          status_log       where          schedule_id = @sched_id and log_id = @log_id       select @xml_data = replace(@xml_data, '&', '&')       updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data        fetch next from log_cursor into @log_id    end    close log_cursor    deallocate log_cursor     -- append the closing XML tags    if ( @xml_data is not null and @xml_data != '' )    begin       select @xml_data = '</ScheduleLog>' + @sqlLf       updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    end     --    -- select the field from the temp table    --    select xml_data from #text_holder    drop table #text_holder
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@sched_id int)

create procedure sel_xml_schedule_status_log    @sched_id		int = null as    declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     declare @comp_id int     select          '<ScheduleStatus>' + @sqlLf +          '  <LogID>' + coalesce(cast(a.log_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</LogID>' + @sqlLf +          '  <ScheduleID>' + coalesce(cast(a.schedule_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</ScheduleID>' + @sqlLf +          '  <HistoryID>' + coalesce(cast(a.history_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</HistoryID>' + @sqlLf +          '  <ComputerID>' + coalesce(cast( ( select b.computer_id from event_schedule b where b.schedule_id = a.schedule_id ) as varchar(10)),'') + '</ComputerID>' + @sqlLf +          '  <EventID>' + coalesce(cast( ( select c.event_id from event_schedule c where c.schedule_id = a.schedule_id ) as varchar(10)),'') + '</EventID>' + @sqlLf + 		   '  <CompletedTime>' + coalesce(cast(a.complete_time as varchar(64)),'') + '</CompletedTime>' +  @sqlLf + 		   '  <Status>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.status,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Status>' + @sqlLf +          '  <StatusCode>' + coalesce(cast(a.status_code as varchar(10)),'') + '</StatusCode>' + @sqlLf +          '  <Module>' + coalesce(cast(a.[module] as varchar(10)),'') + '</Module>' + @sqlLf +          '  <Level>' + coalesce(cast(a.[level] as varchar(10)),'') + '</Level>' + @sqlLf +          '</ScheduleStatus>' + @sqlLf as xml_data    from       sched_status_view a    where       ( @sched_id is not null and a.schedule_id = @sched_id ) or ( @sched_id is null )

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_schedules    @sched_id		int = null,    @event_id      int = null,    @comp_id       int = null,    @start_id      int = 0 as    declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     select '<Schedule>' + @sqlLf +           '<ScheduleID>' + coalesce(cast(a.schedule_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</ScheduleID>' + @sqlLf +           '<ComputerID>' + coalesce(cast(a.computer_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</ComputerID>' + @sqlLf +           '<ComputerName>' + ( select coalesce(b.name,'') from computer b where b.computer_id = a.computer_id ) + '</ComputerName>' + @sqlLf +           '<EventID>' + coalesce(cast(a.event_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</EventID>' + @sqlLf +           '<EventName>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace((select coalesce(b.name,'') from event b where b.event_id = a.event_id ), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '</EventName>' + @sqlLf +           '<CondSeq>' + coalesce(cast(a.cond_seq as varchar(10)),'') + '</CondSeq>' + @sqlLf +           '<TaskSeq>' + coalesce(cast(a.next_task_seq as varchar(10)),'') + '</TaskSeq>' + @sqlLf +           '<StartTime>' + coalesce(cast(a.start_time as varchar(32)),'') + '</StartTime>' + @sqlLf +           '<EndTime>' + coalesce(cast(a.end_time as varchar(32)),'') + '</EndTime>' + @sqlLf +           '<RecurValue>' + coalesce(cast(a.recur_value as varchar(10)),'') + '</RecurValue>' + @sqlLf +           '<RecurType>' + coalesce(cast(a.recur_type as varchar(10)),'') + '</RecurType>' + @sqlLf +           '<Status>' + coalesce(a.status,'') + '</Status>' + @sqlLf +           '<StatusCode>' + coalesce(cast(a.status_code as varchar(10)),'') + '</StatusCode>' + @sqlLf +           '<DeferMins>' + coalesce(cast(a.status_code as varchar(10)),'') + '</DeferMins>' + @sqlLf +           '<DepSchedID>' + coalesce(cast(a.dep_schedule_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</DepSchedID>' + @sqlLf +           '<UserID>' + coalesce(cast(a.user_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</UserID>' + @sqlLf +           '</Schedule>' + @sqlLf as xml_data    from       event_schedule a    where       a.schedule_id >= @start_id and       ( ( @sched_id is not null and a.schedule_id = @sched_id ) or ( @sched_id is null ) ) and       ( ( @event_id is not null and a.event_id = @event_id ) or ( @event_id is null ) ) and       ( ( @comp_id is not null and a.computer_id = @comp_id ) or ( @comp_id is null ) )    order by       a.schedule_id

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_xml_task 	@event_id		int, 	@cond_seq		int, 	@task_seq		int, 	@inc_passwords	tinyint as          declare @xml_task varchar(8000)          select @xml_task = ''           -- get the task information          if exists (select event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from image_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_image_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from unattended_install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_unattended_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_config_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from capture_pct_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_capture_pct_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from deploy_anywhere_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_deploy_anywhere_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_script_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from reboot_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_reboot_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_copyfile_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from registry_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_registry_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords       	 else if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id 1 as    declare  @var_count int,             @counter int, 				@variables varchar(5800), 				@value_id int, 				@value varchar(4096), 				@active smallint     select @counter = 1 	select @var_count=count(*) from unattend_txt_data where event_id=@event_id and cond_seq=@cond_seq and task_seq=@task_seq 	select @variables='<Variables><Count>' + cast(@var_count as varchar(10)) + '</Count>'  	declare unattenddata_cursor cursor for       select unattend_vars_value_id, unattend_vars_value, active          from unattend_txt_data          where event_id=@event_id and cond_seq=@cond_seq and 											'<active>' + coalesce (cast(@active as varchar (10)),'') + '</active>' + 											'</Var' + cast(@counter as varchar(10)) + '>'  		set @counter = @counter+1 		fetch next from unattenddata_cursor into @value_id, @value, @active 	end  	close unattenddata_cursor    deallocate unattenddata_cursor  	set @variables = @variables + '</Variables>'     select @xml_task =          '<Task Type=''Unattended Install''>' +          '<BaseFile>' + coalesce (base_file,'') + '</BaseFile>' +          '<CommandLine>' + coalesce (command_line,'') + '</CommandLine>' +          '<OSFileLocation>' + coalesce (cast(os_file_location as varchar (10)),'') + '</OSFileLocation>' +          '<OSType>' + coalesce (cast(os_type as varchar (10)),'') + '</OSType>' +          '<SetupID>' '<SpFilesID>' + coalesce (cast(unattend_setup_files_id_1 as varchar (10)),'') + '</SpFilesID>' +          '<UnattendFile>' + coalesce (unattend_file,'') + '</UnattendFile>' +          '<NewTask>' + coalesce (cast(new_task as varchar (10)),'') + '</NewTask>' +          '<RdeploySwitch>' + coalesce (ibmaster_switches,'') + '</RdeploySwitch>' +         '<run_rdeployt>' + coalesce ( cast( run_rdeployt as varchar),'') +  '</run_rdeployt>' +          @variables --adding boot option details to xml +          --adding boot option details to xml'</Task>'       from unattended_install_task       where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq -- [  ASK    declare   @xml_temp2    varchar(2000)    declare @boot_id int    declare @boot_type int     declare @cpu_arch int    declare @desc   varchar(2000)     set @boot_id = 0    set @xml_temp2 = ''    select @boot_id = bootoption_id, @cpu_arch = boot_image_cpu_arch from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq    if(@boot_id != 0)    begin     select @boot_type = bootoption_type, @desc = pxe_description from boot_options where bootoption_id = @boot_id      set @xml_temp2 =  '<BootImage>' +         '<ID>' + coalesce ( cast(@boot_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</ID>' +           '<BootType>' + coalesce ( cast(@boot_type as varchar(10)),'') + '</BootType>' +          '<CPUArchType>' + coalesce ( cast(@cpu_arch as varchar(10)),'0') + '</CPUArchType>' +           '<PxeDesc>' + coalesce (@desc,'') + '</PxeDesc>' +           '</BootImage>'    end      set @xml_task = @xml_task + @xml_temp2 +  '</Task>' --]

Object_Definition: create proc uni_add_deploy_anywhere_task 	@table_name          varchar(128), 	@event_id            int, 	@cond_seq            int, 	@task_seq            int, 	@windows_directory   varchar(256), 	@ddb_directory       varchar(256), 	@paramaters          varchar(512) with execute as owner as begin     	declare @sql   nvarchar(4000) 	set     @sql = 'insert into ' +  @table_name + ' (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, windows_directory, ddb_directory, paramaters) ' + 	               'values ( @id, @cs, @ts, @wd, @dd, @pr )' 	execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int, @wd varchar(256), @dd varchar(256), @pr varchar(512)', 	                      @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @windows_directory, @ddb_directory, @paramaters end

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_client_prop_time 	@computer_id int, 	@last_client_upd int, 	@last_user_modify int as 	declare @temp_comp_id int  	select @temp_comp_id = computer_id from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id  	begin transaction  	if( @temp_comp_id ) is not null 	begin 		update aclient_prop set 		last_client_upd = @last_client_upd, 		last_user_modify = @last_user_modify 		where computer_id = @computer_id 	end  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 		return 	end  	commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_comp_status_and_user 	@computer_id	int, 	@status			varchar (254), 	@user			varchar (128), 	@comp_name      varchar(64) = NULL as 	if (@status = '') 		set @status = null  	if (@user = '') 		set @user = null  	begin transaction  	if (@comp_name is null) 		update computer set status = @status, logged_on_user = @user where computer_id = @computer_id 	else 		update computer set status = @status, logged_on_user = @user, [name] = @comp_name where computer_id = @computer_id  	if (@@error != 0) 		rollback transaction 	else 		commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @status varchar, @user varchar, @comp_name varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_from_config_item    @computer_id         int,    @config_item_id		int as    begin transaction     update computer set       	[name] = ci.computer_name, 		computer_name = ci.computer_name, 		ip_hostname = coalesce (ci.ip_hostname, ci.computer_name), 		domain_member = ci.domain_member, 		domain_name = ci.domain_name, 		msnet_dns_domain = ci.msnet_dns_domain,  		nw_pref_server = ci.nw_pref_server, 		nw_pref_tree = ci.nw_pref_tree, 		nw_nds_context = ci.nw_nds_context, 		nw_user_name = ci.nw_user_name, 		nw_login_to_tree = ci.nw_login_to_tree, 		nw_run_scripts = ci.nw_run_scripts, 		lic_os_user = ci.lic_os_user, 		lic_os_org = ci.lic_os_org, 		lic_os_key = ci.lic_os_key 	from config_item ci, computer c 	where ci.target_computer_id = c.computer_id                and c.computer_id = @computer_id                and ci.config_item_id = @config_item_id     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @config_item_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_group_by_expr 	@set_expr       varchar(2048), 	@group_id       int with execute as owner as begin 	declare @sql   nvarchar(2048) 	set     @sql = 'update computer_group set ' + @set_expr + ' where group_id = @id' 	execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int', @group_id end

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_icon    @computer_id   int as    declare @icon   int    exec @icon = sel_icon @computer_id    begin transaction        update computer set icon = @icon where computer_id = @computer_id    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_ip_mac_addr    @computer_id         int,    @ip_addr             varchar (512),    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @nic_id              int = 0 as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = @nic_id     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, ip) values (@computer_id, @nic_id, @ip_addr)    else    begin      if (@ip_addr is not null) 		update nic_interface set ip = @ip_addr where interface_id = @interface_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @ip_addr varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @nic_id int)
