Object_Definition: create procedure wc_upd_computer_location    @computer_id   int,    @site          varchar(128),    @dept          varchar(128),    @mailstop      varchar(128),    @contact       varchar(128),    @email         varchar(128),    @phone         varchar(128) as    declare @compId int    select @compId = computer_id from location where computer_id=@computer_id      begin transaction    if @compId is null 	begin  		insert into location (computer_id, site, dept, mailstop, contact,  				email, phone) values (@computer_id,  @site, @dept, @mailstop, @contact, 				@email, @phone) 	end    else 	begin 		update location set [site] = @site, [dept] = @dept, [mailstop] = @mailstop, 			[contact] = @contact, [email] = @email, [phone] = @phone 			where computer_id = @computer_id 	end    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @site varchar, @dept varchar, @mailstop varchar, @contact varchar, @email varchar, @phone varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item			int,    @field			int,    @operation	    int,    @value			varchar(256) = null,    @drive			varchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct	    smallint     = -1,    @token			varchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint, @token varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job			int,    @condition		int,    @item1		int,    @item2		int as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 	 	   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId			int,    @conditionId1	int,    @conditionId2	int as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 	   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 	   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 	 	   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@tempCondId 	   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as 	update config_item  	set  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  	where Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) 	and config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)

Object_Definition: --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  	@itemId int as  	declare @domain_name as varchar(512) 	declare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)	  	-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name 	select    		@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, 		@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))		 		when '' then domain_name 		else msnet_dns_domain 		end -- case 	from config_item  	where config_item_id=@itemId  	-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it 	if @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 	begin 		select @username=username, @password=[password]  		from domain_accounts  		where domain=@domain_name		 	 		update config_item  		set  		msnet_domain_username=@username, 		msnet_domain_password=@password 		where config_item_id=@itemId 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree, nw_nds_context, nw_user_name, nw_login_to_tree,          nw_run_scripts, msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou       from computer where computer_id = @computerId    open computer_cursor    fetch next from computer_cursor       into @licOsUser, @licOsOrg, @licOsKey, @ipHostname, @computerName, @domainMember, @domainName,       @nwPrefServer, @nwPrefTree, @nwNdsContext, @nwUserName, @nwLoginToTree, @nwRunScripts,       @msnetDnsDomain, @msnetDomainOu     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    if @@fetch_status = 0    begin       update config_item set lic_os_user=@licOsUser, lic_os_org=@licOsOrg, lic_os_key=@licOsKey,          ip_hostname=@ipHostname, computer_name=@computerName, domain_member=@domainMember,          domain_name=@domainName, nw_pref_server=@nwPrefServer, nw_pref_tree=@nwPrefTree,          nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,          nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,          target_computer_id=@computerId       where config_item_id=@itemId    end     -- cleanup cursor    close computer_cursor    deallocate computer_cursor     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Changes for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @deviceId int, @pciBus int, @pciDevice int, @pciFunction int, @vendorId int, @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @description varchar(64), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDHCP smallint, @winsDHCP smallint -- DNS/Wins DHCP for MSN    -- loop through each of the computer's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device, nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id,           ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, nic_id, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp  from nics where computer_id=@computerId       order by nic_id    open nic_cursor    fetch next from nic_cursor       into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins,        @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP     -- update nic_config_item table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- make sure a nic_config_item record exists       declare @configItem int       select @configItem = count(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId          and nic_id=@nicId       -- update existing record       if @configItem = 1       begin          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp=@useDhcp, nic_device_id=@deviceId, nic_pci_bus=@pciBus,             nic_pci_device=@pciDevice, nic_pci_function=@pciFunction, nic_vendor_id=@vendorId,             ip_dns=@ipDns, ip_wins=@ipWins, nic_desc=@description, ip_domain=@ipDomain, netbios=@netBIOS,             dns_use_dhcp = @dnsDHCP, wins_use_dhcp = @winsDHCP          where config_item_id=@itemId and nic_id=@nicId          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId                end       -- create new record       else       begin          insert into nic_config_item             (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device,              nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id, ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp)          values             (@itemId, @nicId, @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId,             @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP)          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId       end       fetch next from nic_cursor into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction,           @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP    end     -- cleanup    close nic_cursor    deallocate nic_cursor                 -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing    	-- update existing record    	-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    	           delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @itemId           	    	-- create new records	           	insert into config_static_route_item    			      (config_item_id, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use])    	select    @itemId, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use]    	from         static_routes where  computer_id = @computerId           -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix       	-- update existing record    	-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    	    	delete dns_suffix where [id] = @itemId    	-- create new records       	    	insert into dns_suffix    			      ([id], dns_suffix, [order])    	select    @itemId, dns_suffix, [order]    	from      dns_suffix where [id] = @computerId
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @computerId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_set    @itemId      int,    @setId		int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256),       @msnetDomainUsername varchar(256), @msnetDomainPassword varchar(256),       @uaUsername varchar(128), @uaFullName varchar(256), @uaPassword varchar(128),       @uaGroups varchar(256), @reboot_after_config smallint    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint,       @uaMustChange smallint, @uaCannotChange smallint, @uaPwNeverExpires smallint,       @uaPrompt smallint     -- fill the variables with config_set record data    select @licOsUser = lic_os_user, @licOsOrg = lic_os_org, @licOsKey = lic_os_key, @nwPrefServer = nw_pref_server,        @nwPrefTree = nw_pref_tree, @nwNdsContext = nw_context, @nwUserName = nw_user_name,        @nwLoginToTree = nw_login_to_tree, @nwRunScripts = nw_run_scripts, @msnetDnsDomain = msnet_dns_domain,        @msnetDomainOu = msnet_domain_ou, @uaUsername = ua_username, @uaFullName = ua_fullname, @uaGroups = ua_groups,        @uaPassword = ua_password, @uaMustChange = ua_must_change, @uaCannotChange = ua_cannot_change,       @uaPwNeverExpires = ua_pw_never_expires, @uaPrompt = ua_prompt, @domainMember = msnet_is_domain_member,        @domainName = msnet_domain_name, @msnetDomainUsername = msnet_domain_username,        @msnetDomainPassword = msnet_domain_password, @reboot_after_config = reboot_after_config       from config_set where config_set_id = @setId    -- generate the first name range value    exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @setId, @computerName output     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    -- collect current config_item values    declare @ilicOsUser varchar(64), @ilicOsOrg varchar(64), @ilicOsKey varchar(64), @iipHostname varchar(128),        @icomputerName varchar(16), @idomainName varchar(512), @inwPrefServer varchar(48),        @inwPrefTree varchar(64), @inwNdsContext varchar(128), @inwUserName varchar(128),        @imsnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @imsnetDomainOu varchar(256), @iuaUsername varchar(128),        @iuaFullName varchar(256), @iuaPassword varchar(128), @iuaGroups varchar(256)    declare @idomainMember smallint, @inwLoginToTree smallint, @inwRunScripts smallint,       @iuaMustChange smallint, @iuaCannotChange smallint, @iuaPwNeverExpires smallint, @iuaPrompt smallint    select @ilicOsUser = lic_os_user, @ilicOsOrg = lic_os_org, @ilicOsKey = lic_os_key,        @iipHostname = ip_hostname, @icomputerName = computer_name, @idomainMember = domain_member,        @idomainName = domain_name, @inwPrefServer = nw_pref_server, @inwPrefTree = nw_pref_tree,        @inwNdsContext = nw_nds_context, @inwUserName = nw_user_name, @inwLoginToTree = nw_login_to_tree,       @inwRunScripts = nw_run_scripts, @imsnetDnsDomain = msnet_dns_domain, @imsnetDomainOu = msnet_domain_ou,        @iuaUsername = ua_username, @iuaFullName = ua_fullname, @iuaPassword = ua_password, @iuaGroups = ua_groups,       @iuaMustChange = ua_must_change, @iuaCannotChange = ua_cannot_change,        @iuaPwNeverExpires = ua_pw_never_expires, @iuaPrompt = ua_prompt       from config_item where config_item_id=@itemId         -- determine which fields to update    -- strings    if @computerName is null or len(@computerName) = 0       set @computerName = @icomputerName    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    if ((@domainName is null or len(@domainName) = 0) and (@msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0))    begin       set @domainName = @idomainName       set @msnetDnsDomain = @imsnetDnsDomain    end    if @nwPrefServer is null or len(@nwPrefServer) = 0       set @nwPrefServer = @inwPrefServer    if @nwPrefTree is null or len(@nwPrefTree) = 0       set @nwPrefTree = @inwPrefTree    if @nwUserName is null or len(@nwUserName) = 0       set @nwUserName = @inwUserName    if @nwNdsContext is null or len(@nwNdsContext) = 0       set @nwNdsContext = @inwNdsContext    if @licOsUser is null or len(@licOsUser) = 0       set @licOsUser = @ilicOsUser    if @licOsOrg is null or len(@licOsOrg) = 0       set @licOsOrg = @ilicOsOrg    if @licOsKey is null or len(@licOsKey) = 0       set @licOsKey = @ilicOsKey    if @ipHostname is null or len(@ipHostname) = 0       set @ipHostname = @iipHostname    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    --if @msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0       --set @msnetDnsDomain = @imsnetDnsDomain    if @uaUsername is null or len(@uaUsername) = 0       set @uaUsername = @iuaUsername    if @uaFullName is null or len(@uaFullName) = 0       set @uaFullName = @iuaFullName    if @uaPassword is null or len(@uaPassword) = 0       set @uaPassword = @iuaPassword    if @uaGroups is null or len(@uaGroups) = 0       set @uaGroups = @iuaGroups    -- bools    if @domainMember is null or @domainMember = 2       set @domainMember = @idomainMember    if @nwRunScripts is null or @nwRunScripts = 2       set @nwRunScripts = @inwRunScripts    if @nwLoginToTree is null or @nwLoginToTree = 2       set @nwLoginToTree = @inwLoginToTree    if @uaMustChange is null or @uaMustChange = 2       set @uaMustChange = @iuaMustChange    if @uaCannotChange is null or @uaCannotChange = 2       set @uaCannotChange = @iuaCannotChange    if @uaPwNeverExpires is null or @uaPwNeverExpires = 2       set @uaPwNeverExpires = @iuaPwNeverExpires    if @uaPrompt is null or @uaPrompt = 2       set @uaPrompt = @iuaPrompt    -- update the OU even if it's blank.    if @msnetDomainOu is null        set @msnetDomainOu = @imsnetDomainOu     update config_item set lic_os_user=@licOsUser, lic_os_org=@licOsOrg, lic_os_key=@licOsKey,       ip_hostname=@ipHostname, computer_name=@computerName, domain_member=@domainMember,       domain_name=@domainName, nw_pref_server=@nwPrefServer, nw_pref_tree=@nwPrefTree,       nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,       nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,       ua_username=@uaUsername, ua_fullname=@uaFullName, ua_password=@uaPassword, ua_groups=@uaGroups,       ua_must_change=@uaMustChange, ua_cannot_change=@uaCannotChange,        ua_pw_never_expires=@uaPwNeverExpires, msnet_domain_username=@msnetDomainUsername,        msnet_domain_password=@msnetDomainPassword, reboot_after_config = @reboot_after_config       where config_item_id=@itemId    exec wc_upd_next_name @setId, @itemId     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Change for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDhcp smallint, @winsDhcp smallint     -- loop through each of the set's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_method, ip_domain, ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_id, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp from nic_config_set where config_set_id=@setId       order by nic_id    open nic_cursor    fetch next from nic_cursor       into @useDhcp, @ipDomain, @ipDns, @ipWins, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDhcp, @winsDhcp     -- update nic_config_item table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- make sure a nic_config_item record exists       declare @configItem int       select @configItem = count(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId          and nic_id=@nicId       -- update existing record       if @configItem = 1       begin          -- get the current item values          declare @iuseDhcp smallint, @inetBIOS smallint          declare @iipDns varchar(512), @iipWins varchar(512), @iipDomain varchar(128)          declare @idnsDhcp smallint, @iwinsDhcp smallint          select @iuseDhcp = ip_use_dhcp, @iipDomain = ip_domain, @iipDns = ip_dns,              @iipWins = ip_wins, @inetBIOS = netbios, @idnsDhcp = dns_use_dhcp, @iwinsDhcp = wins_use_dhcp from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId              and nic_id=@nicId          -- determine which fields to update          if @useDhcp = null or @useDhcp = 2             set @useDhcp = @iuseDhcp          if @ipDns = null or len(@ipDns) = 0             set @ipDns = @iipDns          if @ipWins = null or len(@ipWins) = 0             set @ipWins = @iipWins          if @ipDomain = null or len(@ipDomain) = 0             set @ipDomain = @iipDomain 		 if @netBIOS = null              set @netBIOS = @inetBIOS		  		if @dnsDhcp = null 			set @dnsDhcp = @idnsDhcp 		if @winsDhcp = null 			set @winsDhcp = @winsDhcp          -- update the values          if @useDhcp = 1             set @useDhcp = 0          else             set @useDhcp = 1          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp=@useDhcp, ip_domain=@ipDomain, ip_dns=@ipDns,              ip_wins=@ipWins, netbios = @netBIOS, dns_use_dhcp = @useDhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @winsDhcp          where config_item_id=@itemId and nic_id=@nicId                 end       -- create new record       else       begin          insert into nic_config_item             (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, ip_domain, ip_dns, ip_wins, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp)          values             (@itemId, @nicId, @useDhcp, @ipDomain, @ipDns, @ipWins, @netBIOS, @useDhcp, @winsDhcp)       end        exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @setId, @nicId         fetch next from nic_cursor          into @useDhcp, @ipDomain, @ipDns, @ipWins, @nicId, @netBIOS, @useDhcp, @winsDhcp    end     -- cleanup    close nic_cursor    deallocate nic_cursor        -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing 	-- create new records 	 	insert into config_static_route_item 			      (config_item_id, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use]) 	select    @itemId, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use] 	from         config_static_route_set where config_set_id = @setId 	 -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix  	-- create new records  	insert into dns_suffix 			      ([id], dns_suffix, [order]) 	select    @itemId, dns_suffix, [order] 	from      dns_suffix where [id] = @setId

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_task 	@job			int = null, 	@condition		int = null, 	@task			int = null, 	@configSetId	int = null, 	@configName		varchar(64) = null, 	@licMethod		smallint = 0, 	@licOsUser		varchar(64), 	@licOsOrg		varchar(64), 	@licOsKey		varchar(64), 	@cnameMethod	smallint = 0, 	@cnameFixed		varchar(15),-- Bug no 28207 Length of this field is -- Bug #41687 	@reboot_after_config	smallint, -- PRD itrem 7.1.60 	@cname_addl_padlength smallint = 0 -- bug #40725 as 	if @configSetId is null 		select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  			where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task  	--Microsoft issue: Changes done to handle OU field           declare @msnet_domain_ou varchar(256)          set ua_username = @uaUsername,  		ua_fullname = @uaFullName, ua_groups = @uaGroups, ua_password = @uaPassword, 		ua_must_change = @uaMustChange, ua_cannot_change = @uaCannotChange,  		ua_pw_never_expires msnet_domain_ou = @msnet_domain_ou, 		reboot_after_config = @reboot_after_config, -- PRD itrem 7.1.60 		cname_addl_padlength = @cname_addl_padlength -- bug #40725 		where config_set_id = @configSetId Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_configitem_on_update_of_configset 	@ijob			int = null, 	@icondition		int = null, 	@itask			int = null,    	@isetId			int = null as begin transaction 	if @isetId is null 		select @isetId = config_set_id from config_task  			where event_id = @ijob and cond_seq = @icondition and task_seq = @itask    declare @computerId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor keyset for    select ci.target_computer_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.config_set_id = @isetId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @ijob and ct.cond_seq=@icondition and task_seq=@itask     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @computerId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin     if @itemId is null 		set @addedItem = 0      else 	begin 		if @useExisting = 0  			begin 				delete from config_item where config_item_id=@itemId 				exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T' 				exec ins_config_item @itemId, @isetId, @computerId 				set @addedItem = 1  			end 		else 			set @addedItem = 0 	 end       -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       if @reconfig <> 1 and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @isetId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView                   if @fromSet = 1 or @fromComputer = 1       exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @computerId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    if (@@error != 0) 	rollback transaction    else 	commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@ijob int, @icondition int, @itask int, @isetId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_deploy_image_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq		int,    @filename	varchar(254),    @localStore	smallint,    @commandLine	varchar(512),    @removeBW	smallint,    @removeOEM	smallint,    @srcId		int,    @postConfig  smallint,    @prepareSysprep smallint, -- PRD item 7.1.68 & 7.1.21    @answerfilepath   varchar(261), -- PRD item 7.1.68 & 7.1.21   @standardAnswerFile smallint, -- PRD item 7.1.68 & 7.1.21   @bootoption_id int = null,    --PRD item 7.1.1 PXE pre boot option   @run_rdeployt int = 0, --PRD item 7.1.104 Run RDeploy mode   @bootimage_arch int = 0,   @mass_storage_filepath varchar(261), --Sysprep mass storage file path.   @isDeployAnywhere int = 0 ,   @ghostCastcommandLine varchar(512) = NULL as    begin transaction     update image_task set image_file=@filename, local_store=@localStore,        addl_cmdline=@commandLine, remove_bw=@removeBW, remove_cpq=@removeOEM,       src_comp_id=@srcId, sysprepped = @prepareSysprep, answerfilepath = @answerfilepath, standard_answerfile = @standardAnswerFile, imaging_tool_id = @run_rdeployt,       mass_storage_filepath = @mass_storage_filepath, deploy_any_where = @isDeployAnywhere,ghcastsrv_cmdline = @ghostCastcommandLine    where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq         update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch = @bootimage_arch where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    if ( @prepareSysprep = 0 )     delete  from sysprep_answers where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    -- check for existing configure task    declare @reconfig smallint    declare @configCount int    declare @configTask int    select @configTask = min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @jobId        and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq > @taskSeq    select @reconfig = reconfig from config_task where event_id=@jobId      and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@configTask    set @configCount = @@rowcount     -- alter task IDs to make room for hidden config    declare @nextTask int    select @nextTask = min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @jobId       and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq > @taskSeq    if @postConfig = 1 and @reconfig = 1 and @nextTask = @taskSeq + 1    begin       update task set task_seq = task_seq + 1 where event_id = @jobId           and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq > @taskSeq    end    -- add hidden config task    declare @configSetId   int    if @postConfig = 1 and (@configCount = 0 or @reconfig = 1)    begin              -- add new config set       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1       select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_set where config_set_id =           (select max(config_set_id) from config_set)       if @configSetId is null          set @configSetId = 3000001       else          set @configSetId = @configSetId + 1       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 14)       insert into config_set          (config_set_id, use_existing_data) values (@configSetId, 1)       insert into config_task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, config_set_id, reconfig)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, @configSetId, null)    end    -- remove hidden config if not doing post configure    else if @postConfig = 0 and @configCount = 1 and (@reconfig is null or @reconfig = 0)    begin       select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task where event_id = @jobId           and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq = @configTask       delete from task where event_id = @jobId and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq = @configTask       delete from config_set where config_set_id = @configSetId    end     -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction    -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @filename varchar, @localStore smallint, @commandLine varchar, @removeBW smallint, @removeOEM smallint, @srcId int, @postConfig smallint, @prepareSysprep smallint, @answerfilepath varchar, @standardAnswerFile smallint, @bootoption_id int, @run_rdeployt int, @bootimage_arch int, @mass_storage_filepath varchar, @isDeployAnywhere int, @ghostCastcommandLine varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', 			'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') 	 update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           	where config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic 	@computer_id int, 	@mac_addr varchar(36), 	@ip_use_dhcp smallint, 	@ip_domain varchar(128), 	@ip_dns varchar(512), 	@ip_wins varchar(512), 	@nic_pci_bus int, 	@nic_pci_device int, 	@nic_pci_function int, 	@nic_device_id int, 	@nic_vendor_id int, 	@nic_desc varchar(64), 	@nic_location varchar(64), 	@interface_id int, 	@id int, 	@nic_id int, 	@name varchar(64), 	@ip varchar(16), 	@mask varchar(16), 	@gateway varchar(16), 	@broadcast varchar(16), 	@state int 	 as 	begin 		update nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, 									 nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, 									 nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, 									 nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, 									 nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, 									 nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, 									 nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, 									 nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, 									 nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, 									 nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, 									 nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, 									 nics.nic_location = @nic_location 											where nics.computer_id = @computer_id  		update  nic_interface set					 nic_interface.id = @id, 									 nic_interface.name = @name, 									 nic_interface.ip = @ip, 									 nic_interface.mask = @mask, 									 nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, 									 nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, 									 nic_interface.state = @state 										where  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_use_dhcp smallint, @ip_domain varchar, @ip_dns varchar, @ip_wins varchar, @nic_pci_bus int, @nic_pci_device int, @nic_pci_function int, @nic_device_id int, @nic_vendor_id int, @nic_desc varchar, @nic_location varchar, @interface_id int, @id int, @nic_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @mask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId		int,    @condition		int,     @task		int,     @computerId		int,     @nicId		int,    @domainSuffix	varchar(128),    @ipMethod		smallint,     @wins		varchar(512),    @dns			varchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId		int,    @condition		int,     @task		int,     @computerId		int,    @nicId		int,    @interfaceId		int,    @ip			varchar(16) = null,    @netmask		varchar(16) = null,    @gateway		varchar(16) = null,    @broadcast		varchar(16) = null,    @name		varchar(64) = null,    @state		int = null,    @last		smallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set    @jobId		int = null,    @condition		int = null,     @task		int = null,    @configSetId		int = null,    @nicId		int,    @domainSuffix	varchar(128),    @ipMethod		smallint,     @wins		varchar(512),    @dns			varchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_set record       begin transaction          update nic_config_set set ip_method = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp,wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_set_id = @configSetId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface    @nicId		int,    @interfaceId		int,    @last		smallint = 0,    @jobId		int = null,    @condition		int = null,     @task		int = null,    @configSetId		int = null,    @ip			varchar(16) = null,    @netmask		varchar(16) = null,    @gateway		varchar(16) = null,    @broadcast		varchar(16) = null,    @name		varchar(64) = null,    @state		int = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@nicId int, @interfaceId int, @last smallint, @jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_task_order    @jobId		int,    @conditionId	int,    @taskId1		int,    @taskId2		int as    -- get a temporary task id    declare @tempTaskId   int    select @tempTaskId = max(task_seq) from task where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@conditionId    set @tempTaskId = @tempTaskId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary task id 	   update task set task_seq=@tempTaskId where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id 	   update task set task_seq=@taskId1 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@taskId2 	 	   -- replace the temporary task id with the swap id 	   update task set task_seq=@taskId2 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId and task_seq=@tempTaskId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else 	  commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId int, @taskId1 int, @taskId2 int)

Object_Definition: -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_upd_taskusers  @userName varchar(128), @oldPassword varchar(128), @newPassword varchar(128) as  declare @updatedRecords  int  set @updatedRecords =0  update    script_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update    copyfile_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update   install_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  update   capture_pct_task set       password = @newPassword where     (password = @oldPassword  and username = @userName)  set @updatedRecords = @updatedRecords  + @@ROWCOUNT  select @updatedRecords
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@userName varchar, @oldPassword varchar, @newPassword varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_user    @user int,    @username varchar(100),    @fullName varchar(128),    @description varchar(128),    @password varchar(100) = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security as    declare @userId int    select @userId = [user_id] from securityuser where [user_id] = @user    declare @duplicate varchar(64)     --set @duplicate = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    --select @duplicate = [name] from securityuser where [user_id] != @user and [name] = @username       -- update user      --if @duplicate is  null    --begin    if @userId is not null    begin       declare @domain varchar(50)       select @domain = domain from securityuser where [user_id] = @userId        if len(@domain) > 0       begin          -- only the description can be edited for domain accounts          update securityuser set [description] = @description where [user_id] = @userId       end       else       begin 			if len(@password) >0 			begin          update securityuser set [name] = @username, fullname = @fullName, [description] = @description,             [password] = @password where [user_id] = @userId       end 			else 			begin 				update securityuser set [name] = @username, fullname = @fullName, [description] = @description 					where [user_id] = @userId 			end 		end    end   --end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user int, @username varchar, @fullName varchar, @description varchar, @password varchar)

Object_Definition: --37092 AD User is not getting administrative rights if he is a member of two AD Groups create procedure dbo.wc_upd_user_as_hidden    @aduser varchar(100),    @domain varchar(50) as	 	update securityuser set ad_user=2 	where ([name] = @aduser or upnname= @aduser) and ( upper(domain) = upper(@domain) or upper(netbiosdomain) = upper(@domain) ) and ad_user<>0
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@aduser varchar, @domain varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_upd_x_task_bootoption  as   -- bug #37981 : use defalult boot option id /*	update x_task  	set bootoption_id = coalesce(b.bootoption_id,1)   	from x_task xt, x_boot_options xb left outer join boot_options b  		on xb.bootoption_type = b.bootoption_type and 		lower(xb.pxe_description) = lower(b.pxe_description) 	where xt.bootoption_id = xb.bootoption_id */ --Bug #41171: Changes suggested by Stan if object_id ('x_task') is not null              update x_task set bootoption_id = 129                         where bootoption_id is null and (task_type = 13 or task_type = 15 or task_type = 17)                                     and exists (select bootoption_id from boot_options where bootoption_id = 129)     if object_id ('x_script_task') is not null and object_id ('x_task') is not null             update x_task set bootoption_id = 129 from x_task t, x_script_task st                          where t.event_id = st.event_id and t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq and t.task_seq = st.task_seq                                      and bootoption_id is null and task_type = 10 and execution_mode = 0                                     and exists (select bootoption_id from boot_options where bootoption_id = 129)     if object_id ('x_task') is not null  update x_task set bootoption_id = 1              where bootoption_id not in (select bootoption_id from boot_options where bootoption_id < 160)                                     and bootoption_id > 1

create procedure wc_update_vm    @vm_id int,    @host_id int,    @vc varchar(256) as    declare @vc_id int        if @host_id = 0       select @host_id = null           select @vc_id = virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc        update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id = @vc_id, virtual_machine_host_id = @host_id        where computer_id = @vm_id     select 1
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@vm_id int, @host_id int, @vc varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_update_vm_host    @host_id int,    @vc varchar(256) as    declare @vc_id int        select @vc_id = virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc        if @vc_id is not null    begin       update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id = @vc_id          where computer_id = @host_id       select 1    end    else       select 0
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@host_id int, @vc varchar)

Object_Definition: create view [dbo].[application_view]  as select 	app.computer_id, 	app.app_id, 	(case    	when  app.name like '{%}' and app.description is not null and app.description !='' then app.description   	else app.name 	end) as [name], 	app.description,  	app.publisher,  	app.version,  	app.product_id, 	app.sys_comp from 	application app

create view history_restore_view as select 	h.history_id, 	h.computer_id, 	h.event_id, 	h.event_name, 	h.[sequence], 	h.task_type, 	h.[filename], 	(select max (s.complete_time) from status_log s where s.history_id = h.history_id and s.status_code = 0) as complete_time from 	history h

--create view [dbo].[history_view] as (select * from history union select * from history_archive)          --Added a new column for Re-deploy computer 		 create view [dbo].[history_view] as (select history_id,computer_id,event_id,event_name,[sequence],task_type,[filename],xml_task,complete_time,app_id,[_nslastsent],cond_seq,redeploy  from history union select history_id,computer_id,event_id,event_name,[sequence],task_type,[filename],xml_task,complete_time,app_id,[_nslastsent],cond_seq,redeploy  from history_archive)

create view sched_status_view as select log_id,schedule_id,history_id,[level],status,complete_time,status_code,[module] from	status_log union  select log_id,schedule_id,history_id,[level],status,complete_time,status_code,[module] from	status_log_archive

--create view [dbo].[status_log_view] as (select * from status_log union select * from status_log_archive)    create view [dbo].[status_log_view] as (select log_id,computer_id,schedule_id,history_id,[level],module,status,status_code,schedule_time,[user_id],complete_time,return_code_result,system_logon_user_id,user_log from status_log union select log_id,computer_id,schedule_id,history_id,[level],module,status,status_code,schedule_time,[user_id],complete_time,return_code_result,system_logon_user_id,user_log from status_log_archive)  -- -- PRD 7.1.15 added return_code_result

create view dbo.tsk_type as 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'reboot_task' as tsk_type from reboot_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'registry_task' as tsk_type from registry_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'script_task' as tsk_type from script_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'install_task' as tsk_type from install_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'image_task' as tsk_type from image_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'copyfile_task' as tsk_type from copyfile_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'config_task' as tsk_type from config_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'capture_pct_task' as tsk_type from capture_pct_task 	union 	select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, 'unattended_install_task' as tsk_type from unattended_install_task

Object_Definition: create function fn_get_comparable_ip (  @ip varchar(15) ) returns bigint as begin  	declare @ip_part1 bigint 	declare @ip_part2 bigint 	declare @ip_part3 bigint 	declare @ip_part4 bigint 	declare @first_dot_pos smallint 	declare @second_dot_pos smallint 	declare @third_dot_pos smallint  	set @first_dot_pos = charindex('.', @ip) 	if @first_dot_pos = 0 		return cast(@ip as bigint)  	set @second_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@first_dot_pos + 1) 	set @third_dot_pos = charindex('.',@ip,@second_dot_pos + 1)  	set @ip_part4 = cast(substring(@ip, @third_dot_pos + 1, len(@ip)) as bigint)  	if(@first_dot_pos!=0) 	begin 		set @ip_part1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) 		set @ip_part2 = cast(substring(@ip, @first_dot_pos + 1, @second_dot_pos - @first_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) 		set @ip_part3 = cast(substring(@ip, @second_dot_pos + 1, @third_dot_pos - @second_dot_pos - 1) as bigint) 	end  	return @ip_part1 * 1000000000 + @ip_part2 * 1000000 + @ip_part3 * 1000 + @ip_part4  end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: ( bigint OUT, @ip varchar)

Object_Definition: create function SplitIDs (  @OrderList varchar(8000) ) returns @ParsedList table (  ID int ) as begin 	declare @OrderID varchar(10), @Pos int  	set @OrderList = ltrim(rtrim(@OrderList))+ ',' 	set @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1)  	if replace(@OrderList, ',', '') <> '' 	begin 		while @Pos > 0 		begin 			set @OrderID = ltrim(rtrim(left(@OrderList, @Pos - 1))) 			if @OrderID <> '' 			begin 			insert into @ParsedList (ID) 			values (cast(@OrderID as int)) --Use Appropriate conversion 		end  		set @OrderList = right(@OrderList, len(@OrderList) - @Pos) 		set @Pos = charindex(',', @OrderList, 1) 	end end  return end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@OrderList varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.complete_schedule 	@schedule_id     int, 	@exit_code       int, 	@status_code     int, 	@exit_module     smallint, 	@next_start_time datetime, 	@current_time    datetime, 	@status          varchar( 256 ), 	@level           smallint, 	@next_task_seq   int,	 -- this is ignored if @next_start_time is not null 	@taskresult      int as 	begin transaction  	-- first insert stuff into the log data 	exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, 0, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult  	-- now insert and fix up history for this item 	exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id  	-- update the event schedule table 	if( @next_start_time is null ) 	begin 	   -- Right now we never want to leave the next_task_seq as null for a completed schedule. 	   -- If it is null, set it to whatever the last sequence was 	   if( @next_task_seq is null ) 	   begin 	      select @next_task_seq = next_task_seq 	         from event_schedule 	   	     where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	   end  		DECLARE @called_status varchar(MAX),                 @calling_id    int,                 @dependent_id  int  		SELECT    @calling_id = calling_event             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  		SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id             FROM  event_schedule             WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  		IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) 		BEGIN 			DECLARE @event_name    varchar(128) 			SELECT  @event_name = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN') 				FROM event          AS e 				JOIN event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id 				WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  			IF (@status_code = 0) 			BEGIN 				SELECT @called_status = 'Called Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status 				-- insert status_log for calling schedule 				exec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult 				-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule 				exec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id 				-- clear dependent schedule id and set success status for calling schedule 				UPDATE    event_schedule 					SET   status = @called_status, 						  dep_schedule_id = NULL 					WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id 			END 			ELSE IF (@status_code = 1) 			BEGIN 				SELECT @called_status = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @event_name + '] Returned: ' + @status 				-- insert status_log for calling schedule 				exec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @called_status, @status_code, @exit_code, @exit_module, @level, @taskresult 				-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule 				exec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id 				-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task table 				UPDATE    es 					SET   status = @called_status, 						  status_code = 1, 						  dep_schedule_id = NULL, 						  next_task_seq = nts.next_task_seq, 						  end_time = @current_time 					FROM  event_schedule AS es 					JOIN ( 						SELECT s.schedule_id, MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq, t.cond_seq 							FROM script_task AS t 							JOIN event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id 							WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq 							GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq 						 ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq 					WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id 				-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task table 				UPDATE es 					SET status = @called_status, 						status_code = 1, 						dep_schedule_id = NULL, 						end_time = @current_time 					FROM event_schedule AS es 					WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id AND es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  				IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL) 					EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' 			END 		END  	   -- this event is not supposed to recur, all done        update event_schedule             set status_code = @status_code, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module,                 status = @status, end_time = @current_time, next_task_seq = @next_task_seq, config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  }             where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	end 	else 	begin 		-- this event will recur, update the status and set the new start time 		update event_schedule 			set status_code = null, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module, 				start_time = @next_start_time, status = @status, end_time = @current_time, 				next_task_seq = null, cond_seq = null, dep_schedule_id = null,  -- these should be re-evaluated every time, set to null 				config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null  } 			where schedule_id = @schedule_id 			 			delete from computer_state where  schedule_id = @schedule_id 	end  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @exit_code int, @status_code int, @exit_module smallint, @next_start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @level smallint, @next_task_seq int, @taskresult int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.ins_cookie 	@computer_id	int, 	@name			varchar (32), 	@value			varchar (2048) as 	begin transaction   	if (@value is null or @value = '') 	begin 		delete from dbo.cookies where computer_id = @computer_id and [name] = @name 	end 	else 	begin 		if exists (select computer_id from dbo.cookies where computer_id = @computer_id and lower ([name]) = lower (@name)) 		begin 			update cookies set value = @value where computer_id = @computer_id and [name] = @name 		end 		else 		begin 			insert into dbo.cookies (computer_id, [name], [value])  				values (@computer_id, @name, @value) 		end 	end  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_folder_by_id    @folder_name   varchar(64),    @folder_id     int,    @parent_id     int = null as    declare @folder_id_in_use int,            @temp_parent_id int,            @temp_folder_name varchar(64)     select @folder_id_in_use = folder_id, @temp_parent_id = parent_id, @temp_folder_name = [name] from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id     if (@folder_id_in_use is null)    begin       -- the folder id is not in use just create it       insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @parent_id, @folder_name)    end    else    begin       -- the folder id is in use --      if (@temp_folder_name = @folder_name and (@temp_parent_id = @parent_id or (@temp_parent_id is null and @parent_id is null)))       if (@temp_parent_id = @parent_id or (@temp_parent_id is null and @parent_id is null))       begin          -- the id is being used as a system id, done          return       end       else       begin  -- the system id is being used by a non system folder          declare @new_id int           begin transaction          exec @new_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'           -- give existing folder new id          update event_folder set folder_id = @new_id where folder_id = @folder_id          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return          end           -- add the new system folder          insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @parent_id, @folder_name)          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return          end           commit transaction       end    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@folder_name varchar, @folder_id int, @parent_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_history_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @task_seq      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @schedule_id   int as    declare @history_id int     --Dayakar DE-Enhanced Altiris SDK    declare @app_id int     select @app_id = app_id from event_schedule_info where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	 	if (@app_id is null) 		set @app_id = 0     if exists (select event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_install_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from image_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_image_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from unattended_install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_unattended_install_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_config_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from capture_pct_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_capture_pct_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from deploy_anywhere_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_deploy_anywhere_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_script_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from reboot_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_reboot_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_copyfile_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from registry_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_registry_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_wait_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end     --HLS PRD#7.1.11 {    -- we dont have a "task_table" for Get inventory, thats why we are using task table to find out if the event_id represents a Get inventory task    if exists (select event_id from task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_type = 19)    begin       exec @history_id = ins_history_get_inventory_task @computer_id, @event_id, @task_seq, @cond_seq, @app_id       goto status    end    --}  status:    -- update all status_log records that correspond to this history entry    if (@history_id != 0)    begin       begin transaction       update status_log set history_id = @history_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id and history_id is null       if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          return 0       end        commit transaction    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @task_seq int, @cond_seq int, @schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_live_event_status    @comp_id int,    @task_type int,    @event_name varchar(128),    @status varchar(256),    @status_code int,    @current_time    datetime,    @module smallint,    @level smallint,    @user_id int = 0,    @system_user_id int = 0,    @redeploy int = 0  as       declare @user_name varchar(128)     declare @full_name varchar(128)     declare @domain varchar(128)     declare @user_log varchar(256)     declare @his_id int    begin transaction    if(@user_id != 0 )     begin 	select @user_name = name, @domain = netbiosdomain, @full_name = fullname from securityuser where [user_id] = @user_id               select @user_log = 'user=' + @user_name +' ' + 'domain='+@domain + ' ' + 'fullname=' + @full_name     end     exec @his_id = sel_next_system_id 'HISTORY_ID'    if(@his_id != 0)    begin    	insert into history  				(	history_id,  					computer_id,  					event_name,  					task_type, 					redeploy )  				values  				(	@his_id,  					@comp_id,  					@event_name,  					@task_type, 					@redeploy )               -- Live event schedule id is logged as 1 for identification 	insert into status_log  		(	computer_id,  			schedule_id,  			history_id,  			status,  			status_code,  			schedule_time,  			module,  			complete_time,  			level, 			[user_id],  			system_logon_user_id, 			user_log )  		values  		(	@comp_id,  			1,  			@his_id, 			@status, 			@status_code,  			@current_time,  			@module, 			@current_time,  			@level,  			@user_id,  			@system_user_id,  			@user_log )    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@comp_id int, @task_type int, @event_name varchar, @status varchar, @status_code int, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @user_id int, @system_user_id int, @redeploy int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_locale_info 	@computer_id int, 	@user_index int, 	@lang_id int, 	@locale_id int, 	@time_zone_bias int, 	@oem_cp int, 	@ansi_cp int, 	@oslang_id int = 0  as 	begin transaction  	if not (@oslang_id = 0 AND EXISTS (select * from [locale_info] where  	computer_id = @computer_id)) 	begin  		-- first we need to delete any existing values 		if (@user_index is null) 			delete from [locale_info] where computer_id = @computer_id and user_index is null 		else 			delete from [locale_info] where computer_id = @computer_id and user_index = @user_index  		-- now insert the new values 		insert into [locale_info] 			( computer_id, user_index, lang_id, locale_id, time_zone_bias, oem_cp, ansi_cp,os_langid  ) 			values 			( @computer_id, @user_index, @lang_id, @locale_id, @time_zone_bias, @oem_cp, @ansi_cp,@oslang_id )  	end 	-- Check for error and commit or roll back the transaction 	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.ins_new_event_schedule 	@computer_id int, 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@next_task_seq int, 	@start_time datetime, 	@status_code int, 	@calling_sched_id int = null as 	declare @new_schedule_id int 	--bug fix 25835 	declare @windowsuser_id int 	set @windowsuser_id =0  	begin transaction 	exec @new_schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'  	if (@calling_sched_id is not null) 	begin         	update event_schedule 		set start_time = dateadd(minute, 1, @start_time) 		where computer_id = @computer_id 			and start_time <= @start_time 			and status_code is null 			and dep_schedule_id is null  		update event_schedule 		set dep_schedule_id = @new_schedule_id 			where schedule_id = @calling_sched_id 	end  	insert into event_schedule ( 				schedule_id, 				computer_id, 				event_id, 				cond_seq, 				next_task_seq, 				start_time, 				status_code, 				calling_event 			   ) 	values	( 				@new_schedule_id, 				@computer_id, 				@event_id, 				null, 				@next_task_seq, 				@start_time, 				@status_code, 				@calling_sched_id 			   )     --Bug Fix #25835 showing Windows Login User 	select @windowsuser_id = windows_user_id from event_schedule_info where schedule_id = @calling_sched_id 	  insert into  event_schedule_info 		( schedule_id, windows_user_id ) 	  values         ( @new_schedule_id, @windowsuser_id)      -----------------     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return -1    end     commit transaction     return @new_schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @cond_seq int, @next_task_seq int, @start_time datetime, @status_code int, @calling_sched_id int)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure ins_new_snmp_enclosure   @name varchar(64),   @manuf varchar(64),   @model varchar(64),   @ip_address varchar(20),   @community varchar(256),   @rack_name varchar(64) as   declare @enclosure_id as int,           @tran int,           @status int,           @rack_id int,           @org_name varchar(64)    set @tran = @@trancount    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    select @rack_id=rack_id from physical_rack where name=@rack_name    if(@rack_id is null)   begin     exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'      insert into physical_rack(rack_id, name, real_name, manuf_rack)       values(@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, 1)   end    select @enclosure_id=enclosure_id, @org_name=name from physical_enclosure where manuf=@manuf and model=@model       and ip_address=@ip_address and community=@community and rack_id=@rack_id    if (@enclosure_id is null)   begin     exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'      insert into physical_enclosure(enclosure_id, name, real_name, manuf, model, ip_address, community, rack_id)       values(@enclosure_id, @name, @name, @manuf, @model, @ip_address, @community, @rack_id)      set @status = 1   end   else   begin     if(@org_name = @name)       set @status = 0     else     begin       set @status = 2       update physical_enclosure set name=@name, real_name=@name where enclosure_id=@enclosure_id     end   end    if (@@error != 0)   begin     if (@tran = 0)       rollback transaction   end    if (@tran = 0)   begin     commit transaction     select @enclosure_id, @status   end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @manuf varchar, @model varchar, @ip_address varchar, @community varchar, @rack_name varchar)
