Object_Definition: create procedure ins_nic_interface    @id int,    @nic_id int,    @interface_id int, 		 -- -1 means use existing    @name varchar( 64 ) = null,    @ip varchar( 16 ) = null,    @netmask varchar( 16 ) = null,    @gateway varchar( 16 ) = null,    @broadcast varchar( 16 ) = null,    @state int = null as    declare @last_id int    declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     if( -1 = @interface_id )    begin       -- we don't have an existing id, just insert the data and let SQL generate one       insert into nic_interface          ( [id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state )          values          ( @id, @nic_id, @name, @ip, @netmask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state )        -- save the inserted identity so we can return it       set @last_id = @@identity    end    else    begin       -- update the data       update nic_interface  	     set [id] = @id, nic_id = @nic_id,              [name] = @name, ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,  			broadcast = @broadcast, state = @state          where interface_id = @interface_id              -- the last identity was passed in but return it anyway       set @last_id = @interface_id    end     if( @@error != 0 )    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return -1    end    else    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          commit transaction       return @last_id    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int, @nic_id int, @interface_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_nic_interface_for_init_deploy    @computer_id		int as 	begin transaction  	if not exists (select computer_id from nics where computer_id = @computer_id) 		insert into nics (computer_id, nic_id) values (@computer_id, 0)  	delete nic_interface where [id] = @computer_id  	update nics 		set ip_use_dhcp = nci.ip_use_dhcp, 			ip_domain = nci.ip_domain, 			ip_dns = nci.ip_dns, 			ip_wins = nci.ip_wins 		from nics n, nic_config_item nci 		where n.computer_id = @computer_id 			and n.nic_id = nci.nic_id  	insert nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state) 		select @computer_id, nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state 		from nic_interface where [id] = (select config_item_id from config_item where target_computer_id = @computer_id)  	if @@error = 0 		commit transaction 	else 		rollback transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_redeploy_event    @computer_id   int,    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    declare @new_time         datetime,            @schedule_id      int,            @max_history_id   int,            @bootoption_id    int     set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @start_time)     begin transaction     update event_schedule       set start_time = @new_time       where computer_id = @computer_id           and start_time <= @start_time           and status_code = null     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'     if (@schedule_id = 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     select @max_history_id = max(history_id) from history_view where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into event_schedule       (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, cond_seq, next_task_seq, start_time, redeploy_history_id, rip_replace_event)    values       (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, null, 0, @start_time, @max_history_id, 1)     select top 1 @bootoption_id=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq    if(@bootoption_id = 1 or @bootoption_id is null)    begin      exec @bootoption_id=sel_default_bootoption_id    end     select @bootoption_id as bootoption_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @event_id int, @start_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_registry_task    @event_id   int,    @cond_seq   int,    @task_seq   int,    @directory   varchar(254),    @upload      smallint,    @local_dir   varchar(254) = null,    @include_user   smallint = null,    @bootoption_id int = null,  --added for restoring boot option id    @bootoption_cpu_arch int = 0 as    declare @retval   int    begin transaction     --exec @retval = ins_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     if (@retval = 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     insert into registry_task       (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, directory, upload, local_dir, include_user)    values       (@event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @directory, @upload, @local_dir, @include_user)     --added for restoring boot option id    update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch = @bootoption_cpu_arch where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @directory varchar, @upload smallint, @local_dir varchar, @include_user smallint, @bootoption_id int, @bootoption_cpu_arch int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_reject_computer    @computer_id   int as    begin transaction     delete from reject_computer where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into reject_computer       ( computer_id, [name], serial_num, asset_tag, wol_support )       select computer_id, [name], serial_num, asset_tag, wol_support          from computer          where computer_id = @computer_id     insert into reject_mac_addrs (computer_id, mac_addr, ip_address)       select n.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address          from nics n             left outer join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.[id] = @computer_id )          where computer_id = @computer_id and mac_addr is not null     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 1    end     commit transaction     select n.mac_addr       from nics n       where n.computer_id = @computer_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_schedule_status    @schedule_id     int,    @current_time    datetime,    @status          varchar(254),    @status_code     smallint,    @exit_code       int,    @exit_module     smallint,    @level           smallint = 0,    --PRD 7.1.15    @taskresult  int = 0 as    declare @level_value smallint     --PRD#7.1.58 , LB#28522      declare @system_user_id int   --[ user logging changes     declare @user_name varchar(128)     declare @full_name varchar(128)     declare @domain varchar(128)     declare @user_log varchar(256)     declare @user_id int   --]     if ( @level != 0 )       select @level_value = @level    else    begin       if ( @status_code > 0 )          select @level_value = 3       else          select @level_value = 1    end     -- don't report server control values, just positive values    if ( @status_code < 0 ) 	  select @exit_code = null, @status_code = null     -- check for the exact same status string reported    --    previously and skip it if found    declare @last_status    varchar(256)    declare @last_code      int    select top 1 @last_status = status, @last_code = status_code from status_log       where schedule_id = @schedule_id order by complete_time desc    if ( @last_status = @status and ( ( @last_code is null and @exit_code is null ) or ( @last_code = @exit_code ) ) )       return      declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction    --PRD#7.1.58 , LB#28522   set @system_user_id =0   select @system_user_id = windows_user_id from event_schedule_info where schedule_id = @schedule_id   --PRD#7.1.58 , LB#28522   --[ user logging changes     set @user_id = 0      select @user_id = user_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if(@user_id != 0 )     begin 	select @user_name = name, @domain = netbiosdomain, @full_name = fullname from securityuser where user_id = @user_id               select @user_log = 'user=' + @user_name + ' ' + 'domain='+@domain+ ' ' + 'fullname=' + @full_name     end   --]     insert into status_log       (  computer_id,          schedule_id,          status,          status_code,          [module],          [level],          [user_id],          schedule_time,          complete_time, 	 --PRD 7.1.15 	     return_code_result, 	 --PRD#7.1.58 , LB#28522          system_logon_user_id,          user_log 	 )    select       computer_id,       schedule_id,       @status,       @exit_code,       @exit_module,       @level_value,       user_id,       start_time,       @current_time,       --PRD 7.1.15       @taskresult,       --PRD#7.1.58 , LB#28522       @system_user_id,       @user_log       from          event_schedule       where          schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     if (@tran = 0)       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)

Object_Definition: create procedure ins_session    @computer_id   int,    @engine_id     int,    @engine_ip     varchar(32),    @last_update   datetime,    @client_ip	  varchar(32),    @platform	  smallint,     @boot_env	  smallint  -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes } as    declare  @session_id    int     select @session_id = session_id from sessions where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@session_id is null)    begin       if (@engine_ip) is not null       begin          begin transaction           exec @session_id = sel_next_system_id 'SESSION_ID'           if (@session_id = 0)          begin             rollback transaction             return 0          end           insert into sessions             (session_id, computer_id, engine_id, address, last_update, client_ip, platform, boot_env) -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }          values             (@session_id, @computer_id, @engine_id, @engine_ip, @last_update, @client_ip, @platform, @boot_env) -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }           if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction          else             commit transaction       end       else       begin          set @session_id = 0       end    end    else     begin    -- Update sessions value, if it is not deleted from database due to any reasons.       update sessions set computer_id = @computer_id,engine_id=@engine_id,address=@engine_ip,last_update=@last_update,client_ip=@client_ip,platform=@platform,boot_env=@boot_env 	  where session_id = @session_id    end     return @session_id

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure ins_snmp_blade   @mac_addr1 varchar(36),   @mac_addr2 varchar(36),   @ip_addr1 varchar(20),   @ip_addr2 varchar(20),   @serial_num varchar(64),   @manuf  varchar(128),   @model_num varchar(64),   @prod_name varchar(128),   @physical_enclosure_id int,   @idx int,   @cpu_count int,   @cpu_speed int,   @cpu_desc varchar(128),   @ram_total int,   @bios_ver varchar(64) as declare @computer_id int,           @interface_id int,           @bay_id int,           @tran int,           @change_method int,           @old_computer_id int,           @need_update int,           @event_id int,           @initial_event_id int,           @computer_name varchar(64),           @new_time datetime,           @time datetime,           @schedule_id int,           @bootoption int    set @tran = @@trancount   set @need_update = 0   set @bootoption = NULL    if (@tran = 0)     begin transaction    -- check first if we already have a bay and a computer (RIP&Replace stuff!)   select distinct @computer_id=computer_id from nics where mac_addr = @mac_addr1 or mac_addr = @mac_addr2    select @bay_id=bay_id, @change_method=change_method, @old_computer_id=computer_id, @event_id=event_id,  	@initial_event_id=initial_event_id  	from physical_bay  	where enclosure_id = @physical_enclosure_id and idx = @idx    if(@bay_id is not null)   begin     -- we already have the bay; lets see if it is a virtual one     if(@initial_event_id is not null)     begin       -- the bay, the blade has been plugged in is a virtual one!       set @need_update = 1        -- the inserted blade has been assigned to another bay in the past => remove all identification, but store the history       if (@computer_id is not null)       begin         delete from nics where computer_id = @computer_id         update computer set asset_tag = null, serial_num = null, uuid = null, status = null, icon = 1           where computer_id = @computer_id       end 	  else 	  begin 		if (@old_computer_id is not null and @initial_event_id is not null) 		begin 			delete from nics where computer_id = @old_computer_id 			update computer set asset_tag = null, serial_num = null, uuid = null, status = null, icon = 1 				where computer_id = @old_computer_id 		end 	  end        -- update the virtual bay with the hardware information we received from the new blade       update computer set asset_tag=null, serial_num=@serial_num, uuid=null, status=null, icon=1, manuf=@manuf, hidden=null,            model_num=@model_num, prod_name=@prod_name, processor_count=@cpu_count, bios_version=@bios_ver where computer_id=@old_computer_id        if(@initial_event_id = 0)       begin         -- just send a wait with the default boot option         exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id         select 2 as change_method, @old_computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption       end       else       begin         -- we have a pre-defined job for this bay, let's schedule it         -- reschedule any events that might be already scheduled for this computer to run after the rule event.           set @time = getdate()           set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @time)            update event_schedule set start_time = @new_time where computer_id = @old_computer_id                                                             and start_time <= @time and status_code is null            select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule where event_id = @initial_event_id and @old_computer_id = computer_id           if (@schedule_id is null)           begin             exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'             insert into event_schedule (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, start_time, next_task_seq)               values (@schedule_id, @old_computer_id, @initial_event_id, @time, 0)           end           else           begin             update event_schedule set start_time = @time, status = null, status_code = null,                                     end_time = null, broker_time = null, cond_seq = null, next_task_seq = 0                                   where schedule_id = @initial_event_id           end           -- make sure that we have a computer name, otherwise just use the mac as name => bug #37925           update computer set name=@mac_addr1, computer_name=@mac_addr1 where computer_id=@old_computer_id and (computer_name is null or computer_name = '')            -- get the boot environment           select top 1 @bootoption=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@initial_event_id order by task_seq           if(@bootoption = 1 or @bootoption is null)           begin             exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id           end            select 1 as change_method, @old_computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption       end        -- update the bay information       update physical_bay set initial_event_id=null, icon=37 where bay_id=@bay_id       set @computer_id = @old_computer_id     end     else     begin       -- the bay is not a virtual one       -- lets check the change methode       if(@change_method < 3)       begin         -- rip & replace (0), select a job (1), wait for user interaction (2)         if (@old_computer_id != @computer_id or @computer_id is null)         begin           if(@old_computer_id is not null)           begin             -- the computer has been associated with another bay             update computer set asset_tag=null, serial_num=@serial_num, uuid=null, status=null, icon=1, manuf=@manuf,               model_num=@model_num, prod_name=@prod_name, processor_count=@cpu_count, bios_version=@bios_ver where computer_id=@old_computer_id              insert into deleted_mac_addrs select mac_addr from nics where computer_id=@old_computer_id             delete from nics where computer_id=@old_computer_id             delete from hardware where computer_id=@old_computer_id             set @need_update = 1           end           if(@computer_id is not null)           begin             delete from nics where computer_id=@computer_id             update computer set asset_tag=null, serial_num=null, uuid=null, status=null, icon=1               where computer_id=@computer_id             set @need_update = 1           end            set @computer_id = @old_computer_id            if(@change_method = 0)           begin             -- redeploy             if((select count(history_id) from history where computer_id=@computer_id) = 0)             begin               -- we don't have a history although we should have => send a wait               update physical_bay set [wait]=1 where computer_id=@computer_id               exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id               select 2 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption             end             else             begin               select @computer_name=computer_name from computer where computer_id=@computer_id               select 0 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, @computer_name as computer_name, 0 as bootoption             end           end            if(@change_method = 1)           begin             -- If Run Event rule             -- reschedule any events that might be already scheduled for this computer to run after the rule event.             set @time = getdate()             set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @time)              update event_schedule set start_time = @new_time where computer_id = @computer_id                                                             and start_time <= @time and status_code is null              select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule where event_id = @event_id and @computer_id = computer_id             if (@schedule_id is null)             begin               exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID'               insert into event_schedule (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, start_time, next_task_seq)                 values (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, @time, 0)             end             else             begin               update event_schedule set start_time = @time, status = null, status_code = null,                                     end_time = null, broker_time = null, cond_seq = null, next_task_seq = 0                                   where schedule_id = @schedule_id             end              -- get the boot environment             select top 1 @bootoption=bootoption_id from task where event_id=@event_id order by task_seq             if(@bootoption = 1 or @bootoption is null)             begin               exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id             end              select 1 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption           end            if(@change_method = 2)           begin             -- wait             update physical_bay set [wait]=1 where computer_id=@computer_id              -- get the default boot environment             exec @bootoption=sel_default_bootoption_id              select 2 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, @bootoption as bootoption           end         end         else         begin           -- the bay includes the same computer as before => just ignore it, no action needed           select 3 as change_method, @computer_id as computer_id, '' as computer_name, 0 as bootoption         end       end        if(@change_method = 3)       begin         -- ignore the change         if (@computer_id is null)         begin           exec @computer_id = sel_next_system_id 'COMPUTER_ID'            if (@computer_id = 0)           begin             rollback transaction             return -1           end           set @need_update = 1           -- insert a new computer record           insert into computer(computer_id, name, computer_name, serial_num, manuf, model_num, prod_name, processor_count, pxe_support, bios_version, node_type)             values(@computer_id, Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[is_need_check_visibility]     @user_id int, 	@obj_id  int AS BEGIN     DECLARE @need_check int     SELECT  @need_check = 1      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM database_info WHERE req_login = 1 AND enforce_visibility = 1)         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securityprivilegelink l                         LEFT JOIN securitygroupmember   m ON m.group_id = l.[user_id]                         WHERE     l.privilege_id = 1 AND @user_id IN (l.[user_id], m.[user_id]) )         SET @need_check = 0     ELSE IF EXISTS ( SELECT TOP 1 1                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                         WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                         AND       p.[object_id] = @obj_id AND p.[allow] > 0 )         SET @need_check = 0      RETURN  @need_check END

Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task]     @schedule_id   int,     @operation_str varchar(64) as begin 	DECLARE   @calling_id   int 	SELECT    @calling_id = calling_event         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id  	DECLARE   @dependent_id   int 	SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @calling_id         AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id  	IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL) 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @failure_code int,                 @exit_code    int, 		        @taskresult   int, 		        @exit_module  smallint, 		        @level        smallint, 		        @current_time datetime         SELECT  @failure_code = 1,                 @exit_code    = 19501,                 @taskresult   = 0,                 @exit_module  = 16,                 @level        = 3,                 @current_time = GETDATE()  		DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @schedule_id  		DECLARE @errstatus   varchar(MAX);         SELECT  @errstatus = 'Failed Because Dependent Job [' + @eventname + '] Was ' + @operation_str 		 		-- insert status_log for calling schedule 		exec ins_schedule_status @calling_id, @current_time, @errstatus, @failure_code, @exit_code, @exit_module,                                  @level, @taskresult  		-- insert and fix up history for calling schedule 		exec ins_history_by_schedule @calling_id 		 		-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is derived from script_task 		UPDATE es             SET status          = @errstatus,                 status_code     = @failure_code,                 dep_schedule_id = NULL,                 next_task_seq   = nts.next_task_seq,                 end_time        = @current_time             FROM event_schedule AS es             JOIN (                 SELECT    s.schedule_id,                           MAX(t.task_seq) AS next_task_seq,                           t.cond_seq                     FROM  script_task    AS t                     JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON t.cond_seq = s.cond_seq AND t.event_id = s.event_id                     WHERE t.task_seq < s.next_task_seq                     GROUP BY s.schedule_id, t.cond_seq                  ) AS nts ON es.schedule_id = nts.schedule_id AND es.cond_seq = nts.cond_seq             WHERE es.schedule_id = @calling_id             AND   es.dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id 		 		-- fail and clear dependent schedule id when next_task_seq is NOT derived from script_task 		UPDATE    event_schedule             SET   status          = @errstatus,                   status_code     = @failure_code,                   dep_schedule_id = NULL,                   end_time        = @current_time             WHERE schedule_id     = @calling_id             AND   dep_schedule_id = @schedule_id          IF (@calling_id IS NOT NULL)             EXEC mm_checkandresolve_schedule_task @calling_id, 'Failed' 	END end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @operation_str varchar)

next_task_seq = NULL, 		    start_time = @start_time, 			status = @status, 			recur_value = @recur_value, 			recur_type = @recur_type, 			defer_mins = @defer, 		    user_id = @user_id, 			status_code = null, 			exit_code = null, 			exit_module = null, 			broker_time = null, 			cond_seq = null, 			config_choice_id = null, 			end_time = null, 			dep_schedule_id = null, 			initial_deployment = null, User 		update  event_schedule_info  			set schedule_id = @new_schedule_id, 				windows_user_id = @winuser_id, 				job_exec_time = null	-- PRD 7.1.49 (Bug Fix #36624) 			where 				schedule_id  = @schedule_id		 		-------------------------------------------			    end     if( @tran = 0 )    begin      if (@@error != 0)         rollback transaction      else         commit transaction    end     return @new_schedule_id

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.mm_upd_sched_dependency    @schedule_id   int,    @schedule_dependent_on int as    declare   @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount    if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction     --begin transaction -- we do a transaction around the whole thing now    update event_schedule        set dep_schedule_id = @schedule_dependent_on       where schedule_id = @schedule_id     --commit transaction    if( 0 = @tran )    begin       if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end

Object_Definition: create procedure mth_check_automation_job    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule es          where ( (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is NULL)             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)            and es.event_id in ( select t.event_id from [task] t left outer join [script_task] st 			on t.event_id = st.event_id  			and t.cond_seq = st.cond_seq  			and t.task_seq = st.task_seq 			where ((t.task_type = 10 and st.execution_mode = 0) 			or t.task_type = 13 			or t.task_type = 15 			or t.task_type = 17 			or t.task_type = 22) )        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure mth_check_current_schedule 	@computer_id	int, 	@schedule_id	int, 	@task_seq		int, 	@boot_env		int as 	declare @return_code  int 	set @return_code = null  	if (@schedule_id = 0) 	begin 		-- The agent thinks there is has not work, lets make sure. 		select top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule es join task t  				on es.event_id = t.event_id 				and es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq 				and es.next_task_seq = t.task_seq 			where computer_id = @computer_id and (es.status_code = -1 or es.status_code = -3) 				and ( ( @boot_env = 1 -- BOOT_AUTOMATION = 1 						and ( t.task_type = 10 						or t.task_type = 11 						or t.task_type = 13 						or t.task_type = 15 						or t.task_type = 17 ) ) 					or  					( @boot_env != 1 ) )  		if (@return_code is null) 			set @return_code = 0 	end 	else 	begin 		-- The agent thinks it is working on a job. 		select top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule 			where computer_id = @computer_id 				and schedule_id = @schedule_id 				and next_task_seq = @task_seq 				and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  		if (@return_code is null) 		begin 			select top 1 @return_code = schedule_id from event_schedule 				where computer_id = @computer_id and status_code < 0 and status_code != -2  			if (@return_code is null) 				set @return_code = 0 -- Agent thinks it has a job, but we don't.  			-- We think it is working on a different job than the agent thinks. 		end 		else 		begin 			-- We are in sync with the agent. 			set @return_code = 0 		end 	end  	return @return_code
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_env int)

if object_id('cond_seqs') is not null delete from cond_seqs        --for each event condition in the initial deployment event       insert into cond_seqs (cond_seq)select distinct cond_seq from x_task where           event_id = 2000001 order by cond_seq        --debug --      select cond_seq from cond_seqs        declare cond_cursor cursor static local for       select distinct cond_seq         from cond_seqs        open cond_cursor        fetch next from cond_cursor         into @cond_seq        while @@fetch_status = 0       begin         --use the condition name         select @name = [name] from x_event_condition where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq 		--create a new job for each condition on the old initial deployment event         exec @event_id = ins_event @name as an initial deployment job         update event set initial_deployment = 1 where event_id = @event_id          --update all the task types         update x_task                    set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_capture_pct_task        set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq 		update x_wait_task               set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_config_task             set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_copyfile_task           set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_image_task              set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_install_task            set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_partition_task          set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_reboot_task             set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_registry_task           set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_script_task             set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_unattended_install_task set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where event_id = 2000001 and cond_seq = @cond_seq         update x_event_condition         set event_id = @event_id, cond_seq = 0 where Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[mth_set_folder_visibility] @user_id int as 	--Check if user is admin 	declare @adminright int 	set @adminright = 1	--admin right  	declare @isadmin int 	declare @do_vis_check int  	set @do_vis_check = 0  	if (select top 1 req_login from database_info) = 1 and (select top 1 enforce_visibility from database_info) = 1 	begin 	declare  @privilege_tablename    varchar(128) 		set @privilege_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 	if object_id('tempdb..' + @privilege_tablename) is not null 		exec ('delete from '+@privilege_tablename) 					 		--LB#74142	 		exec wc_sel_security_right @user_id,@adminright,0, @privilege_tablename 		--exec wc_sel_security_right @user_id,@adminright    		set @isadmin = null 		--select @isadmin = granted from ##wc_last_effective_rights 		declare @strsql nvarchar(128) 		declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500); 		set @strsql = N'select @isadminOut=granted from '+@privilege_tablename;  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@isadminOut int OUTPUT'; 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @isadminOut=@isadmin OUTPUT;  		if (@isadmin > 0) 		begin 			exec mth_set_all_folders_visibility @user_id, 1 		end 		else 		begin 			set @do_vis_check = 1  			--create temp folder table 			declare @folders table (x int identity, folder_id int, processed int default 0, markedvisible int default 0) 			--seed with root folders 			insert into @folders (folder_id)  				select folder_id from event_folder where parent_id is null  			-- add all event folders to @folders 			while @@RowCount > 0 				insert into @folders (folder_id) 				select event_folder.folder_id 				from event_folder 					inner join @folders RecordList on event_folder.parent_id = RecordList.folder_id 					where not exists  					(select * from @folders CurrentRecords where CurrentRecords.folder_id = event_folder.folder_id)  			declare  @permissions_tablename    varchar(128) 			set @permissions_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_permissions' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))  			if object_id('tempdb..' + @permissions_tablename+'') is not null 				exec ('drop table dbo.' + @permissions_tablename ) 			exec ( 'create table dbo.'+ @permissions_tablename + '(permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)')  			--put the root (Jobs) into the group list. It is represented as -10 even though in the db table, event.folder_id it is NULL 			insert into @folders (folder_id) values (-1)  			declare @folder_id int 			declare @actual_visible int 			declare folder_cursor cursor local for select folder_id from @folders order by x desc 			open folder_cursor 			fetch next from folder_cursor into @folder_id 			while @@fetch_status = 0		--for each folder 			begin 				--		for each folder in temp table ordered by leaves first 				--			actual_visible = wc_sel_security_permission 				declare @folder_marked_visible int  --				exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, 80, @folder_id, 0 				-- -1 tells wc_sel_security_permission to match any permission 				--LB#74142 				declare  @tablename    varchar(128) 				set @tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 				exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @folder_id, 0, @tablename							 				--exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @folder_id, 0 		 				set @strsql = N'select @actual_visibleOut=granted from '+@permissions_tablename;  				set @ParmDefinition = N'@actual_visibleOut int OUTPUT'; 				execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @actual_visibleOut=@actual_visible OUTPUT; 				--select @actual_visible = granted from ##wc_last_effective_permissions 				if @actual_visible is null 					set @actual_visible = 0   				select top 1 @folder_marked_visible = markedvisible from @folders where folder_id = @folder_id 				--if folder not markedvisible 				if @folder_marked_visible = 0 or @actual_visible = 1 				begin --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, @actual_visible) 					insert into #job_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, @actual_visible) 				end       else  				begin 					-- set folder.folder_id,visible = 2	 					-- has a child folder that is visible. Don't want to have an orphaned group 					-- setting visible to 2 means that the group will be displayed, but none of its immediate child jobs --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, 2) 					insert into #job_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @folder_id, 2) 				end 				 				--if folder is visible 				if @folder_marked_visible = 1 or @actual_visible = 1 					--set folders parent to markedvisible 					update @folders set markedvisible = 1  						where folder_id in (select parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id)  				fetch next from folder_cursor into @folder_id 			end   			close folder_cursor 			deallocate folder_cursor 		end 	end       else 	begin 		--security not turned on make everything visible woohooo 		exec mth_set_all_folders_visibility @user_id, 1 	end  	return @do_vis_check

 		--select @isadmin = granted from ##wc_last_effective_rights 		if (@isadmin > 0) 		begin 			exec mth_set_all_groups_visibility @user_id, 1 		end 		else 		begin 			set @do_vis_check = 1  			--create temp group table 			declare @groups table (x int identity, group_id int, processed int default 0, markedvisible int default 0) 			--seed with root folders 			insert into @groups (group_id)  				select group_id from computer_group where parent_id is null  			-- add all computer groups to @groups 			while @@RowCount > 0 			insert into @groups (group_id) 			select computer_group.group_id 			from computer_group 				inner join @groups RecordList on computer_group.parent_id = RecordList.group_id 			where not exists (select * from @groups CurrentRecords where CurrentRecords.group_id = computer_group.group_id) 			 			declare  @permissions_tablename    varchar(128) 			set @permissions_tablename = '##wc_last_effective_permissions' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 			if object_id('tempdb..'+@permissions_tablename) is not null 				exec('drop table '+ @permissions_tablename) 			exec ('create table dbo.' + @permissions_tablename + '(permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)')  			--put the root (All Computers) into the group list. It is represented as -1 even though in the computer table it is NULL 			insert into @groups (group_id) values (-1)  			declare @group_id int 			declare @actual_visible int 			declare group_cursor cursor local for select group_id from @groups order by x desc 			open group_cursor 			fetch next from group_cursor into @group_id 			while @@fetch_status = 0		--for each group 			begin 				--		for each group in temp table ordered by leaves first 				--			actual_visible = wc_sel_security_permission 				declare @group_marked_visible int  				-- -1 tells wc_sel_security_permission to match any permission 				--	exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, 80, @group_id, 0 				--LB#74142 				declare  @tablename    varchar(128) 				set @tablename = '##wc_last_effective_rights' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 				exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @group_id, 0, @tablename							 				--exec wc_sel_security_permission @user_id, -1, @group_id, 0 				----------------- 				 				declare @str_sql nvarchar(128) 				declare @Parm_Definition nvarchar(500); 				set @str_sql = N'select @actual_visibleOut=granted from '+@permissions_tablename;  				set @Parm_Definition = N'@actual_visibleOut int OUTPUT'; 				execute sp_executesql @str_sql, @Parm_Definition, @actual_visibleOut=@actual_visible OUTPUT; 				--select @actual_visible = granted from ##wc_last_effective_permissions 				if @actual_visible is null 					set @actual_visible = 0  				select top 1 @group_marked_visible = markedvisible from @groups where group_id = @group_id 				--if group not markedvisible 				if @group_marked_visible = 0 or @actual_visible = 1 				begin 					--	set computer_group.group_id.visible = actual_visible --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, @actual_visible)  					--new 					insert into #computer_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, @actual_visible) 				end 				else 				begin 					-- set computer_group.group_id,visible = 2	 					-- has a child group that is visible. Don't want to have an orphaned group 					-- setting visible to 2 means that the group will be displayed, but none of its immediate child computers --					insert into object_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, 2)  					--new 					insert into #computer_visibility ( user_id, object_id, visible ) values (@user_id, @group_id, 2) 				end 				 				--if group is visible 				if @group_marked_visible = 1 or @actual_visible = 1 					--set groups parent to markedvisible 					update @groups set markedvisible = 1  						where group_id in (select parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @group_id)  				fetch next from group_cursor into @group_id 			end  			close group_cursor 			deallocate group_cursor 		end 	end 	else 	begin 		--security not turned on make everything visible woohooo 		exec mth_set_all_groups_visibility @user_id, 1 	end  	return @do_vis_check

Object_Definition: create procedure mth_validate_bootoptions as 	if object_id ('x_task') is not null and object_id ('x_bootoptions') is not null 	begin 		declare @x_bootoption_id int 		declare @x_boot_image_cpu_arch int 		declare @x_boot_option_type int 		declare @x_cpus_supported int  		declare x_task_cursor cursor local for 		  select bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch from x_task  		open x_task_cursor 		fetch next from x_task_cursor into @x_bootoption_id, @x_boot_image_cpu_arch  		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			declare @bootoption_type int 			declare @b_bootoption_valid int 			declare @cpus_supported int  			set @b_bootoption_valid = 0  			select @bootoption_type = (select top 1 bootoption_type from boot_options  				where bootoption_id = @x_bootoption_id) 			 			if @bootoption_type is not null 			begin 				--check if @x_boot_image_cpu_arch is auto select 				if @x_boot_image_cpu_arch = 0 				begin 					set @b_bootoption_valid = 1 				end 				else 				begin 					select @cpus_supported = (select top 1 cpus_supported from boot_options  						where bootoption_id = @x_bootoption_id and 						bootoption_type = @bootoption_type)  					if @cpus_supported is not null 					begin 						--check if @x_boot_image_cpu_arch is supported by @cpus_supported 						if (@x_boot_image_cpu_arch = 1 and 1 & @cpus_supported != 0) or 						(@x_boot_image_cpu_arch = 2 and 6 & @cpus_supported != 0) 							set @b_bootoption_valid = 1 					end 				end 			end  			--if there is no match in the boot_options table set it to default 			if @b_bootoption_valid = 0 				update x_task set bootoption_id = 1 where bootoption_id = @x_bootoption_id  			fetch next from x_task_cursor into @x_bootoption_id, @x_boot_image_cpu_arch 		end  		close x_task_cursor 		deallocate x_task_cursor 	end

create procedure nsa_sel_xml_schedules 	@top_count int, 	@last_date datetime as declare @sqlLf char(2) select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10) set rowcount @top_count select '<Schedule>' + @sqlLf + 	'<ComputerName>' + coalesce(c.computer_name, '') + '</ComputerName>' + @sqlLf + 	'<DomainName>' + coalesce(domain_name, '') + '</DomainName>' + @sqlLf + 	'<JobID>' + coalesce(cast(es.event_id as varchar(10)), '') + '</JobID>' + @sqlLf + 	'<JobName>' + coalesce(e.name, '') + '</JobName>' + @sqlLf + 	'<Status>' + coalesce(es.status, '') + '</Status>' + @sqlLf + 	'<StartTime>' + coalesce(cast(es.start_time as varchar(32)), '') + '</StartTime>' + @sqlLf + 	'<Recur>' + coalesce(cast(es.recur_value as varchar(10)), '') + '</Recur>' + @sqlLf + 	'<RecurType>' + coalesce(cast(es.recur_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</RecurType>' + @sqlLf + 	'<LastSentTime>' + coalesce(cast(es.[_nslastsent] as varchar(32)), '') + '</LastSentTime>' + @sqlLf + 	'</Schedule>' + @sqlLf as xml_data from event_schedule es, event e, computer c where es.event_id = e.event_id 	and es.computer_id = c.computer_id 	and (es._nslastsent is null or es._nslastsent <  @last_date) order by es.event_id, es.start_time;

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_bootoption_id 	@schedule_id int, 	@resolve_default int = 1 as 	 	declare @default_bootoption_id int 	declare @bootoptionid int 	declare @cpu_arch int  	select @bootoptionid = bootoption_id, @cpu_arch = boot_image_cpu_arch from task t, event_schedule es                        		where t.event_id = es.event_id                                 and  t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq               			and  t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 			 	and  es.schedule_id = @schedule_id                                 and (es.event_id in (select it.event_id from image_task it 		                	where it.event_id = es.event_id 		                        and it.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		                        and it.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 					or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from registry_task rt 						where rt.event_id = es.event_id 							and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 					or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from unattended_install_task rt 						where rt.event_id = es.event_id 							and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 					or es.event_id in (select st.event_id from script_task st 						where st.event_id = es.event_id 							and st.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and st.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 							and st.execution_mode = 0) 					or es.event_id in (select w.event_id from wait_task w 						where w.event_id = es.event_id 							and w.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 							and w.task_seq = es.next_task_seq)) 	if ( @bootoptionid is NULL) 		set @bootoptionid = 0  	if ( @cpu_arch is NULL) 		set @cpu_arch = 0  	if (@resolve_default = 1) 	begin	 		if (@bootoptionid = 1 ) 		begin 			exec @default_bootoption_id = sel_default_bootoption_id 			select @default_bootoption_id, @cpu_arch 		end 	end 	  	select @bootoptionid, @cpu_arch
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @resolve_default int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_comp_is_present 	@comp_id	int, 	@serial_num varchar(64), 	@uuid		varchar(64), 	@asset_tag	varchar(64), 	@mac_addr	varchar(64), 	@os			varchar(128), 	@primary_lookup int as 	declare @comp_count int 	declare @found		int 	set @found = 0  	if ((@primary_lookup | 4) = 4) -- serial 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( computer_id ) 			from computer 			where computer_id = @comp_id and serial_num = @serial_num and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = 4 	end  	if ((@primary_lookup | 8) = 8) -- asset 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( computer_id ) 			from computer 			where computer_id = @comp_id and asset_tag = @asset_tag and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = @found | 8  	end  	if ((@primary_lookup | 16) = 16) -- uuid 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( computer_id ) 			from computer 			where computer_id = @comp_id and uuid = @uuid and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = @found | 16 	end  	if ((@primary_lookup | 32) = 32)-- mac_addr 	begin 		set @comp_count = 0  		select @comp_count = count( c.computer_id ) 			from computer c join nics n	on c.computer_id = n.computer_id 			where c.computer_id = @comp_id and n.mac_addr = @serial_num and os = @os  		if (@comp_count > 0) 			set @found = @found | 32 	end  	if (@found = @primary_lookup) 		set @comp_count = 1 	else 		set @comp_count = 0  	return @comp_count
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@comp_id int, @serial_num varchar, @uuid varchar, @asset_tag varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @os varchar, @primary_lookup int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_comp_status_code 	@schedule_id 	int, 	@check_task		int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select @ret_val = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 	end 	else 	begin 		if @check_task = 1 		begin 			set @ret_val = null 			select top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq from task t, event_schedule es 				where t.event_id = es.event_id and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 					and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 					and es.status_code != 0 					and es.status_code is not null 					and es.next_task_seq >= 0 					and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id 				order by t.task_seq asc  			if @ret_val is null 			begin 				set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 			end 		end 	end  	return @ret_val
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @check_task int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_event_tree]     @nInitDeployIcon     int,     @nFolderIcon         int,     @nBaseIcon           int,     @user_id             int,     @do_visibility_check int    -- not used AS BEGIN     EXEC @do_visibility_check = is_need_check_visibility @user_id, -10     IF ( @do_visibility_check = 0 )     BEGIN         SELECT      event_id  AS [ID],                     folder_id AS [ParentID],                     201       AS [Container],                     CASE WHEN event_id = 2000001                               THEN @nInitDeployIcon                          WHEN master_guid IS NOT NULL AND master_server IS NOT NULL                                THEN 68 -- IIDX_LINKED_JOB                               ELSE @nBaseIcon                      END      AS [Icon],                     [name],                     CASE WHEN event_id = 2000001 THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS [OrderSeq]             FROM    event         UNION         SELECT      folder_id,                     parent_id,                     200,                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016                               THEN 49 -- IIDX_SYSTEM_EVENT_FOLDER                               ELSE @nFolderIcon                     END,                     [name],                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END             FROM    event_folder         ORDER BY 2, 6, 5, 1     END     ELSE     BEGIN         DECLARE       @tmpUsrObj TABLE (ObjectId int, PermissionId int, Allow int)         INSERT INTO   @tmpUsrObj             SELECT    p.[object_id], p.[permission_id], p.[allow]                 FROM  securityuser           u                 JOIN  securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = u.[user_id]                 WHERE u.[user_id] = @user_id                 AND   p.[object_id] > 1000000              DECLARE      @tmpObjs TABLE (ObjectId int, Visible int)             INSERT INTO  @tmpObjs                 SELECT   DISTINCT [object_id], 1                     FROM (                         SELECT        p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                             FROM      securitygroupmember    m                             JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                             LEFT JOIN @tmpUsrObj             u ON u.ObjectId = p.[object_id] AND u.PermissionId = p.[permission_id]                             WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                             AND       p.[object_id] > 1000000                             AND       u.ObjectId IS NULL                             GROUP BY  p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                             HAVING    MIN(p.[allow]) > 0                     ) a                 UNION ALL                 SELECT   DISTINCT ObjectId, 1 FROM  @tmpUsrObj WHERE Allow > 0          WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    ef.folder_id, 1                     FROM  event_folder ef                     JOIN  @tmpObjs ov on ov.ObjectId = ef.parent_id                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tmpObjs cr where cr.ObjectId = ef.folder_id)          DECLARE @i int = 1         WHILE   @i > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    DISTINCT ef.parent_id, 0                     FROM  event_folder ef                     JOIN  @tmpObjs    oo ON oo.ObjectId = ef.folder_id                     WHERE ef.parent_id NOT IN (SELECT ObjectId FROM @tmpObjs )              SET @i = @@ROWCOUNT         END          SELECT      event_id         AS [ID],                     folder_id        AS [ParentID],                     201              AS [Container],                     @nInitDeployIcon AS [Icon],                     [name],                     0                AS [OrderSeq]             FROM    event             WHERE   event_id = 2000001         UNION         SELECT      event_id,                     folder_id,                     201,                     CASE WHEN master_guid IS NOT NULL AND master_server IS NOT NULL                               THEN 68 -- IIDX_LINKED_JOB                               ELSE @nBaseIcon                      END,                     [name],                     3             FROM    event    ev             JOIN    @tmpObjs ov ON ov.Visible = 1 AND ov.ObjectId = ev.folder_id OR (ev.folder_id IS NULL AND ov.ObjectId = ev.event_id)             WHERE   event_id <> 2000001         UNION         SELECT      folder_id,                     parent_id,                     200,                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016                               THEN 49 -- IIDX_SYSTEM_EVENT_FOLDER                               ELSE @nFolderIcon                     END,                     [name],                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END             FROM    event_folder ef             JOIN    @tmpObjs     ov ON ov.ObjectId = ef.folder_id         ORDER BY 2, 6, 5, 1     END END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@nInitDeployIcon int, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int, @user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules    @cur_time   datetime as 	select top 50 es.broker_time, es.computer_id, es.event_id, es.next_task_seq, es.schedule_id, es.start_time,  		es.status, es.status_code, es.recur_type, es.recur_value, es.defer_mins, es.cond_seq, es.config_choice_id,  		es.rip_replace_event, es.initial_deployment, st.location, st.cond_seq 		from event_schedule es  left outer join script_task st on 				es.event_id = st.event_id 				and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq or es.cond_seq is null) 				and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq 		where start_time <= @cur_time 		and ( next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null ) 		and ( status_code is NULL or status_code = -2 ) 		and es.schedule_id in 		(	select top 1 schedule_id 			from event_schedule es2 			where computer_id = es.computer_id 				and start_time <= @cur_time 				and ( next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null ) 				and ( status_code is NULL or status_code = -2 )                 and ( es2.dep_schedule_id is null or                    es2.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule                       where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 and schedule_id = es2.dep_schedule_id ) ) 			order by start_time, schedule_id 		)         and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or            dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule 		      where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 and schedule_id = es.dep_schedule_id ) ) 		and computer_id not in 					( select computer_id 						from event_schedule 			where next_task_seq > -1 				and (status_code < 0 and es.schedule_id != schedule_id) 		) 		and( computer_id in (select computer_id from sessions) 			or st.location = 2) 		order by start_time, schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines    @time      datetime,    @wol_wait  int = 60,    @to_all    char(1) = 'Y' as    declare @wol_time datetime    set @wol_time = DATEADD(second, -@wol_wait, @time)     --    -- I changed the join on the nic_interface table to a left outer join because there are no    -- entries in the nic_interface table if BootWorks is the only agent that's connected to the    -- database.  This is because we don't want BootWorks to update the nic_interface table    -- because it's supposed to be used for the production OS.    -- This fixes bug #24899.    --     if (@to_all = 'Y')    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c 		    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) 		order by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end    else    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c 			join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where c.wol_support = 1             and (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0  and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) 		order by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt    @time      datetime as       select top 1 c.computer_id           from computer c 		    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on ni.id = n.computer_id          where -- (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time) and  			es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		      and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 		and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  				where es.event_id = st.event_id  					and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 					and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2)  				)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_wol    @time   datetime as  select [broker_time], [computer_id], [event_id], [next_task_seq], [schedule_id], [start_time], [status],           [status_code], [recur_type], [recur_value], [defer_mins], [cond_seq], [config_choice_id]    from event_schedule es    where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null) and (status_code is null or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @time          and computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 )          and computer_id not in ( select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is not null) )          and( computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions )  			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) )          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )    order by start_time, schedule_id

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_find_next_computer     @BeginID char(7),     @SearchTable varchar(255),     @SearchColumn varchar(255),     @SearchData varchar(255) as declare @Children TABLE (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int) declare @RowCnt int declare @MaxRows int declare @ExecSql nvarchar(2048) --LB#74365  create table #GroupOrder (group_id int, parent_id int, name varchar(64), search_order int) insert into #GroupOrder (group_id, parent_id, name, search_order)   select group_id, parent_id, name, 2147483647   from computer_group    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id IS NULL AND group_id != -7 order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end  create table  #SortedComputers (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, computer_id int) insert     into      #SortedComputers (computer_id)     select    c.computer_id     from      computer    c     left join #GroupOrder g on c.group_id = g.group_id     order by  isnull(g.search_order, case when c.node_type IS NULL then 2147483647                                           when c.node_type < 3     then 1 else NULL end) DESC, c.name  select @ExecSql =  case @SearchTable   when 'nic_interface' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.id AND            t.' + @SearchColumn + ' LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   when 'all_fields' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM   #SortedComputers s LEFT OUTER JOIN             computer c ON s.computer_id = c.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nics n ON s.computer_id = n.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nic_interface i ON s.computer_id = i.id LEFT OUTER JOIN             physical_bay p ON s.computer_id = p.computer_id      WHERE (c.computer_id LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.lic_os_key) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.computer_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.asset_tag) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.serial_num) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.logged_on_user) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(c.uuid) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(n.mac_addr) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             i.ip LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             LOWER(p.real_name) LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''') AND             s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   else     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.computer_id AND            LOWER(t.' + @SearchColumn + ') LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum' end execute sp_executesql @ExecSql drop table #SortedComputers drop table #GroupOrder
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@BeginID char, @SearchTable varchar, @SearchColumn varchar, @SearchData varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_find_next_computer_set_order (@GroupID int) as begin   declare @Children table (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int)   declare @RowCnt int   declare @MaxRows int   declare @ExecSql nvarchar(255)    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id = @GroupID order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end    update #GroupOrder set search_order = (select MIN(search_order) - 1 from #GroupOrder) where group_id = @GroupID  end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@GroupID int)

80      declare @host_const int     declare @vm_const   int      set @host_const = 12000000     set @vm_const   = 13000000      DECLARE @tmpObjs TABLE (GroupId int)      EXEC @do_visibility_check = is_need_check_visibility @user_id, -1     IF ( @do_visibility_check = 1 )     BEGIN         DECLARE       @tmpUsrObj TABLE (ObjectId int, PermissionId int, Allow int)         INSERT INTO   @tmpUsrObj             SELECT    p.[object_id], p.[permission_id], p.[allow]                 FROM  securityuser           u                 JOIN  securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = u.[user_id]                 WHERE u.[user_id] = @user_id                 AND   p.[object_id] <= 1000000          INSERT INTO  @tmpObjs             SELECT   DISTINCT [object_id]                 FROM (                     SELECT        p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]   AND       p.[object_id] <= 1000000                         AND       u.ObjectId IS NULL                         GROUP BY  p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                         HAVING    MIN(p.[allow]) > 0                 ) a             UNION ALL             SELECT   DISTINCT ObjectId FROM  @tmpUsrObj WHERE Allow > 0          WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs [parent_id] END AS [ParentGrId]                                 FROM [computer_group]                             ) cg                     JOIN  @tmpObjs ov on ov.GroupId = cg.ParentGrId                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tmpObjs cr where cr.GroupId = cg.GroupId)          DECLARE @i int = 1         WHILE   @i > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    DISTINCT cg.parent_id                     FROM  computer_group cg                     JOIN  @tmpObjs    oo ON oo.GroupId = cg.group_id                     WHERE cg.parent_id NOT IN (SELECT GroupId FROM @tmpObjs )              SET @i = @@ROWCOUNT         END     END      IF ( @bComps = 0 )     BEGIN         -- only display containers and physical devices (no computers)          SELECT       name            AS [name]             FROM      computer_group  cg             LEFT JOIN @tmpObjs        ov ON ov.GroupId = cg.group_id             WHERE     @do_visibility_check = 0             OR        ov.GroupId IS NOT NULL         UNION         SELECT        rack_id, -9, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_rack, name             FROM      physical_rack         UNION         SELECT        enclosure_id, rack_id, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_enclosure, name             FROM      physical_enclosure         UNION         SELECT        bay_id, enclosure_id, @cont_physical_device_leaf,                       coalesce(                         ( select @iidx_virt_bay where e.initial_event_id is not null),                         ( select @iidx_bay_wait where e.computer_id in ( select sz.computer_id from sessions sz where sz.computer_id = e.computer_id and sz.wait_state = 1 ) ),                         ( select @iidx_empty_bay where e.computer_id is null ),                         ( select @iidx_bay )                       ),                       [name]             FROM      physical_bay e         ORDER BY 2, 3, 5     END     ELSE     BEGIN         -- display containers with computers also          SELECT        group_id     as [id],                       parent_id    as [parentid],                       @cont_folder as [container],                       icon         as [icon],                       name,                       0            as [proc_type],                       0            as [os_bit],                       0             FROM      computer_group  cg             LEFT JOIN @tmpObjs        ov ON ov.GroupId = cg.group_id             WHERE   ( @do_visibility_check = 0 OR ov.GroupId IS NOT NULL )         UNION         SELECT        cc.computer_id, cc.group_id, cc.node_type, cc.icon, cc.[name],                       coalesce(( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = cc.computer_id ), 0),                       coalesce([os_bit], 32),                       0             FROM      computer cc             LEFT JOIN @tmpObjs ov ON ov.GroupId = cc.group_id OR ( cc.group_id IS NULL AND ov.GroupId = -1 )             WHERE     cc.hidden is null             AND     ( @do_visibility_check = 0 OR ov.GroupId IS NOT NULL )         UNION         SELECT    c.rack_id, -9, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_rack, c.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  physical_rack c         UNION         SELECT    d.enclosure_id, d.rack_id, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_enclosure, d.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  physical_enclosure d         UNION         SELECT    e.bay_id, e.enclosure_id, @cont_physical_device_leaf,                   coalesce(                     ( select @iidx_virt_bay where e.initial_event_id is not null),                     ( select @iidx_bay_wait where e.computer_id in ( select sz.computer_id from sessions sz where sz.computer_id = e.computer_id and sz.wait_state = 1 ) ),                     ( select @iidx_empty_bay where e.computer_id is null ),                     ( select @iidx_bay )                     ),                   e.[name], 0, 0, e.idx             FROM  physical_bay e         UNION         SELECT    f.virtual_machine_host_group_id, -11, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_virtual_machine_host_group, f.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  virtual_machine_host_group f          UNION         SELECT    g.computer_id + @host_const, g.virtual_machine_host_group_id, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_virtual_machine_host, g.name, 0, 0, 0 @iidx_virtual_machine                   END,                   [name], 0, 0, 0             FROM  computer             WHERE virtual_machine_host_id IS NOT NULL         ORDER BY 2, 3, 8, 5, 7     END Object_Definition: create procedure sel_inventory_group_tree 	@user_id int, 	@do_visibility_check int as 	declare @cont_folder int 	declare @cont_thin_client int  	select @cont_folder = 0; 	select @cont_thin_client = 4;  	-- display containers with computers also 	select  		group_id as id,  		parent_id as parentid,  		@cont_folder as container,  		icon as icon,  		name,  		0 as proc_type,  		0 as [os_bit],	 		0 	from computer_group cg left outer join #computer_visibility ov  			on cg.group_id = ov.object_id where @do_visibility_check = 0 or (ov.user_id = @user_id and (ov.visible > 0)) 	union 	select 		a.computer_id, 		a.group_id, 		a.node_type,         a.icon, 		a.[name], 		coalesce( 			( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = a.computer_id), 			(0) 			) as proc_type, 		coalesce([os_bit], 32),	 		0 	from 		computer a left outer join nics n 			on a.computer_id = n.computer_id 		where a.hidden is null and node_type = @cont_thin_client  			and (@do_visibility_check = 0 or exists  				(select visible from #computer_visibility ov  					where ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.visible = 1 and ((ov.object_id = a.group_id) or (ov.object_id = -1 and a.group_id is null) 					or (a.group_id is null and ov.object_id = a.computer_id) ) ) ) --63670, 63679 --					where ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.object_id = a.group_id and ov.visible = 1) 	order by 2 asc, 3 asc, 8 asc, 5 asc, 7 asc
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc 	 	if (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) 	begin 		return -1 	end  	select @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  	 	if( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) 		set @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  	select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set 		where config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task 			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  	if (@config_set_id is null) 		return -1     return @next_task_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc 	 	if (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) 	begin 		return -1 	end  	select @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  	 	if( @deploy_any_event_id is null) 		return -1 	 	return 	@next_task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_job_status_info 	@computer_id int as 	select t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, 		case t.task_type 			when 10 then				-- Script 				(select case when location = 1 then 'None' 							 when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  							 else 'Production' 						end  					from script_task st 					where st.event_id = t.event_id  						and st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  						and st.task_seq = t.task_seq) 			when 11 then 'Both'			-- Reboot 			when 12 then 'Production'	-- Copy File 			when 13 then 'Automation'	-- Registry  			when 14 then 'Both'			-- Config 			when 15 then 'Automation'	-- Image 			when 16 then 'Production'	-- Install 			when 17 then 'Automation'	-- Unattended Install 			when 18 then 'Production'	-- PCT 			when 19 then 'Production'	-- Inventory 			when 21 then 'Production'	-- Update Agent  			else 'None' 		end as boot_env 		from dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  			on es.computer_id = @computer_id  				and t.event_id = es.event_id  				and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  				and t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		where es.status_code is not null  			and es.status_code != -2 			and es.status_code < 0
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)
