Object_Definition: create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 	       and boot_env = 1		-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in 		( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  	if 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) 	Begin 		if @last_used_id = 3000000 		begin 			SET @last_used_id = 19000000 		end 	end     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err 	  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 	  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err 		 -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 		 RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_task_seq 	@schedule_id 	int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq 		from task t, event_schedule es 		where t.event_id = es.event_id 				and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 				and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 				and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id 				order by t.task_seq asc  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 	end  	return @ret_val

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_pxe_machine_status    @start_time   datetime,    @computer_id  int = 0 as    if (@computer_id != 0)    begin       exec upd_next_task_seq @start_time 		select c.serial_num, c.asset_tag, c.uuid, n.mac_addr, coalesce ( 		        (select 'Automation' from event_schedule es 		         	where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 		            and (es.event_id in (select it.event_id from image_task it 		                                 where it.event_id = es.event_id 		                                    and it.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		                                    and it.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 		            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from registry_task rt 		                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id 		                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 		            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from unattended_install_task rt 		                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id 		                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 		            or es.event_id in (select st.event_id from script_task st 		                                 where st.event_id = es.event_id 		                                    and st.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		                                    and st.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		                                    and st.execution_mode = 0) 					or es.event_id in (select w.event_id from wait_task w 										 where w.event_id = es.event_id 					                        and w.cond_seq = es.cond_seq                                             and w.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), 	         (select 'Reboot' from event_schedule es 	            where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 	               and (es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from reboot_task rt 	                                    where rt.event_id = es.event_id 	                                       and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 	                                       and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 				   or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from config_task rt 	                                    where rt.event_id = es.event_id 	                                       and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 	                                       and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), 		         'Production') as 'boot', 0 as 'count', 					coalesce ((select top 1 c.node_type from physical_bay b where c.computer_id = b.computer_id), 3) as node_type 		---7.1.1 start 		,coalesce ( (select top 1 bootoption_id from task ts, event_schedule es 			where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 			and es.event_id  = ts.event_id 			and ts.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		        and ts.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		),0) as bootoption_id                -- 7.1.1 end 		,coalesce ( (select top 1 boot_image_cpu_arch  from task ts, event_schedule es 			where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 			and es.event_id  = ts.event_id 			and ts.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		        and ts.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		),0) as boot_image_cpu_arch   		from computer c join nics n on c.computer_id = n.computer_id 		left outer join ( 			select min (schedule_id) as schedule_id, computer_id from event_schedule 			where cond_seq is not null 		               and (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null) 		               and start_time <= @start_time 		               and (status_code is null or status_code = -2) 		               and (dep_schedule_id is null or 		                    dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) ) 			group by computer_id, start_time 		) as t 		ON c.computer_id = t.computer_id 		where n.computer_id = @computer_id and (node_type != 2 or node_type is null) 		      and n.mac_addr not in (select mac_addr from ads_reject_mac_addrs r where r.mac_addr = n.mac_addr)       return    end     if object_id ('#pxe_info') is null    begin       create table #pxe_info       (          serial_num   varchar(80), 		 asset_tag    varchar(64), 		 uuid         varchar(64),          mac_addr     varchar(36),          boot         varchar(16) not null,          node_type    smallint, 		 boot_id int, --7.1.1 		 cpu_arch int       )    end    else       delete #pxe_info     insert into #pxe_info (serial_num, asset_tag, uuid, mac_addr, boot, node_type, boot_id, cpu_arch) 	select c.serial_num, c.asset_tag, c.uuid, n.mac_addr, coalesce ( 	        (select 'Automation' from event_schedule es 	         	where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 	            and (es.event_id in (select it.event_id from image_task it 	                                 where it.event_id = es.event_id 	                                    and it.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 	                                    and it.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 	            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from registry_task rt 	                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id 	                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 	                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 	            or es.event_id in (select rt.event_id from unattended_install_task rt 	                                 where rt.event_id = es.event_id 	                                    and rt.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 	                                    and rt.task_seq = es.next_task_seq) 	            or es.event_id in (select st.event_id from script_task st 	                                 where st.event_id = es.event_id 	                                    and st.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 	                                    and st.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 	                                    and st.execution_mode = 0) 				or es.event_id in (select w.event_id from wait_task w 									 where w.event_id = es.event_id 										and w.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 										and w.task_seq = es.next_task_seq))), 	         'Production'), 				coalesce ((select top 1 c.node_type from physical_bay b where c.computer_id = b.computer_id), 3) as node_type 	--7.1.1 start 		, coalesce ( (select top 1 bootoption_id from task ts, event_schedule es 			where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 			and es.event_id  = ts.event_id 			and ts.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		        and ts.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		), 0) as bootoption_id                -- 7.1.1 end 		,coalesce ( (select top 1 boot_image_cpu_arch  from task ts, event_schedule es 			where es.schedule_id = t.schedule_id 			and es.event_id  = ts.event_id 			and ts.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 		        and ts.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		),0) as cpu_arch   	from computer c join nics n on c.computer_id = n.computer_id 	left outer join ( 		select min (schedule_id) as schedule_id, computer_id from event_schedule 		where cond_seq is not null 	               and (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null) 	               and start_time <= @start_time 	               and (status_code is null or status_code = -2) 	               and (dep_schedule_id is null or 	                    dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) ) 		group by computer_id, start_time 	) as t 	ON c.computer_id = t.computer_id 	where (node_type != 2 or node_type is null) 	      and n.mac_addr not in (select mac_addr from ads_reject_mac_addrs r where r.mac_addr = n.mac_addr)     insert into #pxe_info (mac_addr, boot, node_type)    select mac_addr, 'Reject', -1 from reject_mac_addrs     select serial_num, asset_tag, uuid, mac_addr, boot, 0 as 'count', node_type, boot_id, cpu_arch from #pxe_info --Added boot_id

declare @end1     tinyint    declare @end2     tinyint    declare @end3     tinyint    declare @end4     tinyint    declare @port_start   int    declare @port_end     int    declare @rotate_ip char(1)    declare @rotate_port char(1)     declare @last1   tinyint    declare @last2   tinyint    declare @last3   tinyint    declare @last4   tinyint    declare @last_port int     declare @master1   tinyint    declare @master2   tinyint    declare @master3   tinyint    declare @master4   tinyint     declare @master_ip   varchar(20)    set @master_ip = '224.2.0.2'    declare @master_port int    set @master_port = 401     select @start1 = ip_start_oct_1,           @start2 = ip_start_oct_2,           @start3 = ip_start_oct_3,           @start4 = ip_start_oct_4,           @end1 = ip_end_oct_1,           @end2 = ip_end_oct_2,           @end3 = ip_end_oct_3,           @end4 = ip_end_oct_4,           @port_start = port_start,           @port_end = port_end    from rapid_deploy_ip_addrs_range     select @last1 = oct1,           @last2 = oct2,           @last3 = oct3,           @last4 = oct4,           @last_port = port    from rapid_deploy_ip_last_used  	if (@start1 != @end1 or @start2 != @end2 or @start3 != @end3 or @start4 != @end4) 		set @rotate_ip = 'Y'  	if (@port_start != @port_end) 		set @rotate_port = 'Y'     if ((@rotate_ip != 'Y' or @rotate_ip is null) and (@rotate_port != 'Y' or @rotate_port is null))    begin       set @master_ip = ''       exec ins_rapid_deploy_tracking @engine_id, @master_id, @master_ip, @master_port       select @master_ip as master_ip, @master_port as master_port       return    end  /*******************************************************************************************/     if (@rotate_ip = 'Y')    begin       if (@start1 is not null          and @start2 is not null          and @start3 is not null          and @start4 is not null          and @end1 is not null          and @end2 is not null          and @end3 is not null          and @end4 is not null)       begin          if (@last1 is null or @last2 is null or @last3 is null or @last4 is null)          begin             set @last1 = @start1             set @last2 = @start2             set @last3 = @start3             set @last4 = @start4          end          else          begin             declare @state tinyint             set @state = 0             if (@last1 < @start1)                set @state = 1             else if (@last2 < @start2 and @last1 = @start1)                set @state = 2             else if (@last3 < @start3 and @last2 = @start2 and @last1 = @start1)                set @state = 3             else if (@last4 < @start4 and @last3 < @start3 and @last2 = @start2 and @last1 = @start1)                set @state = 4              if (@last1 > @end1)                set @state = 5             else if (@last2 > @end2 and @last1 = @end1)                set @state = 6             else if (@last3 > @end3 and @last2 = @end2 and @last1 = @end1)                set @state = 7             else if (@last4 > @end4 and @last3 = @end3 and @last2 = @end2 and @last1 = @end1)                set @state = 8              if (@state > 0)             begin                set @last1 = @start1                set @last2 = @start2                set @last3 = @start3                set @last4 = @start4             end             else             begin              if (((@last4 + 1) > @end4 and @last3 >= @end3 and @last2 >= @end2 and @last1 >= @end1) or (@last4 + 1) > 255)             begin                if (@last3 >= @end3 and @last2 >= @end2 and @last1 >= @end1)                   set @last4 = @start4                else                   set @last4 = 0                if ((@last3 + 1) > @end3 and @last2 >= @end2 and @last1 >= @end1 or @last3 >= 255)                begin                   if (@last2 >= @end2 and @last1 >= @end1)                      set @last3 = @start3                   else                      set @last3 = 0                   if ((@last2 + 1) > @end2 and @last1 >= @end1 or @last2 >= 255)                   begin                      if (@last1 >= @end1)                         set @last2 = @start2                      else                         set @last2 = 0                      if (@last1 >= @end1 or @last1 >= 255)                         set @last1 = @start1                      else                         set @last1 = @last1 + 1                   end                   else                      set @last2 = @last2 + 1                end                else                   set @last3 = @last3 + 1             end             else                set @last4 = @last4 + 1             end          end           select @master_ip = cast(@last1 as varchar(4)) + '.' + cast(@last2 as varchar(4)) + '.' + cast(@last3 as varchar(4)) + '.' + cast(@last4 as varchar(4))           begin transaction           delete rapid_deploy_ip_last_used          insert into rapid_deploy_ip_last_used             (oct1, oct2, oct3, oct4)          values             (@last1, @last2, @last3, @last4)           if (@@error = 0)             commit transaction          else             rollback transaction           if (@port_start is begin          if (@last_port is null)          begin             set @master_port = @port_start             set @last_port = @master_port          end          else          begin             if (@port_start != @port_end)             begin                if ((@last_port+1) > @port_end)                   set @master_port = @port_start                else                   set @master_port = @last_port+1                select @last_port = @master_port             end             else             begin                set @master_port = @port_start                set @last_port = @master_port             end          end           begin transaction           delete rapid_deploy_ip_last_used          insert into rapid_deploy_ip_last_used (port) values (@last_port)           if          and @start4 is not null             and @end1 is not null             and @end2 is not null             and @end3 is not null             and @end4 is not null)          begin             select @master_ip = cast(@start1 as varchar(4)) + '.' + cast(@start2 as varchar(4)) + '.' + cast(@start3 as varchar(4)) + '.' + cast(@start4 as varchar(4))          end       end       else       begin          set @master_ip = ''       end        exec ins_rapid_deploy_tracking @engine_id, @master_id, @master_ip, @master_port       select @master_ip as master_ip, @master_port as master_port       return    end     if (@start1 is null       or @start2 is null       or @start3 is null       or @start4 is null       or @end1 is null       or @end2 is null       or @end3 is null       or @end4 Object_Definition: create procedure sel_redeploy_tasks    @computer_id   int as    declare  @temp_id int,             @history_id int,             @script_tag_id int     select top 1 @temp_id = history_id       from history_view       where ((task_type = 15 and xml_task like '%<Upload>0%')or task_type = 17)     -- Image task or Unattended Install          and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@temp_id is not null)    begin       declare @new_history_id int       declare @min_task_seq int        set @min_task_seq = null       select @min_task_seq = min(task_seq) from task               where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)        if (@min_task_seq is null)       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and redeploy = 1             order by [sequence], history_id desc       end       else       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and [sequence] = @min_task_seq and redeploy = 1              order by history_id desc       end 		                 if (@new_history_id != @temp_id)          set @temp_id = @new_history_id        select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view          where history_id < @temp_id             and computer_id = @computer_id             and task_type != 10             and task_type != 11             and task_type != 12 	    and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        select top 1 @script_tag_id = history_id from history_view          where computer_id = @computer_id             and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%')  and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        -- get the one which was the lastest one ran.       if ((@script_tag_id > @history_id or @history_id is null) and @script_tag_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @script_tag_id - 1       end        if ( @history_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @history_id + 1       end       else       begin          -- if there was script, copy file or reboot prior to image event          -- get the first history_id for this computer          select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view             where history_id < @temp_id                and computer_id = @computer_id 	       and redeploy = 1             order by history_id           if ( @history_id is null)             set @history_id = @temp_id       end        select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id        return    end     -- no image or scripted install found, looking for tag.    select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id          and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%') 	 and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@history_id is not null)    begin       select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id       return    end     -- nothing was found, we will send all the history for this computer.    select task_type, xml_task       from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_return_handler 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@task_seq int, 	@ret_code int = null as declare @count int declare @handler int declare @handlername nvarchar(64)  select @count = count(*) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  if @count < 1    begin 	if @ret_code = 0 		select @handler = 1 -- continue 	else 	   begin 		select @handler = on_fail 		  from task 		  where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq 		  group by on_fail 	   end    end else    select @handler = handler 	from task_return_handlers 	where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  select @handler = coalesce (@handler, 0) -- default, stop  if @handler <> 0 AND @handler <> 1 	select @handler, [name] from event where event_id = @handler else 	select @handler, ' '  return @handler
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @ret_code int)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_return_handler_status_info @sched_id int, @ret_code int AS declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id 	from event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  select status, ret_code, result from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and 						        task_seq = @task_seq and 						        cond_seq = @cond_seq and 						         ret_code = @ret_code

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE sel_task_failure_response  @sched_id int, @ret_code int   AS  declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id from event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  exec @retval = sel_return_handler @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @ret_code  return @retval

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_task_handlers 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@task_seq int as 	select ret_code, handler, event.name handler_name, result, status -- PRD 7.1.15 also select result and status 		from task_return_handlers 		left join event on handler = event.event_id 		where task_return_handlers.event_id = @event_id 			and task_return_handlers.cond_seq = @cond_seq 			and task_return_handlers.task_seq = @task_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_task_password    @username		varchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      		select @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or 		   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_task_scheduled    @computer_id   int as    declare @tsk_type as int     select @tsk_type = task_type from task ts, event_schedule es where es.event_id = ts.event_id 							and es.cond_seq = ts.cond_seq 							and es.next_task_seq = ts.task_seq 							and es.status_code = -1 							and es.computer_id = @computer_id  return @tsk_type
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_task_type    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as 	declare @task_type smallint    select @task_type = task_type from task       where event_id = @event_id          and cond_seq = @cond_seq          and task_seq = @task_seq  	if @task_type is null 		set @task_type = 0x4a4d4120  	return @task_type
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_tc_job_tree    @SoftwarePackages varchar(50),    @nFolderIcon int,    @nBaseIcon int as 	declare @software_packages_folder_id int  	declare @job_folder table 	(	 		folder_id int 	)  	--Make sure we have a Software Packages folder under Thin Client System folder 	select @software_packages_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder  		where parent_id = 1000009 and name = @SoftwarePackages 	if @software_packages_folder_id is null 	begin 		exec @software_packages_folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID' 		insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, name) values (@software_packages_folder_id, 1000009, @SoftwarePackages) 	end  	declare @tmp_folder_id int 	declare folder_cursor cursor for select folder_id from @job_folder  	insert into @job_folder (folder_id) values (@software_packages_folder_id)  	open folder_cursor 	fetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id  	select @tmp_folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  	while @@fetch_status = 0 	begin 		--add any subfolders 		insert into @job_folder (folder_id) select ef.folder_id from event_folder ef where ef.parent_id = @tmp_folder_id		 		fetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id 	end  	close folder_cursor 	deallocate folder_cursor  	delete from @job_folder where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  	--Get the imediate child folders of @software_packages_folder_id    select       folder_id,       null,        200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union 	--Get the sub folders of @software_packages_folder_id's children folders    select       folder_id,       parent_id,       200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    union 	--Get immediate child jobs of @software_packages_folder_id    select	       event_id,       null,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union 	--Get jobs from @software_packages_folder_id's child folders    select       event_id,       folder_id,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    order by 2, 6, 5, 1
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@SoftwarePackages varchar, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_unattend_task_data     @event_id int,     @cond_seq int,     @task_seq int as    select t3.active, t3.value, t3.value_id, t3.vars_id, t3.vars_name, t3.type, t1.unattend_section_id as section_id,          t1.name as section_name, t3.unattend_id   from unattended_install_task t2, unattend_section t1   left join (select t1.event_id as [event_id], t1.cond_seq as [cond_seq], t1.task_seq as [task_seq], t1.active as [active],                     t1.unattend_vars_value as [value], t1.unattend_vars_value_id as [value_id],                     t2.unattend_vars_id as [vars_id], t2.name as [vars_name], t2.type as [type],                     t1.unattend_txt_data_id as [unattend_id], t3.unattend_section_id as section_id              from unattend_txt_data t1, unattend_vars t2, unattend_section t3, unattend_vars_value t4              where t1.unattend_vars_value_id = t4.unattend_vars_value_id and t4.unattend_vars_id = t2.unattend_vars_id and                    t2.unattend_section_id = t3.unattend_section_id) t3   on t3.section_id=t1.unattend_section_id and t3.event_id=@event_id and t3.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t3.task_seq=@task_seq   where t1.unattend_setup_id=t2.unattend_setup_id and t2.event_id=@event_id and t2.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t2.task_seq=@task_seq order by t1.unattend_section_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_wol_computer    @computer_id      int,    @wol_support      int = null as  if (@wol_support is null or @wol_support = '')       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id 	       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id    else       select c.computer_id, n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask          from computer c, nics n, nic_interface ni          where c.computer_id = @computer_id                and c.wol_support = 1                and c.computer_id = n.computer_id                and n.mac_addr is not null                and n.computer_id = ni.id 	       and n.nic_id = ni.nic_id                and ni.interface_id = ( select min( ni2.interface_id ) from nic_interface ni2                                          where ni2.id = n.computer_id and ni2.nic_id = n.nic_id )            order by n.nic_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @wol_support int)

Object_Definition: -- -- the wol_proxy property has been moved to the aclient_prop table, and will be sent to -- aclient as a normal setting. --  create procedure sel_wol_proxy    @computer_id   int as    declare @wol_proxy smallint     select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     if( ( @wol_proxy = 0 ) or ( @wol_proxy is null ) )    begin       return 0    end     return 1
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_capture_pct_task    @event_id      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @task_seq      int,    @xml_task      varchar(8000) output,    @inc_passwords int = 1  as    declare @xml_extra varchar(6000)    select @xml_extra = ''     if ( @inc_passwords = 1 )    begin       select @xml_extra =          '<Username><![CDATA[' + coalesce (username,'') + ']]></Username>' +          '<Password><![CDATA[' + coalesce (password,'') + ']]></Password>' +          '<PackagePassword><![CDATA[' + coalesce (pkg_password,'') + ']]></PackagePassword>'       from  capture_pct_task       where  @event_id = event_id             and @cond_seq = cond_seq             and @task_seq = task_seq    end     select @xml_task =       '<Task Type=''Capture PCT''>' +       '<TemplateFile>' + coalesce (template_file,'') + '</TemplateFile>' +       '<Folder>' + coalesce (folder,'') + '</Folder>' +       '<AddlCommandLine>' + coalesce (addl_cmd_line,'') + '</AddlCommandLine>' +       '<DomainUsers>' + coalesce (cast(domain_users as varchar (10)),'') + '</DomainUsers>' +       '<LocalUsers>' + coalesce (cast(local_users as varchar (10)),'') + '</LocalUsers>' +       '<CustomUsers>' + coalesce (custom_users,'') + '</CustomUsers>' +       '<CustomGroups>' + coalesce (custom_groups,'') + '</CustomGroups>' +       '<LastAccessed>' + coalesce (cast(last_accessed as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastAccessed>' +       '<LastValue>' + coalesce (cast(last_value as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastValue>' +       '<LastScale>' + coalesce (cast(last_scale as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastScale>' +       '<DontClean>' + coalesce (cast(dont_clean as varchar (10)),'') + '</DontClean>' + 	  '<CreatePkg>' + coalesce (cast(create_pkg as varchar (10)),'') + '</CreatePkg>' +       @xml_extra +       '</Task>'    from  capture_pct_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_event    @event_id      int,    @inc_passwords int = 1 as    create table #text_holder ( xml_data text )    insert into #text_holder values ( '' )    declare @ptrval binary(16)    select @ptrval = textptr(xml_data) from #text_holder     declare @xml_data varchar(8000)    set @xml_data = ''     declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     if not exists ( select event_id from event where @event_id = event_id )    begin       select '<Event></Event>' as xml_data       return 0    end     declare @temp_folder_id int    declare @temp_folder_name varchar (256)     select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event where event_id = @event_id    set @temp_folder_name = ''    if @temp_folder_id is not null    select @temp_folder_name = b.[name] from event_folder b, event a where b.folder_id = a.folder_id and a.event_id = @event_id     -- build the event XML tags    select @xml_data = @xml_data +       '<Event>' + @sqlLf +       '<EventID>' + coalesce(cast(@event_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</EventID>' + @sqlLf +       '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Name>' + @sqlLf +       '<Description>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.description, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Description>' + @sqlLf +       '<FolderID>' + coalesce(cast(@temp_folder_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</FolderID>' + @sqlLf +       '<FolderName>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(@temp_folder_name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</FolderName>' + @sqlLf +       '<JobDuration>' + coalesce(cast(isnull(datediff(ss, es.broker_time, es.end_time), 0) as varchar(20)),'') + '</JobDuration>' + @sqlLf    from event a 	left join event_schedule es 		on a.event_id = es.event_id    where a.event_id = @event_id     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''     --    -- iterate through the conditions    --    select @xml_data = @xml_data + '<Conditions>' + @sqlLf     declare @cond_seq int    declare event_condition_cursor cursor local for       select cond_seq from event_condition where event_id = @event_id    open event_condition_cursor    fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin        select @xml_data = @xml_data +             '<Condition>' + @sqlLf +             '<CondSeq>' + coalesce(cast(cond_seq as varchar(10)),'') + '</CondSeq>' + @sqlLf +             '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Name>' + @sqlLf +             '<ConditionItems>' + @sqlLf       from event_condition       where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''       --       -- iterate through the condition items       --       declare @item_seq int       declare condition_item_cursor cursor local for          select item_seq from condition_item where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq order by item_seq       open condition_item_cursor       fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @item_seq       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          select @xml_data = @xml_data +             '<ConditionItem>' +  @sqlLf +             '<FieldType>' + coalesce(cast(field_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</FieldType>' + @sqlLf +             '<OperType>' + coalesce(cast(oper_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</OperType>' + @sqlLf +             '<KeyValue>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(key_value, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</KeyValue>' + @sqlLf +             '<Drive>' + coalesce(drive, '') + '</Drive>' + @sqlLf +             '<Conjunct>' + coalesce(cast(conjunct as varchar(10)), '') + '</Conjunct>' + @sqlLf +             '</ConditionItem>' + @sqlLf          from condition_item          where event_id = @event_id and             cond_seq = @cond_seq and             item_seq = @item_seq           -- get the next condition item          fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @item_seq       end       close condition_item_cursor       deallocate condition_item_cursor        select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</ConditionItems>' + @sqlLf        updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data       select @xml_data = ''        -- iterate through the tasks       select @xml_data = @xml_data + '<Tasks>' + @sqlLf        declare @task_seq int       declare task_cursor cursor local for          select task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq       open task_cursor       fetch next from task_cursor into @task_seq       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin           declare @xml_task varchar(8000)          select @xml_task = ''           -- get the task information          if exists (select event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from image_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_image_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from unattended_install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_unattended_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_config_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from capture_pct_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_capture_pct_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from deploy_anywhere_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_deploy_anywhere_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_script_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from reboot_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_reboot_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_copyfile_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from registry_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_registry_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords  		 else if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_wait_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords            -- append the task information          select @xml_data = @xml_data + @xml_task           updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data          select @xml_data = ''           -- get the next task for this condition          fetch next from task_cursor into @task_seq       end       close task_cursor       deallocate task_cursor        select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</Tasks>' + @sqlLf + '</Condition>' + @sqlLf        updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data       select @xml_data = ''        --  get the next condition       fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    end    close event_condition_cursor    deallocate event_condition_cursor     select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</Conditions>' + @sqlLf + '</Event>' + @sqlLf     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''     -- return the data as a row of one column    select xml_data from #text_holder    drop table #text_holder
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @inc_passwords int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_folders    @parent_id  int = null,    @folder_id   int = null as    select '<EventFolder ID="' + coalesce(cast(a.folder_id as varchar(10)), '') + '" ' +           'Name="' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.name, '') , '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '" ' +           'ParentID="' + coalesce(cast(a.parent_id as varchar(10)), '') + '" ' +           'ParentName="' + ( coalesce((select coalesce(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(b.name, '') , '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', '''), '') from event_folder b where b.folder_id = a.parent_id), '') ) + '" ' +           '/>'    from       event_folder a    where       ( @folder_id is not null and a.folder_id = @folder_id ) or       ( @folder_id is null and ( ( @parent_id is not null and a.parent_id = @parent_id ) or                                  ( @parent_id is null ) or                                  ( @parent_id = 0 and a.parent_id is null ) ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@parent_id int, @folder_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_groups    @parent_id  int = null,    @group_id   int = null as select '<ComputerGroup ID="' + coalesce(cast(a.group_id as varchar(10)), '') + '" ' +           'Name="' + replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.[name], '') , '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '''', ''') + '" ' +           'ParentID="' + coalesce(cast(a.parent_id as varchar(10)), '') + '" ' +           'ParentName="' + coalesce( (select b.[name] from computer_group b where b.group_id = a.parent_id), '' ) + '" ' + '/>'    from       computer_group a    where       ( @group_id is not null and @group_id = a.group_id ) or       ( @group_id is null and ( ( @parent_id is not null and a.parent_id = @parent_id ) or                                 ( @parent_id is null and a.parent_id is null ) or                                 ( @parent_id = 0 and a.parent_id is null ) ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@parent_id int, @group_id int)

select @xml_task =          '<Task Type=''Image''>' +          '<ImageFile>' + coalesce (image_file,'') + '</ImageFile>' +          '<ImageDesc>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(image_desc,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</ImageDesc>' +          '<Upload>' + coalesce (cast(upload as varchar(10)),'') + '</Upload>' +          '<Compression>' + coalesce (cast(compression as varchar(10)),'') + '</Compression>' +          '<Bandwidth>' + coalesce (cast(bandwidth as varchar(10)),'') + '</Bandwidth>' +          '<AddlCmdline>' + coalesce (addl_cmdline,'') + '</AddlCmdline>' +          '<MediaSize>' + coalesce (cast(media_size as varchar(10)),'') + '</MediaSize>' +          '<RemoveBootwork>' + coalesce (cast(remove_bw as varchar(10)),'') + '</RemoveBootwork>' +          '<RemoveCompaq>' + coalesce (cast(remove_cpq as varchar(10)),'') + '</RemoveCompaq>' +          '<SourceComputerID>' + coalesce (cast(src_comp_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</SourceComputerID>' +          '<MasterComputerID>' + coalesce (cast(master_comp_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</MasterComputerID>' +          '<LocalStore>' + coalesce (cast(local_store as varchar(10)),'') + '</LocalStore>' +          '<ImageBaseFile>' + coalesce (image_basefile,'') + '</ImageBaseFile>' + 	     '<prepare_image>' + coalesce ( cast( prepare_image as varchar),'') + '</prepare_image>'+ 	     '<sysprepped>' + coalesce ( cast( sysprepped as varchar),'') + '</sysprepped>'+          '<standard_answerfile>' + coalesce ( cast (standard_answerfile as varchar),'') + '</standard_answerfile>' +          '<answerfilepath>' + coalesce ( answerfilepath,'') + '</answerfilepath>' + 		 '<mass_storage_option>' + coalesce (cast(mass_storage_option as varchar(10)),'') + '</mass_storage_option>' + --47509 		 '<mass_storage_filepath>' + coalesce ( mass_storage_filepath,'') + '</mass_storage_filepath>' +	--47509 		 '<mass_storage_driverpath>' + coalesce ( mass_storage_driverpath,'') + '</mass_storage_driverpath>' +	--47509 	     '<addl_cmdline_sysprep>' + coalesce ( addl_cmdline_sysprep ,'') + '</addl_cmdline_sysprep>' + 	     '<imaging_tool_id>' + coalesce ( cast (imaging_tool_id as varchar),'') + '</imaging_tool_id>'+ 		 '<deploy_anywhere>' + coalesce ( cast( deploy_any_where as varchar(10)),'') + '</deploy_anywhere>'+          '<PartitionList>'    from image_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq     declare   @partition   int    declare   @use_percent smallint    declare   @size        int    declare   @xml_temp    varchar(2000)     declare partition_cursor cursor for    select partition,           use_percent,           [size]    from partition_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq     open partition_cursor     fetch next from partition_cursor into @partition, @use_percent, @size     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       set @xml_temp =          '<PartitionItem>' +          '<Partition>' + coalesce (cast(@partition as varchar(10)),'') + '</Partition>' +          '<UsePercent>' + coalesce (cast(@use_percent as varchar(10)),'') + '</UsePercent>' +          '<Size>' + coalesce (cast(@size as varchar(10)),'') + '</Size>' +          '</PartitionItem>'       set @xml_task = @xml_task + @xml_temp       fetch next from partition_cursor into @partition, @use_percent, @size    end     close partition_cursor    deallocate partition_cursor       --    ASK adding boot option details to xml    declare   @xml_temp2    varchar(2000)    declare @boot_id int    declare @boot_type int     declare @cpu_arch int    declare @desc   varchar(2000)     set @boot_id = 0    set @xml_temp2 = ''	    select @boot_id = bootoption_id,@cpu_arch = boot_image_cpu_arch from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq    if(@boot_id != 0)    begin     select @boot_type = bootoption_type, @desc = pxe_description from boot_options where bootoption_id = @boot_id      set @xml_temp2 =  '<BootImage>' +         '<ID>' + coalesce ( cast(@boot_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</ID>' +           '<BootType>' + coalesce ( cast(@boot_type as varchar(10)),'') + '</BootType>' +           '<CPUArchType>' + coalesce ( cast(@cpu_arch as varchar(10)),'0') + '</CPUArchType>' +           '<PxeDesc>' + coalesce (@desc,'') + '</PxeDesc>' +           '</BootImage>'    end  	-- Add Sysprep related information into image task 	declare @xml_temp3		varchar(300) 	declare @os				varchar(100) 	declare @product_key	varchar(100)  	set @xml_temp3 = ''	 	select @os = os, @product_key = product_key from sysprep_answers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq 	 	set @xml_temp3 =   				'<os>' + coalesce (@os,'') + '</os>' + 				'<product_key>' + coalesce (@product_key,'') + '</product_key>' 	-- End Sysprep related information  --   set @xml_task = @xml_task + '</PartitionList></Task>'    set @xml_task = @xml_task + '</PartitionList>'+ @xml_temp2 + @xml_temp3 + '</Task>'

@var_count=count(*) from unattend_txt_data where event_id=@event_id and cond_seq=@cond_seq and task_seq=@task_seq 	select @variables='<Variables><Count>' + cast(@var_count as varchar(10)) + '</Count>'  	declare unattenddata_cursor cursor for       select unattend_vars_value_id, unattend_vars_value, active          from unattend_txt_data          where event_id=@event_id and cond_seq=@cond_seq and task_seq=@task_seq  	open unattenddata_cursor  	fetch next from unattenddata_cursor into @value_id, @value, @active    while @@fetch_status = 0 	begin 		set @variables = @variables + '<Var' + cast(@counter as varchar(10)) + '>' + 											'<value_id>' + coalesce (cast(@value_id as varchar (10)),'') + '</value_id>' + 											'<value>' + coalesce (@value, '') + '</value>' + 											'<active>' + coalesce (cast(@active as varchar (10)),'') + '</active>' + 											'</Var' + cast(@counter as varchar(10)) + '>'  		set @counter = @counter+1 		fetch next from unattenddata_cursor into @value_id, @value, @active 	end  	close unattenddata_cursor    deallocate unattenddata_cursor  	set @variables = @variables + '</Variables>'     select @xml_task =          '<Task Type=''Unattended Install''>' +          '<BaseFile>' + coalesce (base_file,'') + '</BaseFile>' +          '<CommandLine>' + coalesce (command_line,'') + '</CommandLine>' +          '<OSFileLocation>' + coalesce (cast(os_file_location as varchar (10)),'') + '</OSFileLocation>' +          '<OSType>' + coalesce (cast(os_type as varchar (10)),'') + '</OSType>' +          '<SetupID>' '<SpFilesID>' + coalesce (cast(unattend_setup_files_id_1 as varchar (10)),'') + '</SpFilesID>' +          '<UnattendFile>' + coalesce (unattend_file,'') + '</UnattendFile>' +          '<NewTask>' + coalesce (cast(new_task as varchar (10)),'') + '</NewTask>' +          '<RdeploySwitch>' + coalesce (ibmaster_switches,'') + '</RdeploySwitch>' +         '<run_rdeployt>' + coalesce ( cast( run_rdeployt as varchar),'') +  '</run_rdeployt>' +          @variables --adding boot option details to xml +          --adding boot option details to xml'</Task>'       from unattended_install_task       where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq -- [  ASK    declare   @xml_temp2    varchar(2000)    declare @boot_id int    declare @boot_type int     declare @cpu_arch int    declare @desc   varchar(2000)     set @boot_id = 0    set @xml_temp2 = ''    select @boot_id = bootoption_id, @cpu_arch = boot_image_cpu_arch from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq    if(@boot_id != 0)    begin     select @boot_type = bootoption_type, @desc = pxe_description from boot_options where bootoption_id = Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_wait_task    @event_id      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @task_seq      int,    @xml_task      varchar(8000) output,    @inc_passwords int = 1 as   select @xml_task =          '<Task Type=''WaitTask''>' +          '<WaitTime>' + coalesce (cast(wait_time as varchar (10)),'') + '</WaitTime>'     from wait_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq      declare   @xml_temp2    varchar(2000)    declare @boot_id int    declare @boot_type int     declare @cpu_arch int    declare @desc   varchar(2000)     set @boot_id = 0    set @xml_temp2 = ''    select @boot_id = bootoption_id, @cpu_arch = boot_image_cpu_arch from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq    if(@boot_id != 0)    begin     select @boot_type = bootoption_type, @desc = pxe_description from boot_options where bootoption_id = @boot_id      set @xml_temp2 =  '<BootImage>' +         '<ID>' + coalesce ( cast(@boot_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</ID>' +           '<BootType>' + coalesce ( cast(@boot_type as varchar(10)),'') + '</BootType>' +          '<CPUArchType>' + coalesce ( cast(@cpu_arch as varchar(10)),'0') + '</CPUArchType>' +           '<PxeDesc>' + coalesce (@desc,'') + '</PxeDesc>' +           '</BootImage>'    end      set @xml_task = @xml_task + @xml_temp2 +  '</Task>'

Object_Definition: create proc uni_add_deploy_anywhere_task 	@table_name          varchar(128), 	@event_id            int, 	@cond_seq            int, 	@task_seq            int, 	@windows_directory   varchar(256), 	@ddb_directory       varchar(256), 	@paramaters          varchar(512) with execute as owner as begin     	declare @sql   nvarchar(4000) 	set     @sql = 'insert into ' +  @table_name + ' (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, windows_directory, ddb_directory, paramaters) ' + 	               'values ( @id, @cs, @ts, @wd, @dd, @pr )' 	execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int, @wd varchar(256), @dd varchar(256), @pr varchar(512)', 	                      @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @windows_directory, @ddb_directory, @paramaters end

Object_Definition: create proc uni_add_task     @table_name varchar(128),     @set_expr   varchar(2048),     @event_id   int,     @cond_seq   int,     @task_seq   int with execute as owner as begin     	declare @sql   nvarchar(4000) 	set     @sql = 'insert into ' +  @table_name + ' (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq) values ( @id, @cs, @ts )' 	execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int', @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq  	if ( upper(@set_expr) != 'NULL' ) 	begin 		set     @sql = 'update ' +  @table_name + ' set ' + @set_expr + ' where event_id = @id and cond_seq = @cs and task_seq = @ts' 		execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int', @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq 	end end

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_ip_mac_addr    @computer_id         int,    @ip_addr             varchar (512),    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @nic_id              int = 0 as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = @nic_id     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, ip) values (@computer_id, @nic_id, @ip_addr)    else    begin      if (@ip_addr is not null) 		update nic_interface set ip = @ip_addr where interface_id = @interface_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @ip_addr varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @nic_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_name    @computer_id   int,    @new_name      varchar(64) as    if exists (select computer_id from computer where computer_id = @computer_id and [name] = @new_name) 	  return     declare @os varchar(128)    select @os = os from computer where computer_id = @computer_id     begin transaction     if (@os is null)       update computer set [name] = @new_name, os = ' ' where computer_id = @computer_id    else       update computer set [name] = @new_name where computer_id = @computer_id     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[upd_computer_nic_pci] @PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar(128) as declare @nNicId int declare @nConfigItemId int begin transaction  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  	and nic_pci_bus = @PciBus     and nic_pci_device = @PciDevice     and nic_pci_function = @PciFunction 	and mac_addr = @strMacaddr 	  if(@nNicId is not NULL) begin 	commit transaction 	return end  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  	and nic_pci_bus is NULL      and nic_pci_device is NULL     and nic_pci_function is NULL   if(@nNicId is NULL) begin 	commit transaction 	return end  if exists (select n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @strMacaddr) 		update nics set mac_addr = null where mac_addr = @strMacaddr  update nics set nic_pci_device = @PciDevice, 				nic_pci_bus = @PciBus, 				nic_pci_function = @PciFunction, 				mac_addr = @strMacaddr where nic_id = @nNicId and computer_id = @computer_id  if (@@error != 0) 		rollback transaction 	else 		commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_computer_state] @computer_id int, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @boot_count int, @last_status_code int as declare @nRebootCount int begin transaction select  @nRebootCount = boot_count from computer_state where computer_id = @computer_id and schedule_id = @schedule_id  and task_seq = @task_seq if (@nRebootCount  is null) 	insert into computer_state ( computer_id,schedule_id,task_seq,boot_count,last_status_code) values (@computer_id,@schedule_id ,@task_seq ,@boot_count,@last_status_code ) else 	update  computer_state set boot_count = @boot_count , last_status_code = @last_status_code where  computer_id = @computer_id and schedule_id = @schedule_id  and task_seq = @task_seq if (@@error != 0) 		rollback transaction 	else 		commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_deferred_schedule 	@schedule_id int, 	@start_time datetime, 	@current_time datetime, 	@status varchar( 256 ), 	@status_module smallint as     declare @comp_id int  	-- make sure the schedule is valid 	select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	if( @comp_id is null ) 	begin 	   return 	end  	begin transaction  	-- update the event schedule table 	update event_schedule 		set status_code = null, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, 			start_time = @start_time, status = @status 		where schedule_id = @schedule_id  	-- now insert stuff into the log data 	exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, -1, -1, @status_module  	-- erase old wol info 	exec upd_computer_wol_info @comp_id, null  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_module smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_cond_seq    @schedule_id   int,    @cond_seq      int,    @status_code   int = NULL,    @status        varchar (254) = NULL,    @exit_code     int = NULL,    @exit_module   smallint = NULL as 	if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) 		set @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is NULL and @status_code is NULL)       update event_schedule set cond_seq = @cond_seq where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else    begin       update event_schedule 		set cond_seq = @cond_seq, status_code = @status_code, 			status = @status, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module 		where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_config_choice    @schedule_id      int,    @config_choice_id int = null,    @status_code      int = null,    @status           varchar(254) = null as    begin transaction     if (@config_choice_id = 0)    begin       declare @comp_id int 	  select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id       update computer set domain_name = 'WORKGROUP', domain_member = 0 where computer_id = @comp_id 	  if exists (select 1 from nics where computer_id = @comp_id and nic_id = 0) 		update nics set ip_use_dhcp = 1 where computer_id = @comp_id 	  else 		insert nics (computer_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp) values (@comp_id, 0, 1)    end     if (@status_code is NULL and @status is NULL)    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id,              status_code = @status_code,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @config_choice_id int, @status_code int, @status varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_init_deploy    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    begin transaction     update event_schedule set start_time = @start_time       where event_id = @event_id          and next_task_seq > -1          and status_code is null 		 and cond_seq is null 		 and initial_deployment = 1     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq    @schedule_id      int,    @next_task_seq    int,    @status_code      smallint,    @exit_code        int,    @exit_module      smallint,    @status           varchar(254),    @current_time     datetime,    @module           smallint,    @level            smallint,    @taskresult       int as begin     if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0)         set @status_code = 1      declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount      if( 0 = @tran )         begin transaction  	DECLARE   @dependent_id   int     SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id      IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL AND @status_code IS NULL AND @status = 'Error ' + LTRIM(@exit_code) + ' during script execution')     BEGIN         DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @dependent_id          SELECT @status = 'Scheduled Job [' + @eventname + '] Due To Return Code Handler: ' + LTRIM(@exit_code)     END      -- update status_log table with schedule info     exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level, @taskresult      -- now insert and fix up history for this item     exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id      -- now update the event_schedule table     update event_schedule         set next_task_seq = @next_task_seq,         status = @status,         status_code = @status_code,         exit_code = @exit_code,         exit_module = @exit_module,         config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null }     where schedule_id = @schedule_id      if( 0 = @tran )     begin         if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction         else             commit transaction     end end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @next_task_seq int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_status    @schedule_id   int,    @status_code   smallint,    @exit_code	   int,    @exit_module   smallint,    @status        varchar(254),    @broker_time   datetime,    @module        smallint,    @level         smallint,    @log_event     smallint = 0 as    declare @upd_status_code smallint     -- we need to remember the status code that was passed in, but if it's null,    -- we want to get the status code that is currently in the event schedule.    set @upd_status_code = @status_code     if (@upd_status_code is null and @log_event = 1)       select @upd_status_code = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@exit_code is not null ) and ( @exit_code != 0 ) and ( @status_code is not null ) and       ( @status_code > 0 )    begin       set @status_code = 1    end     begin transaction     if (@broker_time is null)    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, 			exit_code = @exit_code, 			exit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, 			exit_code = @exit_code, 			exit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status,             broker_time = @broker_time          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id  	--LB#40844        if( @status_code >= 0 )       	 begin      		exec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@broker_time        	end    end     -- use the passed in status code for this function, unlike above where we use our    -- adjusted @use_status_code var.  This is so we can save exit_codes without    -- killing the status_code in the event schedule table.    exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @broker_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @broker_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @log_event smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_status    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36),    @schedule_id   int,    @task_seq      int,    @status        varchar(254),    @status_code   int as    if (@status is null and @status_code is null)       return     begin transaction     if (@status_code is not null and @status is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code,             status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else if (@status_code is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else       update event_schedule          set status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error = 0)       commit transaction    else       rollback transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @status varchar, @status_code int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_hardware_for_bootwork    @comp_id       int,    @proc_count    int,    @proc_desc     varchar(128),    @proc_speed    int,    @ram_total     int,    @ram_free      int as    declare   @temp_comp_id       int,              @temp_proc_count    int,              @temp_proc_desc     varchar(128),              @temp_proc_speed    int,              @temp_ram_total     int,              @temp_ram_free      int     select @temp_comp_id    = computer_id,           @temp_proc_count = proc_count,           @temp_proc_desc  = proc_desc,           @temp_proc_speed = proc_speed,           @temp_ram_total  = ram_total,           @temp_ram_free   = ram_free       from hardware       where computer_id = @comp_id     if (@temp_comp_id = @comp_id and        (@temp_proc_count = @proc_count or @proc_count is null) and        (@temp_proc_desc = @proc_desc or @proc_desc is null) and        (@temp_proc_speed = @proc_speed or @proc_speed is null) and        (@temp_ram_total = @ram_total or @ram_total is null) and        (@temp_ram_free = @ram_free or @ram_free is null)       )    return     begin transaction    if (@temp_comp_id is not null)    begin       if (@proc_count is not null)          set @temp_proc_count = @proc_count        if (@proc_desc is not null)          set @temp_proc_desc = @proc_desc        if (@proc_speed is not null)          set @temp_proc_speed = @proc_speed        if (@ram_total is not null)          set @temp_ram_total = @ram_total        if (@temp_ram_free is not null)          set @temp_ram_free = @ram_free        update hardware         set proc_desc = @temp_proc_desc,             proc_speed = @temp_proc_speed,             ram_total = @temp_ram_total,             ram_free = @temp_ram_free,             proc_count = @temp_proc_count          where computer_id = @temp_comp_id    end    else    begin       insert into hardware (computer_id, proc_desc, proc_speed, ram_total, ram_free, proc_count)          values (@comp_id, @proc_desc, @proc_speed, @ram_total, @ram_free, @proc_count)    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@comp_id int, @proc_count int, @proc_desc varchar, @proc_speed int, @ram_total int, @ram_free int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_increment_default_condition    @event_id int as    declare @last_condition int    declare @new_cond_seq int     -- get the old condition count    select @last_condition = max( cond_seq ) from event_condition       where event_id = @event_id     -- update the event_condition table to meet the new requirements -    -- the triggers will take care of updating everything else    set @new_cond_seq = @last_condition + 1    update event_condition set cond_seq = @new_cond_seq       where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @last_condition     -- return the number of the condition we just moved    return @last_condition

create procedure upd_new_computer_info    @computer_id         int,    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @serial_num          varchar (80),    @uuid                varchar (64),    @asset_tag           varchar (64),    @node_type           smallint as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = 0 and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = 0     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr  		where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = 0 	update computer set serial_num = @serial_num, uuid = @uuid, asset_tag = @asset_tag, node_type = @node_type 		where computer_id = @computer_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id) values (@computer_id, 0)     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @serial_num varchar, @uuid varchar, @asset_tag varchar, @node_type smallint)

Object_Definition: create proc upd_next_task_seq    @start_time   datetime as    begin transaction     update event_schedule       set next_task_seq = (select top 1 task_seq from task t where t.event_id = es.event_id order by t.task_seq)       from event_schedule es       where next_task_seq is null          and es.start_time <= @start_time     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_nic_ip_addr 	@computer_id   int, 	@mac_addr      varchar(36), 	@ip_address    varchar(16) = null as 	declare @temp_id int 	declare @high_nic_id   int  	select @temp_id = n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr and n.computer_id = @computer_id  	if (@temp_id is null) 	begin 		select @temp_id = min(n.nic_id) from nics n where n.mac_addr is null and n.computer_id = @computer_id  		if (@temp_id is null) 		begin		  			set @high_nic_id = null 			select @high_nic_id = max(nic_id) from nics where computer_id = @computer_id  			begin transaction  			if (@high_nic_id is null) 				insert into nics (computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr) values (@computer_id, 0, @mac_addr) 			else 				insert into nics (computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr) values (@computer_id, @high_nic_id+1, @mac_addr) 		end 		else  		begin 			begin transaction			 			update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr where nic_id = @temp_id and computer_id = @computer_id 		end  		if (@@error != 0) 			rollback transaction 		else 			commit transaction 		 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_address varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_physical_enclosure    @rack_name		varchar( 64 ),    @enclosure_name  varchar( 64 ),    @model			varchar( 64 ),    @bay_count       varchar( 64 ),    @manuf           varchar(64) = '' as    declare @enclosure_id int    declare @old_bay_count int    declare @new_bay_count int     -- get the old enclosure information before we update it    select @enclosure_id = enclosure_id, @old_bay_count = bay_count       from physical_enclosure e, physical_rack r 	  where r.[real_name] = @rack_name 		 and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name 		 and r.rack_id = e.rack_id     -- we want to set the bay count to the larger of what is was before,    -- or what we're trying to update it to.  Never make it smaller.    -- this was at HP's request, so that they could use sleves to put    -- more servers in an enclousure than originally fit.    set @new_bay_count = @bay_count    if( @new_bay_count < @old_bay_count )       set @new_bay_count = @old_bay_count     -- now update the enclosure    update physical_enclosure       set bay_count = @new_bay_count, 	  model = @model, 	  manuf = @manuf 	  where enclosure_id = @enclosure_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@rack_name varchar, @enclosure_name varchar, @model varchar, @bay_count varchar, @manuf varchar)
