Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subgroup table (for group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_groups_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_groups_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_groups_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root -- Bug #41543 	insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) 	  select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  	    left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  	    left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  	   where c.group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)  	 select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  	   left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  	   left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id 	 where c.group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @id          order by [name]    end     -- loop through subgroups to gather all children computer IDs    declare @subgroup int    select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    while @subgroup is not null    begin       -- get subgroups of this group       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @subgroup       -- remove this group from subgroup table       delete from #wc_groups_to_check where [id] = @subgroup       -- get computers in this group -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) 	select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  		left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  		left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id 	where c.group_id = @subgroup 	order by c.[name]       -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history 	 @computer_id 		int as 	select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,	 	s.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, 	convert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 	from     history_view h inner join 	status_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on 		  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id 	left join external_application ea  		on h.app_id=ea.app_id 	  	where (s.status_code is not null)  and    	(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  	order by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,	 	s.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, 	convert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 	xml_task 	from     history_view h inner join 	status_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id 	where    	(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 	order by h.complete_time desc
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_image_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    	int as 	exec wc_sel_image_task1 @jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq 	exec wc_sel_image_task2 @jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq 	exec wc_sel_image_task3 @jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch 	@id int, 	@selectResults int = 1 as 	declare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) 	set @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 	if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null 		exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) 		 	exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + 		'([level] 	int IDENTITY, 	 	 name 		varchar(128), 		 id			int NOT NULL, 		 type		varchar(8))')  	if @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 	begin 		-- Get the job node 		declare @strsql nvarchar(500) 		declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) 		set @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  						select name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type 						from event where event_id = @intid'  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  		 		--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  		--	select name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type 		--	from event where event_id ='+ @intid)  		-- Get the folder_id 		select @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id 	end	  	-- Get folders down branch to root node 	while @id is not null and @id != -10 	begin 		-- Get the folder node 		set @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  						select name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type 						from event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; 		--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) 		--	select name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type 		--	from event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) 		 		-- Get the parent_id 		declare @oldId int 		set @oldId = @id 		set @id = null 		select @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId 	end  	exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) 		 values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')	-- Return the completed branch list  	if @selectResults = 1 		exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc')
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  		left outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  		left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as 	declare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) 	set @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  	declare @strsql nvarchar(500) 	declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') 		 		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  					  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type 					  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end	     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') 		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  					  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type 					  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; 	       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  					  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type 					  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; 		    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type 	exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc')
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)

create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  	@jobids    varchar(8000), 	@compids    varchar(8000)  as 	--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. 	select lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  		where  		msnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' 		and config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 	union 	select lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  		where  		msnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' 		and config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 	union 	select lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  		where config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 		and domain_member=1 		and config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id 		and reconfig =1  		and target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) 	union 	select lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  		where (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  		and config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 		and domain_member=1 		and config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id 		and reconfig =1  		and target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) 	 	--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information 	-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well 	select count(*) from config_set, config_task  	where 	config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 		and config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id 		and ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    	int as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null 		drop table ##wc_return_code  	-- make a temporary table 	create table ##wc_return_code 		(code		varchar(11), 		 handler		int, 		 result 		int, 		 status   varchar(256))  	-- store the default handler 	insert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) 		select 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status 		from task where event_id=@jobId and   		cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  	-- get the rest of the handlers 	insert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) 		select ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers 		where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and	task_seq=@taskSeq  	select * from ##wc_return_code
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 	@schedule int as 	declare @user int 	select @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  	where es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  	if @user is null 	begin 		select s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  			s.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  			s.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  			'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  			s.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  		from event_schedule s, computer c, event e 		where s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule 	end 	else 	begin 		select s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  			s.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  			s.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  			u.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  			s.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  		from event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u 		where s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule 			and u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] 	end

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_authenticate 	@username 		varchar(64), 	@password		varchar(64), 	@domain			varchar(50) = null, 	@upnname		varchar(128) = null as 	declare @authenticated tinyint 	set @authenticated = 0 	 	declare @matchUser	varchar(64)         declare @matchUPN	varchar(64) 	declare @matchPwd	varchar(64) 	declare @matchNetdom    varchar(64) 	declare @userId	int 	declare @ad_user smallint  	if @domain is not null and len(@domain) > 0 	begin 		declare secuser_cursor cursor for  			select [name], upnname, domain, netbiosdomain, [user_id]  			from securityuser 			where (deleted is null or deleted=0) --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI 						 		open secuser_cursor 	 		fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId 		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			if (@matchUser = @username or @matchUPN = @upnname) and (upper(@domain) = upper(@matchPwd) or upper(@matchNetdom) = upper(@domain)) -- @matchPwd is the domain name 			begin 				set @authenticated = 1 				break 			end 			fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId 		end	 		close secuser_cursor 		deallocate secuser_cursor 	end 	else 	begin 		declare secuser_cursor cursor for select [name], [password], [user_id], ad_user from securityuser  where deleted is null or deleted=0  --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI 		open secuser_cursor 	 		fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user 		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			if @matchUser = @username and @matchPwd = @password and @ad_user = 0 			begin 				set @authenticated = 1 				break 			end 			fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user 		end	 		close secuser_cursor 		deallocate secuser_cursor 	end 	 	if @authenticated = 1 and len(@domain) > 0 		set @authenticated = 2 	else  		set @matchUser = @username --Bug #39428  	select @authenticated as authenticated, @userId as [user_id], @matchUser as securityuser

create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_permission 	@userId			int, 	@permission		int, 	@objectId		int, 	@selectResults  int = 0, 	@tableName     varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights'	 as 	declare @isJob smallint 	set @isJob = 0 	declare @userName varchar(64) 	declare @actualUsername varchar(64)--PRD 7.1.66 Security 	declare @userGroup varchar(64)--PRD 7.1.66 Security 	declare @right int 	set @right = 1 	declare @result smallint 	set @result = 0 	declare @fromAdmin smallint 	set @fromAdmin = 0 	declare @permSource int 	set @permSource = 0 	declare @parentSource int 	set @parentSource = 0 	declare @fromGroup int 	set @fromGroup = 0     --make sure there are no old rows    --Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights 	if object_id('tempdb..'+@tableName+'') is not null 		exec('delete from '+@tableName)  	EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName   	set @result = null 	--Bug #63690 	--select @result = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource from ##wc_last_effective_rights		   	declare @sql    nvarchar(512), 			@params nvarchar(512) 	 	set @sql = 'select @Sqlresult = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource from '+@tableName  	set @params = N'@Sqlresult smallint OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT' 				 	exec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@Sqlresult=@result output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output  	declare @bayCheck smallint 	set @bayCheck = 0  TRAVERSEBRANCH: 	declare @objectName varchar(64) 	if @result = 0 	begin 		-- computer or group object 		if (@objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000) or  			(@objectId = -7 or @objectId = -1 or (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId <= 1000000)) 			exec wc_sel_computer_branch @objectId, 0 		-- job or folder 		else if (@objectId >= 2000001 and @objectId <= 3000000) or 		   (@objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId <= 2000000) or 		   @objectId = -10 		begin 			exec wc_sel_job_branch @objectId, 0 			set @isJob = 1 		end 		-- rack/enclosure/bay 		else 		   exec wc_sel_reb_branch @objectId, 0 	 		declare @level int 		set @level = 1 		  		declare @branch_tablename  varchar (128) 		set @branch_tablename  = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 		DECLARE @dynamicSQL nvarchar(200)         -- Have code that will construct the dynamic SQL 		set @dynamicSQL = 'select [id], [name], [level] from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level]'  		declare @branch_cursor cursor --for select [id], [name], [level] from ##wc_branch order by [level] 		set @dynamicSQL = 'SET @branch_cursor = cursor for ' + @dynamicSQL + '; OPEN @branch_cursor'  		exec sp_executesql                  -- sp_executesql will essentially create a sproc               @dynamicSQL,                 -- The SQL statement to execute (body of sproc)               N'@branch_cursor CURSOR OUTPUT', -- The parameter list for the sproc: OUTPUT CURSOR               @branch_cursor OUTPUT         -- The parameter to pass to the sproc: the CURSOR  		--open branch_cursor 		fetch next from @branch_cursor Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_tasktype 	@folder_id as int as /* 	select all child folder of current folder  temp table. 	For each this folder find child folder and store this in temp table. 	repeat this step for all rows in temp table	 */  declare @tbl_folder table (	folder_id int	 )   insert into @tbl_folder select folder_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for 	select folder_id 	from @tbl_folder  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id while @@fetch_status = 0 begin 	insert into @tbl_folder 	select folder_id 	from event_folder 	where parent_id=@folder_id	  	fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select count(t.folder_id),count(e.event_id) from @tbl_folder t,event e where e.folder_id = t.folder_id select distinct task_type from task where task_type not in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder)) select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type from task where task_type in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder))

Object_Definition: -- #32375 - Select all CE.Net unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_cedotnet as  	-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on CE.Net computers 	select distinct event_id 	from task  	where task_type=13 or task_type=18	 --Bug #41448 - Imaging job are allowed on CE.Net computers.

-- #32375 - Select all handheld unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld as 	if object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_handleld') is not null 		drop table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld  	-- make a temporary table 	create table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld 		(event_id	int)  	insert into ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld 		-- Registory task (13), Image task (15) and Capture PCT task (18) not allowed on pocket pc 		select distinct event_id 		from task  		where task_type=13 or task_type=15 or task_type=18  		union 		-- For pocket pc execution location of script is allowed only on DS Side  		select distinct event_id  		from script_task  		where (location != 1)   		union 		-- Only reboot is allowed on pocket pc (logoff, shutdown etc not allowed) 		select distinct event_id 		from reboot_task  		where (reboot_method != 1) 			 	select event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld

-- #32375 - Select all linux unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux  as  	if object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_linux') is not null 		drop table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux  	-- make a temporary table 	create table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux 		(event_id	int)  	insert into ##wc_unsafe_job_linux 		-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on linux 		select distinct event_id 		from task  		where task_type=13 or task_type=18 		 		union 		-- Only Reboot, Shutdown, WakeUp is allowed on linux for reboot task 		select distinct event_id 		from reboot_task  		where (reboot_method = 8)  			 	select event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_linux

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_computer_configuration    @job int,    @condition int,    @task int,    @computer int,    @computer_name varchar(64),    @ip_hostname varchar(128),    @lic_os_user varchar(64),    @lic_os_org varchar(64),    @lic_os_key varchar(64),    @domain_member smallint,    @domain_name varchar(256),    @nw_pref_server varchar(48),    @nw_pref_tree varchar(64),    @nw_nds_context varchar(128),    @nw_username varchar(128),    @nw_login_to_tree smallint,    @nw_run_scripts smallint,    @ua_username varchar(128),    @ua_full_name varchar(256),    @ua_groups varchar(256),    @ua_password varchar(128),    @ua_must_change smallint,    @ua_cannot_change smallint,    @ua_pw_never_expires smallint,    @msnet_domain_username varchar(256),    @msnet_domain_password varchar(256),    @msnet_dns_domain varchar(512), -- Bug #41687    @reboot_after_config smallint -- PRD item 7.1.60 Reboot option as    declare @config_set_id int    select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task        where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    declare @config_item_id int    select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id       and target_computer_id = @computer        --Microsoft issue: Changes done to handle OU field    declare @msnet_domain_ou varchar(256)    set 	@msnet_domain_ou = null	    if( 	@domain_member <> 0 )    begin	 	if ( CHARINDEX('.',@domain_name) > 0) 	begin 		set @msnet_dns_domain = @domain_name 		set @domain_name = null		 	end      	declare @ouSplit  int	    	set @ouSplit=CHARINDEX('/',@msnet_dns_domain) 	if(@ouSplit>0) 	begin 		set @msnet_domain_ou = SUBSTRING(@msnet_dns_domain, (@ouSplit+1) ,LEN(@msnet_dns_domain)) 		set @msnet_dns_domain = SUBSTRING(@msnet_dns_domain,0,@ouSplit) 	end   	set @ouSplit = CHARINDEX('/', @domain_name) 	if(@ouSplit>0) 	begin 		set @msnet_domain_ou = SUBSTRING( @domain_name , (@ouSplit+1) , LEN( @domain_name )) 		set @domain_name = SUBSTRING( @domain_name , 0, @ouSplit) 	end	    end     update config_item set lic_os_user = @lic_os_user, lic_os_org = @lic_os_org, lic_os_key = @lic_os_key,       domain_member = @domain_member, domain_name = @domain_name, computer_name = @computer_name,       nw_pref_server = @nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree = @nw_pref_tree, msnet_dns_domain = @msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou = @msnet_domain_ou,        nw_nds_context = @nw_nds_context, nw_user_name = @nw_username, nw_login_to_tree = @nw_login_to_tree,        nw_run_scripts = @nw_run_scripts, ua_username = @ua_username,        ua_fullname = @ua_full_name, ua_groups = @ua_groups, ua_password = @ua_password,       ua_must_change = @ua_must_change, ua_cannot_change = @ua_cannot_change,        ua_pw_never_expires = @ua_pw_never_expires, msnet_domain_username = @msnet_domain_username,        msnet_domain_password = @msnet_domain_password, ip_hostname = @ip_hostname, reboot_after_config = @reboot_after_config       where config_item_id = @config_item_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @task int, @computer int, @computer_name varchar, @ip_hostname varchar, @lic_os_user varchar, @lic_os_org varchar, @lic_os_key varchar, @domain_member smallint, @domain_name varchar, @nw_pref_server varchar, @nw_pref_tree varchar, @nw_nds_context varchar, @nw_username varchar, @nw_login_to_tree smallint, @nw_run_scripts smallint, @ua_username varchar, @ua_full_name varchar, @ua_groups varchar, @ua_password varchar, @ua_must_change smallint, @ua_cannot_change smallint, @ua_pw_never_expires smallint, @msnet_domain_username varchar, @msnet_domain_password varchar, @msnet_dns_domain varchar, @reboot_after_config smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_upd_computer_location    @computer_id   int,    @site          varchar(128),    @dept          varchar(128),    @mailstop      varchar(128),    @contact       varchar(128),    @email         varchar(128),    @phone         varchar(128) as    declare @compId int    select @compId = computer_id from location where computer_id=@computer_id      begin transaction    if @compId is null 	begin  		insert into location (computer_id, site, dept, mailstop, contact,  				email, phone) values (@computer_id,  @site, @dept, @mailstop, @contact, 				@email, @phone) 	end    else 	begin 		update location set [site] = @site, [dept] = @dept, [mailstop] = @mailstop, 			[contact] = @contact, [email] = @email, [phone] = @phone 			where computer_id = @computer_id 	end    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @site varchar, @dept varchar, @mailstop varchar, @contact varchar, @email varchar, @phone varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item			int,    @field			int,    @operation	    int,    @value			varchar(256) = null,    @drive			varchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct	    smallint     = -1,    @token			varchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint, @token varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job			int,    @condition		int,    @item1		int,    @item2		int as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 	 	   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId			int,    @conditionId1	int,    @conditionId2	int as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 	   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 	   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 	 	   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@tempCondId 	   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as 	update config_item  	set  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  	where Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) 	and config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)

Object_Definition: --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  	@itemId int as  	declare @domain_name as varchar(512) 	declare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)	  	-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name 	select    		@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, 		@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))		 		when '' then domain_name 		else msnet_dns_domain 		end -- case 	from config_item  	where config_item_id=@itemId  	-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it 	if @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 	begin 		select @username=username, @password=[password]  		from domain_accounts  		where domain=@domain_name		 	 		update config_item  		set  		msnet_domain_username=@username, 		msnet_domain_password=@password 		where config_item_id=@itemId 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree, nw_nds_context, nw_user_name, nw_login_to_tree,          nw_run_scripts, msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou       from computer where computer_id = @computerId    open computer_cursor    fetch next from computer_cursor       into @licOsUser, @licOsOrg, @licOsKey, @ipHostname, @computerName, @domainMember, @domainName,       @nwPrefServer, @nwPrefTree, @nwNdsContext, @nwUserName, @nwLoginToTree, @nwRunScripts,       @msnetDnsDomain, @msnetDomainOu     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    if @@fetch_status = 0    begin       update config_item set lic_os_user=@licOsUser, lic_os_org=@licOsOrg, lic_os_key=@licOsKey,          ip_hostname=@ipHostname, computer_name=@computerName, domain_member=@domainMember,          domain_name=@domainName, nw_pref_server=@nwPrefServer, nw_pref_tree=@nwPrefTree,          nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,          nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,          target_computer_id=@computerId       where config_item_id=@itemId    end     -- cleanup cursor    close computer_cursor    deallocate computer_cursor     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Changes for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @deviceId int, @pciBus int, @pciDevice int, @pciFunction int, @vendorId int, @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @description varchar(64), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDHCP smallint, @winsDHCP smallint -- DNS/Wins DHCP for MSN    -- loop through each of the computer's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device, nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id,           ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, nic_id, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp  from nics where computer_id=@computerId       order by nic_id    open nic_cursor    fetch next from nic_cursor       into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins,        @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP     -- update nic_config_item table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- make sure a nic_config_item record exists       declare @configItem int       select @configItem = count(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id=@itemId          and nic_id=@nicId       -- update existing record       if @configItem = 1       begin          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp=@useDhcp, nic_device_id=@deviceId, nic_pci_bus=@pciBus,             nic_pci_device=@pciDevice, nic_pci_function=@pciFunction, nic_vendor_id=@vendorId,             ip_dns=@ipDns, ip_wins=@ipWins, nic_desc=@description, ip_domain=@ipDomain, netbios=@netBIOS,             dns_use_dhcp = @dnsDHCP, wins_use_dhcp = @winsDHCP          where config_item_id=@itemId and nic_id=@nicId          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId                end       -- create new record       else       begin          insert into nic_config_item             (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device,              nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id, ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp)          values             (@itemId, @nicId, @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction, @vendorId,             @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP)          exec wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing @itemId, @computerId, @nicId       end       fetch next from nic_cursor into @useDhcp, @deviceId, @pciBus, @pciDevice, @pciFunction,           @vendorId, @ipDns, @ipWins, @description, @ipDomain, @nicId, @netBIOS, @dnsDHCP, @winsDHCP    end     -- cleanup    close nic_cursor    deallocate nic_cursor                 -- For PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing    	-- update existing record    	-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    	           delete config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @itemId           	    	-- create new records	           	insert into config_static_route_item    			      (config_item_id, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use])    	select    @itemId, destination, netmask, gateway, interface, metric, flag, ref, [use]    	from         static_routes where  computer_id = @computerId           -- For PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix       	-- update existing record    	-- As there is no primary key, we need to delete all existing records for that item and then add all records    	    	delete dns_suffix where [id] = @itemId    	-- create new records       	    	insert into dns_suffix    			      ([id], dns_suffix, [order])    	select    @itemId, dns_suffix, [order]    	from      dns_suffix where [id] = @computerId
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @computerId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_set    @itemId      int,    @setId		int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256),       @msnetDomainUsername varchar(256), @msnetDomainPassword varchar(256),       @uaUsername varchar(128), @uaFullName varchar(256), @uaPassword varchar(128),       @uaGroups varchar(256), @reboot_after_config smallint    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint,       @uaMustChange smallint, @uaCannotChange smallint, @uaPwNeverExpires smallint,       @uaPrompt smallint     -- fill the variables with config_set record data    select @licOsUser = lic_os_user, @licOsOrg = lic_os_org, @licOsKey = lic_os_key, @nwPrefServer = nw_pref_server,        @nwPrefTree = nw_pref_tree, @nwNdsContext = nw_context, @nwUserName = nw_user_name,        @nwLoginToTree = nw_login_to_tree, @nwRunScripts = nw_run_scripts, @msnetDnsDomain = msnet_dns_domain,        @msnetDomainOu = msnet_domain_ou, @uaUsername = ua_username, @uaFullName = ua_fullname, @uaGroups = ua_groups,        @uaPassword = ua_password, @uaMustChange = ua_must_change, @uaCannotChange = ua_cannot_change,       @uaPwNeverExpires = ua_pw_never_expires, @uaPrompt = ua_prompt, @domainMember = msnet_is_domain_member,        @domainName = msnet_domain_name, @msnetDomainUsername = msnet_domain_username,        @msnetDomainPassword = msnet_domain_password, @reboot_after_config = reboot_after_config       from config_set where config_set_id = @setId    -- generate the first name range value    exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @setId, @computerName output     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    -- collect current config_item values    declare @ilicOsUser varchar(64), @ilicOsOrg varchar(64), @ilicOsKey varchar(64), @iipHostname varchar(128),        @icomputerName varchar(16), @idomainName varchar(512), @inwPrefServer varchar(48),        @inwPrefTree varchar(64), @inwNdsContext varchar(128), @inwUserName varchar(128),        @imsnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @imsnetDomainOu varchar(256), @iuaUsername varchar(128),        @iuaFullName varchar(256), @iuaPassword varchar(128), @iuaGroups varchar(256)    declare @idomainMember smallint, @inwLoginToTree smallint, @inwRunScripts smallint,       @iuaMustChange smallint, @iuaCannotChange smallint, @iuaPwNeverExpires smallint, @iuaPrompt smallint    select @ilicOsUser = lic_os_user, @ilicOsOrg = lic_os_org, @ilicOsKey = lic_os_key,        @iipHostname = ip_hostname, @icomputerName = computer_name, @idomainMember = domain_member,        @idomainName = domain_name, @inwPrefServer = nw_pref_server, @inwPrefTree = nw_pref_tree,        @inwNdsContext = nw_nds_context, @inwUserName = nw_user_name, @inwLoginToTree = nw_login_to_tree,       @inwRunScripts = nw_run_scripts, @imsnetDnsDomain = msnet_dns_domain, @imsnetDomainOu = msnet_domain_ou,        @iuaUsername = ua_username, @iuaFullName = ua_fullname, @iuaPassword = ua_password, @iuaGroups = ua_groups,       @iuaMustChange = ua_must_change, @iuaCannotChange = ua_cannot_change,        @iuaPwNeverExpires = ua_pw_never_expires, @iuaPrompt = ua_prompt       from config_item where config_item_id=@itemId         -- determine which fields to update    -- strings    if @computerName is null or len(@computerName) = 0       set @computerName = @icomputerName    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    if ((@domainName is null or len(@domainName) = 0) and (@msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0))    begin       set @domainName = @idomainName       set @msnetDnsDomain = @imsnetDnsDomain    end    if @nwPrefServer is null or len(@nwPrefServer) = 0       set @nwPrefServer = @inwPrefServer    if @nwPrefTree is null or len(@nwPrefTree) = 0       set @nwPrefTree = @inwPrefTree    if @nwUserName is null or len(@nwUserName) = 0       set @nwUserName = @inwUserName    if @nwNdsContext is null or len(@nwNdsContext) = 0       set @nwNdsContext = @inwNdsContext    if @licOsUser is null or len(@licOsUser) = 0       set @licOsUser = @ilicOsUser    if @licOsOrg is null or len(@licOsOrg) = 0       set @licOsOrg = @ilicOsOrg    if @licOsKey is null or len(@licOsKey) = 0       set @licOsKey = @ilicOsKey    if @ipHostname is null or len(@ipHostname) = 0       set @ipHostname = @iipHostname    --Bug #41687 - Webconsole has a bug when moving a machine from a Workgroup  or Pre-FQDN Domain    --if @msnetDnsDomain is null or len(@msnetDnsDomain) = 0       --set @msnetDnsDomain = @imsnetDnsDomain    if @uaUsername is null or len(@uaUsername) = 0       set @uaUsername = @iuaUsername    if @uaFullName is null or len(@uaFullName) = 0       set @uaFullName = @iuaFullName    if @uaPassword is null or len(@uaPassword) = 0       set @uaPassword = @iuaPassword    if @uaGroups is null or len(@uaGroups) = 0       set @uaGroups = @iuaGroups    -- bools    if @domainMember is null or @domainMember = 2       set @domainMember = @idomainMember    if @nwRunScripts is null or @nwRunScripts = 2       set @nwRunScripts = @inwRunScripts    if @nwLoginToTree is null or @nwLoginToTree = 2       set @nwLoginToTree = @inwLoginToTree    if @uaMustChange is null or @uaMustChange = 2       set @uaMustChange = @iuaMustChange    if @uaCannotChange is null or @uaCannotChange = 2       set @uaCannotChange = @iuaCannotChange    if config_item_id=@itemId    exec wc_upd_next_name @setId, @itemId     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Change for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDhcp smallint, @winsDhcp smallint     --      into @computerId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin     if @itemId is null 		set @addedItem = 0      else 	begin 		if @useExisting = 0  			begin 				delete into config_task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, config_set_id, reconfig)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, @configSetId, null)    end    -- remove hidden config if not doing post configure    else if @postConfig = 0 and @configCount = 1 and (@reconfig is null or @reconfig = 0)    begin       select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task where event_id = @jobId           and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq = @configTask       delete from task where event_id = @jobId and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq = @configTask       delete from config_set where config_set_id = @configSetId    end     -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction    -- return the task Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_ip    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int,    @nic_id int as    -- test for a static IP range    declare @master_ip varchar(16), @duplicate_ip varchar(16), @final_ip varchar(16)    declare @interface_name varchar(64)    declare @interface_id int    declare config_ip_cursor cursor for       select ip, [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @config_set_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open config_ip_cursor    declare item_ip_cursor cursor for       select interface_id from nic_interface where [id] = @config_item_id and nic_id = @nic_id       and [name] is not null    open item_ip_cursor    fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name    fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       if len(@master_ip) > 0       begin          -- test for duplicate IP usage          set @duplicate_ip = @master_ip          set @final_ip = @master_ip          declare @computer_id int          select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id          while @duplicate_ip is not null          begin             set @duplicate_ip = null             -- test for another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface where [id] >= 5000001 and [id] <= 8000000                 and [id] != @computer_id and ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                and c.target_computer_id != @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip             -- test for a config_item assigned to this computer IN THIS CONFIG that already has this IP             select top 1 @duplicate_ip = ip from nic_interface n, config_item c where n.[id] = c.config_item_id                 and c.target_computer_id = @computer_id and n.ip = @final_ip and c.config_item_id = @config_item_id                and [name] != @interface_name             -- get a new IP if a duplicate was found             if @duplicate_ip is not null                exec wc_increment_ip @duplicate_ip, @final_ip output          end           -- update the config_item nic_interface ip value to the non-duplicate found          update nic_interface set ip = @final_ip where interface_id = @interface_id       end        fetch next from config_ip_cursor into @master_ip, @interface_name       fetch next from item_ip_cursor into @interface_id    end    close config_ip_cursor    deallocate config_ip_cursor    close item_ip_cursor    deallocate item_ip_cursor
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int, @nic_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_next_name    @config_set_id int,    @config_item_id int as    -- test for a name range    declare @method smallint    select @method = cname_method from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       -- test for duplicate name usage       declare @duplicate_name varchar(64), @final_name varchar(64)       --PRD item 7.1.12 Use token: To remove the addition of network adapter       select @final_name = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id       if @final_name in ('%NAME%','%SERIALNUM%','%NODENAME%','%NIC1MACADDR%','%NIC2MACADDR%', 			'%NIC3MACADDR%','%NIC4MACADDR%','%NIC5MACADDR%','%NIC6MACADDR%','%NIC7MACADDR%','%NIC8MACADDR%') 	 update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           	where config_item_id = @config_item_id       else       begin       select @final_name = computer_name from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       set @duplicate_name = @final_name       declare @computer_id int       select @computer_id = target_computer_id from config_item where config_item_id = @config_item_id       while @duplicate_name is not null       begin          set @duplicate_name = null          -- test for another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from computer where computer_name = @final_name             and computer_id != @computer_id          -- test for a config_item assigned to another computer that already has this name          select top 1 @duplicate_name = computer_name from config_item where target_computer_id != @computer_id             and computer_name = @final_name          -- get a new name if a duplicate was found          if @duplicate_name is not null             exec wc_increment_name @config_set_id, @duplicate_name, @final_name output       end       -- update the config_item computer_name, ip_hostname to the non-duplicate value generated       update config_item set computer_name = @final_name, ip_hostname = @final_name           where config_item_id = @config_item_id    end    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @config_item_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic 	@computer_id int, 	@mac_addr varchar(36), 	@ip_use_dhcp smallint, 	@ip_domain varchar(128), 	@ip_dns varchar(512), 	@ip_wins varchar(512), 	@nic_pci_bus int, 	@nic_pci_device int, 	@nic_pci_function int, 	@nic_device_id int, 	@nic_vendor_id int, 	@nic_desc varchar(64), 	@nic_location varchar(64), 	@interface_id int, 	@id int, 	@nic_id int, 	@name varchar(64), 	@ip varchar(16), 	@mask varchar(16), 	@gateway varchar(16), 	@broadcast varchar(16), 	@state int 	 as 	begin 		update nics set nics.mac_addr = @mac_addr, 									 nics.ip_use_dhcp = @ip_use_dhcp, 									 nics.ip_domain = @ip_domain, 									 nics.ip_dns = @ip_dns, 									 nics.ip_wins = @ip_wins, 									 nics.nic_pci_bus = @nic_pci_bus, 									 nics.nic_pci_device = @nic_pci_device, 									 nics.nic_pci_function = @nic_pci_function, 									 nics.nic_device_id = @nic_device_id, 									 nics.nic_vendor_id = @nic_vendor_id, 									 nics.nic_desc = @nic_desc, 									 nics.nic_location = @nic_location 											where nics.computer_id = @computer_id  		update  nic_interface set					 nic_interface.id = @id, 									 nic_interface.name = @name, 									 nic_interface.ip = @ip, 									 nic_interface.mask = @mask, 									 nic_interface.gateway = @gateway, 									 nic_interface.broadcast = @broadcast, 									 nic_interface.state = @state 										where  nic_interface.interface_id = @interface_id; 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @ip_use_dhcp smallint, @ip_domain varchar, @ip_dns varchar, @ip_wins varchar, @nic_pci_bus int, @nic_pci_device int, @nic_pci_function int, @nic_device_id int, @nic_vendor_id int, @nic_desc varchar, @nic_location varchar, @interface_id int, @id int, @nic_id int, @name varchar, @ip varchar, @mask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @state int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item    @jobId		int,    @condition		int,     @task		int,     @computerId		int,     @nicId		int,    @domainSuffix	varchar(128),    @ipMethod		smallint,     @wins		varchar(512),    @dns			varchar(512),    @netbios             smallint = 1,--PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configItemId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_item record       begin transaction          update nic_config_item set ip_use_dhcp = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_item_id = @configItemId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId		int,    @condition		int,     @task		int,     @computerId		int,    @nicId		int,    @interfaceId		int,    @ip			varchar(16) = null,    @netmask		varchar(16) = null,    @gateway		varchar(16) = null,    @broadcast		varchar(16) = null,    @name		varchar(64) = null,    @state		int = null,    @last		smallint = 0 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @interfaceId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int, @last smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set    @jobId		int = null,    @condition		int = null,     @task		int = null,    @configSetId		int = null,    @nicId		int,    @domainSuffix	varchar(128),    @ipMethod		smallint,     @wins		varchar(512),    @dns			varchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     if @configSetId is not null    begin       -- update the nic_config_set record       begin transaction          update nic_config_set set ip_method = @ipMethod, ip_domain = @domainSuffix,              ip_dns = @dns, ip_wins = @wins, netbios = @netbios, dns_use_dhcp = @dns_use_dhcp,wins_use_dhcp = @wins_use_dhcp where config_set_id = @configSetId and             nic_id = @nicId              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @nicId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_config_set_interface    @nicId		int,    @interfaceId		int,    @last		smallint = 0,    @jobId		int = null,    @condition		int = null,     @task		int = null,    @configSetId		int = null,    @ip			varchar(16) = null,    @netmask		varchar(16) = null,    @gateway		varchar(16) = null,    @broadcast		varchar(16) = null,    @name		varchar(64) = null,    @state		int = null as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- update the IP interface    begin transaction       update nic_interface set ip = @ip, mask = @netmask, gateway = @gateway,          broadcast = @broadcast, [name] = @name, state = @state where [id] = @id          and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id = @interfaceId        if @last = 1          delete from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId and interface_id > @interfaceId    -- handle errors/commit transaction    if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@nicId int, @interfaceId int, @last smallint, @jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @configSetId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_nic_interface_from_existing    @itemId int,    @id int,    @nicId int as    declare @name varchar(64)    declare @ip varchar(16), @mask varchar(16), @gateway varchar(16), @broadcast varchar(16)    declare @state int, @interfaceCount int    set @interfaceCount = 0    -- incremental IP for updates from config_set    declare @increment_ip bit    if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000       set @increment_ip = 1    declare nic_interface_cursor cursor for       select [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state from nic_interface where id = @id       and nic_id = @nicId order by interface_id    open nic_interface_cursor    fetch next from nic_interface_cursor       into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    --Bug #43065 To save computer nic_interface data.    declare @iname varchar(64), @iip varchar(16), @imask varchar(16),        @igateway varchar(16), @ibroadcast varchar(16), @istate int   if @id >= 3000001 and @id <= 4000000   begin    select @iname = name, @iip = ip, @imask = mask, @igateway = gateway, @ibroadcast = broadcast, @istate = state from      nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId          if @name is null or len(@name) = 0       set @name = @iname    if @ip is null or len(@ip) = 0       set @ip = @iip    if @mask is null or len(@mask) = 0       set @mask = @imask    if @gateway is null or len(@gateway) = 0       set @gateway = @igateway    if @broadcast is null or len(@broadcast) = 0       set @broadcast = @ibroadcast    if @state is null        set @state = @istate        end    -- remove existing nic_interface objects and always add new ones    delete from nic_interface where id = @itemId and nic_id = @nicId     -- update nic_inteface table with variable data    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- create new record       insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway, broadcast, state)          values (@itemId, @nicId, @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state)              if @increment_ip = 1          exec wc_upd_next_ip @id, @itemId, @nicId                 fetch next from nic_interface_cursor          into @name, @ip, @mask, @gateway, @broadcast, @state    end     close nic_interface_cursor    deallocate nic_interface_cursor
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int, @id int, @nicId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_power_control_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq		int,    @type    	smallint,    @forceApps	smallint as    -- update the power control task    begin transaction       update reboot_task set          reboot_method=@type, [force]=@forceApps          where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction     select @@error as error

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_registry_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq		int,    @type 		smallint,    @directory	varchar(254),    @osDir		varchar(254),    @copyUsers	smallint,    @bootoption_id int = null, --PRD item 7.1.1 PXE pre boot option    @bootimage_arch int = 0 as       update registry_task set upload=@type, directory=@directory, 	     local_dir=@osDir, include_user=@copyUsers 	  where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq 	   	  update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch=@bootimage_arch where event_id=@jobId  		and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @type smallint, @directory varchar, @osDir varchar, @copyUsers smallint, @bootoption_id int, @bootimage_arch int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_schedule    @schedule int,    @computer int,    @job int,    @startTime datetime,    @recur int,    @recurType smallint,    @defer int,    @dependantScheduleId int     as    if @dependantScheduleId <= 100000000 or @dependantScheduleId > 200000000        set @dependantScheduleId = null    begin transaction       update event_schedule set computer_id = @computer, start_time = @startTime,           recur_value = @recur, recur_type = @recurType, defer_mins = @defer,           dep_schedule_id = @dependantScheduleId, status_code = null, status = '',          next_task_seq = 0, cond_seq = null, broker_time = null, end_time = null,          exit_code = null, exit_module = null  where schedule_id = @schedule 	  --Bug #36624 To set job_exec_time null at reschudule. 	  update event_schedule_info set job_exec_time = null where schedule_id = @schedule    if @@error != 0    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule int, @computer int, @job int, @startTime datetime, @recur int, @recurType smallint, @defer int, @dependantScheduleId int)

Object_Definition: create  procedure wc_upd_schedule_info  	@schedule_id 	int,     @user_id	int,     @app_id int =0 --Enhance ASDK - change to update extaernal App ID as 	declare @scheduleCount int 	set @scheduleCount = 0               select @scheduleCount=count(schedule_id ) from event_schedule_info where schedule_id=@schedule_id               begin transaction 		if @scheduleCount > 0  		update event_schedule_info set windows_user_id =  @user_id, app_id=@app_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id 		 else  		insert into event_schedule_info (schedule_id,windows_user_id) values(@schedule_id,@user_id) 		  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 		return 	end  	commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @user_id int, @app_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_script_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq		int,    @scriptFile	varchar(256),    @script		varchar(6000),    @description varchar(128),    @platform	smallint,    @runAtServer smallint,    @window		smallint,    @username	varchar(128) = null,    @password	varchar(128) = null,     -- PRD Item 7.2.2 Extend Run Script task    @addlcmdline varchar(512)=null,    @bootoption_id int=null, --PRD item 7.1.1 PXE pre boot option    @execution_mode smallint=1, --PRD UI changes of Automation    @bootimage_arch int=0,    @execute_options smallint=0 as       update script_task set script_file=@scriptFile, script=@script,  	     [description]=@description, os_reqd=@platform, location=@runAtServer, 		 window=@window, username=@username, password=@password,addl_cmdline=@addlcmdline, execution_mode=@execution_mode, execute_options=@execute_options 	  where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq 	   	  update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch=@bootimage_arch where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int, @scriptFile varchar, @script varchar, @description varchar, @platform smallint, @runAtServer smallint, @window smallint, @username varchar, @password varchar, @addlcmdline varchar, @bootoption_id int, @execution_mode smallint, @bootimage_arch int, @execute_options smallint)
