Object_Definition: create procedure sel_comp_status_code 	@schedule_id 	int, 	@check_task		int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select @ret_val = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 	end 	else 	begin 		if @check_task = 1 		begin 			set @ret_val = null 			select top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq from task t, event_schedule es 				where t.event_id = es.event_id and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 					and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 					and es.status_code != 0 					and es.status_code is not null 					and es.next_task_seq >= 0 					and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id 				order by t.task_seq asc  			if @ret_val is null 			begin 				set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 			end 		end 	end  	return @ret_val
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @check_task int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_event_tree]     @nInitDeployIcon     int,     @nFolderIcon         int,     @nBaseIcon           int,     @user_id             int,     @do_visibility_check int    -- not used AS BEGIN     EXEC @do_visibility_check = is_need_check_visibility @user_id, -10     IF ( @do_visibility_check = 0 )     BEGIN         SELECT      event_id  AS [ID],                     folder_id AS [ParentID],                     201       AS [Container],                     CASE WHEN event_id = 2000001                               THEN @nInitDeployIcon                          WHEN master_guid IS NOT NULL AND master_server IS NOT NULL                                THEN 68 -- IIDX_LINKED_JOB                               ELSE @nBaseIcon                      END      AS [Icon],                     [name],                     CASE WHEN event_id = 2000001 THEN 0 ELSE 3 END AS [OrderSeq]             FROM    event         UNION         SELECT      folder_id,                     parent_id,                     200,                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016                               THEN 49 -- IIDX_SYSTEM_EVENT_FOLDER                               ELSE @nFolderIcon                     END,                     [name],                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END             FROM    event_folder         ORDER BY 2, 6, 5, 1     END     ELSE     BEGIN         DECLARE       @tmpUsrObj TABLE (ObjectId int, PermissionId int, Allow int)         INSERT INTO   @tmpUsrObj             SELECT    p.[object_id], p.[permission_id], p.[allow]                 FROM  securityuser           u                 JOIN  securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = u.[user_id]                 WHERE u.[user_id] = @user_id                 AND   p.[object_id] > 1000000              DECLARE      @tmpObjs TABLE (ObjectId int, Visible int)             INSERT INTO  @tmpObjs                 SELECT   DISTINCT [object_id], 1                     FROM (                         SELECT        p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                             FROM      securitygroupmember    m                             JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                             LEFT JOIN @tmpUsrObj             u ON u.ObjectId = p.[object_id] AND u.PermissionId = p.[permission_id]                             WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                             AND       p.[object_id] > 1000000                             AND       u.ObjectId IS NULL                             GROUP BY  p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                             HAVING    MIN(p.[allow]) > 0                     ) a                 UNION ALL                 SELECT   DISTINCT ObjectId, 1 FROM  @tmpUsrObj WHERE Allow > 0          WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    ef.folder_id, 1                     FROM  event_folder ef                     JOIN  @tmpObjs ov on ov.ObjectId = ef.parent_id                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tmpObjs cr where cr.ObjectId = ef.folder_id)          DECLARE @i int = 1         WHILE   @i > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    DISTINCT ef.parent_id, 0                     FROM  event_folder ef                     JOIN  @tmpObjs    oo ON oo.ObjectId = ef.folder_id                     WHERE ef.parent_id NOT IN (SELECT ObjectId FROM @tmpObjs )              SET @i = @@ROWCOUNT         END          SELECT      event_id         AS [ID],                     folder_id        AS [ParentID],                     201              AS [Container],                     @nInitDeployIcon AS [Icon],                     [name],                     0                AS [OrderSeq]             FROM    event             WHERE   event_id = 2000001         UNION         SELECT      event_id,                     folder_id,                     201,                     CASE WHEN master_guid IS NOT NULL AND master_server IS NOT NULL                               THEN 68 -- IIDX_LINKED_JOB                               ELSE @nBaseIcon                      END,                     [name],                     3             FROM    event    ev             JOIN    @tmpObjs ov ON ov.Visible = 1 AND ov.ObjectId = ev.folder_id OR (ev.folder_id IS NULL AND ov.ObjectId = ev.event_id)             WHERE   event_id <> 2000001         UNION         SELECT      folder_id,                     parent_id,                     200,                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016                               THEN 49 -- IIDX_SYSTEM_EVENT_FOLDER                               ELSE @nFolderIcon                     END,                     [name],                     CASE WHEN folder_id > 1000000 AND folder_id < 1000016 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END             FROM    event_folder ef             JOIN    @tmpObjs     ov ON ov.ObjectId = ef.folder_id         ORDER BY 2, 6, 5, 1     END END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@nInitDeployIcon int, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int, @user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules    @cur_time   datetime as 	select top 50 es.broker_time, es.computer_id, es.event_id, es.next_task_seq, es.schedule_id, es.start_time,  		es.status, es.status_code, es.recur_type, es.recur_value, es.defer_mins, es.cond_seq, es.config_choice_id,  		es.rip_replace_event, es.initial_deployment, st.location, st.cond_seq 		from event_schedule es  left outer join script_task st on 				es.event_id = st.event_id 				and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq or es.cond_seq is null) 				and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq 		where start_time <= @cur_time 		and ( next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null ) 		and ( status_code is NULL or status_code = -2 ) 		and es.schedule_id in 		(	select top 1 schedule_id 			from event_schedule es2 			where computer_id = es.computer_id 				and start_time <= @cur_time 				and ( next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null ) 				and ( status_code is NULL or status_code = -2 )                 and ( es2.dep_schedule_id is null or                    es2.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule                       where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 and schedule_id = es2.dep_schedule_id ) ) 			order by start_time, schedule_id 		)         and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or            dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule 		      where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 and schedule_id = es.dep_schedule_id ) ) 		and computer_id not in 					( select computer_id 						from event_schedule 			where next_task_seq > -1 				and (status_code < 0 and es.schedule_id != schedule_id) 		) 		and( computer_id in (select computer_id from sessions) 			or st.location = 2) 		order by start_time, schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines    @time      datetime,    @wol_wait  int = 60,    @to_all    char(1) = 'Y' as    declare @wol_time datetime    set @wol_time = DATEADD(second, -@wol_wait, @time)     --    -- I changed the join on the nic_interface table to a left outer join because there are no    -- entries in the nic_interface table if BootWorks is the only agent that's connected to the    -- database.  This is because we don't want BootWorks to update the nic_interface table    -- because it's supposed to be used for the production OS.    -- This fixes bug #24899.    --     if (@to_all = 'Y')    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c 		    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) 		order by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end    else    begin       select n.mac_addr, ni.ip as ip_address, ni.mask as ip_netmask, c.computer_id, es.schedule_id, c.node_type          from computer c 			join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on (ni.id = n.computer_id and ni.nic_id = n.nic_id)          where c.wol_support = 1             and (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time)             and es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		    and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0  and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and ( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) ) 		order by n.mac_addr, start_time desc, schedule_id    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@time datetime, @wol_wait int, @to_all char)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_machines_ignore_last_wol_attempt    @time      datetime as       select top 1 c.computer_id           from computer c 		    join event_schedule es on es.computer_id = c.computer_id 			join nics n on n.computer_id = es.computer_id and n.mac_addr is not null 			-- see comment above about left outer join 			left outer join nic_interface ni on ni.id = n.computer_id          where -- (c.last_wol_attempt <= @wol_time or c.last_wol_attempt is null or c.last_wol_attempt < es.start_time) and  			es.next_task_seq > -1 and (es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code = -2) 		      and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and es.start_time <= @time             and es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 and computer_id = es.computer_id)             and( es.computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions where computer_id = es.computer_id) 		and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  				where es.event_id = st.event_id  					and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 					and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2)  				)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_expired_schedules_wol    @time   datetime as  select [broker_time], [computer_id], [event_id], [next_task_seq], [schedule_id], [start_time], [status],           [status_code], [recur_type], [recur_value], [defer_mins], [cond_seq], [config_choice_id]    from event_schedule es    where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null) and (status_code is null or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @time          and computer_id not in ( select computer_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq > -1 and status_code < 0 )          and computer_id not in ( select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is null and computer_id not in (select computer_id from nics where mac_addr is not null) )          and( computer_id not in ( select computer_id from sessions )  			and es.event_id not in (select event_id from script_task st  							where es.event_id = st.event_id  							and ( es.cond_seq = st.cond_seq ) 							and es.next_task_seq = st.task_seq and st.location=2) )          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )    order by start_time, schedule_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_find_next_computer     @BeginID char(7),     @SearchTable varchar(255),     @SearchColumn varchar(255),     @SearchData varchar(255) as declare @Children TABLE (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int) declare @RowCnt int declare @MaxRows int declare @ExecSql nvarchar(2048) --LB#74365  create table #GroupOrder (group_id int, parent_id int, name varchar(64), search_order int) insert into #GroupOrder (group_id, parent_id, name, search_order)   select group_id, parent_id, name, 2147483647   from computer_group    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id IS NULL AND group_id != -7 order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end  create table  #SortedComputers (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, computer_id int) insert     into      #SortedComputers (computer_id)     select    c.computer_id     from      computer    c     left join #GroupOrder g on c.group_id = g.group_id     order by  isnull(g.search_order, case when c.node_type IS NULL then 2147483647                                           when c.node_type < 3     then 1 else NULL end) DESC, c.name  select @ExecSql =  case @SearchTable   when 'nic_interface' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.id AND            t.' + @SearchColumn + ' LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   when 'all_fields' then     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM   #SortedComputers s LEFT OUTER JOIN             computer c ON s.computer_id = c.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nics n ON s.computer_id = n.computer_id LEFT OUTER JOIN             nic_interface i ON s.computer_id = i.id LEFT OUTER JOIN             physical_bay p ON s.computer_id = p.computer_id      WHERE (c.computer_id LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.name LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.lic_os_user LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.lic_os_key LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.computer_name LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.asset_tag LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.serial_num LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.logged_on_user LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             c.uuid LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             n.mac_addr LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             i.ip LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' OR             p.real_name LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''') AND             s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum'   else     'SELECT s.computer_id      FROM #SortedComputers s, ' + @SearchTable + ' t      WHERE s.computer_id = t.computer_id AND            t.' + @SearchColumn + ' LIKE ''' + @SearchData + ''' AND            s.rownum >= (SELECT rownum FROM #SortedComputers WHERE computer_id = ' + @BeginID + ')      ORDER BY s.rownum' end execute sp_executesql @ExecSql drop table #SortedComputers drop table #GroupOrder
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@BeginID char, @SearchTable varchar, @SearchColumn varchar, @SearchData varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_find_next_computer_set_order (@GroupID int) as begin   declare @Children table (rownum int identity (1, 1) primary key NOT NULL, group_id int)   declare @RowCnt int   declare @MaxRows int   declare @ExecSql nvarchar(255)    set @RowCnt = 1    insert into @Children (group_id) select group_id from #GroupOrder where parent_id = @GroupID order by name    select @MaxRows = count(1) from @Children    while @RowCnt <= @MaxRows   begin     select @ExecSql = 'EXEC sel_find_next_computer_set_order ' + CAST(group_id as varchar(255)) + '' from @Children where rownum = @RowCnt     execute sp_executesql @ExecSql     select @RowCnt = @RowCnt + 1   end    update #GroupOrder set search_order = (select MIN(search_order) - 1 from #GroupOrder) where group_id = @GroupID  end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@GroupID int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sel_group_tree]     @user_id             int,     @do_visibility_check int,    -- ignore     @bComps              tinyint = 1 AS BEGIN     declare @cont_folder int     declare @cont_physical_device_non_leaf int     declare @cont_physical_device_leaf int      set @cont_folder = 0;     set @cont_physical_device_non_leaf = 100;     set @cont_physical_device_leaf = 101;      declare @iidx_group_off int     declare @iidx_rack int     declare @iidx_enclosure int     declare @iidx_bay int     declare @iidx_empty_bay int     declare @iidx_bay_wait int     declare @iidx_virt_bay int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine_host_group int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine_host int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine int     declare @iidx_virtual_machine_no_client int      set @iidx_group_off = 3;     set @iidx_rack = 35;     set @iidx_enclosure = 36;     set @iidx_bay = 37;     set @iidx_empty_bay = 38;     set @iidx_bay_wait = 45;     set @iidx_virt_bay = 67;     set @iidx_virtual_machine_host_group = 70;     set @iidx_virtual_machine_host = 71;     set @iidx_virtual_machine = 72;     set @iidx_virtual_machine_no_client = 80      declare @host_const int     declare @vm_const   int      set @host_const = 12000000     set @vm_const   = 13000000      DECLARE @tmpObjs TABLE (GroupId int)      EXEC @do_visibility_check = is_need_check_visibility @user_id, -1     IF ( @do_visibility_check = 1 )     BEGIN         DECLARE       @tmpUsrObj TABLE (ObjectId int, PermissionId int, Allow int)         INSERT INTO   @tmpUsrObj             SELECT    p.[object_id], p.[permission_id], p.[allow]                 FROM  securityuser           u                 JOIN  securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = u.[user_id]                 WHERE u.[user_id] = @user_id                 AND   p.[object_id] <= 1000000          INSERT INTO  @tmpObjs             SELECT   DISTINCT [object_id]                 FROM (                     SELECT        p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                         FROM      securitygroupmember    m                         JOIN      securitypermissionlink p ON p.[user_id] = m.[group_id]                         LEFT JOIN @tmpUsrObj             u ON u.ObjectId = p.[object_id] AND u.PermissionId = p.[permission_id]                         WHERE     m.[user_id] = @user_id                         AND       p.[object_id] <= 1000000                         AND       u.ObjectId IS NULL                         GROUP BY  p.[object_id], p.[permission_id]                         HAVING    MIN(p.[allow]) > 0                 ) a             UNION ALL             SELECT   DISTINCT ObjectId FROM  @tmpUsrObj WHERE Allow > 0          WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    cg.GroupId                     FROM  ( SELECT   [group_id] AS [GroupId],                                         CASE WHEN [parent_id] IS NULL AND [group_id] > -1 THEN -1 ELSE [parent_id] END AS [ParentGrId]                                 FROM [computer_group]                             ) cg                     JOIN  @tmpObjs ov on ov.GroupId = cg.ParentGrId                     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tmpObjs cr where cr.GroupId = cg.GroupId)          DECLARE @i int = 1         WHILE   @i > 0         BEGIN             INSERT INTO   @tmpObjs                 SELECT    DISTINCT cg.parent_id                     FROM  computer_group cg                     JOIN  @tmpObjs    oo ON oo.GroupId = cg.group_id                     WHERE cg.parent_id NOT IN (SELECT GroupId FROM @tmpObjs )              SET @i = @@ROWCOUNT         END     END      IF ( @bComps = 0 )     BEGIN         -- only display containers and physical devices (no computers)          SELECT        group_id        AS [id],                       parent_id       AS [parentid],                       @cont_folder    AS [container],                       @iidx_group_off AS [icon],                       name            AS [name]             FROM      computer_group  cg             LEFT JOIN @tmpObjs        ov ON ov.GroupId = cg.group_id             WHERE     @do_visibility_check = 0             OR        ov.GroupId IS NOT NULL         UNION         SELECT        rack_id, -9, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_rack, name             FROM      physical_rack         UNION         SELECT        enclosure_id, rack_id, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_enclosure, name             FROM      physical_enclosure         UNION         SELECT        bay_id, enclosure_id, @cont_physical_device_leaf,                       coalesce(                         ( select @iidx_virt_bay where e.initial_event_id is not null),                         ( select @iidx_bay_wait where e.computer_id in ( select sz.computer_id from sessions sz where sz.computer_id = e.computer_id and sz.wait_state = 1 ) ),                         ( select @iidx_empty_bay where e.computer_id is null ),                         ( select @iidx_bay )                       ),                       [name]             FROM      physical_bay e         ORDER BY 2, 3, 5     END     ELSE     BEGIN         -- display containers with computers also          SELECT        group_id     as [id],                       parent_id    as [parentid],                       @cont_folder as [container],                       icon         as [icon],                       name,                       0            as [proc_type],                       0            as [os_bit],                       0             FROM      computer_group  cg             LEFT JOIN @tmpObjs        ov ON ov.GroupId = cg.group_id             WHERE   ( @do_visibility_check = 0 OR ov.GroupId IS NOT NULL )         UNION         SELECT        cc.computer_id, cc.group_id, cc.node_type, cc.icon, cc.[name],                       coalesce(( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = cc.computer_id ), 0),                       coalesce([os_bit], 32),                       0             FROM      computer cc             LEFT JOIN @tmpObjs ov ON ov.GroupId = cc.group_id OR ( cc.group_id IS NULL AND ov.GroupId = -1 )             WHERE     cc.hidden is null             AND     ( @do_visibility_check = 0 OR ov.GroupId IS NOT NULL )         UNION         SELECT    c.rack_id, -9, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_rack, c.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  physical_rack c         UNION         SELECT    d.enclosure_id, d.rack_id, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_enclosure, d.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  physical_enclosure d         UNION         SELECT    e.bay_id, e.enclosure_id, @cont_physical_device_leaf,                   coalesce(                     ( select @iidx_virt_bay where e.initial_event_id is not null),                     ( select @iidx_bay_wait where e.computer_id in ( select sz.computer_id from sessions sz where sz.computer_id = e.computer_id and sz.wait_state = 1 ) ),                     ( select @iidx_empty_bay where e.computer_id is null ),                     ( select @iidx_bay )                     ),                   e.[name], 0, 0, e.idx             FROM  physical_bay e         UNION         SELECT    f.virtual_machine_host_group_id, -11, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_virtual_machine_host_group, f.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  virtual_machine_host_group f          UNION         SELECT    g.computer_id + @host_const, g.virtual_machine_host_group_id, @cont_physical_device_non_leaf, @iidx_virtual_machine_host, g.name, 0, 0, 0             FROM  computer g             WHERE g.virtual_machine_host_group_id IS NOT NULL             AND   g.virtual_machine_host_id IS NULL         UNION         SELECT    computer_id + @vm_const, virtual_machine_host_id + @host_const, @cont_physical_device_leaf,                   CASE WHEN hidden = 1 THEN @iidx_virtual_machine_no_client                                        ELSE @iidx_virtual_machine                   END,                   [name], 0, 0, 0             FROM  computer             WHERE virtual_machine_host_id IS NOT NULL         ORDER BY 2, 3, 8, 5, 7     END END

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_inventory_group_tree 	@user_id int, 	@do_visibility_check int as 	declare @cont_folder int 	declare @cont_thin_client int  	select @cont_folder = 0; 	select @cont_thin_client = 4;  	-- display containers with computers also 	select  		group_id as id,  		parent_id as parentid,  		@cont_folder as container,  		icon as icon,  		name,  		0 as proc_type,  		0 as [os_bit],	 		0 	from computer_group cg left outer join #computer_visibility ov  			on cg.group_id = ov.object_id where @do_visibility_check = 0 or (ov.user_id = @user_id and (ov.visible > 0)) 	union 	select 		a.computer_id, 		a.group_id, 		a.node_type,         a.icon, 		a.[name], 		coalesce( 			( select h.proc_type from hardware h where h.computer_id = a.computer_id), 			(0) 			) as proc_type, 		coalesce([os_bit], 32),	 		0 	from 		computer a left outer join nics n 			on a.computer_id = n.computer_id 		where a.hidden is null and node_type = @cont_thin_client  			and (@do_visibility_check = 0 or exists  				(select visible from #computer_visibility ov  					where ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.visible = 1 and ((ov.object_id = a.group_id) or (ov.object_id = -1 and a.group_id is null) 					or (a.group_id is null and ov.object_id = a.computer_id) ) ) ) --63670, 63679 --					where ov.user_id = @user_id and ov.object_id = a.group_id and ov.visible = 1) 	order by 2 asc, 3 asc, 8 asc, 5 asc, 7 asc
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user_id int, @do_visibility_check int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_boot_optionid_valid  @bootoption_id int as begin declare @returnoptionid as int  if object_id ('dbo.x_bootoptions') is not null begin   set @returnoptionid = (select top 1 bo.bootoption_id from boot_options bo, x_bootoptions xbo     where bo.bootoption_type = xbo.bootoption_type and     bo.pxe_description = xbo.pxe_description and xbo.bootoption_id = @bootoption_id) end else   set @returnoptionid = 0  return @returnoptionid end

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure [dbo].[sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast]  	@event_id	int as BEGIN 	declare @event_count int      SET @event_count = 0 	select @event_count = count(event_id)  		from image_task 		where event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0  	if( @event_count > 0 ) 	begin 			return 1 	end  	return 0 END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure [dbo].[sel_is_deployment_using_ghostcast_first_task]  	@event_id	int as BEGIN 	declare @task_count int      SET @task_count = 0 	select @task_count = count(event_id)  		from image_task 		where event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0  		       and task_seq =(select min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @event_id)  	if( @task_count > 0 ) 	begin 			return 1 	end  	return 0 END

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_image_post_config    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc 	 	if (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) 	begin 		return -1 	end  	select @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  	 	if( @deploy_any_event_id != 0 ) 		set @next_task_seq = @next_task_seq + 1  	select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_set 		where config_set_id = (select config_set_id from config_task 			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq and reconfig is null)  	if (@config_set_id is null) 		return -1     return @next_task_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_is_next_task_deploy_anywhere    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    declare @config_set_id   int    declare @deploy_any_event_id int     set @next_task_seq = null    set @config_set_id = null    set @deploy_any_event_id = null     select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc 	 	if (@next_task_seq = -1 or @next_task_seq is null) 	begin 		return -1 	end  	select @deploy_any_event_id = event_id from deploy_anywhere_task  			where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @next_task_seq  	 	if( @deploy_any_event_id is null) 		return -1 	 	return 	@next_task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_job_status_info 	@computer_id int as 	select t.task_type, es.schedule_id, es.next_task_seq, 		case t.task_type 			when 10 then				-- Script 				(select case when location = 1 then 'None' 							 when execution_mode = 0 then 'Automation'  							 else 'Production' 						end  					from script_task st 					where st.event_id = t.event_id  						and st.cond_seq = t.cond_seq  						and st.task_seq = t.task_seq) 			when 11 then 'Both'			-- Reboot 			when 12 then 'Production'	-- Copy File 			when 13 then 'Automation'	-- Registry  			when 14 then 'Both'			-- Config 			when 15 then 'Automation'	-- Image 			when 16 then 'Production'	-- Install 			when 17 then 'Automation'	-- Unattended Install 			when 18 then 'Production'	-- PCT 			when 19 then 'Production'	-- Inventory 			when 21 then 'Production'	-- Update Agent  			else 'None' 		end as boot_env 		from dbo.task t join dbo.event_schedule es  			on es.computer_id = @computer_id  				and t.event_id = es.event_id  				and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq  				and t.task_seq = es.next_task_seq 		where es.status_code is not null  			and es.status_code != -2 			and es.status_code < 0
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_lic_info    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36) as    declare  @del_expire   datetime     select @del_expire = expire from deleted_computer where mac_addr = @mac_addr     if (@computer_id = 0)    begin       select @del_expire as del_expire    end    else    begin       select expire, limited_license, @del_expire as del_expire          from computer where computer_id = @computer_id    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_more_work    @computer_id    int,    @time_now       datetime as    declare  @work_to_do    int,             @schedule_id   int     if (@computer_id is not null)    begin       select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule          where (next_task_seq > -1             and ( status_code is NULL or status_code < 0 )             and start_time <= @time_now             and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )             and computer_id = @computer_id)             or (event_id = 2000001 and status_code is NULL and computer_id = @computer_id)        if (@schedule_id is null)          set @work_to_do = 0       else          set @work_to_do = 1        return @work_to_do    end   --LB#35552   -- select computer_id from sessions where platform = 1 and computer_id not in (    select computer_id from sessions where boot_env = 1 and computer_id not in ( -- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }       select distinct s.computer_id from sessions s, event_schedule es          where s.computer_id = es.computer_id --LB#35552    and platform = 1 	       and boot_env = 1		-- { HLS LB#35705BugFixes }             and es.start_time <= @time_now             and ( ( es.status_code is NULL or es.status_code < 0 )                   and ( es.dep_schedule_id is null or es.dep_schedule_id in                      ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )                or ( es.event_id = 2000001 and es.status_code is NULL ) ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @time_now datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_expired_time    @cur_time   datetime as    declare @sched_in_progress int     select top 1 @sched_in_progress = schedule_id from event_schedule where status_code < 0    if (@sched_in_progress is null)       set @sched_in_progress = 0    else       set @sched_in_progress = 1     if exists (select top 1 es.schedule_id       from event_schedule es       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time <= @cur_time          and es.computer_id in (select s.computer_id from sessions s where es.computer_id = s.computer_id          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in 		( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ))))    select dateadd (mi, -1, @cur_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress    else    select min (start_time) as next_time, @sched_in_progress as sched_in_progress       from event_schedule       where (next_task_seq > -1 or next_task_seq is null)          and (status_code is NULL or status_code = -2)          and start_time >= @cur_time          and ( dep_schedule_id is null or dep_schedule_id in ( select schedule_id from event_schedule where next_task_seq = -1 and status_code = 0 ) )
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@cur_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_seq_by_sched    @schedule_id int as    declare @event_id int    declare @cond_seq int    declare @task_seq int    declare @next_sequence int     select @event_id = event_id, @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq       from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     exec @next_sequence = sel_next_sequence @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq     return @next_sequence
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_sequence    @event_id int,    @cond_seq int,    @task_seq int as    declare @next_task_seq   int    set @next_task_seq = null    select top 1 @next_task_seq = task_seq          from task          where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq > @task_seq          order by task_seq asc     return coalesce (@next_task_seq, -1)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_system_id    @object_id   varchar(64),    @update      char(1) = 'T' as    declare  @last_used_id int,             @tran         int    declare  @err    varchar(100)     set @tran = @@trancount     if (@tran = 0)       begin transaction     select @last_used_id = last_used_id + 1       from system_id with (xlock, rowlock)       where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)  	if 'EVENT_ID' = upper(@object_id) 	Begin 		if @last_used_id = 3000000 		begin 			SET @last_used_id = 19000000 		end 	end     if (@last_used_id is null)    begin       set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id in selecting object ' + @object_id       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction;       -- raiserror 30008 @err 	  -- THROW 30008, @err, 1 	  RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)       return 0    end     if (upper(@update) = 'T')    begin       update system_id set last_used_id = @last_used_id          where [object_name] = upper(@object_id)        if (@@error != 0)       begin          set @err = 'Error in sel_next_system_id updating object ' + @object_id          if (@tran = 0)             rollback transaction;          -- raiserror 30009 @err 		 -- THROW 30009, @err, 1 		 RAISERROR (@err, 16, 1)          return 0       end        if (@tran = 0)          commit transaction    end    else    begin       if (@tran = 0)          rollback transaction    end     return coalesce (@last_used_id, 0)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@object_id varchar, @update char)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_task_seq 	@schedule_id 	int as 	declare @ret_val int 	select top 1 @ret_val = t.task_seq 		from task t, event_schedule es 		where t.event_id = es.event_id 				and t.cond_seq = es.cond_seq 				and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 				and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id 				order by t.task_seq asc  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = 0x4a4d4120 	end  	return @ret_val
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_next_task_seq_copy @event_id bigint, @cond_seq int as declare @ret_val int  	select top 1 @ret_val = task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq  order by  task_seq desc  	if @ret_val is null 	begin 		set @ret_val = -1 	end  	set @ret_val = @ret_val +1  	return @ret_val
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id bigint, @cond_seq int)

redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@temp_id is not null)    begin       declare @new_history_id int       declare @min_task_seq int        set @min_task_seq = null       select @min_task_seq = min(task_seq) from task               where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)        if (@min_task_seq is null)       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and redeploy = 1             order by [sequence], history_id desc       end       else       begin          select top 1 @new_history_id = history_id from history_view             where event_id = (select event_id from history_view where history_id = @temp_id)                   and history_id <= @temp_id and [sequence] = @min_task_seq and redeploy = 1              order by history_id desc       end 		                 if (@new_history_id != @temp_id)          set @temp_id = @new_history_id        select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view          where history_id < @temp_id             and computer_id = @computer_id             and task_type != 10             and task_type != 11             and task_type != 12 	    and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        select top 1 @script_tag_id = history_id from history_view          where computer_id = @computer_id             and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%')  and redeploy = 1          order by history_id desc        -- get the one which was the lastest one ran.       if ((@script_tag_id > @history_id or @history_id is null) and @script_tag_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @script_tag_id - 1       end        if ( @history_id is not null)       begin          set @history_id = @history_id + 1       end       else       begin          -- if there was script, copy file or reboot prior to image event          -- get the first history_id for this computer          select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view             where history_id < @temp_id                and computer_id = @computer_id 	       and redeploy = 1             order by history_id           if ( @history_id is null)             set @history_id = @temp_id       end        select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id        return    end     -- no image or scripted install found, looking for tag.    select top 1 @history_id = history_id from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id          and (lower(xml_task) like '%start deployment%' or lower(xml_task) like '%deployment start%') 	 and redeploy = 1       order by history_id desc     if (@history_id is not null)    begin       select task_type, xml_task          from history_view          where history_id >= @history_id             and computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1          order by history_id       return    end     -- nothing was found, we will send all the history for this computer.    select task_type, xml_task       from history_view       where computer_id = @computer_id and redeploy = 1       order by history_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_return_handler 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@task_seq int, 	@ret_code int = null as declare @count int declare @handler int declare @handlername nvarchar(64)  select @count = count(*) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  if @count < 1    begin 	if @ret_code = 0 		select @handler = 1 -- continue 	else 	   begin 		select @handler = on_fail 		  from task 		  where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq 		  group by on_fail 	   end    end else    select @handler = handler 	from task_return_handlers 	where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq and task_seq = @task_seq and ret_code = @ret_code  select @handler = coalesce (@handler, 0) -- default, stop  if @handler <> 0 AND @handler <> 1 	select @handler, [name] from event where event_id = @handler else 	select @handler, ' '  return @handler
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @ret_code int)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_return_handler_status_info @sched_id int, @ret_code int AS declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id 	from event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  select status, ret_code, result from task_return_handlers where event_id = @event_id and 						        task_seq = @task_seq and 						        cond_seq = @cond_seq and 						         ret_code = @ret_code

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE sel_task_failure_response  @sched_id int, @ret_code int   AS  declare @retval int declare @event_id int declare @cond_seq int declare @task_seq int  select @cond_seq = cond_seq, @task_seq = next_task_seq, @event_id = event_id from event_schedule where event_schedule.schedule_id = @sched_id  exec @retval = sel_return_handler @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @ret_code  return @retval

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_task_handlers 	@event_id int, 	@cond_seq int, 	@task_seq int as 	select ret_code, handler, event.name handler_name, result, status -- PRD 7.1.15 also select result and status 		from task_return_handlers 		left join event on handler = event.event_id 		where task_return_handlers.event_id = @event_id 			and task_return_handlers.cond_seq = @cond_seq 			and task_return_handlers.task_seq = @task_seq

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_task_password    @username		varchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    declare @tmprowscount   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction      		select @tmprowscount = count(event_id) from copyfile_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from script_task where   username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(distinct event_id) from install_task where (username = @username and password = @oldpassword) or 		   (exec_username = @username and exec_password = @oldpassword)  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount  		select @tmprowscount =count(event_id) from capture_pct_task where username = @username and password = @oldpassword  		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @tmprowscount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @oldpassword varchar)

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure sel_task_scheduled    @computer_id   int as    declare @tsk_type as int     select @tsk_type = task_type from task ts, event_schedule es where es.event_id = ts.event_id 							and es.cond_seq = ts.cond_seq 							and es.next_task_seq = ts.task_seq 							and es.status_code = -1 							and es.computer_id = @computer_id  return @tsk_type

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_tc_job_tree    @SoftwarePackages varchar(50),    @nFolderIcon int,    @nBaseIcon int as 	declare @software_packages_folder_id int  	declare @job_folder table 	(	 		folder_id int 	)  	--Make sure we have a Software Packages folder under Thin Client System folder 	select @software_packages_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder  		where parent_id = 1000009 and name = @SoftwarePackages 	if @software_packages_folder_id is null 	begin 		exec @software_packages_folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID' 		insert into event_folder (folder_id, parent_id, name) values (@software_packages_folder_id, 1000009, @SoftwarePackages) 	end  	declare @tmp_folder_id int 	declare folder_cursor cursor for select folder_id from @job_folder  	insert into @job_folder (folder_id) values (@software_packages_folder_id)  	open folder_cursor 	fetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id  	select @tmp_folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  	while @@fetch_status = 0 	begin 		--add any subfolders 		insert into @job_folder (folder_id) select ef.folder_id from event_folder ef where ef.parent_id = @tmp_folder_id		 		fetch next from folder_cursor into @tmp_folder_id 	end  	close folder_cursor 	deallocate folder_cursor  	delete from @job_folder where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id  	--Get the imediate child folders of @software_packages_folder_id    select       folder_id,       null,        200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union 	--Get the sub folders of @software_packages_folder_id's children folders    select       folder_id,       parent_id,       200,       @nFolderIcon,       [name],       2    from event_folder where parent_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    union 	--Get immediate child jobs of @software_packages_folder_id    select	       event_id,       null,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id = @software_packages_folder_id    union 	--Get jobs from @software_packages_folder_id's child folders    select       event_id,       folder_id,       201,       coalesce(          ( select 68 where master_guid is not null and master_server is not null),          ( select @nBaseIcon )       ),       [name],       3    from event    where folder_id in (select folder_id from @job_folder)    order by 2, 6, 5, 1
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@SoftwarePackages varchar, @nFolderIcon int, @nBaseIcon int)

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_unattend_task_data     @event_id int,     @cond_seq int,     @task_seq int as    select t3.active, t3.value, t3.value_id, t3.vars_id, t3.vars_name, t3.type, t1.unattend_section_id as section_id,          t1.name as section_name, t3.unattend_id   from unattended_install_task t2, unattend_section t1   left join (select t1.event_id as [event_id], t1.cond_seq as [cond_seq], t1.task_seq as [task_seq], t1.active as [active],                     t1.unattend_vars_value as [value], t1.unattend_vars_value_id as [value_id],                     t2.unattend_vars_id as [vars_id], t2.name as [vars_name], t2.type as [type],                     t1.unattend_txt_data_id as [unattend_id], t3.unattend_section_id as section_id              from unattend_txt_data t1, unattend_vars t2, unattend_section t3, unattend_vars_value t4              where t1.unattend_vars_value_id = t4.unattend_vars_value_id and t4.unattend_vars_id = t2.unattend_vars_id and                    t2.unattend_section_id = t3.unattend_section_id) t3   on t3.section_id=t1.unattend_section_id and t3.event_id=@event_id and t3.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t3.task_seq=@task_seq   where t1.unattend_setup_id=t2.unattend_setup_id and t2.event_id=@event_id and t2.cond_seq=@cond_seq and t2.task_seq=@task_seq order by t1.unattend_section_id

Object_Definition: create procedure sel_xml_capture_pct_task    @event_id      int,    @cond_seq      int,    @task_seq      int,    @xml_task      varchar(8000) output,    @inc_passwords int = 1  as    declare @xml_extra varchar(6000)    select @xml_extra = ''     if ( @inc_passwords = 1 )    begin       select @xml_extra =          '<Username><![CDATA[' + coalesce (username,'') + ']]></Username>' +          '<Password><![CDATA[' + coalesce (password,'') + ']]></Password>' +          '<PackagePassword><![CDATA[' + coalesce (pkg_password,'') + ']]></PackagePassword>'       from  capture_pct_task       where  @event_id = event_id             and @cond_seq = cond_seq             and @task_seq = task_seq    end     select @xml_task =       '<Task Type=''Capture PCT''>' +       '<TemplateFile>' + coalesce (template_file,'') + '</TemplateFile>' +       '<Folder>' + coalesce (folder,'') + '</Folder>' +       '<AddlCommandLine>' + coalesce (addl_cmd_line,'') + '</AddlCommandLine>' +       '<DomainUsers>' + coalesce (cast(domain_users as varchar (10)),'') + '</DomainUsers>' +       '<LocalUsers>' + coalesce (cast(local_users as varchar (10)),'') + '</LocalUsers>' +       '<CustomUsers>' + coalesce (custom_users,'') + '</CustomUsers>' +       '<CustomGroups>' + coalesce (custom_groups,'') + '</CustomGroups>' +       '<LastAccessed>' + coalesce (cast(last_accessed as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastAccessed>' +       '<LastValue>' + coalesce (cast(last_value as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastValue>' +       '<LastScale>' + coalesce (cast(last_scale as varchar (10)),'') + '</LastScale>' +       '<DontClean>' + coalesce (cast(dont_clean as varchar (10)),'') + '</DontClean>' + 	  '<CreatePkg>' + coalesce (cast(create_pkg as varchar (10)),'') + '</CreatePkg>' +       @xml_extra +       '</Task>'    from  capture_pct_task    where  @event_id = event_id          and @cond_seq = cond_seq          and @task_seq = task_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @xml_task varchar OUT, @inc_passwords int)

declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     declare @nic_id int     declare nic_cursor cursor for    select nic_id from nics where computer_id = @comp_id     open nic_cursor    fetch next from nic_cursor into @nic_id    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       select @xml_temp = @xml_temp +          '<Nic>' + @sqlLf +          '<NicID>' + declare @ptrval binary(16)    select @ptrval = textptr(xml_data) from #text_holder     declare @xml_data varchar(8000)    set @xml_data = ''     declare @sqlLf char(2)    select @sqlLf = char(13) + char(10)     if not exists ( select event_id from event where @event_id = event_id )    begin       select '<Event></Event>' as xml_data       return 0    end     declare @temp_folder_id int    declare @temp_folder_name varchar (256)     select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event where event_id = @event_id    set @temp_folder_name = ''    if @temp_folder_id is not null    select @temp_folder_name = b.[name] from event_folder b, event a where b.folder_id = a.folder_id and a.event_id = @event_id     -- build the event XML tags    select @xml_data = @xml_data +       '<Event>' + @sqlLf +       '<EventID>' + coalesce(cast(@event_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</EventID>' + @sqlLf +       '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Name>' + @sqlLf +       '<Description>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(a.description, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Description>' + @sqlLf +       '<FolderID>' + coalesce(cast(@temp_folder_id as varchar(10)),'') + '</FolderID>' + @sqlLf +       '<FolderName>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(@temp_folder_name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</FolderName>' + @sqlLf +       '<JobDuration>' + coalesce(cast(isnull(datediff(ss, es.broker_time, es.end_time), 0) as varchar(20)),'') + '</JobDuration>' + @sqlLf    from event a 	left join event_schedule es 		on a.event_id = es.event_id    where a.event_id = @event_id     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''     --    -- iterate through the conditions    --    select @xml_data = @xml_data + '<Conditions>' + @sqlLf     declare @cond_seq int    declare event_condition_cursor cursor local for       select cond_seq from event_condition where event_id = @event_id    open event_condition_cursor    fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin        select @xml_data = @xml_data +             '<Condition>' + @sqlLf +             '<CondSeq>' + coalesce(cast(cond_seq as varchar(10)),'') + '</CondSeq>' + @sqlLf +             '<Name>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(name,''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</Name>' + @sqlLf +             '<ConditionItems>' + @sqlLf       from event_condition       where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''       --       -- iterate through the condition items       --       declare @item_seq int       declare condition_item_cursor cursor local for          select item_seq from condition_item where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq order by item_seq       open condition_item_cursor       fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @item_seq       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          select @xml_data = @xml_data +             '<ConditionItem>' +  @sqlLf +             '<FieldType>' + coalesce(cast(field_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</FieldType>' + @sqlLf +             '<OperType>' + coalesce(cast(oper_type as varchar(10)), '') + '</OperType>' + @sqlLf +             '<KeyValue>' + replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(key_value, ''), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"') + '</KeyValue>' + @sqlLf +             '<Drive>' + coalesce(drive, '') + '</Drive>' + @sqlLf +             '<Conjunct>' + coalesce(cast(conjunct as varchar(10)), '') + '</Conjunct>' + @sqlLf +             '</ConditionItem>' + @sqlLf          from condition_item          where event_id = @event_id and             cond_seq = @cond_seq and             item_seq = @item_seq           -- get the next condition item          fetch next from condition_item_cursor into @item_seq       end       close condition_item_cursor       deallocate condition_item_cursor        select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</ConditionItems>' + @sqlLf        updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data       select @xml_data = ''        -- iterate through the tasks       select @xml_data = @xml_data + '<Tasks>' + @sqlLf        declare @task_seq int       declare task_cursor cursor local for          select task_seq from task where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @cond_seq       open task_cursor       fetch next from task_cursor into @task_seq       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin           declare @xml_task varchar(8000)          select @xml_task = ''           -- get the task information          if exists (select event_id from install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from image_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_image_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from unattended_install_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_unattended_install_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from config_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_config_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from capture_pct_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_capture_pct_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from deploy_anywhere_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_deploy_anywhere_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from script_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_script_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from reboot_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_reboot_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from copyfile_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_copyfile_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords           else if exists (select event_id from registry_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_registry_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords  		 else if exists (select event_id from wait_task where event_id = @event_id and task_seq = @task_seq and cond_seq = @cond_seq)             exec sel_xml_wait_task @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @xml_task output, @inc_passwords            -- append the task information          select @xml_data = @xml_data + @xml_task           updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data          select @xml_data = ''           -- get the next task for this condition          fetch next from task_cursor into @task_seq       end       close task_cursor       deallocate task_cursor        select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</Tasks>' + @sqlLf + '</Condition>' + @sqlLf        updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data       select @xml_data = ''        --  get the next condition       fetch next from event_condition_cursor into @cond_seq    end    close event_condition_cursor    deallocate event_condition_cursor     select @xml_data = @xml_data + '</Conditions>' + @sqlLf + '</Event>' + @sqlLf     updatetext #text_holder.xml_data @ptrval null 0 @xml_data    select @xml_data = ''     -- return the data as a row of one column    select xml_data from #text_holder    drop table #text_holder

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_alterdiagram 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id	int	= null, 		@version 	int, 		@definition 	varbinary(max) 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 	 		declare @theId 			int 		declare @retval 		int 		declare @IsDbo 			int 		 		declare @UIDFound 		int 		declare @DiagId			int 		declare @ShouldChangeUID	int 	 		if(@diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Invalid ARG', 16, 1) 			return -1 		end 	 		execute as caller; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();	  		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');  		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		revert; 	 		select @ShouldChangeUID = 0 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname  		 		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @theId <> @UIDFound)) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1); 			return -3 		end 	 		if(@IsDbo <> 0) 		begin 			if(@UIDFound is null or USER_NAME(@UIDFound) is null) -- invalid principal_id 			begin 				select @ShouldChangeUID = 1 ; 			end 		end  		-- update dds data			 		update dbo.sysdiagrams set definition = @definition where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		-- change owner 		if(@ShouldChangeUID = 1) 			update dbo.sysdiagrams set principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		-- update dds version 		if(@version is not null) 			update dbo.sysdiagrams set version = @version where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		return 0 	END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int, @version int, @definition varbinary)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_creatediagram 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id		int	= null, 	 		@version 		int, 		@definition 	varbinary(max) 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 	 		declare @theId int 		declare @retval int 		declare @IsDbo	int 		declare @userName sysname 		if(@version is null or @diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		execute as caller; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();  		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 		revert;  		 		if @owner_id is null 		begin 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		end 		else 		begin 			if @theId <> @owner_id 			begin 				if @IsDbo = 0 				begin 					RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1); 					return -1 				end 				select @theId = @owner_id 			end 		end 		-- next 2 line only for test, will be removed after define name unique 		if EXISTS(select diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @diagramname) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1); 			return -2 		end 	 		insert into dbo.sysdiagrams(name, principal_id , version, definition) 				VALUES(@diagramname, @theId, @version, @definition) ; 		 		select @retval = @@IDENTITY  		return @retval 	END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int, @version int, @definition varbinary)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_dropdiagram 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id	int	= null 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 		declare @theId 			int 		declare @IsDbo 			int 		 		declare @UIDFound 		int 		declare @DiagId			int 	 		if(@diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Invalid value', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		EXECUTE AS CALLER; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');  		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		REVERT;  		 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname  		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId)) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1) 			return -3 		end 	 		delete from dbo.sysdiagrams where diagram_id = @DiagId; 	 		return 0; 	END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition 	( 		@diagramname 	sysname, 		@owner_id	int	= null 		 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on  		declare @theId 		int 		declare @IsDbo 		int 		declare @DiagId		int 		declare @UIDFound	int 	 		if(@diagramname is null) 		begin 			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		execute as caller; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		revert;  	 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname; 		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId )) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1); 			return -3 		end  		select version, definition FROM dbo.sysdiagrams where diagram_id = @DiagId ;  		return 0 	END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagrams 	( 		@diagramname sysname = NULL, 		@owner_id int = NULL 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		DECLARE @user sysname 		DECLARE @dboLogin bit 		EXECUTE AS CALLER; 			SET @user = USER_NAME(); 			SET @dboLogin = CONVERT(bit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner')); 		REVERT; 		SELECT 			[Database] = DB_NAME(), 			[Name] = name, 			[ID] = diagram_id, 			[Owner] = USER_NAME(principal_id), 			[OwnerID] = principal_id 		FROM 			sysdiagrams 		WHERE 			(@dboLogin = 1 OR USER_NAME(principal_id) = @user) AND 			(@diagramname IS NULL OR name = @diagramname) AND 			(@owner_id IS NULL OR principal_id = @owner_id) 		ORDER BY 			4, 5, 1 	END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_renamediagram 	( 		@diagramname 		sysname, 		@owner_id		int	= null, 		@new_diagramname	sysname 	 	) 	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo' 	AS 	BEGIN 		set nocount on 		declare @theId 			int 		declare @IsDbo 			int 		 		declare @UIDFound 		int 		declare @DiagId			int 		declare @DiagIdTarg		int 		declare @u_name			sysname 		if((@diagramname is null) or (@new_diagramname is null)) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Invalid value', 16, 1); 			return -1 		end 	 		EXECUTE AS CALLER; 		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');  		if(@owner_id is null) 			select @owner_id = @theId; 		REVERT; 	 		select @u_name = USER_NAME(@owner_id) 	 		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname  		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @UIDFound <> @theId)) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1) 			return -3 		end 	 		-- if((@u_name is not null) and (@new_diagramname = @diagramname))	-- nothing will change 		--	return 0; 	 		if(@u_name is null) 			select @DiagIdTarg = diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @new_diagramname 		else 			select @DiagIdTarg = diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @new_diagramname 	 		if((@DiagIdTarg is not null) and  @DiagId <> @DiagIdTarg) 		begin 			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1); 			return -2 		end		 	 		if(@u_name is null) 			update dbo.sysdiagrams set [name] = @new_diagramname, principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId 		else 			update dbo.sysdiagrams set [name] = @new_diagramname where diagram_id = @DiagId 		return 0 	END
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int, @new_diagramname sysname)

Object_Definition: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams 	AS 	BEGIN 		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagrams') IS NOT NULL 			return 0; 	 		CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams 		( 			name sysname NOT NULL, 			principal_id int NOT NULL,	-- we may change it to varbinary(85) 			diagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY, 			version int, 	 			definition varbinary(max) 			CONSTRAINT UK_principal_name UNIQUE 			( 				principal_id, 				name 			) 		);   		/* Add this if we need to have some form of extended properties for diagrams */ 		/* 		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL 		BEGIN 			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties 			( 				diagram_id int, 				name sysname, 				value varbinary(max) NOT NULL 			) 		END 		*/  		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.dtproperties') IS NOT NULL 		begin 			insert into dbo.sysdiagrams 			( 				[name], 				[principal_id], 				[version], 				[definition] 			) 			select	  				convert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]), 				DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),			-- will change to the sid of sa 				0,							-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version], 				dgdef.[lvalue] 			from dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm 				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]	 				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid] 				 			where dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_'  			return 2; 		end 		return 1; 	END

create proc uni_add_deploy_anywhere_task 	@table_name          varchar(128), 	@event_id            int, 	@cond_seq            int, 	@task_seq            int, 	@windows_directory   varchar(256), 	@ddb_directory       varchar(256), 	@paramaters          varchar(512) with execute as owner as begin     	declare @sql   nvarchar(4000) 	set     @sql = 'insert into ' +  @table_name + ' (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, windows_directory, ddb_directory, paramaters) ' + 	               'values ( @id, @cs, @ts, @wd, @dd, @pr )' 	execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int, @wd varchar(256), @dd varchar(256), @pr varchar(512)', 	                      @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq, @windows_directory, @ddb_directory, @paramaters end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@table_name varchar, @event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int, @windows_directory varchar, @ddb_directory varchar, @paramaters varchar)

Object_Definition: create proc uni_add_task     @table_name varchar(128),     @set_expr   varchar(2048),     @event_id   int,     @cond_seq   int,     @task_seq   int with execute as owner as begin     	declare @sql   nvarchar(4000) 	set     @sql = 'insert into ' +  @table_name + ' (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq) values ( @id, @cs, @ts )' 	execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int', @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq  	if ( upper(@set_expr) != 'NULL' ) 	begin 		set     @sql = 'update ' +  @table_name + ' set ' + @set_expr + ' where event_id = @id and cond_seq = @cs and task_seq = @ts' 		execute sp_executesql @sql, N' @id int, @cs int, @ts int', @event_id, @cond_seq, @task_seq 	end end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@table_name varchar, @set_expr varchar, @event_id int, @cond_seq int, @task_seq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_computer_ip_mac_addr    @computer_id         int,    @ip_addr             varchar (512),    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @nic_id              int = 0 as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = @nic_id     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = @nic_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, ip) values (@computer_id, @nic_id, @ip_addr)    else    begin      if (@ip_addr is not null) 		update nic_interface set ip = @ip_addr where interface_id = @interface_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @ip_addr varchar, @mac_addr varchar, @nic_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure [dbo].[upd_computer_nic_pci] @PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar(128) as declare @nNicId int declare @nConfigItemId int begin transaction  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  	and nic_pci_bus = @PciBus     and nic_pci_device = @PciDevice     and nic_pci_function = @PciFunction 	and mac_addr = @strMacaddr 	  if(@nNicId is not NULL) begin 	commit transaction 	return end  select @nNicId=min(nic_id) from nics where computer_id=@computer_id  	and nic_pci_bus is NULL      and nic_pci_device is NULL     and nic_pci_function is NULL   if(@nNicId is NULL) begin 	commit transaction 	return end  if exists (select n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @strMacaddr) 		update nics set mac_addr = null where mac_addr = @strMacaddr  update nics set nic_pci_device = @PciDevice, 				nic_pci_bus = @PciBus, 				nic_pci_function = @PciFunction, 				mac_addr = @strMacaddr where nic_id = @nNicId and computer_id = @computer_id  if (@@error != 0) 		rollback transaction 	else 		commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@PciDevice int, @PciBus int, @PciFunction int, @computer_id int, @strMacaddr varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_deferred_schedule 	@schedule_id int, 	@start_time datetime, 	@current_time datetime, 	@status varchar( 256 ), 	@status_module smallint as     declare @comp_id int  	-- make sure the schedule is valid 	select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	if( @comp_id is null ) 	begin 	   return 	end  	begin transaction  	-- update the event schedule table 	update event_schedule 		set status_code = null, exit_code = null, exit_module = null, 			start_time = @start_time, status = @status 		where schedule_id = @schedule_id  	-- now insert stuff into the log data 	exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, -1, -1, @status_module  	-- erase old wol info 	exec upd_computer_wol_info @comp_id, null  	if (@@error != 0) 	begin 		rollback transaction 	end 	else 	begin 		commit transaction 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @start_time datetime, @current_time datetime, @status varchar, @status_module smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_domain_account    @domain varchar( 256 ),    @username varchar( 256 ),    @password varchar( 256 ) as    declare @td varchar( 256 )    set @td = null     begin transaction     select @td = [domain] from domain_accounts where [domain] = @domain    if @td is null    begin       insert into domain_accounts ([domain], [username], [password]) 	     values (@domain, @username, @password)    end    else    begin       update domain_accounts set [username] = @username, [password] = @password 	     where [domain] = @domain    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
