Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_cond_seq    @schedule_id   int,    @cond_seq      int,    @status_code   int = NULL,    @status        varchar (254) = NULL,    @exit_code     int = NULL,    @exit_module   smallint = NULL as 	if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) 		set @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is NULL and @status_code is NULL)       update event_schedule set cond_seq = @cond_seq where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else    begin       update event_schedule 		set cond_seq = @cond_seq, status_code = @status_code, 			status = @status, exit_code = @exit_code, exit_module = @exit_module 		where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @cond_seq int, @status_code int, @status varchar, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_config_choice    @schedule_id      int,    @config_choice_id int = null,    @status_code      int = null,    @status           varchar(254) = null as    begin transaction     if (@config_choice_id = 0)    begin       declare @comp_id int 	  select @comp_id = computer_id from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id       update computer set domain_name = 'WORKGROUP', domain_member = 0 where computer_id = @comp_id 	  if exists (select 1 from nics where computer_id = @comp_id and nic_id = 0) 		update nics set ip_use_dhcp = 1 where computer_id = @comp_id 	  else 		insert nics (computer_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp) values (@comp_id, 0, 1)    end     if (@status_code is NULL and @status is NULL)    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set config_choice_id = @config_choice_id,              status_code = @status_code,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    end     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @config_choice_id int, @status_code int, @status varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_init_deploy    @event_id      int,    @start_time    datetime as    begin transaction     update event_schedule set start_time = @start_time       where event_id = @event_id          and next_task_seq > -1          and status_code is null 		 and cond_seq is null 		 and initial_deployment = 1     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@event_id int, @start_time datetime)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_next_task_seq    @schedule_id      int,    @next_task_seq    int,    @status_code      smallint,    @exit_code        int,    @exit_module      smallint,    @status           varchar(254),    @current_time     datetime,    @module           smallint,    @level            smallint,    @taskresult       int as begin     if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0)         set @status_code = 1      declare @tran int     set @tran = @@trancount      if( 0 = @tran )         begin transaction  	DECLARE   @dependent_id   int     SELECT    @dependent_id = dep_schedule_id         FROM  event_schedule         WHERE schedule_id = @schedule_id      IF (@dependent_id IS NOT NULL AND @status_code IS NULL AND @status = 'Error ' + LTRIM(@exit_code) + ' during script execution')     BEGIN         DECLARE   @eventname   varchar(128);         SELECT    @eventname = ISNULL(e.name, 'UNKNOWN')             FROM  event          AS e             JOIN  event_schedule AS s ON e.event_id = s.event_id             WHERE s.schedule_id = @dependent_id          SELECT @status = 'Scheduled Job [' + @eventname + '] Due To Return Code Handler: ' + LTRIM(@exit_code)     END      -- update status_log table with schedule info     exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level, @taskresult      -- now insert and fix up history for this item     exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id      -- now update the event_schedule table     update event_schedule         set next_task_seq = @next_task_seq,         status = @status,         status_code = @status_code,         exit_code = @exit_code,         exit_module = @exit_module,         config_choice_id = NULL -- { HLS LB#40188,40209 We should set config_choice_id to null }     where schedule_id = @schedule_id      if( 0 = @tran )     begin         if (@@error != 0)             rollback transaction         else             commit transaction     end end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @next_task_seq int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @current_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @taskresult int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_schedule_status    @schedule_id   int,    @status_code   smallint,    @exit_code	   int,    @exit_module   smallint,    @status        varchar(254),    @broker_time   datetime,    @module        smallint,    @level         smallint,    @log_event     smallint = 0 as    declare @upd_status_code smallint     -- we need to remember the status code that was passed in, but if it's null,    -- we want to get the status code that is currently in the event schedule.    set @upd_status_code = @status_code     if (@upd_status_code is null and @log_event = 1)       select @upd_status_code = status_code from event_schedule where schedule_id = @schedule_id     if (@exit_code is not null ) and ( @exit_code != 0 ) and ( @status_code is not null ) and       ( @status_code > 0 )    begin       set @status_code = 1    end     begin transaction     if (@broker_time is null)    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, 			exit_code = @exit_code, 			exit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id    end    else    begin       update event_schedule          set status_code = @upd_status_code, 			exit_code = @exit_code, 			exit_module = @exit_module,             status = @status,             broker_time = @broker_time          where             schedule_id = @schedule_id  	--LB#40844        if( @status_code >= 0 )       	 begin      		exec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@broker_time        	end    end     -- use the passed in status code for this function, unlike above where we use our    -- adjusted @use_status_code var.  This is so we can save exit_codes without    -- killing the status_code in the event schedule table.    exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @broker_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return    end     commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule_id int, @status_code smallint, @exit_code int, @exit_module smallint, @status varchar, @broker_time datetime, @module smallint, @level smallint, @log_event smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_event_status    @computer_id   int,    @mac_addr      varchar(36),    @schedule_id   int,    @task_seq      int,    @status        varchar(254),    @status_code   int as    if (@status is null and @status_code is null)       return     begin transaction     if (@status_code is not null and @status is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code,             status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else if (@status_code is not null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq    else       update event_schedule          set status = @status          from event_schedule es, nics n          where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr             and n.computer_id = @computer_id             and n.computer_id = es.computer_id             and es.schedule_id = @schedule_id             and es.next_task_seq = @task_seq     if (@@error = 0)       commit transaction    else       rollback transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @schedule_id int, @task_seq int, @status varchar, @status_code int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_hardware    @computer_id   int,    @proc_type       int as       begin transaction         if exists (select computer_id from hardware where computer_id = @computer_id)             update hardware set proc_type = @proc_type where computer_id = @computer_id       else              insert into hardware                   ( computer_id, proc_type )             values                   ( @computer_id, @proc_type )         if (@@error = 0)             commit transaction       else             rollback transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @proc_type int)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_hardware_for_bootwork    @comp_id       int,    @proc_count    int,    @proc_desc     varchar(128),    @proc_speed    int,    @ram_total     int,    @ram_free      int as    declare   @temp_comp_id       int,              @temp_proc_count    int,              @temp_proc_desc     varchar(128),              @temp_proc_speed    int,              @temp_ram_total     int,              @temp_ram_free      int     select @temp_comp_id    = computer_id,           @temp_proc_count = proc_count,           @temp_proc_desc  = proc_desc,           @temp_proc_speed = proc_speed,           @temp_ram_total  = ram_total,           @temp_ram_free   = ram_free       from hardware       where computer_id = @comp_id     if (@temp_comp_id = @comp_id and        (@temp_proc_count = @proc_count or @proc_count is null) and        (@temp_proc_desc = @proc_desc or @proc_desc is null) and        (@temp_proc_speed = @proc_speed or @proc_speed is null) and        (@temp_ram_total = @ram_total or @ram_total is null) and        (@temp_ram_free = @ram_free or @ram_free is null)       )    return     begin transaction    if (@temp_comp_id is not null)    begin       if (@proc_count is not null)          set @temp_proc_count = @proc_count        if (@proc_desc is not null)          set @temp_proc_desc = @proc_desc        if (@proc_speed is not null)          set @temp_proc_speed = @proc_speed        if (@ram_total is not null)          set @temp_ram_total = @ram_total        if (@temp_ram_free is not null)          set @temp_ram_free = @ram_free        update hardware         set proc_desc = @temp_proc_desc,             proc_speed = @temp_proc_speed,             ram_total = @temp_ram_total,             ram_free = @temp_ram_free,             proc_count = @temp_proc_count          where computer_id = @temp_comp_id    end    else    begin       insert into hardware (computer_id, proc_desc, proc_speed, ram_total, ram_free, proc_count)          values (@comp_id, @proc_desc, @proc_speed, @ram_total, @ram_free, @proc_count)    end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_increment_default_condition    @event_id int as    declare @last_condition int    declare @new_cond_seq int     -- get the old condition count    select @last_condition = max( cond_seq ) from event_condition       where event_id = @event_id     -- update the event_condition table to meet the new requirements -    -- the triggers will take care of updating everything else    set @new_cond_seq = @last_condition + 1    update event_condition set cond_seq = @new_cond_seq       where event_id = @event_id and cond_seq = @last_condition     -- return the number of the condition we just moved    return @last_condition

create procedure upd_new_computer_info    @computer_id         int,    @mac_addr            varchar (36),    @serial_num          varchar (80),    @uuid                varchar (64),    @asset_tag           varchar (64),    @node_type           smallint as    declare @nic_item_id int    declare @wol_proxy smallint    declare @interface_id int     -- get the count of the items to make sure we have valid input    select @nic_item_id = computer_id from nics       where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = 0 and mac_addr is null     select top 1 @interface_id = ni.interface_id       from nics n          join nic_interface ni on ni.[id] = n.computer_id       where          n.computer_id = @computer_id and n.nic_id = 0     -- we always need to return whether this was a wake-on-lan proxy even if there was an error    select @wol_proxy = wol_proxy from aclient_prop where computer_id = @computer_id     -- if there was an error, return without updating anything    if (@nic_item_id is null)    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     if (select 1 from computer where computer_id = @computer_id) is null    begin       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     begin transaction     -- update the nics    update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr  		where computer_id = @computer_id and nic_id = 0 	update computer set serial_num = @serial_num, uuid = @uuid, asset_tag = @asset_tag, node_type = @node_type 		where computer_id = @computer_id     -- update the remaining item    if (@interface_id is null)      insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id) values (@computer_id, 0)     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select 'error' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy       return 0    end     commit transaction    select 'success' as result, @wol_proxy as wol_proxy
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int, @mac_addr varchar, @serial_num varchar, @uuid varchar, @asset_tag varchar, @node_type smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_nic_ip_addr 	@computer_id   int, 	@mac_addr      varchar(36), 	@ip_address    varchar(16) = null as 	declare @temp_id int 	declare @high_nic_id   int  	select @temp_id = n.computer_id from nics n where n.mac_addr = @mac_addr and n.computer_id = @computer_id  	if (@temp_id is null) 	begin 		select @temp_id = min(n.nic_id) from nics n where n.mac_addr is null and n.computer_id = @computer_id  		if (@temp_id is null) 		begin		  			set @high_nic_id = null 			select @high_nic_id = max(nic_id) from nics where computer_id = @computer_id  			begin transaction  			if (@high_nic_id is null) 				insert into nics (computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr) values (@computer_id, 0, @mac_addr) 			else 				insert into nics (computer_id, nic_id, mac_addr) values (@computer_id, @high_nic_id+1, @mac_addr) 		end 		else  		begin 			begin transaction			 			update nics set mac_addr = @mac_addr where nic_id = @temp_id and computer_id = @computer_id 		end  		if (@@error != 0) 			rollback transaction 		else 			commit transaction 		 	end

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_physical_enclosure    @rack_name		varchar( 64 ),    @enclosure_name  varchar( 64 ),    @model			varchar( 64 ),    @bay_count       varchar( 64 ),    @manuf           varchar(64) = '' as    declare @enclosure_id int    declare @old_bay_count int    declare @new_bay_count int     -- get the old enclosure information before we update it    select @enclosure_id = enclosure_id, @old_bay_count = bay_count       from physical_enclosure e, physical_rack r 	  where r.[real_name] = @rack_name 		 and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name 		 and r.rack_id = e.rack_id     -- we want to set the bay count to the larger of what is was before,    -- or what we're trying to update it to.  Never make it smaller.    -- this was at HP's request, so that they could use sleves to put    -- more servers in an enclousure than originally fit.    set @new_bay_count = @bay_count    if( @new_bay_count < @old_bay_count )       set @new_bay_count = @old_bay_count     -- now update the enclosure    update physical_enclosure       set bay_count = @new_bay_count, 	  model = @model, 	  manuf = @manuf 	  where enclosure_id = @enclosure_id

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_rack_enclosure_bay    @rack_name           varchar(64),    @enclosure_name      varchar(64),    @model               varchar(64),    @bay_count           int,    @bay_name            varchar(64),    @bay_number			smallint,    @used_bays           int,    @computer_id         int,    @computer_name       varchar(64),    @time                datetime,    @init_deploy         varchar(5) = 'no',    @manuf_rack          int = 0,    @manuf               varchar(64) = '',    @group_id			int = -7 as    declare   @temp_comp_id    int,              @rack_id         int,              @enclosure_id    int,              @bay_id          int,              @change_method   smallint,              @event_id        int,              @temp_id         int,              @new_comp_made   char(1),              @virtual_bay     int, 	         @new_schedule_id int  -- only use this for vreb!!!     set @bay_id = null    set @change_method = null    set @event_id = null    set @new_comp_made = 'N'    set @new_schedule_id = null     select   @bay_id = b.bay_id,             @change_method = b.change_method,             @event_id = b.event_id,       	   @virtual_bay = b.initial_event_id       from  physical_bay b,             physical_enclosure e,             physical_rack r       where r.[real_name] = @rack_name          and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name          and b.[real_name] = @bay_name          and r.rack_id = e.rack_id          and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id     if (@bay_id is null)    begin       -- Not found, lets create it.       begin transaction        -- If we don't have a computer_id we will get one.       set @change_method = null        if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)       begin          exec @computer_id = sel_next_system_id 'COMPUTER_ID'           if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)          begin             rollback transaction             select 0 as computer_id, -1 as change_method             return          end           declare @new_comp_name   varchar(20)          set @new_comp_name = replace (right(@computer_name, 15), ' ', '-')          while (left(@new_comp_name,1) = '-' and len(@new_comp_name) > 0)          begin             set @new_comp_name = right(@new_comp_name, (len(@new_comp_name)-1))          end           if (@new_comp_name = '')             set @new_comp_name = 'C-' + cast (@computer_id as varchar(20))           insert into computer (computer_id, [name], computer_name, ip_hostname , group_id)                 values (@computer_id, left (@computer_name, 64), @new_comp_name, @computer_name, @group_id)           if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             select 0 as computer_id, -1 as change_method             return          end           set @new_comp_made = 'Y'       end        delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id        set @rack_id = null 	  if (@manuf_rack = 1) 	     select @rack_id = rack_id, @change_method = change_method from physical_rack where [real_name] = @rack_name and manuf_rack = 1       else           select @rack_id = rack_id, @change_method = change_method from physical_rack where [real_name] = @rack_name       if (@rack_id is null)       begin          if (@change_method is null)             set @change_method = 2          exec @rack_id = sel_next_system_id 'RACK_ID'          insert into physical_rack (rack_id, [name], real_name, change_method, manuf_rack) values (@rack_id, @rack_name, @rack_name, @change_method, @manuf_rack)       end        set @enclosure_id = null       select @enclosure_id = enclosure_id, @change_method = change_method 			from physical_enclosure where [real_name] = @enclosure_name and rack_id = @rack_id       if (@enclosure_id is null)       begin          if (@change_method is null)             set @change_method = 2          exec @enclosure_id = sel_next_system_id 'ENCLOSURE_ID'          insert into physical_enclosure (enclosure_id, rack_id, [name], real_name, change_method, model, bay_count, manuf)                                  values (@enclosure_id, @rack_id, @enclosure_name, @enclosure_name, @change_method, @model, @bay_count, @manuf)       end 	  else 	  begin 		   declare @temp_enc_id int 		   set @temp_enc_id = null  		   select   @temp_enc_id = e.enclosure_id 			  from  physical_enclosure e, 					physical_rack r 			  where r.[real_name] = @rack_name 				 and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name 				 and r.rack_id = e.rack_id 				 and e.bay_count = @bay_count 				 and e.model = @model 				 and e.manuf = @manuf  		   if (@temp_enc_id is null) 		      exec upd_physical_enclosure @rack_name, @enclosure_name, @model, @bay_count, @manuf 	  end        set @bay_id = null       select @bay_id = bay_id from physical_bay where [real_name] = @bay_name and enclosure_id = @enclosure_id       if (@bay_id is null)       begin          if (@change_method is null)              set @change_method = 2          exec @bay_id = sel_next_system_id 'BAY_ID'          insert into physical_bay (bay_id, enclosure_id, [name], real_name, computer_id, change_method, used_bays, idx) 						   values (@bay_id, @enclosure_id, @bay_name, @bay_name, @computer_id, @change_method, @used_bays, @bay_number)       end        if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          set @change_method = -1       end       else       begin          commit transaction       end        if (@change_method = 2)          exec upd_session_wait_state @computer_id        if  (@init_deploy = 'yes') 		set @change_method = 202        select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method       return    end     -- we need to update enclosure information here if it is different.    set @enclosure_id = null    select   @enclosure_id = e.enclosure_id       from  physical_enclosure e,             physical_rack r       where r.[real_name] = @rack_name          and e.[real_name] = @enclosure_name          and r.rack_id = e.rack_id          and e.bay_count = @bay_count          and e.model = @model          and e.manuf = @manuf     if (@enclosure_id is null)       exec upd_physical_enclosure @rack_name, @enclosure_name, @model, @bay_count, @manuf     if (@virtual_bay is not null)    begin 	  set @change_method = 1    end     if (@virtual_bay = 0)    begin       set @change_method = 2 	  update physical_bay set initial_event_id = null, used_bays = @used_bays where bay_id = @bay_id 	  update computer set hidden = null from physical_bay b, computer c 		where b.computer_id = c.computer_id and b.bay_id = @bay_id    end     -- Check for any changes.    set @temp_id = null    select @temp_id = bay_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @bay_id and computer_id = @computer_id    if (@temp_id is not null)    begin       -- No changes       set @change_method = 100  -- no change       if ((select count (bay_id) from physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id) > 1)       begin          begin transaction           delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id and bay_id != @bay_id           if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             set @change_method = -1          end          else          begin             commit transaction          end       end        select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method       return    end     -- There is a change.     -- If Ignore rule.    if (@change_method = 3)    begin       begin transaction        -- If we don't have a computer_id we will get one.       if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)       begin          exec @computer_id = sel_next_system_id 'COMPUTER_ID'           if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)          begin             rollback transaction             select 0 as computer_id, -1 as change_method             return          end           insert into computer (computer_id, [name], group_id) values (@computer_id, @bay_name, @group_id)           if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             select 0 as computer_id, -1 as change_method             return          end           set @new_comp_made = 'Y'       end        delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id and bay_id != @bay_id        update physical_bay set computer_id = @computer_id          where bay_id = @bay_id        if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          set @change_method = -1       end       else       begin          commit transaction       end        select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method       return    end     -- The following need to keep the history with the bay.    -- Move the information     if( ( @virtual_bay is not null ) and ( @virtual_bay != 0 ) and        ( @computer_id is not null ) and ( @computer_id != 0 ) )    begin       -- we need to do special processing for virtual bays, we need to delete the information       -- for the old computer if it was associated with another bay, then later we'll set       -- the new computer id to the ID of the computer in the new virtual bay       set @temp_id = null       select @temp_id = computer_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @bay_id       if( @temp_id is not null )       begin          begin transaction           -- this computer was associated with a different bay          update computer             set asset_tag = null,                 serial_num = null,                 uuid = null,                 status = null, 				hidden = 1,                 icon = 1             where computer_id = @computer_id           insert into deleted_mac_addrs select mac_addr from nics where computer_id = @computer_id          delete nics where computer_id = @computer_id           if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             set @change_method = -1             select @temp_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method             return          end          else          begin             commit transaction          end           -- set the computer ID to null, this way we won't delete the new virtual bay          -- information, we'll later set the @computer_id to the id of the new virtual bay.          set @computer_id = null       end    end      set @temp_id = null    select @temp_id = computer_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @bay_id    if (@temp_id is null)    begin       -- We have no computer_id, there for no history.       -- Check for this computer_id else where, if found we have a problem.       select @temp_id = bay_id from physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id        begin transaction        if (@temp_id is not null)       begin          -- this computer was associated with a different bay          update computer             set asset_tag = null,                 serial_num = null,                 uuid = null,                 status = null, 				hidden = 1,                 icon = 1             where computer_id = @computer_id          insert into deleted_mac_addrs select mac_addr from nics where computer_id = @computer_id          delete nics where computer_id = @computer_id          set @computer_id = null       end       -- If we don't have a computer_id we will get one.       if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)       begin          exec @computer_id = sel_next_system_id 'COMPUTER_ID'           if (@computer_id is null or @computer_id = 0)          begin             rollback transaction             select 0 as computer_id, -1 as change_method             return          end           insert into computer (computer_id, [name], group_id) values (@computer_id, @bay_name, @group_id)          if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             select 0 as computer_id, -1 as change_method             return          end           set @new_comp_made = 'Y'       end       delete physical_bay where computer_id = @computer_id and bay_id != @bay_id       update physical_bay set computer_id = @computer_id where bay_id = @bay_id       if (@@error != 0)       begin          rollback transaction          set @change_method = -1          select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method          return       end       else       begin          commit transaction       end    end    else    begin       -- Remove the information from the old computer_id.       -- If we don't have a computer_id we will get one.       if (@computer_id is not null and @computer_id != 0)       begin          begin transaction           insert into deleted_mac_addrs select mac_addr from nics where computer_id = @computer_id or computer_id = @temp_id          delete nics where computer_id = @computer_id or computer_id = @temp_id           update computer             set asset_tag = null,                 serial_num = null,                 uuid = null,                 status = null, 				hidden = 1,                 icon = 1             where computer_id = @computer_id           if (@@error != 0)          begin             rollback transaction             set @change_method = -1             select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method             return          end          else          begin             commit transaction          end       end       else       begin          if( @virtual_bay is null )          begin             insert into deleted_mac_addrs select mac_addr from nics where computer_id = @temp_id             delete nics where computer_id = @temp_id          end       end        -- Reassign the new computer_id       set @computer_id = @temp_id    end     -- If Wait rule    if (@change_method = 2)    begin       exec upd_session_wait_state @computer_id       select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method       return    end     -- If Redeploy rule    if (@change_method = 0)    begin       -- Is there a history to redeploy to.       if ((select count(history_id) from history_view where computer_id = @computer_id) = 0)       begin          -- There is no history, so send treat as a wait.  Rollback is to reset events time.          exec upd_session_wait_state @computer_id          select @computer_id as computer_id, 2 as change_method     -- Send as a wait.          return       end        -- AxEngine will process the scheduling of the history.        if (@@error != 0)          set @change_method = -1        select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method       return    end     -- reschedule any events that might be already scheduled for this computer to run after the rule event.    declare @new_time datetime    set @new_time = dateadd (minute, 1, @time)     begin transaction     update event_schedule       set start_time = @new_time       where computer_id = @computer_id           and start_time <= @time           and status_code = null     -- If Run Event rule    if (@change_method = 1)    begin       declare @schedule_id int        if (@virtual_bay is not null)       begin          set @event_id = @virtual_bay 		 update physical_bay set initial_event_id = null, used_bays = @used_bays where bay_id = @bay_id 		 update computer set hidden = null where computer_id = @computer_id       end        if (@virtual_bay is null or @virtual_bay != 0) 	  begin 		  select @schedule_id = schedule_id from event_schedule where event_id = @event_id and @computer_id = computer_id 		  if (@schedule_id is null) 		  begin 			 exec @schedule_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_SCHEDULE_ID' 			 insert into event_schedule (schedule_id, computer_id, event_id, start_time, next_task_seq) 				values (@schedule_id, @computer_id, @event_id, @time, 0)  			 -- save this to return from this function 			 set @new_schedule_id = @schedule_id 		  end 		  else 		  begin 			 update event_schedule 				set start_time = @time, 					status = null, 					status_code = null, 					end_time = null, 					broker_time = null, 					cond_seq = null, 					next_task_seq = 0 				where schedule_id = @schedule_id 		  end       end    end    else       set @change_method = -1     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @computer_id as computer_id, @change_method as change_method, @new_schedule_id as new_schedule_id

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_schedule_status    @schedule_id         int,    @status_code         smallint,    @exit_code           int,    @exit_module         smallint,    @status              varchar(254) = null,    @current_time        datetime = null,    @module              smallint = null,    @level               smallint = null as    if (@status_code = -99)       set @exit_code = null  	if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) 		set @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, 				exit_code = @exit_code, 				exit_module = @exit_module          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, 				exit_code = @exit_code, 				exit_module = @exit_module,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id 	--LB#40844 	 if (@status_code >=0 and @current_time is not null) 	begin   		exec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@current_time    	end     if ( @current_time is not null )    begin       exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level  end -- now insert and fix up history for this item --LB#34907 if ( @exit_code=5 ) begin       exec ins_history_by_schedule @schedule_id end     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_schedule_update_status    @schedule_id         int,    @status_code         smallint,    @exit_code           int,    @exit_module         smallint,    @status              varchar(254) = null,    @current_time        datetime = null,    @module              smallint = null,    @level               smallint = null as    if (@status_code = -99)       set @status_code = null     if exists (select schedule_id from event_schedule 					where schedule_id = @schedule_id and status_code = 0 and next_task_seq = -1)       return  	if (@exit_code is not null and @exit_code != 0 and @status_code is not null and @status_code > 0) 		set @status_code = 1     begin transaction     if (@status is null)       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code          where schedule_id = @schedule_id    else       update event_schedule          set status_code = @status_code, 			 exit_code = @exit_code, 			 exit_module = @exit_module,              status = @status          where schedule_id = @schedule_id  --LB#40844 	if(@status_code >=0 and @current_time is not null) 	begin 		exec upd_schedule_end_time @schedule_id,@current_time 	end     if ( @current_time is not null )       exec ins_schedule_status @schedule_id, @current_time, @status, @status_code, @exit_code, @module, @level     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_set_next_task 	@schedule_id int as 	declare @next_seq_id int 	declare @retval int  	select top 1 @next_seq_id = t.task_seq 		from task t	inner join event_schedule es on es.cond_seq = t.cond_seq and es.event_id = t.event_id 		where es.schedule_id = @schedule_id and t.task_seq > es.next_task_seq 		order by task_seq  	if (@next_seq_id is not null) 	begin 		begin transaction  		update event_schedule set next_task_seq = @next_seq_id where schedule_id = @schedule_id  		if (@@error = 0) 			commit transaction 		else 			rollback transaction  		set @retval = @next_seq_id 	end 	else 	begin 		set @retval = -1 	end  	return @retval

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghost_cmdline]    @event_id	int,    @new_session_name varchar(50) as    declare @tran int    declare @old_session_name varchar(50)    set @tran = @@trancount     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  	  update image_task  	  set @old_session_name = SUBSTRING(addl_cmdline,CHARINDEX('"', addl_cmdline , 1) + 1,LEN(addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('"', addl_cmdline) - CHARINDEX('"', REVERSE(addl_cmdline))), 	  ghcastsrv_cmdline = case when ghcastsrv_cmdline is not null then replace(ghcastsrv_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) else NULL end, 	  addl_cmdline =  replace(addl_cmdline,@old_session_name,@new_session_name) 	  where event_id = @event_id and CHARINDEX('@MC',addl_cmdline) > 0             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction

Object_Definition: CREATE procedure [dbo].[upd_task_ghostcast_setting]    @event_id	int,    @ghostcast_setting varchar(10) as    declare @tran int    set @tran = @@trancount     set @ghostcast_setting = ' ' + @ghostcast_setting     if( 0 = @tran )       begin transaction  	  update image_task set ghcastsrv_cmdline =  	  case   when CHARINDEX(' -N',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -N%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  			 when CHARINDEX(' -T',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -T%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)  			 when CHARINDEX(' -O',ghcastsrv_cmdline) > 0 then stuff(ghcastsrv_cmdline,PATINDEX('% -O%', ghcastsrv_cmdline),LEN(ghcastsrv_cmdline)-1,@ghostcast_setting)           END 	  where event_id = @event_id and ghcastsrv_cmdline is not NULL             if (@@error != 0)    begin       if( 0 = @tran )          rollback transaction       return    end     if( 0 = @tran )       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_task_password    @username		varchar(128),    @oldpassword     varchar(128),    @newpassword     varchar(128) as    declare @rowsupdated   int    set     @rowsupdated  = 0     begin transaction  		update    copyfile_task 		set       password =@newpassword 		where     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) 		set @rowsupdated = @@rowcount  		update    script_task 		set          password =@newpassword 		where     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) 		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  		update    install_task 		set          password =@newpassword 		where     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) 		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  		update    install_task 		set          exec_password =@newpassword 		where     (lower (exec_username) = lower (@username)) and (exec_password = @oldpassword) 		--the install_task.username and install_task.exec_username appear to always be the same so do not add to the count set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount  		update    capture_pct_task 		set          password =@newpassword 		where     (lower (username) = lower (@username)) and (password = @oldpassword) 		set @rowsupdated = @rowsupdated + @@rowcount     if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       return 0    end     commit transaction     return @rowsupdated

Object_Definition: create procedure upd_unattend_var     @var_id int,     @default_val int,     @var_name varchar(254),     @var_desc varchar(254),     @var_type smallint,     @val_value varchar(256),     @val_displayed varchar(256) as     declare @old_type int      begin transaction      select @old_type=[type] from unattend_vars where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      update unattend_vars set [name]=@var_name, [description]=@var_desc, [type]=@var_type                        where unattend_vars_id=@var_id      if(@old_type = 0 and @var_type != 0)     begin       delete from unattend_vars_value where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and unattend_vars_value_id <> @default_val     end      if(@var_type != 0)     begin       update unattend_vars_value set [value]=@val_value, name_displayed=@val_displayed                       where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val     end      if(@var_type = 0)     begin       set @default_val=NULL        select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                       where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value] like @val_value        update unattend_vars_value set [default]=0 where unattend_vars_id=@var_id        if (@default_val is null)       begin         insert into unattend_vars_value(unattend_vars_id, [value], name_displayed, [default])                     values(@var_id, @val_value, @val_displayed, 1)          select @default_val=unattend_vars_value_id from unattend_vars_value                     where unattend_vars_id=@var_id and [value]=@val_value       end       else       begin         update unattend_vars_value set [default]=1 where unattend_vars_value_id=@default_val       end     end      select @default_val as [val_id], @var_id as [var_id]      commit transaction

Object_Definition: -- this SP is added to fix bug #28880 create procedure wc_del_config_event_for_live_schedule    @jobId         int as    begin transaction     declare @cnt int    declare @reConfig smallint    declare @useExisting smallint     select @reConfig=ct.reconfig ,@useExisting=cs.use_existing_data     from config_set cs join config_task ct on ct.config_set_id = cs.config_set_id     where ct.event_id = @jobId     -- delete only if it is live job     if(@reConfig=1) and (@useExisting=1)    begin 	-- delete if this is scheduled on this computer only  	select @cnt=count(target_computer_id)  	from config_item ci join config_task ct on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id  	where ct.event_id = @jobId         -- if no schedule on this job then delete this         if (@cnt=0) 	     exec del_event @jobId    end  	    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)

create procedure dbo.wc_del_user    @user int,    @del_unexec_schedule smallint = 0 --#38370 Delete unexecuted schedule entries while deleting user as    begin transaction       declare @userId int    select @userId = [user_id] from securityuser where [user_id] = @user     -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    if @userId is not null    begin    	if @del_unexec_schedule = 1     	begin  	       		delete from securityuser where [user_id] = @userId       		delete from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @userId       		       		--#38370 Delete event schedule which are still not executed.       		delete event_schedule 			from event_schedule s 			where s.[user_id]=@userId and s.status_code is null       	end       	else       	begin       		--#38370 If specified "not-to-delete" schedule then we cant delete user. We will hide it.       		update securityuser       		set deleted=1       		where [user_id] = @userId       		       		delete from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @userId       	end    end        if (@@error != 0)          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@user int, @del_unexec_schedule smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_generate_first_computer_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64) output as    -- get the name range data from the config_set record    declare @method smallint, @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @method = cname_method, @fixed = cname_fixed, @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append,       @numbers = cname_numbers from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id     if @method = 2    begin       if @numbers = 1 -- numeric portion       begin          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))          else             set @name = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed       end       else -- alpha portion       begin          -- convert number to ascii character values          declare @alpha varchar(64)          set @alpha = ''          while @addl >= 0          begin                         declare @dval smallint             set @dval = @addl % 26             set @addl = @addl / 26             set @alpha = @alpha + char(@dval + 97)             set @addl = @addl - 1          end          -- reverse the character order to form the final string          set @alpha = reverse(@alpha)          if @append = 1             set @name = @fixed + @alpha          else             set @name = @alpha + @fixed       end    end    else       set @name = null
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar OUT)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_have_computer_for_vm    @vm_uuid varchar(128),    @host_uuid varchar(128),    @vc_computer varchar(256) as    declare @vm_comp_id int        select @vm_comp_id = computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)        if @vm_comp_id is not null    begin       update computer set virtual_machine_host_group_id =           (select virtual_machine_host_group_id from virtual_machine_host_group where computer = @vc_computer),          virtual_machine_host_id = (select computer_id from computer where lower(uuid) = lower(@host_uuid))          where lower(uuid) = lower(@vm_uuid)                 select 1    end    else    begin       select 0    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@vm_uuid varchar, @host_uuid varchar, @vc_computer varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_increment_ip    @ip varchar(16),    @ip_out varchar(16) output as    -- break the IP address into integer octet values    declare @octet1 int, @octet2 int, @octet3 int, @octet4 int    declare @dot_index1 int, @dot_index2 int    select @dot_index1 = charindex('.', @ip)    set @octet1 = cast(substring(@ip, 1, @dot_index1 - 1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index1 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet2 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = charindex('.', @ip, @dot_index1)    set @octet3 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - @dot_index1) as int)    set @dot_index1 = @dot_index2 + 1    select @dot_index2 = len(@ip)    set @octet4 = cast(substring(@ip, @dot_index1, @dot_index2 - (@dot_index1 - 1)) as int)     -- increment octet values as needed to increment the ip    if @octet4 < 255       set @octet4 = @octet4 + 1    else    begin       set @octet4 = 1       if @octet3 < 255          set @octet3 = @octet3 + 1       else       begin          set @octet3 = 0          if @octet2 < 255             set @octet2 = @octet2 + 1          else          begin             set @octet2 = 0             if @octet1 < 255                set @octet1 = @octet1 + 1             else             begin                set @octet1 = 1                set @octet2 = 1                set @octet3 = 1                set @octet4 = 1             end          end       end    end     set @ip_out = cast(@octet1 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet2 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet3 as varchar(3)) + '.' + cast(@octet4 as varchar(3))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@ip varchar, @ip_out varchar OUT)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_increment_name    @config_set_id int,    @name varchar(64),    @name_out varchar(64) output as    -- Get the name range information from the config_set record    declare @addl smallint, @append smallint, @numbers smallint    declare @fixed varchar(64)    select @addl = cname_addl, @append = cname_append, @numbers = cname_numbers,       @fixed = cname_fixed from config_set where config_set_id = @config_set_id    if len(@name) = 0       exec wc_generate_first_computer_name @config_set_id, @name     -- Split the fixed and variable text in the @name passed in    declare @variable_text varchar(64)    declare @fixed_pos int    set @fixed_pos = charindex(@fixed, @name)    if @fixed_pos > 1 -- prefix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, 1, @fixed_pos - 1)    else -- postfix       set @variable_text = substring(@name, len(@fixed) + 1, len(@name) - len(@fixed))           -- Increment the @variable_text    if @numbers = 1    begin       -- numeric variable       set @addl = cast(@variable_text as smallint) + 1       if @append = 1          set @name_out = @fixed + cast(@addl as varchar(64))       else          set @name_out = cast(@addl as varchar(64)) + @fixed    end    else    begin       -- alpha variable       -- test for all Z characters       set @variable_text = upper(@variable_text)       declare @z_count int, @z_loc int       set @z_loc = 0       set @z_count = 0       set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text)       while @z_loc > 0       begin          set @z_count = @z_count + 1          set @z_loc = charindex('Z', @variable_text, @z_loc + 1)       end       if len(@variable_text) = @z_count       begin          -- reset to all A characters and add A to the end          set @name_out = replace(@variable_text, 'Z', 'A')          set @name_out = @variable_text + 'A'       end       else       begin          -- advance all needed characters          declare @addl_out varchar(64)          set @addl_out = ''                    declare @char int          declare @increment_done smallint          set @increment_done = 0          while len(@variable_text) > 0          begin             set @char = ascii(substring(@variable_text, len(@variable_text), 1))             if @increment_done = 0             begin                if @char = 90                   set @char = 65                else                begin                   set @char = @char + 1                   set @increment_done = 1                end             end              set @addl_out = @addl_out + char(@char)              if len(@variable_text) > 1                set @variable_text = substring(@variable_text, 1, len(@variable_text) - 1)             else                set @variable_text = ''          end          set @addl_out = reverse(@addl_out)          if @append = 1             set @name_out = @fixed + @addl_out          else             set @name_out = @addl_out + @fixed       end    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@config_set_id int, @name varchar, @name_out varchar OUT)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_bay    @changeMethod  smallint,    @predefinedJob int,    @enclosure int,    @initialJob int,    @computer int,    @bayIdx int = null,    @icon smallint = 67 as    declare @addedIdx int    set @addedIdx = -1    -- ensure enclosure exists    declare @enclosureId int    select @enclosureId = enclosure_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @enclosure    declare @manuf smallint    select @manuf = manuf_rack from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e        where e.enclosure_id = @enclosure and e.rack_id = r.rack_id    declare @recordsAdded int     if @enclosureId is not null and @manuf = 0    begin       -- determine number of bays that can be added       declare @bayRecCount int       select @bayRecCount = count(bay_id) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @bayCount int       select @bayCount = bay_count from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @bayId int       exec @bayId = sel_next_system_id 'BAY_ID'       declare @single int       set @single = @bayIdx       if @bayIdx is null          select @bayIdx = max(idx) from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId       declare @missingBay smallint       set @missingBay = 1        -- insert a bay       if @bayRecCount < @bayCount       begin                      if @single is null          begin             while @bayIdx is not null             begin                set @bayIdx = null                select @bayIdx = bay_id from physical_bay where enclosure_id = @enclosureId                   and idx = @missingBay                if @bayIdx is not null 			   begin 			      set @missingBay = @missingBay + 1 			   end             end          end          else             set @missingBay = @bayIdx          -- hide the virtual computer          insert into physical_bay(bay_id, enclosure_id, idx, [name], real_name, computer_id, icon,                change_method, event_id, initial_event_id)              values (@bayId, @enclosureId, @missingBay, cast(@missingBay as varchar),                 cast(@missingBay as varchar), @computer, @icon, @changeMethod, @predefinedJob, @initialJob)          set @addedIdx = @missingBay           update computer set hidden=1 where computer_id=@computer       end    end    return @addedIdx

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_condition 	@job 	int, 	@name	varchar(64) as 	declare @condition   int    	select @condition = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id = @job    	if @condition is null 	begin 		begin transaction 		insert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq, [name]) 			values (@job, 1, null) 		if(@@error != 0) 		begin 			rollback transaction 			set @condition = -1 		end 		else 		begin 			commit transaction 			set @condition = 0 		end 	end    	else 	begin 		begin transaction 			update event_condition set cond_seq = @condition + 1 				where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition 		if (@@error != 0) 		begin 	      	rollback transaction 			set @condition = -1 		end 	   	else 	      	commit transaction 	end  	if @condition > -1 	begin 		begin transaction 		 			insert into event_condition (event_id, cond_seq, [name]) 			values (@job, @condition, @name) 	 		if (@@error != 0) 		begin 	      		rollback transaction 			set @condition = -1 		end 	   	else 	      		commit transaction 	end  	select @condition as cond_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @name varchar)

Object_Definition: -- PRD item 7.1.7_and_7.1.8 Active and Inactive computer Filter  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_filter 	@name	varchar(64) as 	declare @filter   int 	select @filter = max(filter_id) from filter 	if @filter is null 	begin 		begin transaction 		insert into filter (filter_id, folder_id, [name]) 			values (8000001, null, null) 		if(@@error != 0)	 		begin 			rollback transaction 			set @filter = -1 		end 		else 		begin 			commit transaction 			set @filter = 0 		end 	end  	else if @filter > -1 	begin 		begin transaction 		 			insert into filter (filter_id, folder_id, [name]) 			values (@filter+1, null, @name) 	 		if (@@error != 0) 		begin 	      		rollback transaction 			set @filter = -1 		end 	   	else 	      		commit transaction 	end  	select @filter+1 as filter_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@name varchar)

Object_Definition: -- PRD item 7.1.7_and_7.1.8 Active and Inactive computer Filter  create procedure dbo.wc_ins_filter_item    @filter int,    @field int,    @operation int,    @value varchar(256) = null,    @drive varchar(8) = null,    @conjunct smallint = -1 as    -- get the next filter  item id    declare @item   int    select @item = max(item_seq) from filter_condition where filter_id = @filter     if @item is null       set @item = 0    else       set @item = @item + 1     begin transaction     	insert into filter_condition (filter_id, item_seq, field_type, oper_type, key_value, drive, conjunct) 		values (@filter, @item, @field, @operation, @value, @drive, @conjunct)     if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @item as item_seq
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@filter int, @field int, @operation int, @value varchar, @drive varchar, @conjunct smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_folder    @name          varchar(64) = null,    @parentId     int = -10 as    begin transaction     declare @folderId int    set @folderId = null    exec @folderId = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'     if(@name is null)       set @name = 'New Folder ' + cast((@folderId - 1000000) as varchar)      if(@parentId = -10)       set @parentId = null        if(@folderId != 0)       insert into event_folder ( folder_id, name, parent_id )        values ( @folderId, @name, @parentId )     if (@@error != 0 or @folderId = 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction     select @folderId as FolderId

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_install_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @filename	varchar(254),    @username	varchar(128),    @password	varchar(128),    @commandLine	varchar(254),    @allUsers	smallint,    @type		smallint,    @quietMode	smallint,    @pkgPassword	varchar(254),    @aclient		smallint,    @downloadDir	smallint,    @recurseDir	smallint,    @cmdlineParams varchar(254),    @pkg_title varchar(64) = '', --Bug #32636    @pkg_desc varchar(254) = '', --Bug #32636    @pkg_ver float = 0,   --Bug #32636    @pkg_creation int = 0, -- DE 2.19    @exec_username varchar(128),    @exec_password varchar(128),    @svs_action int, -- DE 2.19    @svs_action_force smallint, -- DE 2.19    @svs_layer_guid varchar(36) as    -- collect the highest task sequence value for the event/condition    declare @taskSeq   int    select @taskSeq = task_seq from task where task_seq =        (select top 1 task_seq from task         where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq        order by task_seq desc)    -- increment to get available task sequence slot    if @taskSeq is null       set @taskSeq = 0    else       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1     -- insert a new task    begin transaction       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 15)       insert into install_task 	     (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, install_file, username, [password], addl_cmd_line,           all_users, pkg_type, quiet_mode, pkg_password, aclient_to_download, download_directory,           recurse_dir, cmdline_params, pkg_title, pkg_desc, pkg_ver, pkg_mod_time, exec_username , exec_password, svs_action, svs_action_force, svs_layer_guid)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 0)    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction     -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_inventory_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int     as    -- collect the highest task sequence value for the event/condition    declare @taskSeq   int    select @taskSeq = task_seq from task where task_seq =        (select top 1 task_seq from task         where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq        order by task_seq desc)    -- increment to get available task sequence slot    if @taskSeq is null       set @taskSeq = 0    else       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1     -- insert a new task    begin transaction       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)	--, type_code)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 19)	--, null)        insert into task_return_handlers          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, ret_code)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 0)    -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction     -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_job    @name         varchar(128) = null,    @folder_id    int = -10,    @folder_name  varchar(64) = NULL,    @add_number   int = 0,    @default_event_name	varchar(64) = 'New Job',    @default_folder_name varchar(64) = 'New Folder',    @description   varchar(254) = null as    declare @event_id int     exec @event_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_ID'     if (@event_id = 0)    begin       return -1    end     if (@name is null or @name = '')    begin       select @name = @default_event_name    end     if (@add_number > 0)    begin       select @name = @name + ' ' + cast((@event_id - 2000006) as varchar(30))    end     if ( @folder_id < 1 and @folder_name is null)    begin       begin transaction       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description], version) values (@event_id, @name, @description, 1)     end    else    begin       declare @temp_folder_id int        if (@folder_name is null or @folder_name = '')          set @folder_name = @default_folder_name        if (@folder_id < 1)       begin          set @folder_id = null          select @folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where [name] = @folder_name          if (@folder_id is null)             exec @folder_id = sel_next_system_id 'EVENT_FOLDER_ID'          if (@@error != 0)             set @folder_id = null       end        if (@folder_id is null)          set @temp_folder_id = 1       else          select @temp_folder_id = folder_id from event_folder where folder_id = @folder_id              begin transaction       if (@temp_folder_id) is null          insert into event_folder (folder_id, [name]) values (@folder_id, @folder_name)       insert into event (event_id, [name], [description], folder_id, version)           values (@event_id, @name, @description, @folder_id, 1)    end        if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction            select @event_id as event_id    return @event_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@name varchar, @folder_id int, @folder_name varchar, @add_number int, @default_event_name varchar, @default_folder_name varchar, @description varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic 	@computer_id int, 	@mac_addr varchar(36), 	@ip_use_dhcp smallint, 	@ip_domain varchar(128), 	@ip_dns varchar(512), 	@ip_wins varchar(512), 	@nic_pci_bus int, 	@nic_pci_device int, 	@nic_pci_function int, 	@nic_device_id int, 	@nic_vendor_id int, 	@nic_desc varchar(64), 	@nic_location varchar(64), 	@interface_id int, 	@id int, 	@nic_id int, 	@name varchar(64), 	@ip varchar(16), 	@mask varchar(16), 	@gateway varchar(16), 	@broadcast varchar(16), 	@state int, 	@netBIOS int=1 -- For PRD item 7.1.53 as 	begin 		insert into nics values(@computer_id, 								@nic_id, 								@mac_addr, 								@ip_use_dhcp, 								@ip_domain, 								@ip_dns, 								@ip_wins, 								@nic_pci_bus, 								@nic_pci_device, 								@nic_pci_function, 								@nic_device_id, 								@nic_vendor_id, 								@nic_desc, 								@nic_location, 								@netBIOS, 								1, 								1, 								NULL) 								  		insert into nic_interface values(@computer_id, 							   @nic_id, 							   @name, 							   @ip, 							   @mask, 							   @gateway, 							   @broadcast, 							   @state) 	end

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item    @jobId		int,    @condition		int,     @task		int,     @computerId		int,     @domainSuffix	varchar(128),    @ipMethod		smallint,     @wins		varchar(512),    @dns			varchar(512),    @netbios             smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS setting for nic    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_config_item    declare @configItemId int    select @configItemId = i.config_item_id from config_item i, config_set s, config_task t        where i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- get the highest nic_id from existing nic_config_item records    declare @maxNicId int    select @maxNicId = max(nic_id) from nic_config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId     -- test for valid records    declare @nicId int    set @nicId = @maxNicId    if @configItemId is not null and @maxNicId is not null    begin       -- generate the generic NIC description       set @nicId = @nicId + 2       declare @nicDesc varchar(64)       set @nicDesc = 'Network Adapter ' + cast(@nicId as varchar)        -- insert the new nic_config_item record       begin transaction          insert into nic_config_item (config_item_id, nic_id, ip_use_dhcp, ip_domain, ip_dns,              ip_wins, nic_desc, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp) values (@configItemId, @nicId, @ipMethod, @domainSuffix, @dns,             @wins, @nicDesc, @netbios, @dns_use_dhcp, @wins_use_dhcp)              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end        -- return the new nic_id or -1 on error    select @nicId as nic_id
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @domainSuffix varchar, @ipMethod smallint, @wins varchar, @dns varchar, @netbios smallint, @dns_use_dhcp smallint, @wins_use_dhcp smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_item_interface    @jobId		int,    @condition		int,     @task		int,     @computerId		int,    @nicId		int,    @ip			varchar(16) = null,    @netmask		varchar(16) = null,    @gateway		varchar(16) = null,    @broadcast		varchar(16) = null,    @name		varchar(64) = null,    @state		int = null as    -- get the appropriate config_item_id for this nic_interface    declare @id int    select @id = ni.config_item_id from nic_config_item ni, config_item i, config_set s,        config_task t where ni.config_item_id = i.config_item_id and ni.nic_id = @nicId       and i.target_computer_id = @computerId and i.config_set_id = s.config_set_id        and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId        and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- give unnamed intefaces a default name    if @name is null    begin       declare @maxInterface varchar(64)       select @maxInterface = max([name]) from nic_interface where [id] = @id and          nic_id = @nicId       declare @colonIndex int       select @colonIndex = charindex(@maxInterface, ':')       if @colonIndex > 0       begin          declare @numLen int          select @numLen = len(@maxInterface) - @colonIndex          declare @num varchar(7)          set @colonIndex = @colonIndex + 1          select @num = substring(@maxInterface, @colonIndex, @numLen)          declare @interfaceNum int          set @interfaceNum = cast(@num as int)          if @interfaceNum is null             set @interfaceNum = 0          else             set @interfaceNum = @interfaceNum + 1          set @name = 'eth' + cast(@nicId as varchar) + ':' + cast(@interfaceNum as varchar)       end    end     -- check for duplicate IP Interface name    declare @nameMatch varchar(64)    select @nameMatch = [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId       and [name] like @name    if @nameMatch is null    begin       -- add the IP interface       begin transaction          insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway,              broadcast, state) values (@id, @nicId, @name, @ip, @netmask,              @gateway, @broadcast, @state)       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condition int, @task int, @computerId int, @nicId int, @ip varchar, @netmask varchar, @gateway varchar, @broadcast varchar, @name varchar, @state int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_set    @jobId		int = null,    @condition		int = null,     @task		int = null,     @domainSuffix	varchar(128),    @ipMethod		smallint,     @wins		varchar(512),    @dns			varchar(512),    @configSetId int = null,    @netbios     smallint=1, --PRD item 7.1.53 Net BIOS    @dns_use_dhcp smallint = 1,    @wins_use_dhcp smallint = 1 as    -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_config_set    if @configSetId is null       select @configSetId = s.config_set_id from config_set s, config_task t           where s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task     -- get the highest nic_id from existing nic_config_set records    declare @maxNicId int    select @maxNicId = max(nic_id) from nic_config_set where config_set_id = @configSetId    if @maxNicId is null       set @maxNicId = -1    set @maxNicId = @maxNicId + 1     -- test for valid records    declare @nicId int    set @nicId = @maxNicId    if @configSetId is not null and @maxNicId is not null    begin       -- insert the new nic_config_set record       begin transaction          insert into nic_config_set (config_set_id, nic_id, ip_method, ip_domain, ip_dns,              ip_wins, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, wins_use_dhcp) values (@configSetId, @nicId, @ipMethod, @domainSuffix, @dns, @wins, @netbios, @dns_use_dhcp, @wins_use_dhcp)              -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0       begin          rollback transaction          set @nicId = -1       end       else          commit transaction    end        -- return the new nic_id or -1 on error    select @nicId as nic_id

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_nic_config_set_interface    @jobId		int = null,    @condition		int = null,     @task		int = null,    @configSetId		int = null,    @nicId		int,    @ip			varchar(16) = null,    @netmask		varchar(16) = null,    @gateway		varchar(16) = null,    @broadcast		varchar(16) = null,    @name		varchar(64) = null,    @state		int = null as    declare @id int    if @configSetId is null       -- get the appropriate config_set_id for this nic_interface            select @id = ns.config_set_id from nic_config_set ns, config_set s,           config_task t where ns.config_set_id = s.config_set_id and ns.nic_id = @nicId          and s.config_set_id = t.config_set_id and t.event_id = @jobId           and t.cond_seq = @condition and t.task_seq = @task    else       set @id = @configSetId     -- give unnamed intefaces a default name    if @name is null    begin       declare @maxInterface varchar(64)       select @maxInterface = max([name]) from nic_interface where [id] = @id and          nic_id = @nicId       declare @colonIndex int       select @colonIndex = charindex(@maxInterface, ':')       if @colonIndex > 0       begin          declare @numLen int          select @numLen = len(@maxInterface) - @colonIndex          declare @num varchar(7)          set @colonIndex = @colonIndex + 1          select @num = substring(@maxInterface, @colonIndex, @numLen)          declare @interfaceNum int          set @interfaceNum = cast(@num as int)          if @interfaceNum is null             set @interfaceNum = 0          else             set @interfaceNum = @interfaceNum + 1          set @name = 'eth' + cast(@nicId as varchar) + ':' + cast(@interfaceNum as varchar)       end    end     -- check for duplicate IP Interface name    declare @nameMatch varchar(64)    select @nameMatch = [name] from nic_interface where [id] = @id and nic_id = @nicId       and [name] like @name    if @nameMatch is null    begin       -- add the IP interface       begin transaction          insert into nic_interface ([id], nic_id, [name], ip, mask, gateway,              broadcast, state) values (@id, @nicId, @name, @ip, @netmask,              @gateway, @broadcast, @state)       -- handle errors/commit transaction       if @@error != 0          rollback transaction       else          commit transaction    end

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_schedule    @jobIds varchar(8000), --Bug #45310    @computerId int,    @userId int,    @deferMins int,    @startTime datetime,    @recur int,    @recurType smallint,    @windowsUserId int = null--Bug #45310 as    declare @scheduleId int    declare @configItemId int --27730    declare @existing_schedule int    declare @jobId int        begin transaction     --Bug #45310 - Assigning numerous multiple jobs in the web console very slow		    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_schedule_config') is null        create table dbo.##wc_schedule_config (scheduleId int, configItemId int)    else 		delete from dbo.##wc_schedule_config     declare schedule_cursor cursor for  	select ID from SplitIDs(@jobIds)       open schedule_cursor 	 	fetch next from schedule_cursor into @jobId 	while @@fetch_status = 0 	begin 			 		-- check for existing schedule for this computer/job   		select @existing_schedule = count(schedule_id) from event_schedule 			where computer_id = @computerId and event_id = @jobId  		-- create a new schedule 		if @existing_schedule = 0 			exec @scheduleId = ins_event_schedule @jobId, 0 		else 			select @scheduleId = schedule_id from event_schedule 				where computer_id = @computerId and event_id = @jobId  		-- update new schedule fields 		if @scheduleId > -1 		begin 			update event_schedule set computer_id = @computerId, start_time = @startTime,  				recur_value = @recur, recur_type = @recurType, defer_mins = @deferMins,  				dep_schedule_id = null, status_code = null, status = '', next_task_seq = null,  				cond_seq = null, broker_time = null, end_time = null, exit_code = null,  				exit_module = null, [user_id] = @userId where schedule_id = @scheduleId 		end  		-- update configuration data 		if @existing_schedule = 0 			EXEC @configItemId =  wc_upd_config_data @jobId,@computerId    		EXEC wc_ins_schedule_info @scheduleId,@windowsUserId  		insert into ##wc_schedule_config values (@scheduleId, @configItemId) 		 		fetch next from schedule_cursor into @jobId 	end	 	close schedule_cursor 	deallocate schedule_cursor        if @@error != 0       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction           select scheduleId, configItemId from ##wc_schedule_config    --#63690    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_schedule_config') is not null 		drop table dbo.##wc_schedule_config
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobIds varchar, @computerId int, @userId int, @deferMins int, @startTime datetime, @recur int, @recurType smallint, @windowsUserId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_upd_set_permission    @permission int,    @user       int,    @object     int,    @allow      smallint as    -- determine if the permission already exists    declare @isAllowed smallint    select @isAllowed = allow from securitypermissionlink        where [user_id] = @user and [object_id] = @object       and permission_id = @permission     if @isAllowed is null       -- add a new permission       insert into securitypermissionlink (permission_id, [user_id], [object_id], allow)          values (@permission, @user, @object, @allow)    else       -- edit an existing permission       update securitypermissionlink set allow = @allow where permission_id = @permission          and [user_id] = @user and [object_id] = @object
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@permission int, @user int, @object int, @allow smallint)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_ins_user    @username varchar(100),    @fullName varchar(128),    @description varchar(128),    @password varchar(64) = null,    @domain varchar(50) = null,    @netbiosdomain varchar(50) = null, --7.1.31 Active Directory     @displayname varchar(100) = null ,    @upnname varchar(128) = null,    @userguid varchar(128) = null as    declare @userId int        -- test for duplicate user    declare @count int    select @count = count([user_id]) from securityuser    declare @duplicate varchar(64)    --set @duplicate = null -- PRD 7.1.66 Security    --select @duplicate = [name] from securityuser where [name] = @username      -- add user    --if @duplicate is null     --begin       if @domain is null          insert into securityuser ([name], fullname, [description], [password])             values (@username, @fullName, @description, @password)       else       begin           --37092 AD User is not getting administrative rights if he is a member of two AD Groups          -- Check if user is present as hidden          select @userId=[user_id]           from securityuser           where ([name]=@username or [upnname] = @username) and ( upper(domain) = upper(@domain) or upper(netbiosdomain) = upper(@domain) )                    -- if not then insert, else update          if(@userId is null) 			insert into securityuser ([name], fullname, [description], ad_user, domain, netbiosdomain, displayname, upnname, user_guid)  				values (@username, @fullName, @description, 1, @domain, @netbiosdomain, @displayname, @upnname, @userguid)			 		else 			update securityuser 			set  [description]=@description, 			ad_user=1 			where [user_id]=@userId			       end  	  if @userId is null 		set @userId = @@identity            -- make sure at least one user has the administrative right       if @count = 0          insert into securityprivilegelink ([user_id], privilege_id)             values (@userId, 1)       --end   select @userId
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @fullName varchar, @description varchar, @password varchar, @domain varchar, @netbiosdomain varchar, @displayname varchar, @upnname varchar, @userguid varchar)

Object_Definition: --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth 	@folder_id as int as /* 	select all child folder of current folder with level as 1 in temp table. 	For each this folder find child folder with level = level + 1 and store this in temp table. 	repeat this step for all rows in temp table 	Find max level value which will be max depth for given folder */  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (	folder_id int, 	[name] varchar(64), 	[level]	int )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for 	select folder_id,[name],[level]  	from @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin 	insert into @tbl_folder_depth 	select folder_id, [name], @level + 1 	from event_folder 	where parent_id=@folder_id	  	fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)

Object_Definition: --#36251 - Web console allows to create more than 30 nested folders and user is not able to delete the parent folder. create procedure dbo.wc_sel_child_folder_depth_x  @folder_id as int  as  --This SP is same as wc_sel_child_folder_depth but for import where tables are different.  declare @level as int  declare @name as varchar(64)  set @level =1  declare @tbl_folder_depth table (	folder_id int, 	[name] varchar(64), 	[level]	int )   insert into @tbl_folder_depth select folder_id, [name], @level  from x_event_folder where parent_id =@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for 	select folder_id,[name],[level]  	from @tbl_folder_depth  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level while @@fetch_status = 0 begin 	insert into @tbl_folder_depth 	select folder_id, [name], @level + 1 	from x_event_folder 	where parent_id=@folder_id	  	fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id, @name, @level end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select max(level) from @tbl_folder_depth
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)
