Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_branch 	@id int, 	@selectResults int = 1 as 	declare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) 	set @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 	if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null 		exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)  	exec('create table dbo.'+@branch_tablename+ 		'([level] 	int IDENTITY, 	 	 name 		varchar(64), 		 id			int NOT NULL, 		 type		varchar(8))') 	declare @strsql nvarchar(500) 	declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) 	if @id >= 5000001 and @id <= 8000000 	begin 		-- Get the computer node 		--exec('insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  		--	select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type 		--	from computer where computer_id =' +@id) 		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  					  select name, computer_id as id, ''computer'' as type 					  from computer where computer_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; 		-- Get the group_id 		select @id = group_id from computer where computer_id = @id 	end	  	-- Get groups down branch to root node 	while @id is not null and @id != -1 	begin 		-- Get the group node 		--insert into ##wc_branch (name, id, type) 		--	select name, group_id as id, 'group' as type 		--	from computer_group where group_id = @id 		set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 		set @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) select name, group_id as id, ''group'' as type from computer_group where group_id = @intid'; 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; 		 		-- Get the parent_id 		declare @oldId int 		set @oldId = @id 		set @id = null 		select @id = parent_id from computer_group where group_id = @oldId 	end  	exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) 		 values (''All Computers'', -1, ''group'')')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResults = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc')
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_configuration 	@job			int, 	@condition		int, 	@task			int, 	@computer		int as 	declare @configSetId int 	select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task  		where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task 	declare @configItemId int 	select @configItemId = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @configSetId 		and target_computer_id = @computer  	select * from config_item where config_item_id = @configItemId         -- Changed for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & 7.1.53 DNS Suffix         select * from dns_suffix where [id] = @configItemId         select * from config_static_route_item where config_item_id = @configItemId

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_computer_schedules 	@computer_id int as 		--Bug #40255: Web Console not showing all computers that have been scheduled for a job 		select	schd.schedule_id, schd.computer_id, schd.event_id, schd.cond_seq, schd.next_task_seq, schd.start_time, schd.recur_value , schd.recur_type , schd.status_code , schd.status, schd.broker_time, schd.defer_mins, schd.config_choice_id, schd.end_time, schd.dep_schedule_id, schd.user_id, schd.initial_deployment, schd.redeploy_history_id, schd.calling_event, schd.rip_replace_event, schd.exit_code, schd.exit_module, schd._nslastsent,  				evnt.[name] as 'job_name', comp.[name] as 'computer_name', evntinfo.job_exec_time as 'job_execution_time' 		from event_schedule as schd  		left outer join event as evnt on evnt.event_id = schd.event_id 		left outer join computer as comp on schd.computer_id = comp.computer_id  		left outer join event_schedule_info as evntinfo on schd.schedule_id = evntinfo.schedule_id 		where schd.computer_id = @computer_id

Object_Definition: --return a dataset of permissions for the given user and object create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_permissions    @userId int,    @objectId int as    declare @permission int     --create temp table    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_permissions') is not null       drop table ##wc_last_effective_permissions    create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_permissions (permission int, granted int, [permissionName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int,  [userName] varchar(64),  [userGroup] varchar(64),  parentSource int, fromGroup int)        --get permissions that apply to the object    if @objectId = 2000001 --init_deploy       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where initial_deployment = 1    else if (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId < 1000001) or @objectId = -1 --comp_group, ALL_COMPUTERS       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer_group = 1    else if @objectId = -7 --new_comp_group       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where new_computer_group = 1    else if @objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000 --comp       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where computer = 1    else if (@objectId >= 11000001 and @objectId < 14000001) or @objectId = -9 --physical_device       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where physical_device = 1    else if @objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId < 2000001 or @objectId = -10 --event_folder       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event_folder = 1    else if @objectId > 2000001 and @objectId < 3000001 --event       declare permissions_cursor cursor for          select permission          from wc_applicable_permissions where event = 1    else       goto DONE        declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @permissionType varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0      select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights     open permissions_cursor    fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each permission       if @isAdmin > 0 --@isAdmin = 1 When user has admin rights and gets admin rights from one or more admin groups.       begin          select @permissionType = [name] from securitypermission where permission_id = @permission          insert into ##wc_last_effective_permissions values (@permission, 1, @permissionType, @fromAdmin, @permSource,'Administrative Rights', 'Administrative Group',0, @fromGroup)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_permission @userId, @permission, @objectId, 0        fetch next from permissions_cursor into @permission    end          -- cleanup cursor    close permissions_cursor    deallocate permissions_cursor     DONE:  --select temp table     select * from ##wc_last_effective_permissions
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @objectId int)

Object_Definition: --return a dataset of rights for the user create procedure dbo.wc_sel_effective_rights     @userId int, 	@tableName varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights' as    declare @isAdmin int    declare @fromAdmin smallint    declare @right int    declare @permSource int    set @permSource = 0    declare @rightName varchar(50)    declare @fromGroup int    set @fromGroup = 0        set @right = 1 --admin right        --optimize.   only check for administrator once    -- Bug #63690     EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName      --select @isAdmin = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource, @fromGroup = fromGroup from ##wc_last_effective_rights    declare	@sql    nvarchar(512), 			@params nvarchar(512) 			 	set @sql = 'select @SqlisAdmin = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource, @SqlfromGroup = fromGroup from '+@tableName 	 	set @params = N'@SqlisAdmin int OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlfromGroup int OUTPUT' 				 	exec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@SqlisAdmin=@isAdmin output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output, @SqlfromGroup=@fromGroup output      --make sure temp table is empty    -- Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights    if object_id(''+@tableName+'') is not null 	exec('delete from '+@tableName)        declare rights_cursor cursor for          select privilege_id, [name]          from securityprivilege     open rights_cursor    fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName        while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       --for each right       if @isAdmin = 1       begin          select @rightName = [name] from securityprivilege where privilege_id = @right          -- Bug #63690          --insert into ##wc_last_effective_rights values (@right, 1, @rightName, @fromAdmin, @permSource, @fromGroup)          declare @sqlQuery as varchar(128) 		 set @sqlQuery = 'insert into '+ @tableName +' values ('+cast(@right as varchar(10))+',1,'''+@rightName+''','+cast(@fromAdmin as varchar(10))+','+cast(@permSource as varchar(10))+','+cast(@fromGroup as varchar(10))+')' 		 exec (@sqlQuery)       end       else          exec wc_sel_security_right @userId, @right, 0,@tableName        fetch next from rights_cursor into @right, @rightName    end          -- cleanup cursor    close rights_cursor    deallocate rights_cursor      --select temp table   -- Bug #63690    --select * from ##wc_last_effective_rights    exec ('select * from '+@tableName)
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@userId int, @tableName varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(128),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subfolder table (for folder IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folders_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_folders_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_folders_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @id        -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end     -- loop through subfolders to gather all children job IDs    declare @subfolder int    select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    while @subfolder is not null    begin       -- get subfolders of this folder       insert into #wc_folders_to_check ([id])          select folder_id as [id]          from event_folder where parent_id = @subfolder       -- remove this folder from subfolder table       delete from #wc_folders_to_check where [id] = @subfolder       -- get jobs in this folder -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)          select event_id as [id], [name], 'Job' as type, 0 as is_riloe          from event where folder_id = @subfolder       -- get the next subfolder       set @subfolder = null       select @subfolder = min([id]) from #wc_folders_to_check    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_folder_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for job IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_folder_children') is not null       drop table #wc_folder_children    create table dbo.#wc_folder_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Jobs' node    if @id = -10    begin       -- get jobs at the root       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id is null and event_id <> 2000001 -- unless it is initial deployment       -- get first level folders       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get jobs in the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select event_id as [id], 0 as state          from event where folder_id = @id       -- get subfolders of the folder passed in       insert into #wc_folder_children ([id], state)          select folder_id as [id], 0 as state          from event_folder where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered job IDs    select * from #wc_folder_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: -- For PRD item 7.1.66 Copy job folder create procedure wc_sel_folderlevel  @folder_id int, @level int =1 as 	declare @parent_id int 	select @parent_id=parent_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id 	if @parent_id is not null 	begin 		set @level=@level+1 		exec wc_sel_folderlevel @parent_id, @level 	end 	else 		select @level
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int, @level int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543    -- create the subgroup table (for group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_groups_to_check') is not null       drop table #wc_groups_to_check    create table dbo.#wc_groups_to_check       ([id] int not null)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root -- Bug #41543 	insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) 	  select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  	    left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  	    left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id  	   where c.group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)  	 select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  	   left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  	   left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id 	 where c.group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @id          order by [name]    end     -- loop through subgroups to gather all children computer IDs    declare @subgroup int    select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    while @subgroup is not null    begin       -- get subgroups of this group       insert into #wc_groups_to_check ([id])          select group_id as [id]          from computer_group where parent_id = @subgroup       -- remove this group from subgroup table       delete from #wc_groups_to_check where [id] = @subgroup       -- get computers in this group -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe) 	select c.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when r.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end from computer c  		left outer join riloe r on r.computer_id =c.computer_id  		left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id 	where c.group_id = @subgroup 	order by c.[name]       -- get the next subgroup       set @subgroup = null       select @subgroup = min([id]) from #wc_groups_to_check    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_group_children_state    @id int as    -- create the result table (for computer/group IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_group_children') is not null       drop table #wc_group_children    create table dbo.#wc_group_children       ([id] int not null primary key,        state int)        -- deal with 'All Computers' node    if @id = -1    begin       -- get computers at the root       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state           from computer where group_id is null       -- remove virtual bay computers       delete from #wc_group_children where [id] in          (select computer_id as [id] from physical_bay           where initial_event_id is not null)       -- get first level groups       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id is null    end    else    begin       -- get computers in the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select computer_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer where group_id = @id       -- get subgroups of the group passed in       insert into #wc_group_children ([id], state)          select group_id as [id], 0 as state          from computer_group where parent_id = @id    end        -- return the discovered computer IDs    select * from #wc_group_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: -- PRD item 7.1.46 Allow Administrator to Delete History create procedure dbo.wc_sel_history 	 @computer_id 		int as 	select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id,s.complete_time, s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,	 	s.user_log, l.user_name, h.app_id,ea.alias,ea.app_path,ea.description, 	convert(varchar(30),s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time  --Bug #33984 	from     history_view h inner join 	status_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id              left outer  join  loggedon_users l on 		  s.system_logon_user_id = l.user_id 	left join external_application ea  		on h.app_id=ea.app_id 	  	where (s.status_code is not null)  and    	(h.computer_id = @computer_id)  	order by h.history_id desc  select  h.computer_id,h.event_id,h.event_name, h.history_id, h.task_type, h.complete_time, s.[module], s.schedule_time as act_schedule_time,	 	s.status_code, s.status, s.complete_time,s.level,s.return_code_result, 	convert(varchar(30), s.schedule_time, 101) + substring( convert( varchar(30), s.schedule_time , 109) , 12, 9 ) + ' ' + substring(convert( varchar(30), schedule_time),18,3) as schedule_time, --Bug #33984 	xml_task 	from     history_view h inner join 	status_log_view s on h.history_id = s.history_id 	where    	(h.computer_id = @computer_id ) and h.history_id in (select history_id from status_log_view where status_code is not null)  --Bug #33984 	order by h.complete_time desc
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@computer_id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_branch 	@id int, 	@selectResults int = 1 as 	declare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) 	set @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 	if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null 		exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename) 		 	exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename + 		'([level] 	int IDENTITY, 	 	 name 		varchar(128), 		 id			int NOT NULL, 		 type		varchar(8))')  	if @id >= 2000001 and @id <= 3000000 	begin 		-- Get the job node 		declare @strsql nvarchar(500) 		declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500) 		set @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  						select name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type 						from event where event_id = @intid'  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int' 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id  		 		--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  		--	select name, event_id as id, ''job'' as type 		--	from event where event_id ='+ @intid)  		-- Get the folder_id 		select @id = folder_id from event where event_id = @id 	end	  	-- Get folders down branch to root node 	while @id is not null and @id != -10 	begin 		-- Get the folder node 		set @strsql = N'insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type)  						select name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type 						from event_folder where folder_id = @intid';  		set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 		execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid=@id ; 		--exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) 		--	select name, folder_id as id, ''folder'' as type 		--	from event_folder where folder_id =' + @id) 		 		-- Get the parent_id 		declare @oldId int 		set @oldId = @id 		set @id = null 		select @id = parent_id from event_folder where folder_id = @oldId 	end  	exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '(name, id, type) 		 values (''All Jobs'', -10, ''folder'')')	-- Return the completed branch list  	if @selectResults = 1 		exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level] desc')
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResults int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_job_schedules 	@job_id int as 		--Bug #40255: Web Console not showing all computers that have been scheduled for a job 		select	schd.schedule_id, schd.computer_id, schd.event_id, schd.cond_seq, schd.next_task_seq, schd.start_time, schd.recur_value , schd.recur_type , schd.status_code , schd.status, schd.broker_time, schd.defer_mins, schd.config_choice_id, schd.end_time, schd.dep_schedule_id, schd.user_id, schd.initial_deployment, schd.redeploy_history_id, schd.calling_event, schd.rip_replace_event, schd.exit_code, schd.exit_module, schd._nslastsent,  				evnt.[name] as 'job_name', comp.[name] as 'computer_name',evntinfo.job_exec_time as 'job_execution_time' 		from event_schedule as schd 		left outer join event as evnt on evnt.event_id = schd.event_id 		left outer join computer as comp on schd.computer_id = comp.computer_id  		left outer join event_schedule_info as evntinfo on schd.schedule_id = evntinfo.schedule_id 		where schd.event_id = @job_id

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_physical_device_children    @id int -- this param is for compatability and is not used in the procedure as    -- create the result table (for computer IDs)    if object_id('tempdb..#wc_physical_device_children') is not null       drop table #wc_physical_device_children    create table dbo.#wc_physical_device_children       ([id] int not null,        [name] varchar(64),        type varchar(20),        is_riloe smallint) -- Bug #41543     -- iterate through all of the racks    declare @rackId int    declare rack_cursor cursor for       select rack_id from physical_rack    open rack_cursor    fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- get computers in the bays in the enclosures in this rack       -- Bug #41543       insert into #wc_physical_device_children ([id], [name], type, is_riloe)             select b.computer_id as [id], c.[name], 'Computer' as type, 'is_riloe' = case when ri.computer_id is null then 0 else 1 end              from physical_rack r, physical_enclosure e, physical_bay b, computer c  		left outer join riloe ri on ri.computer_id =c.computer_id  		left outer join physical_bay p on p.computer_id =c.computer_id              where r.rack_id = e.rack_id and r.rack_id = @rackId              and e.enclosure_id = b.enclosure_id and b.computer_id = c.computer_id              and b.initial_event_id is null       -- get next rack ID       fetch next from rack_cursor into @rackId    end    -- cleanup cursor    close rack_cursor    deallocate rack_cursor     select * from #wc_physical_device_children
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_reb_branch    @id int,    @selectResult int = 1 as 	declare  @branch_tablename    varchar(128) 	set @branch_tablename = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))    if object_id('tempdb..'+@branch_tablename+'') is not null       exec('drop table ' + @branch_tablename)     exec('create table dbo.' + @branch_tablename +       '([level] int IDENTITY,        [name] varchar(64),        [id] int NOT NULL,        type varchar(20))')  	declare @strsql nvarchar(500) 	declare @ParmDefinition nvarchar(500)    -- If node is a Bay    if @id >= 13000001 and @id <= 14000000    begin       -- Get the bay node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)          -- select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type         -- from physical_bay where bay_id = @id') 		 		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  					  select [name], bay_id as [id], ''bay'' as type 					  from physical_bay where bay_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ;        -- Get the enclosure_id       select @id = enclosure_id from physical_bay where bay_id = @id    end	     -- If node is an Enclosure    if @id >= 12000001 and @id <= 13000000    begin       -- Get the enclosure node      -- exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)         -- select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type         -- from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id') 		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  					  select [name], enclosure_id as [id], ''enclosure'' as type 					  from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; 	       -- Get the rack_id       select @id = rack_id from physical_enclosure where enclosure_id = @id    end     -- If node is a Rack    if @id >= 11000001 and @id <= 12000000    begin       -- Get the rack node       --exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename +'([name], [id], type)        --  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type        --  from physical_rack where rack_id = @id')  		set @strsql = N'insert into '+ @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)  					  select [name], rack_id as [id], ''rack'' as type 					  from physical_rack where rack_id = @intid'; 			set @ParmDefinition = N'@intid int'; 			execute sp_executesql @strsql, @ParmDefinition, @intid = @id ; 		    end     -- Add Physical Devices node    --insert into @branch_tablename ([name], [id], type)      -- select 'Physical Devices' as [name], -9 as [id], 'physical devices' as type 	exec('insert into ' + @branch_tablename + '([name], [id], type)       select ''Physical Devices'' as [name], -9 as [id], ''physical devices'' as type')     -- Return the completed branch list    if @selectResult = 1       exec('select * from ' + @branch_tablename + 'order by [level] desc')
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@id int, @selectResult int)

create procedure dbo.wc_sel_required_domains  	@jobids    varchar(8000), 	@compids    varchar(8000)  as 	--Query on config_set and Config_item table to fetch all required domains. 	select lower(msnet_domain_name) as domain from config_set  		where  		msnet_domain_name is not null and msnet_domain_name <>'' 		and config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 	union 	select lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_set  		where  		msnet_dns_domain is not null and msnet_dns_domain <>'' 		and config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 	union 	select lower(msnet_dns_domain) as domain from config_item, config_task  		where config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 		and domain_member=1 		and config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id 		and reconfig =1  		and target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) 	union 	select lower(domain_name) as domain from config_item, config_task  		where (msnet_dns_domain is null or msnet_dns_domain='')  		and config_item.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 		and domain_member=1 		and config_task.config_set_id = config_item.config_set_id 		and reconfig =1  		and target_computer_id in(select ID from SplitIDs(@compids)) 	 	--Query to check whether we should check for computer domain information 	-- IF count is > 0  then check for computer domains as well 	select count(*) from config_set, config_task  	where 	config_set.config_set_id in(select config_set_id from config_task where event_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@jobids))) 		and config_task.config_set_id = config_set.config_set_id 		and ((use_existing_data=1 and msnet_is_domain_member is null) or (msnet_is_domain_member=1 and ((msnet_domain_name ='' or msnet_domain_name is null) and ( msnet_dns_domain ='' or msnet_dns_domain is null) )) or (use_existing_data=1 and reconfig=1))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobids varchar, @compids varchar)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_codes    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq    	int as    if object_id('tempdb..##wc_return_code') is not null 		drop table ##wc_return_code  	-- make a temporary table 	create table ##wc_return_code 		(code		varchar(11), 		 handler		int, 		 result 		int, 		 status   varchar(256))  	-- store the default handler 	insert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) 		select 'default' as code, on_fail as handler, on_fail as result, null as status 		from task where event_id=@jobId and   		cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq  	-- get the rest of the handlers 	insert into ##wc_return_code (code, handler, result, status) 		select ret_code as code, handler, result, status from task_return_handlers 		where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and	task_seq=@taskSeq  	select * from ##wc_return_code
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @condSeq int, @taskSeq int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_return_handler_jobs    @jobId int as    -- make a temporary table to store the IDs in    if object_id ('#wc_handler_ids') is null       create table dbo.#wc_handler_ids (job int, primary key (job))    -- store the calling job    insert into #wc_handler_ids values (@jobId)     -- declare needed variables    declare @newJobCount int    declare @handler int    declare @job int    declare @fail int     -- loop through all discovered jobs repeatedly until no new linked jobs are found    set @newJobCount = 1    while @newJobCount > 0    begin       set @newJobCount = 0       -- make a cursor to step through all discovered jobs       declare job_cursor cursor for          select job from #wc_handler_ids       open job_cursor       fetch next from job_cursor into @job       while @@fetch_status = 0       begin          -- loop through the linked jobs          -- make a cursor to step through all linked task_return_handlers jobs          declare handler_cursor cursor for             select distinct(handler) from task_return_handlers where event_id = @job                and handler > 2000000 and handler < 3000001 and handler not in --Bug 27827                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open handler_cursor          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@handler)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from handler_cursor into @handler          end          -- cleanup cursor          close handler_cursor          deallocate handler_cursor           -- make a cursor to step through all linked on_fail jobs          declare fail_cursor cursor for             select distinct(on_fail) from task where event_id = @job                and on_fail > 2000000 and on_fail < 3000001 and event_id not in                   (select job from #wc_handler_ids)          open fail_cursor          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          while @@fetch_status = 0          begin             insert into #wc_handler_ids values(@fail)             set @newJobCount = @newJobCount + 1                          fetch next from fail_cursor into @fail          end          -- cleanup cursor          close fail_cursor          deallocate fail_cursor                  fetch next from job_cursor into @job       end       -- cleanup cursor       close job_cursor       deallocate job_cursor    end     -- return the list of jobs discovered    select job from #wc_handler_ids    drop table #wc_handler_ids
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_schedule1 	@schedule int as 	declare @user int 	select @user = su.[user_id] from securityuser su, event_schedule es  	where es.schedule_id = @schedule and es.[user_id] = su.[user_id]  	if @user is null 	begin 		select s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  			s.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  			s.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  			'gznFiP' as 'user_name', 'gznFiP' as user_full_name, '' as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  			s.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  		from event_schedule s, computer c, event e 		where s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule 	end 	else 	begin 		select s.schedule_id, s.computer_id, c.[name] as computer_name, s.event_id, e.[name] as job_name,  			s.cond_seq, s.next_task_seq, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.recur_value, s.recur_type,  			s.status_code, s.status, s.broker_time, s.defer_mins, s.config_choice_id, s.dep_schedule_id,  			u.[name] as 'user_name', u.fullname as user_full_name, u.domain as domain, s.redeploy_history_id,  			s.initial_deployment, s.calling_event, s.rip_replace_event, s.exit_code, s.exit_module  		from event_schedule s, computer c, event e, securityuser u 		where s.computer_id = c.computer_id and s.event_id = e.event_id and s.schedule_id = @schedule 			and u.[user_id] = s.[user_id] 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@schedule int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_authenticate 	@username 		varchar(64), 	@password		varchar(64), 	@domain			varchar(50) = null, 	@upnname		varchar(128) = null as 	declare @authenticated tinyint 	set @authenticated = 0 	 	declare @matchUser	varchar(64)         declare @matchUPN	varchar(64) 	declare @matchPwd	varchar(64) 	declare @matchNetdom    varchar(64) 	declare @userId	int 	declare @ad_user smallint  	if @domain is not null and len(@domain) > 0 	begin 		declare secuser_cursor cursor for  			select [name], upnname, domain, netbiosdomain, [user_id]  			from securityuser 			where (deleted is null or deleted=0) --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI 						 		open secuser_cursor 	 		fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId 		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			if (@matchUser = @username or @matchUPN = @upnname) and (upper(@domain) = upper(@matchPwd) or upper(@matchNetdom) = upper(@domain)) -- @matchPwd is the domain name 			begin 				set @authenticated = 1 				break 			end 			fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchUPN, @matchPwd, @matchNetdom, @userId 		end	 		close secuser_cursor 		deallocate secuser_cursor 	end 	else 	begin 		declare secuser_cursor cursor for select [name], [password], [user_id], ad_user from securityuser  where deleted is null or deleted=0  --For bug #38370 Dont show deleted user on UI 		open secuser_cursor 	 		fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user 		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			if @matchUser = @username and @matchPwd = @password and @ad_user = 0 			begin 				set @authenticated = 1 				break 			end 			fetch next from secuser_cursor into @matchUser, @matchPwd, @userId, @ad_user 		end	 		close secuser_cursor 		deallocate secuser_cursor 	end 	 	if @authenticated = 1 and len(@domain) > 0 		set @authenticated = 2 	else  		set @matchUser = @username --Bug #39428  	select @authenticated as authenticated, @userId as [user_id], @matchUser as securityuser
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar, @domain varchar, @upnname varchar)

create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_permission 	@userId			int, 	@permission		int, 	@objectId		int, 	@selectResults  int = 0, 	@tableName     varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights'	 as 	declare @isJob smallint 	set @isJob = 0 	declare @userName varchar(64) 	declare @actualUsername varchar(64)--PRD 7.1.66 Security 	declare @userGroup varchar(64)--PRD 7.1.66 Security 	declare @right int 	set @right = 1 	declare @result smallint 	set @result = 0 	declare @fromAdmin smallint 	set @fromAdmin = 0 	declare @permSource int 	set @permSource = 0 	declare @parentSource int 	set @parentSource = 0 	declare @fromGroup int 	set @fromGroup = 0     --make sure there are no old rows    --Bug #63690    --if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is not null    --   delete from ##wc_last_effective_rights 	if object_id('tempdb..'+@tableName+'') is not null 		exec('delete from '+@tableName)  	EXEC wc_sel_security_right @userId,@right,0,@tableName   	set @result = null 	--Bug #63690 	--select @result = granted, @fromAdmin = fromAdmin, @permSource = rightSource from ##wc_last_effective_rights		   	declare @sql    nvarchar(512), 			@params nvarchar(512) 	 	set @sql = 'select @Sqlresult = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource from '+@tableName  	set @params = N'@Sqlresult smallint OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlfromAdmin smallint OUTPUT, ' + 				  N'@SqlpermSource int OUTPUT' 				 	exec sp_executesql @sql,@params,@Sqlresult=@result output, @SqlfromAdmin = @fromAdmin output, @SqlpermSource=@permSource output  	declare @bayCheck smallint 	set @bayCheck = 0  TRAVERSEBRANCH: 	declare @objectName varchar(64) 	if @result = 0 	begin 		-- computer or group object 		if (@objectId >= 5000001 and @objectId <= 8000000) or  			(@objectId = -7 or @objectId = -1 or (@objectId >= 1 and @objectId <= 1000000)) 			exec wc_sel_computer_branch @objectId, 0 		-- job or folder 		else if (@objectId >= 2000001 and @objectId <= 3000000) or 		   (@objectId >= 1000001 and @objectId <= 2000000) or 		   @objectId = -10 		begin 			exec wc_sel_job_branch @objectId, 0 			set @isJob = 1 		end 		-- rack/enclosure/bay 		else 		   exec wc_sel_reb_branch @objectId, 0 	 		declare @level int 		set @level = 1 		  		declare @branch_tablename  varchar (128) 		set @branch_tablename  = '##wc_branch' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15)) 		DECLARE @dynamicSQL nvarchar(200)         -- Have code that will construct the dynamic SQL 		set @dynamicSQL = 'select [id], [name], [level] from ' + @branch_tablename + ' order by [level]'  		declare @branch_cursor cursor --for select [id], [name], [level] from ##wc_branch order by [level] 		set @dynamicSQL = 'SET @branch_cursor = cursor for ' + @dynamicSQL + '; OPEN @branch_cursor'  		exec sp_executesql                  -- sp_executesql will essentially create a sproc               @dynamicSQL,                 -- The SQL statement to execute (body of sproc)               N'@branch_cursor CURSOR OUTPUT', -- The parameter list for the sproc: OUTPUT CURSOR               @branch_cursor OUTPUT         -- The parameter to pass to the sproc: the CURSOR  		--open branch_cursor 		fetch next from @branch_cursor into @objectId, @objectName, @level 		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin 			if @objectId = -1 and @isJob = 1 				set @objectId = -10             set @result = null  			--Check whether user has deny permission. 			if (@permission = -1) 			begin 				select top 1 @result = allow from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @userId  					and allow = 0 and [object_id] = @objectId					 			end	 			 			if @result is null 			begin 			-- @permission = -1 means that we are looking for any allow permission 			if (@permission = -1) 			begin 				select top 1 @result = allow from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @userId  					and allow = 1 and [object_id] = @objectId 			end 			else 			begin 			select @result = allow from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @userId  				and permission_id = @permission and [object_id] = @objectId 			end 			end 			-- PRD 7.1.66 Security 			set @userGroup = @objectName --PRD 7.1.66 Security 			declare @actualResult int --To handle the situation when object inhertes from more than one object Bug #34636 			set @actualResult = -1  	 			if @result is not null             begin 		               set @userName = @objectName 		               set @actualUsername = @userName --Bug #34636                set @permSource = @userId                if @level > 1                   set @parentSource = @objectId             end             else 			begin 				declare @group int 				declare group_cursor cursor for select sg.group_id, sg.[name]  					from securitygroup sg, securitygroupmember sgm 					where sg.group_id = sgm.group_id and sgm.[user_id] = @userId 				open group_cursor 				fetch next from group_cursor into @group, @userName 				while @@fetch_status = 0 				begin 					set @result = null  					--Check whether user has deny permission. 					if (@permission = -1) 					begin 						select top 1 @result = allow from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @group  								and allow = 0 and [object_id] = @objectId					 					end	 					if @result is null 					begin 					-- @permission = -1 means that we are looking for any allow permission 					if (@permission = -1) 					begin 						select top 1 @result = allow from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @group  							and allow = 1 and [object_id] = @objectId 					end 					else 					begin 					select @result = allow from securitypermissionlink where [user_id] = @group  						and permission_id = @permission and [object_id] = @objectId 					end 					end  					if @result is not null 					begin                         set @permSource = @group 						set @userId = @group 						if @level > 1 							set @parentSource = @objectId 						set @fromGroup = 1 						if @result = 0 						begin --Bug #34636 							set @actualResult=0 							set @actualUsername = @userName 							break 					end 					else 					begin 						 	set @actualResult = 1		 							set @actualUsername = @userName 					end 					end 					 					fetch next from group_cursor into @group, @userName 				end 				close group_cursor 				deallocate group_cursor 			end 		if @actualResult != -1 --Bug #34636 			set @result=@actualResult  			if @result is not null 				break 			fetch next from @branch_cursor into @objectId, @objectName, @level 		end 		close @branch_cursor 		deallocate @branch_cursor 	end  	-- check for Rack/Enclosure/Bay tree (if riloe board without permission) 	declare @bayId int 	select @bayId = bay_id from physical_bay where computer_id = @objectId         if @result = 0 and @bayId is not null and @bayCheck = 0 	begin 		set @bayCheck = 1 		goto TRAVERSEBRANCH 	end  	-- granted, permission, object, user 	declare @permissionType varchar(50) 	select @permissionType = [name] from securitypermission where permission_id = @permission 	 	declare @permissions_tablename  varchar (128) 		set @permissions_tablename  = '##wc_last_effective_permissions' + cast(@@SPID as varchar(15))          --add the return values to a temp table     if object_id('tempdb..' + @permissions_tablename) is not null      begin   		 -- 		 set @sql = N'insert into ' + @permissions_tablename + ' values ( @perm, @res, @permType, @fromAdm, @permSrc, @actualUname, @usrGrp, @parentSrc, @fromGrp )' 		 --@Sqlresult = granted, @SqlfromAdmin = fromAdmin, @SqlpermSource = rightSource from '+@tableName 		  		 	set @params = N'@perm int, ' + 				  N'@res smallint, ' + 				  N'@permType varchar(50),' + 				 N'@fromAdm smallint , ' + 				  N'@permSrc int, '+ 				 N'@actualUname varchar(64), ' + 				  N'@usrGrp varchar(64), ' + 				  N'@parentSrc int, ' + 				  N'@fromGrp int'  				 	execute sp_executesql @sql,@params, @perm = @permission, @res = @result, @permType = @permissionType, @fromAdm = @fromAdmin, @permSrc = @permSource, @actualUname = @actualUsername, @usrGrp = @userGroup, @parentSrc = @parentSource, @fromGrp = @fromGroup  	end 		 --       -- insert into ##wc_last_effective_permissions values (@permission, @result, @permissionType, @fromAdmin, @permSource, @actualUsername, @userGroup, @parentSource, @fromGroup)     if @selectResults = 1       select @result as granted, @permissionType as permission, @objectName as object, @actualUsername as [user], @fromAdmin as fromAdmin, @permSource as permSource, @parentSource as parentSource, @fromGroup as fromGroup 	--Bug #63690    if object_id('tempdb..'+@tableName+'') is not null    exec('drop table '+@tableName)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_security_right 	@userId		int, 	@right			int, 	@selectResults  int = 0, 	@tableName varchar(128) = '##wc_last_effective_rights' as 	declare @result int 	set @result = 0 	declare @fromAdmin smallint 	set @fromAdmin = 0 	declare @rightSource int 	set @rightSource = 0 	declare @fromGroup int 	set @fromGroup = 0 	-- PRD 7.1.66 Security           select @result =count (user_id) from securityprivilegelink where privilege_id = 1 and ( @userId in (select user_id from securityuser) or @userId in (select group_id from securitygroup))    	 and ([user_id] = @userId  or (user_id in (select group_id from securitygroupmember where user_id = @userId and group_id in (select group_id from securitygroup))))  	--if user is directly an admin 	if @result != 0 	begin 	   set @fromAdmin = 1 	   set @rightSource = @userId 	end 	else 	begin       ---- PRD 7.1.66 Security       select @result =count (user_id) from securityprivilegelink where privilege_id = @right and ( @userId in (select user_id from securityuser) or @userId in (select group_id from securitygroup))  	and ([user_id] = @userId  or (user_id in (select group_id from securitygroupmember where user_id = @userId and group_id in (select group_id from securitygroup)))) 	 	   -- user has right directly 	   if @result != 0 	   begin 	      set @rightSource = @userId 	   end 	end  	if @result = 0 	begin 		declare @group int 		declare group_cursor cursor for select sg.group_id from securitygroup sg, securitygroupmember sgm 			where sg.group_id = sgm.group_id and sgm.[user_id] = @userId 		open group_cursor 		fetch next from group_cursor into @group 		while @@fetch_status = 0 		begin           	-- PRD 7.1.66 Security 		select @result = count (user_id) from securityprivilegelink where privilege_id = 1 and ( @userId in (select user_id from securityuser) or @userId in (select group_id from securitygroup)) 			and ([user_id] = @userId  or (user_id in (select group_id from securitygroupmember where user_id = @userId and group_id in (select group_id from securitygroup)))) 			if @result > 0 			begin                set @fromAdmin = 1                set @fromGroup = 1 			   set @rightSource = @group 			   break 			end  		             -- PRD 7.1.66 Security 			select @result =count (user_id) from securityprivilegelink where privilege_id = @right and ( @userId in (select user_id from securityuser) or @userId in (select group_id from securitygroup)) 				and ([user_id] = @userId  or (user_id in (select group_id from securitygroupmember where user_id = @userId and group_id in (select group_id from securitygroup)))) 			if @result > 0 			begin 			   set @rightSource = @group                set @fromGroup = 1 			   break 			end  			fetch next from group_cursor into @group 		end 		close group_cursor 		deallocate group_cursor 	end 	 	declare @rightType varchar(50) 	select @rightType = [name] from securityprivilege where privilege_id = @right 	-- Bug #63690 	--if object_id('tempdb..##wc_last_effective_rights') is null        --create table dbo.##wc_last_effective_rights ([right] int, granted int, [rightName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int, fromGroup int) 	if object_id('tempdb..'+@tableName+'') is null 		exec('create table dbo.'+ @tableName  +'([right] int, granted int, [rightName] varchar(50), fromAdmin smallint, rightSource int, fromGroup int)') 	else 		exec ('delete from dbo.'+@tableName) 		 	-- Bug #63690     --insert into ##wc_last_effective_rights values (@right, @result, @rightType, @fromAdmin, @rightSource, @fromGroup)       declare @sql varchar(128)       set @sql ='insert into '+ @tableName +' values ('+cast(@right as varchar(10))+','+cast(@result as varchar(10))+','''+@rightType+''','+cast(@fromAdmin as varchar(10))+','+cast(@rightSource as varchar(10))+','+cast(@fromGroup as varchar(10))+')'		  	       exec (@sql)  	-- Bug #63690 	--if @selectResults = 1 		--select * from ##wc_last_effective_rights  	if @selectResults = 1 		exec ('select * from '+@tableName)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_sel_tasktype 	@folder_id as int as /* 	select all child folder of current folder  temp table. 	For each this folder find child folder and store this in temp table. 	repeat this step for all rows in temp table	 */  declare @tbl_folder table (	folder_id int	 )   insert into @tbl_folder select folder_id from event_folder where folder_id=@folder_id   declare cursor_folder cursor for 	select folder_id 	from @tbl_folder  open cursor_folder  fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id while @@fetch_status = 0 begin 	insert into @tbl_folder 	select folder_id 	from event_folder 	where parent_id=@folder_id	  	fetch next from cursor_folder into @folder_id end  close cursor_folder deallocate cursor_folder  select count(t.folder_id),count(e.event_id) from @tbl_folder t,event e where e.folder_id = t.folder_id select distinct task_type from task where task_type not in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder)) select event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type from task where task_type in (13,15,11) and  event_id in( select event_id from event where folder_id in (select folder_id from  @tbl_folder))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@folder_id int)

Object_Definition: -- For PRD item 7.1.14 Centrally Managed Task Password create procedure wc_sel_taskusers_count @username varchar(128), @password varchar(128) as  declare @totalRecordCount  int declare @taskRecordCount  int  set @totalRecordCount = 0 set @taskRecordCount = 0  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from script_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount  select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from copyfile_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from install_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select    @taskRecordCount=count(*) from capture_pct_task where     (password = @password  and username = @username)  set @totalRecordCount = @totalRecordCount  + @taskRecordCount   select @totalRecordCount
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@username varchar, @password varchar)

Object_Definition: -- #32375 - Select all CE.Net unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_cedotnet as  	-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on CE.Net computers 	select distinct event_id 	from task  	where task_type=13 or task_type=18	 --Bug #41448 - Imaging job are allowed on CE.Net computers.

-- #32375 - Select all handheld unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_handheld as 	if object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_handleld') is not null 		drop table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld  	-- make a temporary table 	create table ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld 		(event_id	int)  	insert into ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld 		-- Registory task (13), Image task (15) and Capture PCT task (18) not allowed on pocket pc 		select distinct event_id 		from task  		where task_type=13 or task_type=15 or task_type=18  		union 		-- For pocket pc execution location of script is allowed only on DS Side  		select distinct event_id  		from script_task  		where (location != 1)   		union 		-- Only reboot is allowed on pocket pc (logoff, shutdown etc not allowed) 		select distinct event_id 		from reboot_task  		where (reboot_method != 1) 			 	select event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_handleld

-- #32375 - Select all linux unsafe jobs from database create procedure dbo.wc_sel_unsafe_jobs_for_linux  as  	if object_id('tempdb..##wc_unsafe_job_linux') is not null 		drop table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux  	-- make a temporary table 	create table ##wc_unsafe_job_linux 		(event_id	int)  	insert into ##wc_unsafe_job_linux 		-- Registory task (13) and Capture PCT task (18) are not allowed on linux 		select distinct event_id 		from task  		where task_type=13 or task_type=18 		 		union 		-- Only Reboot, Shutdown, WakeUp is allowed on linux for reboot task 		select distinct event_id 		from reboot_task  		where (reboot_method = 8)  			 	select event_id from ##wc_unsafe_job_linux

Object_Definition: --For bug #37092 - Update AD User-Group membership in table create procedure wc_upd_ad_user_membership    @aduser varchar(50),     @adgroup varchar(50),     @userdomain varchar(1024),     @groupdomain varchar(1024) as 	declare @group_id int       	if @adgroup is not null and @groupdomain is not null 		select @group_id=group_id from securitygroup where upper([name]) = upper(@adgroup) and ad_group = 1 and (upper(ad_group_domain) = upper(@groupdomain) or upper(ad_group_netbiosdomain) = upper(@groupdomain))  	-- If group exist in database 	if @group_id is not null 	begin  		declare @userId int  		select @userId = [user_id]  		from securityuser  		where [name] = @aduser and ( upper(domain) = upper(@userdomain) or upper(netbiosdomain) = upper(@userdomain) ) and ad_user<>0  		declare @member int  		select @member = count([user_id])  		from securitygroupmember  		where [user_id] = @userId and group_id = @group_id 		 		if @userId is not null and @member = 0 			insert into securitygroupmember ([user_id], group_id) values (@userId, @group_id)  	end

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_computer_configuration    @job int,    @condition int,    @task int,    @computer int,    @computer_name varchar(64),    @ip_hostname varchar(128),    @lic_os_user varchar(64),    @lic_os_org varchar(64),    @lic_os_key varchar(64),    @domain_member smallint,    @domain_name varchar(256),    @nw_pref_server varchar(48),    @nw_pref_tree varchar(64),    @nw_nds_context varchar(128),    @nw_username varchar(128),    @nw_login_to_tree smallint,    @nw_run_scripts smallint,    @ua_username varchar(128),    @ua_full_name varchar(256),    @ua_groups varchar(256),    @ua_password varchar(128),    @ua_must_change smallint,    @ua_cannot_change smallint,    @ua_pw_never_expires smallint,    @msnet_domain_username varchar(256),    @msnet_domain_password varchar(256),    @msnet_dns_domain varchar(512), -- Bug #41687    @reboot_after_config smallint -- PRD item 7.1.60 Reboot option as    declare @config_set_id int    select @config_set_id = config_set_id from config_task        where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and task_seq = @task    declare @config_item_id int    select @config_item_id = config_item_id from config_item where config_set_id = @config_set_id       and target_computer_id = @computer        --Microsoft issue: Changes done to handle OU field    declare @msnet_domain_ou varchar(256)    set 	@msnet_domain_ou = null	    if( 	@domain_member <> 0 )    begin	 	if ( CHARINDEX('.',@domain_name) > 0) 	begin 		set @msnet_dns_domain = @domain_name 		set @domain_name = null		 	end      	declare @ouSplit  int	    	set @ouSplit=CHARINDEX('/',@msnet_dns_domain) 	if(@ouSplit>0) 	begin 		set @msnet_domain_ou = SUBSTRING(@msnet_dns_domain, (@ouSplit+1) ,LEN(@msnet_dns_domain)) 		set @msnet_dns_domain = SUBSTRING(@msnet_dns_domain,0,@ouSplit) 	end   	set @ouSplit = CHARINDEX('/', @domain_name) 	if(@ouSplit>0) 	begin 		set @msnet_domain_ou = SUBSTRING( @domain_name , (@ouSplit+1) , LEN( @domain_name )) 		set @domain_name = SUBSTRING( @domain_name , 0, @ouSplit) 	end	    end     update config_item set lic_os_user = @lic_os_user, lic_os_org = @lic_os_org, lic_os_key = @lic_os_key,       domain_member = @domain_member, domain_name = @domain_name, computer_name = @computer_name,       nw_pref_server = @nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree = @nw_pref_tree, msnet_dns_domain = @msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou = @msnet_domain_ou,        nw_nds_context = @nw_nds_context, nw_user_name = @nw_username, nw_login_to_tree = @nw_login_to_tree,        nw_run_scripts = @nw_run_scripts, ua_username = @ua_username,        ua_fullname = @ua_full_name, ua_groups = @ua_groups, ua_password = @ua_password,       ua_must_change = @ua_must_change, ua_cannot_change = @ua_cannot_change,        ua_pw_never_expires = @ua_pw_never_expires, msnet_domain_username = @msnet_domain_username,        msnet_domain_password = @msnet_domain_password, ip_hostname = @ip_hostname, reboot_after_config = @reboot_after_config       where config_item_id = @config_item_id

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item    @job             int,    @condition       int,    @item			int,    @field			int,    @operation	    int,    @value			varchar(256) = null,    @drive			varchar(8)   = null,    @conjunct	    smallint     = -1,    @token			varchar(256) = null as    begin transaction        update condition_item set field_type = @field, oper_type = @operation, key_value = @value,           drive = @drive, conjunct = @conjunct, token = @token          where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item    if (@@error != 0)       rollback transaction    else       commit transaction

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_item_order    @job			int,    @condition		int,    @item1		int,    @item2		int as    -- get a temporary condition item id    declare @tempItemId   int    select @tempItemId = max(item_seq) from condition_item where event_id = @job and cond_seq = @condition    set @tempItemId = @tempItemId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary item id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @tempItemId where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @item1 where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @item2 	 	   -- replace the temporary item id with the swap id 	   update condition_item set item_seq = @item2 where event_id = @job  	      and cond_seq = @condition and item_seq = @tempItemId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@job int, @condition int, @item1 int, @item2 int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_condition_order    @jobId			int,    @conditionId1	int,    @conditionId2	int as    -- get a temporary condition id    declare @tempCondId   int    select @tempCondId = max(cond_seq) from event_condition where event_id=@jobId    set @tempCondId = @tempCondId + 1     begin transaction 	   -- set the original item id to the temporary condition id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@conditionId1 	   update task set cond_seq=@tempCondId where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId1 	 	   -- set the swap item id to the original id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@conditionId2 	   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId1 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@conditionId2 	 	   -- replace the temporary condition id with the swap id        update event_condition set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId 		  and cond_seq=@tempCondId 	   update task set cond_seq=@conditionId2 where event_id=@jobId  	      and cond_seq=@tempCondId    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select @@error as error    end    else       commit transaction
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @conditionId1 int, @conditionId2 int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_data    @jobId       int,    @computerId  int as    declare @setId int, @itemId int    declare @reconfig smallint, @useExisting smallint        declare @addedItem bit    set @addedItem = 0     declare config_task_cursor cursor for    select ct.config_set_id, ct.reconfig, ci.config_item_id, cs.use_existing_data       from config_task ct       left outer join config_item ci on ci.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       and ci.target_computer_id = @computerId       left outer join config_set cs on cs.config_set_id = ct.config_set_id       where ct.event_id = @jobId     open config_task_cursor     fetch next from config_task_cursor       into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting     while @@fetch_status = 0    begin       -- if the config_item_id was null, we need to insert a new one       if @itemId is null       begin          exec @itemId = sel_next_system_id 'CONFIG_ITEM_ID', 'T'          exec ins_config_item @itemId, @setId, @computerId          set @addedItem = 1        end        -- determine how to update the config_item record       declare @hiddenConfig bit       -- Bug #57349 - Check for NULL is applied for post configuration task.       if (@reconfig is null or @reconfig <> 1) and @useExisting = 1          set @hiddenConfig = 1       else          set @hiddenConfig = 0        declare @fromComputer bit       if @addedItem = 1 or @hiddenConfig = 1          set @fromComputer = 1       else          set @fromComputer = 0        declare @fromSet bit       if @addedItem = 1 and @hiddenConfig = 0          set @fromSet = 1       else          set @fromSet = 0        -- update the config_item record       if @fromComputer = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_comp @itemId, @computerId       if @fromSet = 1          exec wc_upd_config_item_from_set @itemId, @setId                 --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView             exec wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials @itemId              fetch next from config_task_cursor into @setId, @reconfig, @itemId, @useExisting    end        close config_task_cursor    deallocate config_task_cursor    return   @itemId --27730
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@jobId int, @computerId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure wc_upd_config_item_data    @ConfigItemId varchar (8000),    @Domain varchar (512),    @Username varchar (256),    @Password varchar (256) as 	update config_item  	set  msnet_domain_username = @Username, msnet_domain_password = @Password  	where Lower(domain_name)= Lower(@Domain) or Lower(msnet_dns_domain) = Lower(@Domain) 	and config_item_id in (select ID from SplitIDs(@ConfigItemId))
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@ConfigItemId varchar, @Domain varchar, @Username varchar, @Password varchar)

Object_Definition: --#34038 - Virtual Machines are not being added to the domain when they are created through the DSweb or DView create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_domain_credentials  	@itemId int as  	declare @domain_name as varchar(512) 	declare @username as varchar(256), @msnet_domain_username as varchar(256), @password as varchar(256)	  	-- select domain name: Priority -> msnet_dns_domain, domain_name 	select    		@msnet_domain_username=msnet_domain_username, 		@domain_name=case (isnull(msnet_dns_domain,''))		 		when '' then domain_name 		else msnet_dns_domain 		end -- case 	from config_item  	where config_item_id=@itemId  	-- If there is no user given in config task then only fetch from domain_accounts table and update it 	if @msnet_domain_username is null or @msnet_domain_username='' --bug 37607 	begin 		select @username=username, @password=[password]  		from domain_accounts  		where domain=@domain_name		 	 		update config_item  		set  		msnet_domain_username=@username, 		msnet_domain_password=@password 		where config_item_id=@itemId 	end
Metadata: PARAMETERS: (@itemId int)

Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_config_item_from_comp    @itemId      int,    @computerId  int as    -- prepare config variables for the update    declare @licOsUser varchar(64), @licOsOrg varchar(64), @licOsKey varchar(64),        @ipHostname varchar(128), @computerName varchar(16), @domainName varchar(512),       @nwPrefServer varchar(48), @nwPrefTree varchar(64), @nwNdsContext varchar(128),       @nwUserName varchar(128), @msnetDnsDomain varchar(256), @msnetDomainOu varchar(256)    declare @domainMember smallint, @nwLoginToTree smallint, @nwRunScripts smallint     -- fill the variables with computer record data    declare computer_cursor cursor for       select lic_os_user, lic_os_org, lic_os_key, ip_hostname, computer_name, domain_member,          domain_name, nw_pref_server, nw_pref_tree, nw_nds_context, nw_user_name, nw_login_to_tree,          nw_run_scripts, msnet_dns_domain, msnet_domain_ou       from computer where computer_id = @computerId    open computer_cursor    fetch next from computer_cursor       into @licOsUser, @licOsOrg, @licOsKey, @ipHostname, @computerName, @domainMember, @domainName,       @nwPrefServer, @nwPrefTree, @nwNdsContext, @nwUserName, @nwLoginToTree, @nwRunScripts,       @msnetDnsDomain, @msnetDomainOu     -- update the config_item table with the variable data    if @@fetch_status = 0    begin       update config_item set lic_os_user=@licOsUser, lic_os_org=@licOsOrg, lic_os_key=@licOsKey,          ip_hostname=@ipHostname, computer_name=@computerName, domain_member=@domainMember,          domain_name=@domainName, nw_pref_server=@nwPrefServer, nw_pref_tree=@nwPrefTree,          nw_nds_context=@nwNdsContext, nw_user_name=@nwUserName, nw_login_to_tree=@nwLoginToTree,          nw_run_scripts=@nwRunScripts, msnet_dns_domain=@msnetDnsDomain, msnet_domain_ou=@msnetDomainOu,          target_computer_id=@computerId       where config_item_id=@itemId    end     -- cleanup cursor    close computer_cursor    deallocate computer_cursor     -- prepare nic config variables for the update    -- Changes for PRD item 7.1.52 Static Routing & PRD item 7.1.53 DNS Suffix    declare @useDhcp smallint, @netBIOS smallint    declare @deviceId int, @pciBus int, @pciDevice int, @pciFunction int, @vendorId int, @nicId int    declare @ipDns varchar(512), @ipWins varchar(512), @description varchar(64), @ipDomain varchar(128)    declare @dnsDHCP smallint, @winsDHCP smallint -- DNS/Wins DHCP for MSN    -- loop through each of the computer's nic records    declare nic_cursor cursor for       select ip_use_dhcp, nic_device_id, nic_pci_bus, nic_pci_device, nic_pci_function, nic_vendor_id,           ip_dns, ip_wins, nic_desc, ip_domain, nic_id, netbios, dns_use_dhcp, Object_Definition: create procedure dbo.wc_upd_deploy_image_task    @jobId       int,    @condSeq     int,    @taskSeq		int,    @filename	varchar(254),    @localStore	smallint,    @commandLine	varchar(512),    @removeBW	smallint,    @removeOEM	smallint,    @srcId		int,    @postConfig  smallint,    @prepareSysprep smallint, -- PRD item 7.1.68 & 7.1.21    @answerfilepath   varchar(261), -- PRD item 7.1.68 & 7.1.21   @standardAnswerFile smallint, -- PRD item 7.1.68 & 7.1.21   @bootoption_id int = null,    --PRD item 7.1.1 PXE pre boot option   @run_rdeployt int = 0, --PRD item 7.1.104 Run RDeploy mode   @bootimage_arch int = 0,   @mass_storage_filepath varchar(261), --Sysprep mass storage file path.   @isDeployAnywhere int = 0 ,   @ghostCastcommandLine varchar(512) = NULL as    begin transaction     update image_task set image_file=@filename, local_store=@localStore,        addl_cmdline=@commandLine, remove_bw=@removeBW, remove_cpq=@removeOEM,       src_comp_id=@srcId, sysprepped = @prepareSysprep, answerfilepath = @answerfilepath, standard_answerfile = @standardAnswerFile, imaging_tool_id = @run_rdeployt,       mass_storage_filepath = @mass_storage_filepath, deploy_any_where = @isDeployAnywhere,ghcastsrv_cmdline = @ghostCastcommandLine    where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq         update task set bootoption_id = @bootoption_id, boot_image_cpu_arch = @bootimage_arch where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    if ( @prepareSysprep = 0 )     delete  from sysprep_answers where event_id=@jobId and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@taskSeq    -- check for existing configure task    declare @reconfig smallint    declare @configCount int    declare @configTask int    select @configTask = min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @jobId        and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq > @taskSeq    select @reconfig = reconfig from config_task where event_id=@jobId      and cond_seq=@condSeq and task_seq=@configTask    set @configCount = @@rowcount     -- alter task IDs to make room for hidden config    declare @nextTask int    select @nextTask = min(task_seq) from task where event_id = @jobId       and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq > @taskSeq    if @postConfig = 1 and @reconfig = 1 and @nextTask = @taskSeq + 1    begin       update task set task_seq = task_seq + 1 where event_id = @jobId           and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq > @taskSeq    end    -- add hidden config task    declare @configSetId   int    if @postConfig = 1 and (@configCount = 0 or @reconfig = 1)    begin              -- add new config set       set @taskSeq = @taskSeq + 1       select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_set where config_set_id =           (select max(config_set_id) from config_set)       if @configSetId is null          set @configSetId = 3000001       else          set @configSetId = @configSetId + 1       insert into task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, task_type)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, 14)       insert into config_set          (config_set_id, use_existing_data) values (@configSetId, 1)       insert into config_task          (event_id, cond_seq, task_seq, config_set_id, reconfig)       values          (@jobId, @condSeq, @taskSeq, @configSetId, null)    end    -- remove hidden config if not doing post configure    else if @postConfig = 0 and @configCount = 1 and (@reconfig is null or @reconfig = 0)    begin       select @configSetId = config_set_id from config_task where event_id = @jobId           and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq = @configTask       delete from task where event_id = @jobId and cond_seq = @condSeq and task_seq = @configTask       delete from config_set where config_set_id = @configSetId    end     -- commit it    if (@@error != 0)    begin       rollback transaction       select -1 as taskSeq    end    else       commit transaction    -- return the task sequence value    select @taskSeq as taskSeq
